items.title: Grammar 1–3 · My Dream

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Explain or clarify something already stated using 可以說是.
grammarPages.explanation: 用來進一步說明前面的說話內容。「可以說是」和「可說是」的意思一樣。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 可以說是 / 可說是 + Noun / Description

patternRows.english: You could say I am your fan.
You could say he is an adult now.
You could call this my second home.

text.traditional: 你演的戲，我都看了，我可以說是你的戲迷喔，快幫我簽個名吧！
text.simplified: 你演的戏，我都看了，我可以说是你的戏迷喔，快帮我签个名吧！
text.pinyin: Nǐ yǎn de xì, wǒ dōu kàn le, wǒ kěyǐ shuō shì nǐ de xìmí o, kuài bāng wǒ qiān ge míng ba!
text.english: I've watched all your dramas; you could say I'm your fan—please sign an autograph for me!

text.traditional: 他下個月就滿十八歲了，可以說是一個大人了。
text.simplified: 他下个月就满十八岁了，可以说是一个大人了。
text.pinyin: Tā xià ge yuè jiù mǎn shíbā suì le, kěyǐ shuō shì yíge dàrén le.
text.english: He turns eighteen next month; you could say he's an adult.

text.traditional: 我在高雄住了十年了，這裡可說是我第二個家。
text.simplified: 我在高雄住了十年了，这里可说是我第二个家。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài Gāoxióng zhù le shí nián le, zhèlǐ kě shuō shì wǒ dì'èr ge jiā.
text.english: I've lived in Kaohsiung for ten years; you could call it my second home.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 可以說是 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This phrase is used to further explain or clarify something already stated. 可以說是 and 可說是 have the same meaning.
summary: 可以說是 means you could say it is. It explains or sums up what was just said, and 可說是 means the same.
It does not mean being able to speak. For that, use 可以說 without 是.
For plain facts like who someone is, use ordinary 是.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Exclaim that something is more … than you expected, using 多（麼）… 啊.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示感嘆的意思，說明事情比本來想的程度高。表達時帶有誇張的語氣，「麼」可以省略，結尾以「啊」結束。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 多（麼）+ Adjective + 啊

patternRows.english: What a pity not to become an actor!
How cute that dog is!
I'm so comfortable!

text.traditional: 你長得這麼好看，身高也夠高……不當演員多麼可惜啊！
text.simplified: 你长得这么好看，身高也够高……不当演员多么可惜啊！
text.pinyin: Nǐ zhǎngde zhème hǎokàn, shēngāo yě gòu gāo… bù dāng yǎnyuán duóme kěxí a!
text.english: You are so good-looking and tall enough…what a pity it would be not to become an actor!

text.traditional: 那隻狗的眼睛大大的，耳朵長長的，多可愛啊！
text.simplified: 那只狗的眼睛大大的，耳朵长长的，多可爱啊！
text.pinyin: Nà zhī gǒu de yǎnjīng dà dà de, ěrduo cháng cháng de, duō kě'ài a!
text.english: That dog's eyes are big and its ears are long; how cute!

text.traditional: 外面熱死了，我在家邊看電視邊吃芒果冰，多舒服啊！
text.simplified: 外面热死了，我在家边看电视边吃芒果冰，多舒服啊！
text.pinyin: Wàimiàn rè sǐ le, wǒ zài jiā biān kàn diànshì biān chī mángguǒ bīng, duō shūfu a!
text.english: It's terribly hot outside; how comfortable it is to watch TV and eat mango ice at home!

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 多麼…啊 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This construction indicates a feeling when one encounters something exceeding one's expectations. Expressed in an exaggerated tone of voice, the 麼 can be dropped, and an 啊 added to the end of the sentence, usually following an adjective.
summary: 多麼 ... 啊 shows strong feeling that something is more than expected, in an exaggerated tone.
麼 can be left out, and 啊 goes at the end of the sentence.
多麼 goes before an adjective, not directly before a noun.
It can't ask about price or amount. Use 多少 for that.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add an additional reason or explanation using 再說.
grammarPages.explanation: 「再說」當連詞。「再說」後面的句子是對前面句子所說的內容，補充、說明或提供進一步的解釋。
grammarPages.pattern: Clause 1 + 再說 + Clause 2

patternRows.english: You look good; besides, audiences approve of your performance.
I have to hand in two reports; besides, finals are coming up.
You make many friends; besides, you understand yourself better.

text.traditional: 你長得這麼好看……不當演員多麼可惜啊！再說，觀眾也都很肯定你的表現。
text.simplified: 你长得这么好看……不当演员多么可惜啊！再说，观众也都很肯定你的表现。
text.pinyin: Nǐ zhǎngde zhème hǎokàn… bù dāng yǎnyuán duóme kěxí a! Zàishuō, guānzhòng yě dōu hěn kěndìng nǐ de biǎoxiàn.
text.english: You are so good-looking…what a pity not to become an actor! Besides, the audience really approves of your performance.

text.traditional: 最近得交兩個報告，再說，快期末考了，下星期的旅遊我不去了。
text.simplified: 最近得交两个报告，再说，快期末考了，下星期的旅游我不去了。
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn děi jiāo liǎng ge bàogào, zàishuō, kuài qímòkǎo le, xià xīngqí de lǚyóu wǒ bú qù le.
text.english: I have to hand in two reports soon; besides, finals are coming up. I'm not going on next week's trip.

text.traditional: 參加社團活動能交到不少朋友，再說，還能讓我們更了解自己，你為什麼不參加呢？
text.simplified: 参加社团活动能交到不少朋友，再说，还能让我们更了解自己，你为什么不参加呢？
text.pinyin: Cānjiā shètuán huódòng néng jiāo dào bùshǎo péngyǒu, zàishuō, hái néng ràng wǒmen gèng liǎojiě zìjǐ, nǐ wèishénme bù cānjiā ne?
text.english: Joining club activities lets us make quite a few friends; besides, it helps us understand ourselves better. Why don't you join?

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 再說 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 再說 is used as a conjunction. The sentence following 再說 reinforces the content of the preceding sentence, or explains that content in greater detail.
summary: 再說 adds one more reason or a fuller explanation to what was just said.
Put 再說 at the start of the added sentence, never at the very end.
To ask someone to say it again, use 請再說一次, not 再說 alone.

dialogue.title: 對話 · Dialogue
dialogue.setting: 在咖啡店 · At the coffee shop

text.traditional: 東賢，沒想到才兩年沒見，你已經是個大明星了。你演的戲，我都看了，我可以說是你的戲迷喔，快幫我簽個名吧！
text.simplified: 东贤，没想到才两年没见，你已经是个大明星了。你演的戏，我都看了，我可以说是你的戏迷喔，快帮我签个名吧！
text.pinyin: Dōngxián, méixiǎngdào cái liǎng nián méi jiàn, nǐ yǐjīng shì ge dà míngxīng le. Nǐ yǎn de xì, wǒ dōu kàn le, wǒ kěyǐ shuō shì nǐ de xìmí o, kuài bāng wǒ qiān ge míng ba!
text.english: Dongxian, I never thought that just two years after we last saw each other, you'd already be a big star! I've watched all the dramas you acted in; you could say I am a fan of yours! Quickly sign an autograph for me!

text.traditional: 別這麼說，我還要繼續努力。
text.simplified: 别这么说，我还要继续努力。
text.pinyin: Bié zhème shuō, wǒ háiyào jìxù nǔlì.
text.english: Don't say that; I still need to keep working hard.

text.traditional: 我覺得你已經很努力了。而且，你的中文進步得這麼快，是怎麼做到的？
text.simplified: 我觉得你已经很努力了。而且，你的中文进步得这么快，是怎么做到的？
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde nǐ yǐjīng hěn nǔlì le. Érqiě, nǐ de Zhōngwén jìnbù de zhème kuài, shì zěnme zuò dào de?
text.english: I think you are already very hardworking. And your Chinese improved so fast, how did you manage that?

text.traditional: 我把劇本裡要說的部分，都請老師錄了音，一有空就不斷地聽，不斷地練習。這樣子才學得好、學得快。
text.simplified: 我把剧本里要说的部分，都请老师录了音，一有空就不断地听，不断地练习。这样子才学得好、学得快。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ jùběn lǐ yào shuō de bùfèn, dōu qǐng lǎoshī lù le yīn, yì yǒukòng jiù búduàn de tīng, búduàn de liànxí. Zhèyàngzi cái xué de hǎo, xué de kuài.
text.english: I had the teacher record all the lines I needed to speak in the script, and whenever I had free time I listened and practiced continuously. That way I could learn well and fast.

text.traditional: 這真是個好辦法，難怪你進步得這麼快。對了，你對未來有什麼計畫？
text.simplified: 这真是个好办法，难怪你进步得这么快。对了，你对未来有什么计划？
text.pinyin: Zhè zhēnshì ge hǎo bànfǎ, nánguài nǐ jìnbù de zhème kuài. Duìle, nǐ duì wèilái yǒu shénme jìhuà?
text.english: That's really a great method, no wonder you improved so quickly. By the way, what plans do you have for the future?

text.traditional: 我從小就想當導演，腦子裡每天都想著這件事。有時連做夢都夢到自己拍電影的樣子，所以我打算明年開始學拍電影。
text.simplified: 我从小就想当导演，脑子里每天都想着这件事。有时连做梦都梦到自己拍电影的样子，所以我打算明年开始学拍电影。
text.pinyin: Wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù xiǎng dāng dǎoyǎn, nǎozi lǐ měitiān dōu xiǎng zhe zhè jiàn shì. Yǒu shí lián zuòmèng dōu mèngdào zìjǐ pāi diànyǐng de yàngzi, suǒyǐ wǒ dǎsuàn míngnián kāishǐ xué pāi diànyǐng.
text.english: Ever since I was little I wanted to be a director, and I think about this every day. Sometimes I even dream of myself filming movies, so I plan to start learning film directing next year.

text.traditional: 導演？你長得這麼好看，身高也夠高，而且什麼角色都演得很好，不當演員多麼可惜啊！再說，觀眾也都很肯定你的表現。
text.simplified: 导演？你长得这么好看，身高也够高，而且什么角色都演得很好，不当演员多么可惜啊！再说，观众也都很肯定你的表现。
text.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn? Nǐ zhǎng de zhème hǎokàn, shēngāo yě gòu gāo, érqiě shénme juésè dōu yǎn de hěn hǎo, bù dāng yǎnyuán duóme kěxí a! Zàishuō, guānzhòng yě dōu hěn kěndìng nǐ de biǎoxiàn.
text.english: Director? You're so good-looking, you're tall enough, and you act well in every role; what a pity not to be an actor! Besides, audiences really appreciate your performance.

text.traditional: 導演還是可以演戲的。其實，要當好導演，不但得懂怎麼拍電影，也要教演員演戲，挑戰更大。
text.simplified: 导演还是可以演戏的。其实，要当好导演，不但得懂怎么拍电影，也要教演员演戏，挑战更大。
text.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn háishì kěyǐ yǎnxì de. Qíshí, yào dāng hǎo dǎoyǎn, búdàn děi dǒng zěnme pāi diànyǐng, yě yào jiāo yǎnyuán yǎnxì, tiǎozhàn gèng dà.
text.english: A director can still act. Actually, to be a good director, not only must one know how to make films, but one also has to guide actors; the challenge is even greater.

text.traditional: 我聽說不少導演為了把電影拍好，連家都很少回去，有的還因為這樣離婚了。不過，我想只要你有實力，就不怕挑戰了。
text.simplified: 我听说不少导演为了把电影拍好，连家都很少回去，有的还因为这样离婚了。不过，我想只要你有实力，就不怕挑战了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ tīngshuō bùshǎo dǎoyǎn wèile bǎ diànyǐng pāi hǎo, lián jiā dōu hěn shǎo huíqù, yǒude hái yīnwèi zhèyàng líhūn le. Búguò, wǒ xiǎng zhǐyào nǐ yǒu shílì, jiù búpà tiǎozhàn le.
text.english: I heard quite a few directors rarely go home just to make good movies, and some even got divorced because of this. But I think as long as you have real capability, you won't fear challenges.

text.traditional: 謝謝。今天能跟妳見面聊聊真好。
text.simplified: 谢谢。今天能跟你见面聊聊真好。
text.pinyin: Xièxie. Jīntiān néng gēn nǐ jiànmiàn liáo liáo zhēn hǎo.
text.english: Thank you. It is really wonderful to meet and chat with you today.

text.traditional: 那你以後別再跟我說，因為要演總統、石油公司大老闆什麼的，沒時間跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留點兒時間給朋友啊！
text.simplified: 那你以后别再跟我说，因为要演总统、石油公司大老板什么的，没时间跟朋友聚一聚。不管多忙，你也要留点儿时间给朋友啊！
text.pinyin: Nà nǐ yǐhòu bié zài gēn wǒ shuō, yīnwèi yào yǎn zǒngtǒng, shíyóu gōngsī dà lǎobǎn shénme de, méi shíjiān gēn péngyǒu jù yí jù. Bùguǎn duō máng, nǐ yě yào liú diǎnr shíjiān gěi péngyǒu a!
text.english: Then don't tell me later that you have no time to gather with friends because you need to play a president or oil tycoon. No matter how busy, leave some time for friends!

text.traditional: 嗯！對了，也聊聊妳自己吧。妳學的是法律，以後要當律師吧？
text.simplified: 嗯！对了，也聊聊你自己吧。你学的是法律，以后要当律师吧？
text.pinyin: Ēn! Duìle, yě liáo liáo nǐ zìjǐ ba. Nǐ xué de shì fǎlǜ, yǐhòu yào dāng lǜshī ba?
text.english: Sure! By the way, let's talk about you. You study law, so you will become a lawyer in the future, right?

text.traditional: 其實，我學法律是因為爸爸的要求。他希望我先當律師，將來有機會當上市長就更好了。
text.simplified: 其实，我学法律是因为爸爸的要求。他希望我先当律师，将来有机会当上市长就更好了。
text.pinyin: Qíshí, wǒ xué fǎlǜ shì yīnwèi bàba de yāoqiú. Tā xīwàng wǒ xiān dāng lǜshī, jiānglái yǒu jīhuì dāng shàng shìzhǎng jiù gèng hǎo le.
text.english: Actually, I studied law because of my father's request. He hopes I first become a lawyer, and it would be even better if I have a chance to become mayor in the future.

text.traditional: 所以當市長是妳的夢想嗎？
text.simplified: 所以当市长是你的梦想吗？
text.pinyin: Suǒyǐ dāng shìzhǎng shì nǐ de mèngxiǎng ma?
text.english: So becoming mayor is your dream?

text.traditional: 唉，誰想當市長啊？不過，從小我爸媽什麼事都替我安排好了，雖然不喜歡，我也只能忍耐。
text.simplified: 唉，谁想当市长啊？不过，从小我爸妈什么事都替我安排好了，虽然不喜欢，我也只能忍耐。
text.pinyin: Āi, shéi xiǎng dāng shìzhǎng a? Búguò, cóngxiǎo wǒ bà mā shénme shì dōu tì wǒ ānpái hǎo le, suīrán bù xǐhuān, wǒ yě zhǐ néng rěnnài.
text.english: Sigh, who wants to be mayor? But since childhood my parents arranged everything for me; even though I don't like it, I can only endure it.

text.traditional: 其實，我們都不是小孩子了，自己的未來應該自己決定吧。
text.simplified: 其实，我们都不是小孩子了，自己的未来应该自己决定吧。
text.pinyin: Qíshí, wǒmen dōu búshì xiǎoháizi le, zìjǐ de wèilái yīnggāi zìjǐ juédìng ba.
text.english: Actually, we are no longer children; our future should be decided by ourselves.

text.traditional: 就是說嘛！但是我爸媽的想法太保守了，一時很難改變他們。
text.simplified: 就是说嘛！但是我爸妈的想法太保守了，一时很难改变他们。
text.pinyin: Jiùshìshuō ma! Dànshì wǒ bà mā de xiǎngfǎ tài bǎoshǒu le, yìshí hěn nán gǎibiàn tāmen.
text.english: Exactly! But my parents' mindset is too conservative; it's very difficult to change them all at once.

text.traditional: 希望有一天，妳也能為了自己的夢想努力。
text.simplified: 希望有一天，你也能为了自己的梦想努力。
text.pinyin: Xīwàng yǒu yì tiān, nǐ yě néng wèile zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng nǔlì.
text.english: I hope that one day you can also strive for your own dream.

text.traditional: 嗯，我們一起加油吧！
text.simplified: 嗯，我们一起加油吧！
text.pinyin: Ēn, wǒmen yìqǐ jiāyóu ba!
text.english: Yeah, let's cheer each other on together!

items.completionDescription: Great progress! You completed the first part of this lesson.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: State a cause and its result, in formal or written Chinese, using 因為……（，）而…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「而」當連詞，「因為」的後面是事情的原因，「而」的後面是事情的結果。常用在書面或正式場合。「因為……（，）而……」有「因為……所以……」的意思。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 因為 + Cause（，）+ 而 + Result

patternRows.english: Some directors became very famous because they made good films.
He moved to the countryside because he could not adjust to city life.
He lost his job because he drove after drinking.

text.traditional: ……還有一些導演因為拍出了好電影而變得很有名。
text.simplified: ……还有一些导演因为拍出了好电影而变得很有名。
text.pinyin: …Háiyǒu yìxiē dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi chū le hǎo diànyǐng ér biàn de hěn yǒumíng.
text.english: …Some directors have also become famous because they made good films.

text.traditional: 他因為不適應都市緊張的生活，而搬到了鄉下，過著自由、簡單的日子。
text.simplified: 他因为不适应都市紧张的生活，而搬到了乡下，过着自由、简单的日子。
text.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi bú shìyìng dūshì jǐnzhāng de shēnghuó, ér bān dào le xiāngxià, guò zhe zìyóu, jiǎndān de rìzi.
text.english: Because he could not adapt to the stress of city life, he moved to the countryside, where he lives a free and simple life.

text.traditional: 大家約他吃飯喝酒，慶祝他找到工作，沒想到他因為喝酒開車而丟了工作。
text.simplified: 大家约他吃饭喝酒，庆祝他找到工作，没想到他因为喝酒开车而丢了工作。
text.pinyin: Dàjiā yuē tā chīfàn hē jiǔ, qìngzhù tā zhǎodào gōngzuò, méixiǎngdào tā yīnwèi hē jiǔ kāichē ér diū le gōngzuò.
text.english: Everyone invited him out for dinner and drinks to celebrate his new job, but no one expected him to lose that job because he drove after drinking.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 而 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 而 is a conjunction, 因為 is followed by the cause, and 而 is followed by the result of the matter. Commonly used in written or formal occasions. 因為……（，）而……means 因為……所以…….
summary: 而 links a cause to its result, mostly in writing or formal speech.
因為 comes before the reason and 而 before the result, so 因為……而…… means 因為……所以…….
Don't use 而 between two nouns. Use 和 or 跟 for nouns.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that an action creates something new, such as a film, a novel or an idea, using V 出 O.
grammarPages.explanation: 動詞後面加「出」可表示動作從裡到外的方向，例如：我從書包裡拿出鉛筆。本課動詞後面加「出」，表示動作完成後，產生新事物。常用的動詞有：想、做、說、穿、拍、寫、找、算、研究等等。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + 出 + Object

patternRows.english: Some directors made good films.
He wrote a novel.
I can't make a cake I'm happy with.

text.traditional: ……還有一些導演因為拍出了好電影而變得很有名。
text.simplified: ……还有一些导演因为拍出了好电影而变得很有名。
text.pinyin: …Háiyǒu yìxiē dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi chū le hǎo diànyǐng ér biàn de hěn yǒumíng.
text.english: …Some directors have also become famous because they made good films.

text.traditional: 他花了三年的時間，最後寫出了一本大家都非常喜愛的小說。
text.simplified: 他花了三年的时间，最后写出了一本大家都非常喜爱的小说。
text.pinyin: Tā huā le sān nián de shíjiān, zuìhòu xiě chū le yì běn dàjiā dōu fēicháng xǐ'ài de xiǎoshuō.
text.english: He spent three years and finally wrote a novel that everyone loves.

text.traditional: 我學做蛋糕學了很久，還是做不出讓自己滿意的蛋糕。
text.simplified: 我学做蛋糕学了很久，还是做不出让自己满意的蛋糕。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xué zuò dàngāo xué le hěn jiǔ, háishì zuò bù chū ràng zìjǐ mǎnyì de dàngāo.
text.english: I've been learning to make cakes for a long time, but I still can't make one I'm happy with.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using V出 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Add 出 after the verb to indicate that the direction of the action is from the inside to the outside. For example, 我從書包裡拿出鉛筆. In this lesson, adding 出 after the verb means that new things will be generated after the action is completed. Commonly used verbs are: 想, 做, 說, 穿, 拍, 寫, 找, 算, 研究, etc.
summary: Put 出 after a verb to say that the action makes something new appear.
Common verbs are 想, 做, 說, 寫 and 畫.
This is not 出 for moving out of a place, which uses 走出來.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that even if something happened, a fact or decision would stay the same, using 就算……（，）也…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「就算」當連詞，後面是一個假設，表示不會因為這個假設的情況，而改變原來的事實或決定。例如：A：今天下雨，我不去學校了。B：不行，就算下雪，也得去學校。
grammarPages.pattern: 就算 + Condition (，) + 也 + Result / Action

patternRows.english: Even if extremely tired, Dongxian still feels very happy.
Even working twelve hours would be no problem.
Even without eating or drinking for twenty years, I still could not afford it.

text.traditional: 這種為了夢想……，就算累得不得了，東賢也覺得很開心、很滿足。
text.simplified: 这种为了梦想……，就算累得不得了，东贤也觉得很开心、很满足。
text.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng wèile mèngxiǎng…, jiùsuàn lèi de bùdéliǎo, Dōngxián yě juéde hěn kāixīn, hěn mǎnzú.
text.english: This kind of life for a dream… even if he is extremely tired, Dongxian still feels very happy and satisfied.

text.traditional: 方小姐想多存一點兒錢，就算一天工作十二個小時也沒問題。
text.simplified: 方小姐想多存一点儿钱，就算一天工作十二个小时也没问题。
text.pinyin: Fāng xiǎojiě xiǎng duō cún yìdiǎnr qián, jiùsuàn yì tiān gōngzuò shí'èr ge xiǎoshí yě méi wèntí.
text.english: Miss Fang wants to save a little more money; even working twelve hours a day is no problem.

text.traditional: 我覺得那個地區房子的價格都太高了，就算二十年不吃不喝也買不起。
text.simplified: 我觉得那个地区房子的价格都太高了，就算二十年不吃不喝也买不起。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde nàge dìqū fángzi de jiàgé dōu tài gāo le, jiùsuàn èrshí nián bù chī bù hē yě mǎi bù qǐ.
text.english: I think the homes in that area are all too expensive; even without eating or drinking for twenty years, I couldn't afford one.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 就算……也…… in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 就算 is a conjunction, followed by a hypothesis, which means that the original situation will not be changed because of the content of this hypothesis. For example, A：今天下雨，我不去學校了。B：不行，就算下雪，也得去學校。
summary: 就算 means even if. The imagined situation after it does not change the facts or the decision.
Use 也 in the second part, not 但是.
雖然 starts a real fact, but 就算 starts an imagined condition.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 追求夢想的東賢 · Dongxian Pursuing His Dream

text.traditional: 現在的電影市場比以前大多了，當導演的機會也變多了，還有一些導演因為拍出了好電影而變得很有名。其實不管在哪一個年代，要拍一部好電影，都是很大的學問。現在科技進步、資源豐富，觀眾對好電影的要求越來越高，拍戲和演戲的工作就變得更不簡單了。
text.simplified: 现在的电影市场比以前大多了，当导演的机会也变多了，还有一些导演因为拍出了好电影而变得很有名。其实不管在哪一个年代，要拍一部好电影，都是很大的学问。现在科技进步、资源丰富，观众对好电影的要求越来越高，拍戏和演戏的工作就变得更不简单了。
text.pinyin: Xiànzài de diànyǐng shìchǎng bǐ yǐqián dà duō le, dāng dǎoyǎn de jīhuì yě biàn duō le, háiyǒu yìxiē dǎoyǎn yīnwèi pāi chū le hǎo diànyǐng ér biàn de hěn yǒumíng. Qíshí bùguǎn zài nǎ yíge niándài, yào pāi yí bù hǎo diànyǐng, dōu shì hěn dà de xuéwèn. Xiànzài kējì jìnbù, zīyuán fēngfù, guānzhòng duì hǎo diànyǐng de yāoqiú yuè lái yuè gāo, pāixì hàn yǎnxì de gōngzuò jiù biàn de gèng bù jiǎndān le.
text.english: Today's film market is much larger than before, and opportunities to become a director have also increased; there are also some directors who became very famous because they made great movies. Actually, no matter in which era, making a good movie requires great learning. Nowadays, with technological progress and abundant resources, audiences have higher and higher demands for good movies, so the work of filmmaking and acting has become even less simple.

text.traditional: 東賢從小的夢想就是當一名導演，但是有導演夢的人很多，能成功的人很少，所以父母希望他能改變主意。不過，性格開朗的東賢向他們保證，為了追求夢想，他一定會努力的。他跟父母說，要先到臺灣學習中文，還要去上表演課程，等中文學得不錯後，再學習更專業的導演技巧。而且他已經成年了，知道怎麼照顧自己，吃點苦也沒關係。爸媽聽了東賢的說明後，覺得他很勇敢、很認真，最後就答應了。
text.simplified: 东贤从小的梦想就是当一名导演，但是有导演梦的人很多，能成功的人很少，所以父母希望他能改变主意。不过，性格开朗的东贤向他们保证，为了追求梦想，他一定会努力的。他跟父母说，要先到台湾学习中文，还要去上表演课程，等中文学得不错后，再学习更专业的导演技巧。而且他已经成年了，知道怎么照顾自己，吃点苦也没关系。爸妈听了东贤的说明后，觉得他很勇敢、很认真，最后就答应了。
text.pinyin: Dōngxián cóngxiǎo de mèngxiǎng jiùshì dāng yì míng dǎoyǎn, dànshì yǒu dǎoyǎn mèng de rén hěn duō, néng chénggōng de rén hěn shǎo, suǒyǐ fùmǔ xīwàng tā néng gǎibiàn zhǔyì. Búguò, xìnggé kāilǎng de Dōngxián xiàng tāmen bǎozhèng, wèile zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng, tā yídìng huì nǔlì de. Tā gēn fùmǔ shuō, yào xiān dào Táiwān xuéxí Zhōngwén, háiyào qù shàng biǎoyǎn kèchéng, děng Zhōngwén xué de búcuò hòu, zài xuéxí gèng zhuānyè de dǎoyǎn jìqiǎo. Érqiě tā yǐjīng chéngnián le, zhīdào zěnme zhàogù zìjǐ, chī diǎn kǔ yě méiguānxi. Bà mā tīng le Dōngxián de shuōmíng hòu, juéde tā hěn yǒnggǎn, hěn rènzhēn, zuìhòu jiù dāyìng le.
text.english: Dongxian's dream since childhood was to become a director, but there are many people with directing dreams and very few who succeed, so his parents hoped he would change his mind. However, cheerful Dongxian promised them that he would work hard to pursue his dream. He told his parents that he would first go to Taiwan to learn Chinese, attend acting courses, and after learning Chinese well, learn more professional directing skills. Moreover, he was already an adult, knew how to take care of himself, and enduring a bit of hardship didn't matter. After listening to Dongxian's explanation, his parents felt he was very brave and earnest, and finally agreed.

text.traditional: 到了臺灣以後，東賢很快就適應了新的生活，也找到了一份模特兒的工作。這樣不但有錢付生活費，還能讓表演經驗更豐富。這種為了夢想，每天很早出門、很晚回家的生活，就算累得不得了，東賢也覺得很開心、很滿足。因為對他來說，夢想就像一張美麗的圖，一開始只是一張白紙，想追求夢想的人就得自己設計、配上顏色，最後才能完成一張好圖。他相信只要自己肯努力，最後一定能夢想成真的。
text.simplified: 到了台湾以后，东贤很快就适应了新的生活，也找到了一份模特儿的工作。这样不但有钱付生活费，还能让表演经验更丰富。这种为了梦想，每天很早出门、很晚回家的生活，就算累得不得了，东贤也觉得很开心、很满足。因为对他来说，梦想就像一张美丽的图，一开始只是一张白纸，想追求梦想的人就得自己设计、配上颜色，最后才能完成一张好图。他相信只要自己肯努力，最后一定能梦想成真的。
text.pinyin: Dào le Táiwān yǐhòu, Dōngxián hěn kuài jiù shìyìng le xīn de shēnghuó, yě zhǎodào le yí fèn mótèr de gōngzuò. Zhèyàng búdàn yǒu qián fù shēnghuó fèi, hái néng ràng biǎoyǎn jīngyàn gèng fēngfù. Zhè zhǒng wèile mèngxiǎng, měitiān hěn zǎo chūmén, hěn wǎn huíjiā de shēnghuó, jiùsuàn lèi de bùdéliǎo, Dōngxián yě juéde hěn kāixīn, hěn mǎnzú. Yīnwèi duì tā lái shuō, mèngxiǎng jiù xiàng yì zhāng měilì de tú, yìkāishǐ zhǐshì yì zhāng bái zhǐ, xiǎng zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de rén jiù děi zìjǐ shèjì, pèi shàng yánsè, zuìhòu cái néng wánchéng yì zhāng hǎo tú. Tā xiāngxìn zhǐyào zìjǐ kěn nǔlì, zuìhòu yídìng néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn de.
text.english: After arriving in Taiwan, Dongxian quickly adapted to his new life and also found a job as a model. This not only provided money to pay living expenses, but also enriched his acting experience. For this kind of life of leaving early and returning late every day for his dream, even if he was exceedingly tired, Dongxian still felt very happy and satisfied. Because to him, a dream is like a beautiful picture: in the beginning it is only a blank sheet of paper, and a person who wants to pursue a dream must design it himself and add colors, and only then can he complete a good picture. He believes that as long as he is willing to work hard, his dream will surely come true in the end.

items.title: Grammar 1–4 · Convenience Stores Are So Convenient

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something already happened or was known long ago, using 早就……了.
grammarPages.explanation: 使用「早就……了」表示說話的人感覺「很久以前已經……了」。比如：「我早就知道他不能來了。」、「蛋糕早就被吃光了。」
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 早就 + Verb Phrase + 了

text.traditional:
朋子：臺灣的便利商店有送洗衣服的服務，我怎麼不知道？
尚恩：早就有了，挺方便的。
text.simplified:
朋子：台湾的便利商店有送洗衣服的服务，我怎么不知道？
尚恩：早就有了，挺方便的。
text.pinyin:
Péngzǐ: Táiwān de biànlì shāngdiàn yǒu sòng xǐ yīfu de fúwù, wǒ zěnme bù zhīdào?
Shàng'ēn: Zǎo jiù yǒu le, tǐng fāngbiàn de.
text.english:
Tomoko: Taiwan's convenience stores have a laundry service? How come I didn't know?
Shawn: They've had it for a long time. It's pretty convenient.

text.traditional:
A：我剛才聽說小張為了照顧生病的奶奶，下個月就要離開公司了。
B：這件事大家早就知道了，你怎麼現在才知道？
text.simplified:
A：我刚才听说小张为了照顾生病的奶奶，下个月就要离开公司了。
B：这件事大家早就知道了，你怎么现在才知道？
text.pinyin:
A: Wǒ gāngcái tīngshuō Xiǎo Zhāng wèile zhàogù shēngbìng de nǎinai, xià ge yuè jiùyào líkāi gōngsī le.
B: Zhè jiàn shì dàjiā zǎo jiù zhīdào le, nǐ zěnme xiànzài cái zhīdào?
text.english:
A: I just heard that Xiao Zhang is leaving the company next month to look after his sick grandmother.
B: Everyone knew that long ago; why have you only just heard?

text.traditional: 你不是早就計畫好要出國了嗎？怎麼出國前兩天才跟老闆請假呢？
text.simplified: 你不是早就计划好要出国了吗？怎么出国前两天才跟老板请假呢？
text.pinyin: Nǐ búshì zǎo jiù jìhuà hǎo yào chū guó le ma? Zěnme chū guó qián liǎng tiān cái gēn lǎobǎn qǐngjià ne?
text.english: Hadn’t you planned your trip abroad long ago? Why did you only ask your boss for leave two days before leaving?

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Complete the book dialogues and answer the situations.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Using 早就……了 means that the speaker feels "It's been... It's already been a long time". For example, 我早就知道他不能來了。Or 蛋糕早就被吃光了。
summary: 早就……了 says the speaker feels something happened a long time ago.
已經 only says it is done. 早就 adds the feeling of long ago.
Don't use it for something that just happened. Use 剛才 or 剛剛 instead.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that someone does a second thing while already doing the first, with little extra trouble, using 順便.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示趁著做某件事情時，同時做第二件事，但不會增加太多麻煩或花太多時間。一般用在拜託某人做某件事，例如：朋友要去郵局寄信，我請他順便買個信封。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Action 1 + 順便 + Action 2

text.traditional: 如果餓了，就順便買個泡麵，還能免費使用熱水，真方便。
text.simplified: 如果饿了，就顺便买个泡面，还能免费使用热水，真方便。
text.pinyin: Rúguǒ è le, jiù shùnbiàn mǎi ge pàomiàn, hái néng miǎnfèi shǐyòng rèshuǐ, zhēn fāngbiàn.
text.english: If you are hungry, buy instant noodles while you are there; you can even use the hot water for free. How convenient!

text.traditional: 紀先生下班經過朋友家時，順便把幫朋友買的筆電送去了。
text.simplified: 纪先生下班经过朋友家时，顺便把帮朋友买的笔电送去了。
text.pinyin: Jì xiānshēng xiàbān jīngguò péngyǒu jiā shí, shùnbiàn bǎ bāng péngyǒu mǎi de bǐ diàn sòng qù le.
text.english: When Mr. Ji passed his friend’s home after work, he also dropped off the laptop he had bought for his friend.

text.traditional: 小龍跟顧客介紹新產品的時候，都會順便說說他自己使用的經驗。
text.simplified: 小龙跟顾客介绍新产品的时候，都会顺便说说他自己使用的经验。
text.pinyin: Xiǎolóng gēn gùkè jièshào xīn chǎnpǐn de shíhòu, dōu huì shùnbiàn shuō shuo tā zìjǐ shǐyòng de jīngyàn.
text.english: Whenever Xiaolong introduces new products to customers, he also talks a little about his own experience using them.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Complete the book dialogues and answer the situations.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 順便 means that while doing something, do the second action at one's convenience, without taking too much trouble or spending too much time. Generally used to ask someone to do something. For example, 朋友要去郵局寄信，我請他順便買個信封。
summary: 順便 means you do a second thing while doing the first, without much extra trouble or time.
It is often used when asking someone to do a small extra thing.
Put 順便 right before the second verb. For a special trip, say 特地 or 專門.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe two alternating actions or rapidly changing conditions using 一會兒…一會兒….
grammarPages.explanation: 「一會兒」作副詞，「一會兒……，一會兒……」表示兩種或多種情況先後或交替發生。說話的人覺得情況在很短的時間內改變，語氣有時有一點誇張。例如：「這幾天的天氣一會兒冷，一會兒熱，容易讓人感冒。」
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一會兒 + Action 1 + 一會兒 + Action 2

text.traditional: 臺灣便利商店的店員一會兒煮咖啡，一會兒擦桌子，太辛苦了。
text.simplified: 台湾便利商店的店员一会儿煮咖啡，一会儿擦桌子，太辛苦了。
text.pinyin: Táiwān biànlì shāngdiàn de diànyuán yìhuǐr zhǔ kāfēi, yìhuǐr cā zhuōzi, tài xīnkǔ le.
text.english: Taiwan’s convenience store clerks make coffee one moment and wipe tables the next. It is exhausting.

text.traditional: 今天整天下雨，風一會兒大，一會兒小，這樣的天氣出門真麻煩！
text.simplified: 今天整天下雨，风一会儿大，一会儿小，这样的天气出门真麻烦！
text.pinyin: Jīntiān zhěngtiān xiàyǔ, fēng yìhuǐr dà, yìhuǐr xiǎo, zhèyàng de tiānqì chūmén zhēn máfán!
text.english: It has rained all day; the wind is strong one moment and weak the next. Going out in this weather is troublesome!

text.traditional: 最近來看房子的人多了起來，大家一會兒幫客人倒茶，一會兒帶客人參觀房子，所有的人都忙死了。
text.simplified: 最近来看房子的人多了起来，大家一会儿帮客人倒茶，一会儿带客人参观房子，所有的人都忙死了。
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn lái kàn fángzi de rén duō le qǐlái, dàjiā yìhuǐr bāng kèrén dào chá, yìhuǐr dài kèrén cānguān fángzi, suǒyǒu de rén dōu máng sǐ le.
text.english: Lately more people have been coming to look at the houses. Everyone is pouring tea for the visitors one moment and showing them around the houses the next. Everyone is extremely busy.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Complete the book dialogues and answer the situations.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 一會兒 is an adverb, 一會兒……，一會兒……means that two or more situations occur one after the other or alternately. The person speaking feels that the situation has changed in a short period of time, and the tone has some exaggeration. For example, 這幾天的天氣一會兒冷，一會兒熱，容易讓人感冒。
summary: 一會兒……，一會兒…… says two or more situations happen one after the other or take turns.
The speaker feels the change is quick, and the tone is sometimes a little exaggerated.
Say both parts. For two actions at the same time, use 一邊……一邊…….

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Let a problem go and settle for an easier option using 算了.
grammarPages.explanation: 「算了」用於口語，表示說話的人對某個事物的情況不滿意，但是也不想再花時間、用太麻煩的辦法處理。「算了」可以單獨成句，也可以放在替代情況之後。例如，A：「對不起，我下個月很忙，不能跟你去旅行了。」B：「算了。」或「我找別人跟我去算了。」
grammarPages.pattern: Alternative + 算了 / 算了 alone

text.traditional:
朋子：……你可以去那裡領。
尚恩：……我在便利商店領算了。
text.simplified:
朋子：……你可以去那里领。
尚恩：……我在便利商店领算了。
text.pinyin:
Péngzǐ:… Nǐ kěyǐ qù nàlǐ lǐng.
Shàng'ēn:… Wǒ zài biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng suànle.
text.english:
Tomoko: … you can withdraw money there.
Shawn: … I'll just withdraw it at the convenience store.

text.traditional: 這幾天工作忙死了，晚上不想煮飯，我想就去便利商店買算了。
text.simplified: 这几天工作忙死了，晚上不想煮饭，我想就去便利商店买算了。
text.pinyin: Zhè jǐ tiān gōngzuò máng sǐ le, wǎnshàng bù xiǎng zhǔ fàn, wǒ xiǎng jiù qù biànlì shāngdiàn mǎi suànle.
text.english: Work has been terribly busy these days, and I do not want to cook at night. I think I will just buy food at a convenience store.

text.traditional:
A：我的手機不小心掉到馬桶裡了，怎麼辦？不知道修理費貴不貴？
B：算了，我看別修理了，換支新的吧。
text.simplified:
A：我的手机不小心掉到马桶里了，怎么办？不知道修理费贵不贵？
B：算了，我看别修理了，换支新的吧。
text.pinyin:
A: Wǒ de shǒujī bù xiǎoxīn diào dào mǎtǒng lǐ le, zěnmebàn? Bù zhīdào xiūlǐ fèi guì bú guì?
B: Suànle, wǒ kàn bié xiūlǐ le, huàn zhī xīn de ba.
text.english:
A: I accidentally dropped my phone in the toilet. What should I do? I wonder if repairs are expensive.
B: Forget it; I think you should get a new one instead of repairing it.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Complete the book dialogues and answer the situations.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 算了 is used colloquially. The person speaking is dissatisfied with a situation, but does not want to spend time or to make too much effort to deal with or solve it. 算了 can be used alone or at the end of the alternative choice. For example, A：對不起，我下個月很忙，不能跟你去旅行了。B: 算了。Or 我找別人跟我去算了。
summary: 算了 is a spoken way to say forget it: you are unhappy but won't spend more time or effort.
It can be a whole sentence by itself, or come after a different choice, as in 我找別人跟我去算了.
To say you finished calculating, use 算好了, not 算了.

dialogue.title: 對話 · 便利商店真方便 · Convenience Stores Are So Convenient

text.traditional: 你提著一大包東西，要去哪裡啊？
text.simplified: 你提着一大包东西，要去哪里啊？
text.pinyin: Nǐ tí zhe yí dà bāo dōngxi, yào qù nǎlǐ a?
text.english: You’re carrying a large bag of things; where are you off to?

text.traditional: 我要去便利商店送洗衣服。
text.simplified: 我要去便利商店送洗衣服。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù biànlì shāngdiàn sòng xǐ yīfu.
text.english: I’m going to the convenience store to drop off my clothes to be washed.

text.traditional: 臺灣的便利商店有送洗衣服的服務，我怎麼不知道？
text.simplified: 台湾的便利商店有送洗衣服的服务，我怎么不知道？
text.pinyin: Táiwān de biànlì shāngdiàn yǒu sòng xǐ yīfu de fúwù, wǒ zěnme bù zhīdào?
text.english: Taiwan’s convenience stores have laundry services? How did I not know?

text.traditional: 早就有了，挺方便的。我剛到臺灣時，跟朋友去便利商店，被嚇了一跳。
text.simplified: 早就有了，挺方便的。我刚到台湾时，跟朋友去便利商店，被吓了一跳。
text.pinyin: Zǎo jiù yǒu le, tǐng fāngbiàn de. Wǒ gāng dào Táiwān shí, gēn péngyǒu qù biànlì shāngdiàn, bèi xià le yí tiào.
text.english: They’ve had it for a long time; it’s quite convenient. When I first arrived in Taiwan, I went to a convenience store with a friend and was shocked.

text.traditional: 怎麼了？被什麼事嚇了一跳？
text.simplified: 怎么了？被什么事吓了一跳？
text.pinyin: Zěnmele? Bèi shénme shì xià le yí tiào?
text.english: What happened? What shocked you?

text.traditional: 我沒想到臺灣的便利商店有這麼多服務。像領錢、買票，還有收電話費、水電費什麼的。
text.simplified: 我没想到台湾的便利商店有这么多服务。像领钱、买票，还有收电话费、水电费什么的。
text.pinyin: Wǒ méixiǎngdào Táiwān de biànlì shāngdiàn yǒu zhème duō fúwù. Xiàng lǐng qián, mǎipiào, háiyǒu shōu diànhuà fèi, shuǐ diànfèi shénme de.
text.english: I never expected Taiwan’s convenience stores to offer so many services. Like withdrawing money, buying tickets, plus collecting phone bills, utilities, and so on.

text.traditional: 對，真的很多。我覺得現在臺灣的便利商店比以前方便，比如說，提供休息空間，讓客人坐下來，好好地吃個東西、喝點飲料。
text.simplified: 对，真的很多。我觉得现在台湾的便利商店比以前方便，比如说，提供休息空间，让客人坐下来，好好地吃个东西、喝点饮料。
text.pinyin: Duì, zhēnde hěn duō. Wǒ juéde xiànzài Táiwān de biànlì shāngdiàn bǐ yǐqián fāngbiàn, bǐrú shuō, tígōng xiūxí kōngjiān, ràng kèrén zuò xià lái, hǎohǎo de chī ge dōngxi, hē diǎn yǐnliào.
text.english: Right, really a lot. I feel Taiwan’s convenience stores now are more convenient than before; for instance, providing seating areas so customers can sit down and comfortably have a bite to eat or drink a beverage.

text.traditional: 是啊。現在我早晚都去，有時候整個下午都在那裡看書、寫功課。如果餓了，就順便買個泡麵，還能免費使用熱水，真方便。
text.simplified: 是啊。现在我早晚都去，有时候整个下午都在那里看书、写功课。如果饿了，就顺便买个泡面，还能免费使用热水，真方便。
text.pinyin: Shì a. Xiànzài wǒ zǎowǎn dōu qù, yǒushíhòu zhěng ge xiàwǔ dōu zài nàlǐ kàn shū, xiě gōngkè. Rúguǒ è le, jiù shùnbiàn mǎi ge pàomiàn, hái néng miǎnfèi shǐyòng rèshuǐ, zhēn fāngbiàn.
text.english: Yeah. Now I go both morning and night; sometimes I spend the whole afternoon there reading and doing homework. If I get hungry, I buy instant noodles while I'm there, and can even use hot water for free; it’s really convenient.

text.traditional: 我來不及做早餐的話，就去那裡買個饅頭、牛奶。有時候也去買最愛的熱狗跟汽水，雖然沒什麼營養，但是可以讓心情變得更好，哈哈哈！
text.simplified: 我来不及做早餐的话，就去那里买个馒头、牛奶。有时候也去买最爱的热狗跟汽水，虽然没什么营养，但是可以让心情变得更好，哈哈哈！
text.pinyin: Wǒ láibùjí zuò zǎocān dehuà, jiù qù nàlǐ mǎi ge mántou, niúnǎi. Yǒushíhòu yě qù mǎi zuì ài de règǒu gēn qìshuǐ, suīrán méishénme yíngyǎng, dànshì kěyǐ ràng xīnqíng biàn de gèng hǎo, hāhāhā!
text.english: If I don’t have time to make breakfast, I go there to buy a steamed bun and milk. Sometimes I also buy my favorite hot dog and soda; although not very nutritious, it puts me in a better mood, hahaha!

text.traditional: 是啊。對了，我聽說日本的便利商店也很方便，商品也很多。
text.simplified: 是啊。对了，我听说日本的便利商店也很方便，商品也很多。
text.pinyin: Shì a. Duìle, wǒ tīngshuō Rìběn de biànlì shāngdiàn yě hěn fāngbiàn, shāngpǐn yě hěn duō.
text.english: Yeah. By the way, I heard convenience stores in Japan are also very convenient, and have lots of merchandise.

text.traditional: 跟臺灣的差不多。從中餐、西餐，到白菜、香蕉等蔬菜水果都買得到，也有各式各樣的生活用品。
text.simplified: 跟台湾的差不多。从中餐、西餐，到白菜、香蕉等蔬菜水果都买得到，也有各式各样的生活用品。
text.pinyin: Gēn Táiwān de chàbùduō. Cóng zhōngcān, xīcān, dào báicài, xiāngjiāo děng shūcài shuǐguǒ dōu mǎi de dào, yě yǒu gèshìgèyàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
text.english: About the same as Taiwan’s. From Chinese food and Western meals to vegetables and fruits like cabbage and bananas, you can buy them all; there are also all kinds of daily necessities.

text.traditional: 我個人覺得便利商店在日本和臺灣能夠成功，除了是二十四小時的，也因為提供的服務非常多，能滿足大家的需求。
text.simplified: 我个人觉得便利商店在日本和台湾能够成功，除了是二十四小时的，也因为提供的服务非常多，能满足大家的需求。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gèrén juéde biànlì shāngdiàn zài Rìběn hàn Táiwān nénggòu chénggōng, chúle shì èrshísì xiǎoshí de, yě yīnwèi tígōng de fúwù fēicháng duō, néng mǎnzú dàjiā de xūqiú.
text.english: Personally, I think convenience stores are successful in Japan and Taiwan not only because they are open 24 hours, but also because they provide so many services, meeting everyone’s needs.

text.traditional: 嗯，我同意。法國沒有這樣的商店嗎？
text.simplified: 嗯，我同意。法国没有这样的商店吗？
text.pinyin: Ēn, wǒ tóngyì. Fǎguó méiyǒu zhèyàng de shāngdiàn ma?
text.english: Mm, I agree. Doesn’t France have stores like this?

text.traditional: 法國沒有二十四小時的，也沒有這麼多服務。我想主要是因為法國人的想法和工作習慣跟臺灣人不一樣吧。
text.simplified: 法国没有二十四小时的，也没有这么多服务。我想主要是因为法国人的想法和工作习惯跟台湾人不一样吧。
text.pinyin: Fǎguó méiyǒu èrshísì xiǎoshí de, yě méiyǒu zhème duō fúwù. Wǒ xiǎng zhǔyào shì yīnwèi Fǎguó rén de xiǎngfǎ hàn gōngzuò xíguàn gēn Táiwān rén bù yíyàng ba.
text.english: France doesn’t have 24-hour ones, nor so many services. I think it’s mainly because French people’s mindset and working habits are different from Taiwanese people’s.

text.traditional: 我的法國朋友也說，臺灣便利商店的店員一會兒煮咖啡，一會兒擦桌子，太辛苦了。
text.simplified: 我的法国朋友也说，台湾便利商店的店员一会儿煮咖啡，一会儿擦桌子，太辛苦了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de Fǎguó péngyǒu yě shuō, Táiwān biànlì shāngdiàn de diànyuán yìhuǐr zhǔ kāfēi, yìhuǐr cā zhuōzi, tài xīnkǔ le.
text.english: My French friend also said that Taiwanese convenience store clerks make coffee one moment and wipe tables the next; it’s so hard!

text.traditional: 是啊，他們真的太忙了。（看錶）不好意思，我等一下有個約會，現在得先去送洗衣服了，也順便領點錢。
text.simplified: 是啊，他们真的太忙了。（看表）不好意思，我等一下有个约会，现在得先去送洗衣服了，也顺便领点钱。
text.pinyin: Shì a, tāmen zhēnde tài máng le. (Kàn biǎo) Bùhǎoyìsi, wǒ děng yíxià yǒu ge yuēhuì, xiànzài děi xiān qù sòng xǐ yīfu le, yě shùnbiàn lǐng diǎn qián.
text.english: Yeah, they really are too busy. (Looks at watch) Excuse me, I have an appointment shortly, so I need to go drop off the laundry now and also withdraw some cash on the way.

text.traditional: 附近有一家銀行的自動提款機不收手續費，你可以去那裡領。
text.simplified: 附近有一家银行的自动提款机不收手续费，你可以去那里领。
text.pinyin: Fùjìn yǒu yì jiā yínháng de zìdòng tíkuǎnjī bù shōu shǒuxùfèi, nǐ kěyǐ qù nàlǐ lǐng.
text.english: There is an ATM from a nearby bank that doesn’t charge fees; you could withdraw there.

text.traditional: 沒關係，手續費不過幾塊錢，我在便利商店領算了。
text.simplified: 没关系，手续费不过几块钱，我在便利商店领算了。
text.pinyin: Méiguānxi, shǒuxùfèi búguò jǐ kuài qián, wǒ zài biànlì shāngdiàn lǐng suànle.
text.english: That’s fine; the transaction fee is only a few dollars, I might as well just withdraw it at the convenience store.

text.traditional: 嗯，你說的對。
text.simplified: 嗯，你说的对。
text.pinyin: Ēn, nǐ shuō de duì.
text.english: Mm, you’re right.

items.completionDescription: Great progress! You completed the first part of this lesson.

items.title: Grammar 5–7 · Convenience Stores Are So Convenient

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something opens or comes apart, or that someone or something moves away, and whether it can happen (打得開 / 打不開), using V 開.
grammarPages.explanation: 「開」當結果補語，有「本來在一起的東西分離」的意思，例如：打「開」、拉「開」。「開」也有「人或物離開本來的地方」的意思，例如：走「開」、離「開」、拿「開」等。也可以在結果補語「開」的前面加上可能補語「得」或「不」，例如：打「得」開、打「不」開、走「得」開、走「不」開等。
grammarPages.pattern: Verb + 開 / 得開 / 不開

text.traditional: 在臺灣，許多人的生活離不開超商，……
text.simplified: 在台湾，许多人的生活离不开超商，……
text.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, xǔduō rén de shēnghuó lí bù kāi chāoshāng,…
text.english: In Taiwan, many people cannot do without convenience stores in their daily lives…

text.traditional:
A：這個門我開了半天就是打不開，你過來看看。
B：你拿錯鑰匙了，怎麼打得開呢？
text.simplified:
A：这个门我开了半天就是打不开，你过来看看。
B：你拿错钥匙了，怎么打得开呢？
text.pinyin:
A: Zhège mén wǒ kāi le bàntiān jiùshì dǎ bù kāi, nǐ guòlái kànkan.
B: Nǐ ná cuò yàoshi le, zěnme dǎ de kāi ne?
text.english:
A: I have tried opening this door for ages, but it will not open. Come and look.
B: You have the wrong key; how could you open it?

text.traditional:
A：媽媽，舅舅打電話給妳。
B：我在煎魚呢，走不開，跟他說我十分鐘後打過去。
text.simplified:
A：妈妈，舅舅打电话给你。
B：我在煎鱼呢，走不开，跟他说我十分钟后打过去。
text.pinyin:
A: Māma, jiùjiu dǎ diànhuà gěi nǐ.
B: Wǒ zài jiān yú ne, zǒu bù kāi, gēn tā shuō wǒ shí fēnzhōng hòu dǎ guòqù.
text.english:
A: Mum, Uncle is calling you.
B: I am frying fish and cannot get away; tell him I will call back in ten minutes.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Complete the book dialogues and answer the situations.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: When 開 is used as a result complement, there is a meaning of "things that are originally together are now separated". For example, 打"開", 拉"開". 開 also means "a person or thing leaves the original condition". For example, 走"開", 離"開", 拿"開", etc. It is also possible to add possible complements 得 or 不 before the result complement 開. For example, 打"得"開, 打"不"開, 走"得"開, 走"不"開, etc.
summary: 開 after a verb is the result of the action. It means things that were together come apart.
It can also mean a person or thing leaves where it was. 走不開 means you are too busy to leave.
Put 得 or 不 between the verb and 開 to say can or can't, as in 打不開.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express a result achieved through a process or time period using 經過.
grammarPages.explanation: 「經過」後面可接過去的一段時間，例如：他寫字寫得很慢，經過了兩個小時才把功課寫完。「經過」還可以接事情進行的過程，例如：我的電腦經過李老闆修理，好用多了。
grammarPages.pattern: 經過 + Time / Process + Result

text.traditional: 有一些超商每經過一段時間，就會舉辦活動……
text.simplified: 有一些超商每经过一段时间，就会举办活动……
text.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē chāoshāng měi jīngguò yí duàn shíjiān, jiù huì jǔbàn huódòng…
text.english: Some convenience stores hold events every so often…

text.traditional: 他以前一句中文都不會說，才經過三個月，現在不但朋友多了，買東西還會講價呢！
text.simplified: 他以前一句中文都不会说，才经过三个月，现在不但朋友多了，买东西还会讲价呢！
text.pinyin: Tā yǐqián yí jù Zhōngwén dōu bú huì shuō, cái jīngguò sān ge yuè, xiànzài búdàn péngyǒu duō le, mǎi dōngxi hái huì jiǎngjià ne!
text.english: He could not speak a single sentence of Chinese before; after just three months, he has more friends and can even bargain when shopping!

text.traditional: 我們社區的健身用品不夠，經過開會討論，決定下個月增加兩輛健身腳踏車。
text.simplified: 我们社区的健身用品不够，经过开会讨论，决定下个月增加两辆健身脚踏车。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen shèqū de jiànshēn yòngpǐn bú gòu, jīngguò kāihuì tǎolùn, juédìng xià ge yuè zēngjiā liǎng liàng jiànshēn jiǎotàchē.
text.english: Our community does not have enough fitness equipment. After discussing it at a meeting, we decided to add two exercise bikes next month.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Complete the book dialogues and answer the situations.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The 經過 of this lesson is followed by a period of time. For example, 他寫字寫得很慢，經過了兩個小時才把功課寫完。經過 can also show the results of a certain action, e.g. 我的電腦經過李老闆修理，好用多了。
summary: 經過 can be followed by a stretch of past time, as in 經過了兩個小時.
It can also be followed by a process that happened, as in 經過李老闆修理.
The sentence then gives the result. Don't put an adjective right after 經過.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say what tool or method you use to do something with 用 NP（來）V.
grammarPages.explanation: 「用」有使用的意思。「用 NP（來）V」表示使用某種方法或手段做某一件事。這裡的「來」可以省略，句子的意思不變。例如：「老師用很多例子來說明語法」和「老師用很多例子說明語法」意思是一樣的。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 用 + Tool / Method +（來）+ Action

text.traditional: 有一些超商……用送神祕小禮物的方式來吸引顧客。
text.simplified: 有一些超商……用送神秘小礼物的方式来吸引顾客。
text.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē chāoshāng… yòng sòng shénmì xiǎo lǐwù de fāngshì lái xīyǐn gùkè.
text.english: Some convenience stores…use mysterious little gifts to attract customers.

text.traditional: 現在手機的功能很強，很多人都用手機來處理事情。
text.simplified: 现在手机的功能很强，很多人都用手机来处理事情。
text.pinyin: Xiànzài shǒujī de gōngnéng hěn qiáng, hěn duō rén dōu yòng shǒujī lái chǔlǐ shìqíng.
text.english: Phones have powerful functions nowadays, and many people use them to handle things.

text.traditional: 孔子常用講故事的方式來告訴學生做人做事的道理。
text.simplified: 孔子常用讲故事的方式来告诉学生做人做事的道理。
text.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ cháng yòng jiǎng gùshì de fāngshì lái gàosu xuéshēng zuòrénzuòshì de dàolǐ.
text.english: Confucius often used stories to teach his students principles for how to live and act.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Complete the book dialogues and answer the situations.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the best option to complete the statement.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 用 here means "to use". 用 NP（來）V means using a certain method or means to do something. The 來 here can be omitted, and the meaning of the sentence does not change. For example, 老師用很多例子來說明語法 and 老師用很多例子說明語法 have the same meaning.
summary: 用 plus a tool or method says how you do something.
Put the tool or method first, then the action.
來 can be left out and the meaning stays the same.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 臺灣的超商 · Convenience Stores in Taiwan

text.traditional: 在臺灣，許多人的生活離不開超商，所以街上到處都看得到超商，每走幾步路就有一家，有時候還能看到兩家超商連在一起。為什麼超商能吸引顧客不斷地上門呢？
text.simplified: 在台湾，许多人的生活离不开超商，所以街上到处都看得到超商，每走几步路就有一家，有时候还能看到两家超商连在一起。为什么超商能吸引顾客不断地上门呢？
text.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, xǔduō rén de shēnghuó lí bù kāi chāoshāng, suǒyǐ jiē shàng dàochù dōu kàn de dào chāoshāng, měi zǒu jǐ bù lù jiù yǒu yì jiā, yǒushíhòu hái néng kàndào liǎng jiā chāoshāng lián zài yìqǐ. Wèishénme chāoshāng néng xīyǐn gùkè búduàn de shàngmén ne?
text.english: In Taiwan, many people cannot do without convenience stores in their daily lives, so convenience stores can be seen everywhere on the streets. There is one every few steps, and sometimes you can even see two stores right next to each other. Why are convenience stores able to attract a steady stream of customers?

text.traditional: 一提到超商的優點，大家馬上想到的，就是可以買到各式各樣的東西。比如，忽然下雨了，沒帶傘的話，就能趕快進超商買把傘；天氣變冷了，就能買到厚的手套和帽子；要是想喝點兒下午茶，也能買到點心，順便再帶杯咖啡回家。而且在超商，還能付停車費、信用卡費、水電費，連送洗衣服都不是問題。
text.simplified: 一提到超商的优点，大家马上想到的，就是可以买到各式各样的东西。比如，忽然下雨了，没带伞的话，就能赶快进超商买把伞；天气变冷了，就能买到厚的手套和帽子；要是想喝点儿下午茶，也能买到点心，顺便再带杯咖啡回家。而且在超商，还能付停车费、信用卡费、水电费，连送洗衣服都不是问题。
text.pinyin: Yì tídào chāoshāng de yōudiǎn, dàjiā mǎshàng xiǎngdào de, jiùshì kěyǐ mǎi dào gèshìgèyàng de dōngxi. Bǐrú, hūrán xiàyǔ le, méi dài sǎn dehuà, jiù néng gǎnkuài jìn chāoshāng mǎi bǎ sǎn; tiānqì biàn lěng le, jiù néng mǎi dào hòu de shǒutào hàn màozi; yàoshì xiǎng hē diǎnr xiàwǔ chá, yě néng mǎi dào diǎnxīn, shùnbiàn zài dài bēi kāfēi huíjiā. Érqiě zài chāoshāng, hái néng fù tíngchē fèi, xìnyòngkǎ fèi, shuǐ diànfèi, lián sòng xǐ yīfu dōu búshì wèntí.
text.english: When mentioning the merits of convenience stores, what immediately comes to mind is that you can purchase all kinds of goods. For instance, if it suddenly rains and you haven’t brought an umbrella, you can quickly step in to buy one; when the weather turns cold, you can purchase thick gloves and a hat; if you want afternoon tea, you can get a snack and pick up a coffee to take home on the way. What’s more, at convenience stores you can pay parking fees, credit card bills, and utilities; even sending clothes to be washed is no problem at all.

text.traditional: 逛超商也能夠增加不少生活的樂趣，因為超商經常進一些特別的商品來吸引顧客，像外國的零食、飲料和化妝品等；而且有一些超商每經過一段時間，就會舉辦活動，用送神祕小禮物的方式來吸引顧客。不少人為了這些小禮物，一天就去買好幾回。對臺灣人來說，超商就像一個親切的好鄰居，每次進去時，店員都帶著微笑對客人說聲歡迎，他們的服務態度真的很不錯。
text.simplified: 逛超商也能够增加不少生活的乐趣，因为超商经常进一些特别的商品来吸引顾客，像外国的零食、饮料和化妆品等；而且有一些超商每经过一段时间，就会举办活动，用送神秘小礼物的方式来吸引顾客。不少人为了这些小礼物，一天就去买好几回。对台湾人来说，超商就像一个亲切的好邻居，每次进去时，店员都带着微笑对客人说声欢迎，他们的服务态度真的很不错。
text.pinyin: Guàng chāoshāng yě nénggòu zēngjiā bùshǎo shēnghuó de lèqù, yīnwèi chāoshāng jīngcháng jìn yìxiē tèbié de shāngpǐn lái xīyǐn gùkè, xiàng wàiguó de língshí, yǐnliào hàn huàzhuāngpǐn děng; érqiě yǒu yìxiē chāoshāng měi jīngguò yí duàn shíjiān, jiù huì jǔbàn huódòng, yòng sòng shénmì xiǎo lǐwù de fāngshì lái xīyǐn gùkè. Bùshǎo rén wèile zhèxiē xiǎo lǐwù, yì tiān jiù qù mǎi hǎojǐ huí. Duì Táiwān rén lái shuō, chāoshāng jiù xiàng yíge qīnqiè de hǎo línjū, měi cì jìnqù shí, diànyuán dōu dài zhe wéixiào duì kèrén shuō shēng huānyíng, tāmen de fúwù tàidù zhēnde hěn búcuò.
text.english: Browsing convenience stores can also add much fun to daily life, because convenience stores regularly stock special items to attract customers, such as imported snacks, drinks, cosmetics, and more. Furthermore, every so often some convenience stores hold promotional events, using mystery gift giveaways to draw customers. For the sake of these small gifts, many people go make purchases several times a day. To Taiwanese people, the convenience store is like a friendly good neighbor; every time you walk in, the clerk smiles and greets guests with a warm welcome—their service attitude is truly great.

text.traditional: 不過，超商的工作是很辛苦的。在小小幾坪的空間裡，店員一會兒要收錢、找零錢，一會兒又要煮咖啡、幫客人把食物加熱，有時候還要教顧客使用機器買票。如果碰到態度差的顧客或看到滿桌的垃圾，也不能生氣。有顧客抱怨時，公司還會要求店員改善服務品質。想當好一個超商店員，真的不容易。
text.simplified: 不过，超商的工作是很辛苦的。在小小几坪的空间里，店员一会儿要收钱、找零钱，一会儿又要煮咖啡、帮客人把食物加热，有时候还要教顾客使用机器买票。如果碰到态度差的顾客或看到满桌的垃圾，也不能生气。有顾客抱怨时，公司还会要求店员改善服务品质。想当好一个超商店员，真的不容易。
text.pinyin: Búguò, chāoshāng de gōngzuò shì hěn xīnkǔ de. Zài xiǎoxiǎo jǐ píng de kōngjiān lǐ, diànyuán yìhuǐr yào shōu qián, zhǎo língqián, yìhuǐr yòu yào zhǔ kāfēi, bāng kèrén bǎ shíwù jiārè, yǒushíhòu háiyào jiāo gùkè shǐyòng jīqì mǎipiào. Rúguǒ pèngdào tàidù chà de gùkè huò kàndào mǎn zhuō de lèsè, yě bùnéng shēngqì. Yǒu gùkè bàoyuàn shí, gōngsī hái huì yāoqiú diànyuán gǎishàn fúwù pǐnzhí. Xiǎng dāng hǎo yíge chāoshāng diànyuán, zhēnde bù róngyì.
text.english: However, convenience store work is very arduous. Within just a few ping of space, the clerk must collect cash and make change one moment, then brew coffee and heat food for customers the next; sometimes they also need to teach customers how to use the ticketing kiosks. Even if they encounter rude customers or see tables strewn with trash, they cannot lose their temper. When a customer complains, the company requires clerks to improve service quality. Being a great convenience store clerk is truly not easy.

text.traditional: 超商的功能多、服務速度快，但是也有缺點，比如有些商品比超級市場貴了點兒。不過，以臺灣人的習慣，不需要花太多時間就買得到想要的東西，就算多付一點兒錢也是可以接受的。
text.simplified: 超商的功能多、服务速度快，但是也有缺点，比如有些商品比超级市场贵了点儿。不过，以台湾人的习惯，不需要花太多时间就买得到想要的东西，就算多付一点儿钱也是可以接受的。
text.pinyin: Chāoshāng de gōngnéng duō, fúwù sùdù kuài, dànshì yě yǒu quēdiǎn, bǐrú yǒuxiē shāngpǐn bǐ chāojíshìchǎng guì le diǎnr. Búguò, yǐ Táiwān rén de xíguàn, bù xūyào huā tài duō shíjiān jiù mǎi de dào xiǎngyào de dōngxi, jiùsuàn duō fù yìdiǎnr qián yě shì kěyǐ jiēshòu de.
text.english: Convenience stores have many functions and fast service, but there are also disadvantages; for instance, some goods are slightly more expensive than at supermarkets. However, according to Taiwanese habits, being able to buy what you want without spending too much time makes paying a little extra acceptable.

items.title: Grammar 1–4 · It Won't Hurt to Shop Around

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say you try something out (試穿, 試喝) before deciding to buy or use it, with 試 + verb.
grammarPages.explanation: 決定購買或使用某物品以前，先試試看是不是真的喜歡、真的合適。這個「V」常是單音節的動詞，例如：吃、穿、用、喝、開等。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 試 + Verb

text.traditional: 這套淺色的也很好看，妳都試穿一下吧！
text.simplified: 这套浅色的也很好看，你都试穿一下吧！
text.pinyin: Zhè tào qiǎnsè de yě hěn hǎokàn, nǐ dōu shìchuān yíxià ba!
text.english: This light-colored outfit looks nice too. Go ahead and try them both on!

text.traditional: 買床的時候一定要試躺，覺得舒服再買。
text.simplified: 买床的时候一定要试躺，觉得舒服再买。
text.pinyin: Mǎi chuáng de shíhòu yídìng yào shì tǎng, juéde shūfu zài mǎi.
text.english: When buying a bed you must try lying down on it, and only buy if it feels comfortable.

text.traditional: 那家超商提供新口味的飲料給客人免費試喝，喝過的人都說好喝。
text.simplified: 那家超商提供新口味的饮料给客人免费试喝，喝过的人都说好喝。
text.pinyin: Nà jiā chāoshāng tígōng xīn kǒuwèi de yǐnliào gěi kèrén miǎnfèi shì hē, hē guò de rén dōu shuō hǎohē.
text.english: That convenience store is letting customers taste its new-flavor drink for free, and everyone who has tried it says it's delicious.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 試+V in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Before deciding to buy a product or to use it, first try to see if you really like it or if it is really suitable. There "V" are often monosyllable verbs, such as 吃, 穿, 用, 喝, 開, etc.
summary: 試 plus a verb means to try it first, before you decide to buy or use something.
The verb is usually one syllable, such as 吃, 穿, 用, 喝 or 開.
Use 試 once, as in 試躺. Don't say 試試躺.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say something is thrown away, sold off, used up or gone with verb + 掉 (扔掉, 賣掉, 跑掉).
grammarPages.explanation: 「掉」是補語，用在及物動詞的後面，有去除或出現不好的結果的意思，例如：吃掉、扔掉、賣掉、拿掉等。如果「掉」用在不及物動詞的後面，表示離開的意思，例如：走掉、飛掉、跑掉、壞掉等。
grammarPages.pattern: Verb + 掉

text.traditional: ……沒穿幾次就破了，最後只好扔掉。
text.simplified: ……没穿几次就破了，最后只好扔掉。
text.pinyin: …Méi chuān jǐ cì jiù pò le, zuìhòu zhǐhǎo rēngdiào.
text.english: …They tore after being worn only a few times, so in the end they had no choice but to throw them away.

text.traditional:
A：你那輛車不常開又舊得很，不如賣掉吧！
B：它還能開，賣掉太可惜了。
text.simplified:
A：你那辆车不常开又旧得很，不如卖掉吧！
B：它还能开，卖掉太可惜了。
text.pinyin:
A: Nǐ nà liàng chē bù cháng kāi yòu jiù dehěn, bùrú màidiào ba!
B: Tā hái néng kāi, màidiào tài kěxí le.
text.english:
A: You don't drive that car much, and it's really old. You might as well sell it!
B: It still runs. Selling it would be a real shame.

text.traditional:
A：我擔心送皮鞋給男朋友，他會跑掉。
B：那就送他皮帶好了，這樣他就跑不掉了。
text.simplified:
A：我担心送皮鞋给男朋友，他会跑掉。
B：那就送他皮带好了，这样他就跑不掉了。
text.pinyin:
A: Wǒ dānxīn sòng píxié gěi nánpéngyǒu, tā huì pǎodiào.
B: Nà jiù sòng tā pídài hǎo le, zhèyàng tā jiù pǎo bú diào le.
text.english:
A: I'm worried that if I give my boyfriend leather shoes, he'll run off.
B: Then just give him a belt. That way he won't be able to run off.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using V掉 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The complement 掉 is used after the transitive verb, and it means to remove or produce bad results, such as 吃掉, 扔掉, 賣掉, 拿掉, etc. If the complement 掉 is used after the intransitive verb, it means to leave. For example, 走掉, 飛掉, 跑掉, 壞掉, etc.
summary: 掉 after a verb with an object means getting rid of something or a bad result, as in 吃掉.
After a verb with no object, 掉 means leaving, as in 走掉 and 跑掉.
完 means finishing. 掉 means throwing away, using up, or a bad result.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say something is true of anything or everything except one thing, using 什麼（……）都……，就是…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「什麼（……）都……」表示「全部、任何」，例如：「他什麼忙都幫」表示他任何忙都會幫，「我什麼東西都吃」表示任何東西我都吃。而「就是」的後面是唯一的選擇或不同的情況。例如：他什麼茶都喝，就是不喝紅茶。
grammarPages.pattern: 什麼 (+ Noun) + 都 + Verb / Adjective，就是 + Exception

text.traditional: 我覺得這個專櫃什麼都好，就是價格高了很多。
text.simplified: 我觉得这个专柜什么都好，就是价格高了很多。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè ge zhuānguì shénme dōu hǎo, jiùshì jiàgé gāo le hěn duō.
text.english: I think everything about this counter is great, except that its prices are a lot higher.

text.traditional: 我剛大學畢業，什麼工作都願意做，就是不能接受老闆要我每天加班。
text.simplified: 我刚大学毕业，什么工作都愿意做，就是不能接受老板要我每天加班。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gāng dàxué bìyè, shénme gōngzuò dōu yuànyì zuò, jiùshì bùnéng jiēshòu lǎobǎn yào wǒ měi tiān jiābān.
text.english: I've just graduated from college, and I'm willing to do any kind of job; the only thing I can't accept is a boss who wants me to work overtime every day.

text.traditional: 文小姐從設計學校畢業後，什麼服裝都設計過，就是沒設計過帽子。
text.simplified: 文小姐从设计学校毕业后，什么服装都设计过，就是没设计过帽子。
text.pinyin: Wén xiǎojiě cóng shèjì xuéxiào bìyè hòu, shénme fúzhuāng dōu shèjì guò, jiùshì méi shèjì guò màozi.
text.english: Since graduating from design school, Miss Wen has designed all kinds of clothing; the only thing she has never designed is hats.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 什麼(N)都……，就是…… in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 什麼（……）都…… means "all, anything", for example, 他什麼忙都幫 means "He will help with anything." And 我什麼東西都吃 means "I will eat anything." The statement after 就是 means the only option or different situation. For example, 他什麼茶都喝，就是不喝紅茶。
summary: 什麼(N)都 means all or any, as in 他什麼忙都幫: he helps with anything.
就是 then names the only choice or the one different case.
他什麼茶都喝，就是不喝紅茶 means he drinks any tea except black tea.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Tell someone to stop doing something with 別再……了, or say that you or someone else won't do it anymore with 不再……了.
grammarPages.explanation: 「別再……了」的意思是，說話的人建議或提醒對方不要再做某件事情了，例如：別再讓父母擔心了。如果說話的人要提醒自己或敘述別人不再做某件事情了，就使用「不再……了」，例如：我不再喝酒了。
grammarPages.pattern: 別再 + Action + 了 / 不再 + Action + 了

patternTable.title: Urging Cessation or Stating No Longer

text.traditional: ……別再買了，妳還要去看球鞋呢！
text.simplified: ……别再买了，你还要去看球鞋呢！
text.pinyin: …Bié zài mǎi le, nǐ hái yào qù kàn qiúxié ne!
text.english: … Don't buy any more; you still have to go look at sneakers!

text.traditional:
孩子：你別再幫我洗衣服了！我自己會洗。
媽媽：我怕你洗不乾淨，如果洗得乾淨，我就不再幫你洗了。
text.simplified:
孩子：你别再帮我洗衣服了！我自己会洗。
妈妈：我怕你洗不干净，如果洗得干净，我就不再帮你洗了。
text.pinyin:
Háizi: Nǐ bié zài bāng wǒ xǐ yīfu le! Wǒ zìjǐ huì xǐ.
Māma: Wǒ pà nǐ xǐ bù gānjìng, rúguǒ xǐ de gānjìng, wǒ jiù bú zài bāng nǐ xǐ le.
text.english:
Child: Don't wash my clothes for me anymore! I can wash them myself.
Mom: I'm afraid you won't get them clean. If you can get them clean, I won't wash them for you anymore.

text.traditional:
太太：你的腳受傷了，別再踢足球了。
先生：要是這次比賽輸了，我就不再踢了。
text.simplified:
太太：你的脚受伤了，别再踢足球了。
先生：要是这次比赛输了，我就不再踢了。
text.pinyin:
Tàitai: Nǐ de jiǎo shòushāng le, bié zài tī zúqiú le.
Xiānshēng: Yàoshì zhè cì bǐsài shū le, wǒ jiù bú zài tī le.
text.english:
Wife: Your foot is injured; don't play soccer anymore.
Husband: If we lose this match, I won't play anymore.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 別再……了 in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 別再……了 means that the person speaking suggests or reminds the other person not to do something anymore. For example, 別再讓父母擔心了。If the speaker reminds himself or mentions that others are not doing something anymore, use 不再……了. For example, 我不再喝酒了。
summary: 別再……了 is for telling or reminding someone else to stop doing something.
不再……了 is for your own decision, or for saying that someone no longer does something.

dialogue.title: 對話 · 貨比三家不吃虧 · It Won’t Hurt to Shop Around

text.traditional: 芳草，妳也來逛百貨公司啊！
text.simplified: 芳草，你也来逛百货公司啊！
text.pinyin: Fāngcǎo, nǐ yě lái guàng bǎihuò gōngsī a!
text.english: Fangcao, you're shopping at the department store too!

text.traditional: 是啊！我下個月要參加朋友的婚禮，來買件合適的衣服。妳呢？怎麼也來了？
text.simplified: 是啊！我下个月要参加朋友的婚礼，来买件合适的衣服。你呢？怎么也来了？
text.pinyin: Shì a! Wǒ xià ge yuè yào cānjiā péngyǒu de hūnlǐ, lái mǎi jiàn héshì de yīfu. Nǐ ne? Zěnme yě lái le?
text.english: Yes! I'm attending a friend's wedding next month and came to buy a suitable outfit. What about you? How come you came too?

text.traditional: 這家百貨公司正在打折，我特地來買上衣。要不要一起逛逛？
text.simplified: 这家百货公司正在打折，我特地来买上衣。要不要一起逛逛？
text.pinyin: Zhè jiā bǎihuò gōngsī zhèngzài dǎzhé, wǒ tèdì lái mǎi shàngyī. Yào búyào yìqǐ guàngguang?
text.english: This department store is currently having a sale, so I specially came to buy a top. Want to browse together?

text.traditional: 好啊，順便請妳給我一些意見。我們先上二樓看看，那裡有各式各樣的衣服、皮帶、皮鞋。如果有時間，我也想買一雙球鞋給我先生。
text.simplified: 好啊，顺便请你给我一些意见。我们先上二楼看看，那里有各式各样的衣服、皮带、皮鞋。如果有时间，我也想买一双球鞋给我先生。
text.pinyin: Hǎo a, shùnbiàn qǐng nǐ gěi wǒ yìxiē yìjiàn. Wǒmen xiān shàng èr lóu kànkan, nàlǐ yǒu gèshìgèyàng de yīfu, pídài, píxié. Rúguǒ yǒu shíjiān, wǒ yě xiǎng mǎi yì shuāng qiúxié gěi wǒ xiānshēng.
text.english: Sure, and while we're at it, you can give me some advice. Let's go up to the second floor first to take a look; they have all kinds of clothes, belts, and leather shoes. If there is time, I also want to buy a pair of sneakers for my husband.

text.traditional: （她們到了二樓A專櫃）
text.simplified: （她们到了二楼A专柜）
text.pinyin: (Tāmen dào le èr lóu A zhuānguì)
text.english: (They reach Counter A on the second floor.)

text.traditional: 這個專櫃的衣服都不錯，模特兒身上那件深藍色的洋裝，設計得很有特色，看起來很適合參加婚禮。
text.simplified: 这个专柜的衣服都不错，模特儿身上那件深蓝色的洋装，设计得很有特色，看起来很适合参加婚礼。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge zhuānguì de yīfu dōu búcuò, mótèr shēnshàng nà jiàn shēn lánsè de yángzhuāng, shèjì de hěn yǒu tèsè, kànqǐlái hěn shìhé cānjiā hūnlǐ.
text.english: The clothes at this counter are all nice; that navy blue dress on the mannequin has a really distinctive design, and it looks perfect for a wedding.

text.traditional: 嗯，這套淺色的也很好看，妳都試穿一下吧！
text.simplified: 嗯，这套浅色的也很好看，你都试穿一下吧！
text.pinyin: Ēn, zhè tào qiǎnsè de yě hěn hǎokàn, nǐ dōu shìchuān yíxià ba!
text.english: Mm, this light-colored outfit looks nice too. Go ahead and try them both on!

text.traditional: （芳草先試穿了深藍色的洋裝後）
text.simplified: （芳草先试穿了深蓝色的洋装后）
text.pinyin: (Fāngcǎo xiān shìchuān le shēn lánsè de yángzhuāng hòu)
text.english: (After Fangcao tries on the navy dress)

text.traditional: 不錯喔！妳的個子高，穿起洋裝來挺好看的。
text.simplified: 不错喔！你的个子高，穿起洋装来挺好看的。
text.pinyin: Búcuò o! Nǐ de gèzi gāo, chuān qǐ yángzhuāng lái tǐng hǎo kàn de.
text.english: Not bad! You're tall, so you look quite nice wearing a dress.

text.traditional: 是挺好看的。不過，價錢有點兒貴，樣子也太正式了，恐怕平常沒什麼機會穿。我再試穿那件淺色的吧！
text.simplified: 是挺好看的。不过，价钱有点儿贵，样子也太正式了，恐怕平常没什么机会穿。我再试穿那件浅色的吧！
text.pinyin: Shì tǐng hǎo kàn de. Búguò, jiàqián yǒudiǎnr guì, yàngzi yě tài zhèngshì le, kǒngpà píngcháng méishénme jīhuì chuān. Wǒ zài shìchuān nà jiàn qiǎnsè de ba!
text.english: It does look quite nice. However, the price is a bit steep and the style is too formal; I'm afraid I wouldn't have much chance to wear it normally. Let me try on that light-colored one!

text.traditional: （芳草試穿了淺色的衣服後）
text.simplified: （芳草试穿了浅色的衣服后）
text.pinyin: (Fāngcǎo shìchuān le qiǎnsè de yīfu hòu)
text.english: (After Fangcao tries on the light-colored outfit)

text.traditional: 這件穿起來有點兒緊，而且比剛才那件還要貴。算了，去別家吧。
text.simplified: 这件穿起来有点儿紧，而且比刚才那件还要贵。算了，去别家吧。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiàn chuān qǐlái yǒudiǎnr jǐn, érqiě bǐ gāngcái nà jiàn háiyào guì. Suànle, qù bié jiā ba.
text.english: This one feels a bit tight, and it's even more expensive than the last one. Forget it, let's go somewhere else.

text.traditional: （她們到了B專櫃）
text.simplified: （她们到了B专柜）
text.pinyin: (Tāmen dào le B zhuānguì)
text.english: (They reach Counter B.)

text.traditional: 沒想到這個專櫃的衣服這麼便宜，設計也不錯，難怪顧客這麼多。我看，在這裡找就行了。
text.simplified: 没想到这个专柜的衣服这么便宜，设计也不错，难怪顾客这么多。我看，在这里找就行了。
text.pinyin: Méixiǎngdào zhè ge zhuānguì de yīfu zhème piányí, shèjì yě búcuò, nánguài gùkè zhème duō. Wǒ kàn, zài zhèlǐ zhǎo jiù xíng le.
text.english: I didn't expect the clothes at this counter to be so cheap and well-designed; no wonder there are so many customers. I think finding something here will be fine.

text.traditional: 是比較便宜。不過，我朋友在這裡買過顏色相同的情侶裝，沒穿幾次就破了，最後只好扔掉。
text.simplified: 是比较便宜。不过，我朋友在这里买过颜色相同的情侣装，没穿几次就破了，最后只好扔掉。
text.pinyin: Shì bǐjiào piányí. Búguò, wǒ péngyǒu zài zhèlǐ mǎi guò yánsè xiāngtóng de qínglǚ zhuāng, méi chuān jǐ cì jiù pò le, zuìhòu zhǐhǎo rēngdiào.
text.english: It is cheaper. But a friend of mine bought matching couple's outfits here; after wearing them just a few times they tore, and in the end they had to throw them away.

text.traditional: 我也有差不多的經驗。以前我買過很便宜的牛仔褲，只穿了一天，皮膚就紅起來了，非常不舒服。後來吃了三天的藥才好，真是受不了。
text.simplified: 我也有差不多的经验。以前我买过很便宜的牛仔裤，只穿了一天，皮肤就红起来了，非常不舒服。后来吃了三天的药才好，真是受不了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yě yǒu chàbùduō de jīngyàn. Yǐqián wǒ mǎi guò hěn piányí de niúzǎikù, zhǐ chuān le yì tiān, pífū jiù hóng qǐlái le, fēicháng bù shūfu. Hòulái chī le sān tiān de yào cái hǎo, zhēnshì shòubùliǎo.
text.english: I had a similar experience. I once bought very cheap jeans; after wearing them for just one day, my skin broke out in red and was terribly uncomfortable. I had to take medicine for three days before getting better; it was truly unbearable.

text.traditional: 便宜沒好貨嘛！為了省錢買了品質差的東西，最後吃虧的還是自己。
text.simplified: 便宜没好货嘛！为了省钱买了品质差的东西，最后吃亏的还是自己。
text.pinyin: Piányí méi hǎo huò ma! Wèile shěngqián mǎi le pǐnzhí chà de dōngxi, zuìhòu chīkuī de háishì zìjǐ.
text.english: You get what you pay for! Buying poor-quality things just to save money—in the end, the one who suffers the loss is yourself.

text.traditional: 嗯，說的沒錯。我們還是去別家吧。
text.simplified: 嗯，说的没错。我们还是去别家吧。
text.pinyin: Ēn, shuō de méicuò. Wǒmen háishì qù bié jiā ba.
text.english: Mm, that's so true. Let's go to another shop instead.

text.traditional: （她們到了C專櫃，店員給她們介紹了各式各樣的衣服，還提到今天有打折活動。）
text.simplified: （她们到了C专柜，店员给她们介绍了各式各样的衣服，还提到今天有打折活动。）
text.pinyin: (Tāmen dào le C zhuānguì, diànyuán gěi tāmen jièshào le gèshìgèyàng de yīfu, hái tídào jīntiān yǒu dǎzhé huódòng.)
text.english: (They reach Counter C. The clerk shows them all kinds of clothes and mentions a sale today.)

text.traditional: 我覺得這個專櫃什麼都好，就是價格高了很多。
text.simplified: 我觉得这个专柜什么都好，就是价格高了很多。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhè ge zhuānguì shénme dōu hǎo, jiùshì jiàgé gāo le hěn duō.
text.english: I feel everything at this counter is great, except the prices are much higher.

text.traditional: 沒關係，專櫃小姐一直強調他們的衣服平時不打折，只有今天打六折，可以省不少錢喔！
text.simplified: 没关系，专柜小姐一直强调他们的衣服平时不打折，只有今天打六折，可以省不少钱喔！
text.pinyin: Méiguānxi, zhuānguì xiǎojiě yìzhí qiángdiào tāmen de yīfu píngshí bù dǎzhé, zhǐyǒu jīntiān dǎ liù zhé, kěyǐ shěng bùshǎo qián o!
text.english: That's fine; the sales clerk kept emphasizing that their clothes are usually not discounted, and only today they are 40% off—you can save quite a bit of money!

text.traditional: 真的嗎？那我趕快找找合適的。
text.simplified: 真的吗？那我赶快找找合适的。
text.pinyin: Zhēnde ma? Nà wǒ gǎnkuài zhǎo zhǎo héshì de.
text.english: Really? Then I'll quickly look for something suitable.

text.traditional: （芳草試穿了一件洋裝後）
text.simplified: （芳草试穿了一件洋装后）
text.pinyin: (Fāngcǎo shìchuān le yí jiàn yángzhuāng hòu)
text.english: (After Fangcao tries on a dress)

text.traditional: 這件我很滿意，肩膀的大小也沒問題。妳覺得呢？
text.simplified: 这件我很满意，肩膀的大小也没问题。你觉得呢？
text.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wǒ hěn mǎnyì, jiānbǎng de dàxiǎo yě méi wèntí. Nǐ juéde ne?
text.english: I'm very satisfied with this one, and the shoulder fit is fine. What do you think?

text.traditional: 嗯，好看。參加婚禮或是平常上課穿都很合適。
text.simplified: 嗯，好看。参加婚礼或是平常上课穿都很合适。
text.pinyin: Ēn, hǎokàn. Cānjiā hūnlǐ huòshì píngcháng shàngkè chuān dōu hěn héshì.
text.english: Mm, looks good. It would work well both for a wedding and for wearing to class every day.

text.traditional: 是啊，而且打了折就便宜多了。我還看到好幾件漂亮的外套、長褲，趁今天打折的好機會，我要多買幾件給我的姊妹。
text.simplified: 是啊，而且打了折就便宜多了。我还看到好几件漂亮的外套、长裤，趁今天打折的好机会，我要多买几件给我的姊妹。
text.pinyin: Shì a, érqiě dǎ le zhé jiù piányí duō le. Wǒ hái kàndào hǎojǐ jiàn piàoliàng de wàitào, chángkù, chèn jīntiān dǎzhé de hǎo jīhuì, wǒ yào duō mǎi jǐ jiàn gěi wǒ de jiěmèi.
text.english: Yeah, and with the discount it's much cheaper. I also saw several pretty jackets and trousers; taking advantage of today's discount opportunity, I want to buy a few more for my sisters.

text.traditional: （芳草又選了一件外套，兩件襯衫。）
text.simplified: （芳草又选了一件外套，两件衬衫。）
text.pinyin: (Fāngcǎo yòu xuǎn le yí jiàn wàitào, liǎng jiàn chènshān.)
text.english: (Fangcao also picks out a jacket and two shirts.)

text.traditional: 好了，好了，別再買了，妳還要去看球鞋呢！
text.simplified: 好了，好了，别再买了，你还要去看球鞋呢！
text.pinyin: Hǎo le, hǎo le, bié zài mǎi le, nǐ hái yào qù kàn qiúxié ne!
text.english: All right, all right, don't buy any more; you still have to go look at sneakers!

text.traditional: 好好好，我就買這幾件。
text.simplified: 好好好，我就买这几件。
text.pinyin: Hǎo hǎo hǎo, wǒ jiù mǎi zhè jǐ jiàn.
text.english: Okay okay, I'll just buy these few pieces.

text.traditional: （付錢的時候）
text.simplified: （付钱的时候）
text.pinyin: (Fù qián de shíhòu)
text.english: (When they pay)

text.traditional: 小姐，這是您的發票，您購買的商品如果有任何問題，七天以內都可以換。
text.simplified: 小姐，这是您的发票，您购买的商品如果有任何问题，七天以内都可以换。
text.pinyin: Xiǎojiě, zhè shì nín de fāpiào, nín gòumǎi de shāngpǐn rúguǒ yǒu rènhé wèntí, qī tiān yǐnèi dōu kěyǐ huàn.
text.english: Miss, here is your receipt; if there are any issues with your purchased merchandise, you can exchange them within seven days.

text.traditional: 好的，謝謝妳。
text.simplified: 好的，谢谢你。
text.pinyin: Hǎo de, xièxie nǐ.
text.english: Great, thank you.

text.traditional: （她們離開專櫃後）
text.simplified: （她们离开专柜后）
text.pinyin: (Tāmen líkāi zhuānguì hòu)
text.english: (After they leave the counter)

text.traditional: 這個專櫃的小姐真體貼，不但用漂亮的紙把衣服包起來，還很小心地放進袋子裡。像她那樣的服務態度，讓我覺得很滿意。
text.simplified: 这个专柜的小姐真体贴，不但用漂亮的纸把衣服包起来，还很小心地放进袋子里。像她那样的服务态度，让我觉得很满意。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge zhuānguì de xiǎojiě zhēn tǐtiē, búdàn yòng piàoliàng de zhǐ bǎ yīfu bāo qǐlái, hái hěn xiǎoxīn de fàng jìn dàizi lǐ. Xiàng tā nàyàng de fúwù tàidù, ràng wǒ juéde hěn mǎnyì.
text.english: The sales assistant at this counter is so thoughtful; she not only wrapped the clothes in nice paper, but also put them carefully into the bag. Service like hers makes me feel very satisfied.

text.traditional: 這就是「貨比三家不吃虧」的道理啊！還好我們看了三家，又比了比價錢、品質，要不然恐怕花了錢還不開心呢！
text.simplified: 这就是「货比三家不吃亏」的道理啊！还好我们看了三家，又比了比价钱、品质，要不然恐怕花了钱还不开心呢！
text.pinyin: Zhè jiù shì “huòbǐsānjiā bù chīkuī” de dàolǐ a! Háihǎo wǒmen kàn le sān jiā, yòu bǐ le bǐ jiàqián, pǐnzhí, yàobùrán kǒngpà huā le qián hái bù kāixīn ne!
text.english: That's the logic of "shopping around won't hurt"! Luckily we visited three counters and compared the price and quality, otherwise we might have spent money and ended up unhappy!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say not only one thing but also another, mostly in writing, with 不僅……，還/也/而且…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「不僅」當連接詞，有「不但」的意思，多用在書面，後面的分句句首用「還、也、而且」。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不僅……，也/還/而且……

patternTable.title: Conjunction 不僅 (Not Only ..., But Also)

text.traditional: 購物時要多看幾家店，不僅要比一比價格，還要比一比品質。
text.simplified: 购物时要多看几家店，不仅要比一比价格，还要比一比品质。
text.pinyin: Gòuwù shí yào duō kàn jǐ jiā diàn, bù jǐn yào bǐ yì bǐ jiàgé, hái yào bǐ yì bǐ pǐnzhí.
text.english: When you go shopping, you should look around at several stores, not only to compare prices but also to compare quality.

text.traditional: 謝先生不僅性格開朗，工作也很認真、負責，所以同事都很喜歡他。
text.simplified: 谢先生不仅性格开朗，工作也很认真、负责，所以同事都很喜欢他。
text.pinyin: Xiè xiānshēng bù jǐn xìnggé kāilǎng, gōngzuò yě hěn rènzhēn, fùzé, suǒyǐ tóngshì dōu hěn xǐhuān tā.
text.english: Mr. Xie not only has a cheerful personality but is also very hardworking and responsible at work, so all his colleagues like him.

text.traditional: 照華人的傳統，除夕當天不僅要打掃、貼春聯，而且家人要在一起吃年夜飯。
text.simplified: 照华人的传统，除夕当天不仅要打扫、贴春联，而且家人要在一起吃年夜饭。
text.pinyin: Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng, chúxī dāngtiān bù jǐn yào dǎsǎo, tiē chūnlián, érqiě jiārén yào zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn.
text.english: According to Chinese tradition, on Lunar New Year's Eve you not only have to clean the house and put up spring couplets, but the family also has to get together for New Year's Eve dinner.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using 不僅……也/還…… in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 不僅 is used as a conjunction connective, which means the same as 不但. It is mostly used in writing. The beginning of the following clauses starts with 還, 也, 而且.
summary: 不僅 means the same as 不但, and it is mostly used in writing.
The second part starts with 還, 也 or 而且 to add more.
Don't use 但是 after 不僅.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: It Won't Hurt to Shop Around
grammarPages.titleTraditional: NP 一 M 比一 M + Vs（了）
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Each One More … Than the Last
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say something keeps getting hotter, better or worse, day by day or one after another, with 一M比一M + adjective (天氣一天比一天熱了).
grammarPages.explanation: 說明事物或情況的程度逐漸變化。例如：天氣一天比一天熱了。
grammarPages.pattern: Topic + 一 + Measure word + 比 + 一 + Measure word + Adjective (+ 了)

text.traditional: 那裡的商品常常是一樣比一樣便宜。
text.simplified: 那里的商品常常是一样比一样便宜。
text.pinyin: Nàlǐ de shāngpǐn chángcháng shì yí yàng bǐ yí yàng piányí.
text.english: There, each item is often cheaper than the last.

text.traditional: 這個學期王小明很用功，考試的成績也一次比一次進步了。
text.simplified: 这个学期王小明很用功，考试的成绩也一次比一次进步了。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge xuéqí Wáng Xiǎomíng hěn yònggōng, kǎoshì de chéngjī yě yí cì bǐ yí cì jìnbù le.
text.english: Wang Xiaoming has been working hard this semester, and his test scores have gotten better each time.

text.traditional: 這個地區因為工廠越來越多的關係，空氣一年比一年差了。
text.simplified: 这个地区因为工厂越来越多的关系，空气一年比一年差了。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge dìqū yīnwèi gōngchǎng yuè lái yuè duō de guānxì, kōngqì yì nián bǐ yì nián chà le.
text.english: Because there are more and more factories in this area, the air has gotten worse year after year.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Practice using NP 一M比一M + Vs (了) in context.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Choose the correct phrase to complete the sentence.
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This sentence structure explains that the degree of a thing or situation changes gradually. For example, 天氣一天比一天熱了。
summary: This pattern says a degree changes step by step, as in 一天比一天熱了.
Put 比 between the two measure words, then the adjective.
Don't drop 比: 一樣一樣 only shows things one after another, with no comparison.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 比價 · Comparing Prices
grammarFocus: NP 一 M 比一 M + Vs（了）

text.traditional: 華人常說「貨比三家不吃虧」，意思是購物時要多看幾家店，不僅要比一比價格，還要比一比品質。這樣才能買得開心、用得放心。
text.simplified: 华人常说「货比三家不吃亏」，意思是购物时要多看几家店，不仅要比一比价格，还要比一比品质。这样才能买得开心、用得放心。
text.pinyin: Huárén cháng shuō “huòbǐsānjiā bù chīkuī”, yìsi shì gòuwù shí yào duō kàn jǐ jiā diàn, bù jǐn yào bǐ yì bǐ jiàgé, hái yào bǐ yì bǐ pǐnzhí. Zhèyàng cái néng mǎi de kāixīn, yòng de fàngxīn.
text.english: Chinese people often say "compare prices at three stores so you won't suffer a loss," meaning that when shopping one should check out several shops, comparing not only prices but also quality. Only in this way can one buy happily and use with peace of mind.

text.traditional: 在臺灣，只要一提到買便宜的東西，大家就會想到夜市或地攤。那裡的商品常常是一樣比一樣便宜。攤販都努力地向客人推銷，希望客人把錢從口袋裡拿出來、把商品都帶走。不過有的客人非常聰明，完全沒忘記品質和價格一樣重要，不管攤販在他們面前說什麼，都不會糊里糊塗地亂買。他們會把每個攤子都看一看、找一找，想辦法買到實在又優惠的商品。
text.simplified: 在台湾，只要一提到买便宜的东西，大家就会想到夜市或地摊。那里的商品常常是一样比一样便宜。摊贩都努力地向客人推销，希望客人把钱从口袋里拿出来、把商品都带走。不过有的客人非常聪明，完全没忘记品质和价格一样重要，不管摊贩在他们面前说什么，都不会糊里糊涂地乱买。他们会把每个摊子都看一看、找一找，想办法买到实在又优惠的商品。
text.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, zhǐyào yì tídào mǎi piányí de dōngxi, dàjiā jiù huì xiǎngdào yèshì huò dìtān. Nàlǐ de shāngpǐn chángcháng shì yí yàng bǐ yí yàng piányí. Tānfàn dōu nǔlì de xiàng kèrén tuīxiāo, xīwàng kèrén bǎ qián cóng kǒudài lǐ ná chū lái, bǎ shāngpǐn dōu dài zǒu. Búguò yǒude kèrén fēicháng cōngmíng, wánquán méi wàngjì pǐnzhí hàn jiàgé yíyàng zhòngyào, bùguǎn tānfàn zài tāmen miànqián shuō shénme, dōu bú huì húlǐhútú de luàn mǎi. Tāmen huì bǎ měi ge tānzi dōu kàn yí kàn, zhǎo yì zhǎo, xiǎng bànfǎ mǎi dào shízài yòu yōuhuì de shāngpǐn.
text.english: In Taiwan, whenever buying cheap things is mentioned, everyone thinks of night markets or street stalls. There, each item is often cheaper than the last. Vendors strive to pitch to customers, hoping they will take money out of their pockets and take merchandise away. However, some customers are very smart and never forget that quality is as important as price; no matter what vendors say to them, they never buy blindly or foolishly. They inspect and search every stall to figure out how to purchase solid and discounted goods.

text.traditional: 以購物習慣來說，一般人除了去商店、超市買東西，網路購物也早就流行了。網路商店提供各式各樣的商品，從碗筷、雨傘、行李箱等生活用品，到電腦、廚房、露營等的設備都找得到，也看得到價格和生產地區，所以網路購物能幫我們節省不少比價和交通的時間。
text.simplified: 以购物习惯来说，一般人除了去商店、超市买东西，网路购物也早就流行了。网路商店提供各式各样的商品，从碗筷、雨伞、行李箱等生活用品，到电脑、厨房、露营等的设备都找得到，也看得到价格和生产地区，所以网路购物能帮我们节省不少比价和交通的时间。
text.pinyin: Yǐ gòuwù xíguàn lái shuō, yìbānrén chúle qù shāngdiàn, chāoshì mǎi dōngxi, wǎnglù gòuwù yě zǎojiù liúxíng le. Wǎnglù shāngdiàn tígōng gèshìgèyàng de shāngpǐn, cóng wǎn kuài, yǔsǎn, xínglǐxiāng děng shēnghuó yòngpǐn, dào diànnǎo, chúfáng, lùyíng děng de shèbèi dōu zhǎo de dào, yě kàn de dào jiàgé hàn shēngchǎn dìqū, suǒyǐ wǎnglù gòuwù néng bāng wǒmen jiéshěng bùshǎo bǐjià hàn jiāotōng de shíjiān.
text.english: In terms of shopping habits, besides going to stores and supermarkets, most people have long been shopping online too. Online stores offer all kinds of goods: from daily necessities like bowls, chopsticks, umbrellas, and luggage, to equipment for computers, kitchens, and camping. Prices and places of manufacture can all be checked, so online shopping saves us a lot of time on price comparison and commuting.

text.traditional: 其實不管採用哪一種購物方式，都有它的優點和缺點。只有想清楚自己到底需要什麼，仔細地讀商品說明，認真地比價格、比品質，這樣才是聰明顧客的最佳選擇。就算眼光很高的人，也保證能夠買到滿意的商品。
text.simplified: 其实不管采用哪一种购物方式，都有它的优点和缺点。只有想清楚自己到底需要什么，仔细地读商品说明，认真地比价格、比品质，这样才是聪明顾客的最佳选择。就算眼光很高的人，也保证能够买到满意的商品。
text.pinyin: Qíshí bùguǎn cǎiyòng nǎ yì zhǒng gòuwù fāngshì, dōu yǒu tā de yōudiǎn hàn quēdiǎn. Zhǐyǒu xiǎng qīngchǔ zìjǐ dàodǐ xūyào shénme, zǐxì de dú shāngpǐn shuōmíng, rènzhēn de bǐ jiàgé, bǐ pǐnzhí, zhèyàng cái shì cōngmíng gùkè de zuìjiā xuǎnzé. Jiùsuàn yǎnguāng hěn gāo de rén, yě bǎozhèng nénggòu mǎi dào mǎnyì de shāngpǐn.
text.english: In reality, no matter which shopping method one adopts, each has its advantages and disadvantages. Only by clearly knowing what you really need, carefully reading product descriptions, and seriously comparing price and quality can you make the smart customer's optimal choice. Even those with very discerning tastes are guaranteed to find satisfactory products.

dialogue.title: 對話 · 孩子滿月了 · One Month Old
grammarFocus: V 來 V 去，還是……

text.traditional: 嗨，芳草，好久沒見。這瓶葡萄酒送妳。
text.simplified: 嗨，芳草，好久没见。这瓶葡萄酒送你。
text.pinyin: Hāi, Fāngcǎo, hǎojiǔ méi jiàn. Zhè píng pútáojiǔ sòng nǐ.
text.english: Hi, Fangcao, long time no see. This bottle of wine is for you.

text.traditional: 快進來！人來就好了，別這麼客氣。請坐，請坐。妳知道佳琳生了一對雙胞胎吧？
text.simplified: 快进来！人来就好了，别这么客气。请坐，请坐。你知道佳琳生了一对双胞胎吧？
text.pinyin: Kuài jìn lái! Rén lái jiù hǎo le, bié zhème kèqì. Qǐng zuò, qǐng zuò. Nǐ zhīdào Jiālín shēng le yí duì shuāngbāotāi ba?
text.english: Come on in! Just having you come is enough; don't be so polite. Please sit down, please sit down. You know Jialin had a pair of twins, right?

text.traditional: 上星期就知道了。我一聽到這個好消息，就立刻打電話恭喜她了，她說孩子又乖又可愛，可是很擔心一下子要養兩個會很辛苦。等小孩滿月那天，我們一起去看她吧。
text.simplified: 上星期就知道了。我一听到这个好消息，就立刻打电话恭喜她了，她说孩子又乖又可爱，可是很担心一下子要养两个会很辛苦。等小孩满月那天，我们一起去看她吧。
text.pinyin: Shàng xīngqí jiù zhīdào le. Wǒ yì tīngdào zhè ge hǎo xiāoxí, jiù lìkè dǎ diànhuà gōngxǐ tā le, tā shuō háizi yòu guāi yòu kě'ài, kěshì hěn dānxīn yíxiàzi yào yǎng liǎng ge huì hěn xīnkǔ. Děng xiǎohái mǎnyuè nà tiān, wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn tā ba.
text.english: I found out last week. As soon as I heard the good news, I immediately called to congratulate her. She said the babies are both well-behaved and cute, but she's worried that raising two all at once will be very tough. When the babies reach their full month, let's go visit her together.

text.traditional: 好啊。我也想看看那對雙胞胎，也許能抱抱他們。妳想送什麼禮物祝福他們？
text.simplified: 好啊。我也想看看那对双胞胎，也许能抱抱他们。你想送什么礼物祝福他们？
text.pinyin: Hǎo a. Wǒ yě xiǎng kànkan nà duì shuāngbāotāi, yěxǔ néng bàobao tāmen. Nǐ xiǎng sòng shénme lǐwù zhùfú tāmen?
text.english: Sure. I also want to see that pair of twins, and maybe get to hold them. What gift do you want to give to bless them?

text.traditional: 我前兩天到百貨公司選了兩件衣服。（拿出手機）妳看，就是這兩件。
text.simplified: 我前两天到百货公司选了两件衣服。（拿出手机）你看，就是这两件。
text.pinyin: Wǒ qián liǎng tiān dào bǎihuò gōngsī xuǎn le liǎng jiàn yīfu. (Ná chū shǒujī) Nǐ kàn, jiùshì zhè liǎng jiàn.
text.english: Two days ago I went to the department store and picked out two pieces of clothing. (Takes out cell phone) Look, it's these two.

text.traditional: 好可愛的衣服啊！我呢，想來想去，還是決定送紅包，可是不知道滿月的紅包要包多少。
text.simplified: 好可爱的衣服啊！我呢，想来想去，还是决定送红包，可是不知道满月的红包要包多少。
text.pinyin: Hǎo kě'ài de yīfu a! Wǒ ne, xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng sòng hóngbāo, kěshì bù zhīdào mǎnyuè de hóngbāo yào bāo duōshǎo.
text.english: What cute clothes! As for me, after thinking back and forth, I still decided to give a red envelope, but I don't know how much to put in for a full-month red envelope.

text.traditional: 送紅包這個主意不錯。包多少，要看妳們的關係怎麼樣。不過錢的數字一定得是雙數，而且不可以有「四」喔！
text.simplified: 送红包这个主意不错。包多少，要看你们的关系怎么样。不过钱的数字一定得是双数，而且不可以有「四」喔！
text.pinyin: Sòng hóngbāo zhè ge zhǔyì búcuò. Bāo duōshǎo, yào kàn nǐmen de guānxì zěnmeyàng. Búguò qián de shùzì yídìng děi shì shuāngshù, érqiě bù kěyǐ yǒu “sì” o!
text.english: Giving a red envelope is a good idea. How much to give depends on your relationship. But the amount must be an even number, and definitely cannot contain "four"!
