text.english: Exactly; my sister said so too.

text.traditional: 你姊姊這次去非洲，還是一個人去嗎？有個人陪比較好吧。
text.simplified: 你姊姊这次去非洲，还是一个人去吗？有个人陪比较好吧。
text.pinyin: Nǐ jiějie zhè cì qù Fēizhōu, háishì yígerén qù ma? Yǒu ge rén péi bǐjiào hǎo ba.
text.english: Is your sister going to Africa by herself again this time? It might be better to have someone accompany her.

text.traditional: 她早就習慣一個人旅行了，想去哪裡就去哪裡，不必在意別人的想法。再說，她的旅行經驗這麼豐富，一個人去絕對沒問題的。像規劃行程、辦簽證，上網查當地的氣溫、地形等等，對她來說，都是小事。
text.simplified: 她早就习惯一个人旅行了，想去哪里就去哪里，不必在意别人的想法。再说，她的旅行经验这么丰富，一个人去绝对没问题的。像规划行程、办签证，上网查当地的气温、地形等等，对她来说，都是小事。
text.pinyin: Tā zǎojiù xíguàn yígerén lǚxíng le, xiǎng qù nǎlǐ jiù qù nǎlǐ, búbì zàiyì biérén de xiǎngfǎ. Zàishuō, tā de lǚxíng jīngyàn zhème fēngfù, yígerén qù juéduì méi wèntí de. Xiàng guīhuà xíngchéng, bàn qiānzhèng, shàngwǎng chá dāngdì de qìwēn, dìxíng děngděng, duì tā lái shuō, dōu shì xiǎoshì.
text.english: She's long used to solo travel: going wherever she wants without having to care about others' opinions. Besides, with her rich travel experience, going alone is no problem at all. Planning itineraries, applying for visas, checking the local temperatures and terrain online—to her, these are all easy.

text.traditional: 這麼說，不管她想去哪裡，沒有去不成的？
text.simplified: 这么说，不管她想去哪里，没有去不成的？
text.pinyin: Zhème shuō, bùguǎn tā xiǎng qù nǎlǐ, méiyǒu qù bù chéng de?
text.english: So that means, wherever she wants to go, there's nowhere she can't make it to?

text.traditional: 是啊。我姊姊有背包客的性格，她認為只有走出舒服的生活環境，才能發現不一樣的自己。
text.simplified: 是啊。我姊姊有背包客的性格，她认为只有走出舒服的生活环境，才能发现不一样的自己。
text.pinyin: Shì a. Wǒ jiějie yǒu bēibāokè de xìnggé, tā rènwéi zhǐyǒu zǒuchū shūfu de shēnghuó huánjìng, cáinéng fāxiàn bù yíyàng de zìjǐ.
text.english: Yeah. My sister has the spirit of a backpacker; she believes only by stepping out of one's comfort zone can one discover a different self.

text.traditional: 難怪你姊姊的背包客日記，內容總是那麼吸引人。
text.simplified: 难怪你姊姊的背包客日记，内容总是那么吸引人。
text.pinyin: Nánguài nǐ jiějie de bēibāokè rìjì, nèiróng zǒngshì nàme xīyǐn rén.
text.english: No wonder her backpacker diary is always so captivating.

text.traditional: 對了，你不是剛跟女朋友分開了嗎？要是你因為失戀而覺得很痛苦，就當個背包客出去走走吧。
text.simplified: 对了，你不是刚跟女朋友分开了吗？要是你因为失恋而觉得很痛苦，就当个背包客出去走走吧。
text.pinyin: Duìle, nǐ búshì gāng gēn nǚpéngyǒu fēnkāi le ma? Yàoshì nǐ yīnwèi shīliàn ér juéde hěn tòngkǔ, jiù dāng ge bēibāokè chūqù zǒuzǒu ba.
text.english: By the way, didn't you just break up with your girlfriend? If you're hurting from the heartbreak, why not go on a backpacking trip to clear your head?

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Only… and Already… / Just… and Right Away…
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something happened surprisingly soon or with surprisingly little, or right after something else, with 才……就…….
grammarPages.explanation:
(1)「才……（，）就……」：「才」在這裡強調時間短、不久，或是數量少、次數少、程度低，後面和「就」一起使用；「就」的後面表示接著出現的事實，但是說話的人對這樣的情況感到驚訝。例如：你不是很餓嗎？怎麼才吃一碗就飽了？這句話的意思是，說話的人覺得你應該要吃兩、三碗，只吃一碗太少了。
(2)「才……（，）就……」：「才」是「剛剛」的意思，表示「才」後面的事情剛發生，「就」後面的事情是緊接著發生的。例如：我才出門就下雨了。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish:
才……（，）就……: 才 here emphasizes that the time is short, or the number is small, the frequency is less often, and the level is low. 才 is used together with 就 in the second part to indicate the fact that follows, but the speaker feels surprised with this situation. For example, 你不是很餓嗎？怎麼才吃一碗飯就飽了？ The meaning of this sentence is that the speaker thinks that you should eat two or three bowls, but only one bowl is not enough!
才……（，）就……: 才 means "just now", which means that the action described after 才 just happened, and the action described after 就 happened immediately afterwards. For example, 我才出門就下雨了。
grammarPages.pattern: 才 + small amount / just-done action（，）就 + what follows

text.traditional: 我們本來計畫旅行十天，可惜才六天就結束了。
text.simplified: 我们本来计划旅行十天，可惜才六天就结束了。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen běnlái jìhuà lǚxíng shí tiān, kěxí cái liù tiān jiù jiéshù le.
text.english: We had planned a ten-day trip, but unfortunately it was over after only six days.

text.traditional: 小馬的工作能力很強，生意越做越大，才二十幾歲就已經是三家公司的老闆了。
text.simplified: 小马的工作能力很强，生意越做越大，才二十几岁就已经是三家公司的老板了。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng, shēngyì yuè zuò yuè dà, cái èrshíjǐ suì jiù yǐjīng shì sān jiā gōngsī de lǎobǎn le.
text.english: Xiao Ma is very capable at work and his business keeps growing; he is only in his twenties and is already the boss of three companies.

text.traditional: 弟弟才剛畢業就立刻找到了一份好工作，運氣真好。
text.simplified: 弟弟才刚毕业就立刻找到了一份好工作，运气真好。
text.pinyin: Dìdi cái gāng bìyè jiù lìkè zhǎodào le yí fèn hǎo gōngzuò, yùnqì zhēn hǎo.
text.english: My younger brother had just graduated and immediately found a good job; he is really lucky.

text.traditional: 你才剛從歐洲旅行回來，就開始安排去非洲旅遊的計畫，不累嗎？
text.simplified: 你才刚从欧洲旅行回来，就开始安排去非洲旅游的计划，不累吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ cái gāng cóng Ōuzhōu lǚxíng huílái, jiù kāishǐ ānpái qù Fēizhōu lǚyóu de jìhuà, bú lèi ma?
text.english: You have just come back from a trip to Europe and already you are planning a trip to Africa; aren't you tired?

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Use 才 and 就 to show a quick or small result.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Complete the dialogues and answer the situations.
summary: 才……就…… shows surprise that a short time or small amount already gives a result, as in 才吃一碗就飽了.
才 can also mean just now, and the 就 part happens right after it, as in 我才出門就下雨了.
剛……就…… only says it just happened, without the surprise.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add a different opinion or return to the main point with 話說回來.
grammarPages.explanation: 跟別人對話時，說話的人雖然不反對對方的說法，但是，自己有不同的意見或更有道理的想法，這個時候就可以在「話說回來」的後面說明。也可以使用「話說回來」把談話的主題拉回來，並表達對這個話題最主要的意見。「話說回來」前面常加「不過、可是、但是」等詞。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 話說回來 is used when talking to others. Although the person speaking does not oppose the other person's ideas, he still has different opinions or more reasonable ideas. At this time, he can use 話說回來 then explain his opinion. 話說回來 can also be used to return to the topic of the conversation and express the most basic opinions on this topic. The words 不過, 可是 or 但是 are often added in front of 話說回來.
grammarPages.pattern: （不過／可是／但是）話說回來，……

text.traditional: ……不過話說回來，就是因為不確定會碰到什麼，所以旅行才這麼迷人。
text.simplified: ……不过话说回来，就是因为不确定会碰到什么，所以旅行才这么迷人。
text.pinyin: …Búguò huàshuō huílái, jiùshì yīnwèi bú quèdìng huì pèngdào shénme, suǒyǐ lǚxíng cái zhème mírén.
text.english: …But then again, it is precisely because you never know what you will run into that travel is so fascinating.

text.traditional:
A：上網找資料不僅方便，還可以找到其他相關的資料。
B：是啊。不過話說回來，網路上的資料不一定都是對的。
text.simplified:
A：上网找资料不仅方便，还可以找到其他相关的资料。
B：是啊。不过话说回来，网路上的资料不一定都是对的。
text.pinyin:
A: Shàngwǎng zhǎo zīliào bù jǐn fāngbiàn, hái kěyǐ zhǎodào qítā xiāngguān de zīliào.
B: Shì a. Búguò huàshuō huílái, wǎnglù shàng de zīliào bùyídìng dōu shì duì de.
text.english:
A: Looking things up online is not only convenient, but you can also find other related information.
B: True. But then again, not everything online is necessarily correct.

text.traditional:
A：住在捷運站附近，方便是方便，不過噪音太大，讓我沒辦法好好休息。
B：可是話說回來，你不是說方便比什麼都重要，所以才搬到那裡去住的嗎？
text.simplified:
A：住在捷运站附近，方便是方便，不过噪音太大，让我没办法好好休息。
B：可是话说回来，你不是说方便比什么都重要，所以才搬到那里去住的吗？
text.pinyin:
A: Zhù zài jiéyùn zhàn fùjìn, fāngbiàn shì fāngbiàn, búguò zàoyīn tài dà, ràng wǒ méibànfǎ hǎohǎo xiūxí.
B: Kěshì huàshuō huílái, nǐ búshì shuō fāngbiàn bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào, suǒyǐ cái bān dào nàlǐ qù zhù de ma?
text.english:
A: Living near the MRT station is convenient, but the noise is too loud and I can't rest properly.
B: But then again, didn't you say convenience matters more than anything, which is why you moved there?

grammarPages.exerciseTitle: Complete the dialogues and answer the situations.
grammarPages.exercisePreview: Use 話說回來 to add a point of your own.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Complete the dialogues and answer the situations.
summary: Use 話說回來 when you don't oppose what the other person said but have a different or better idea.
It can also bring the talk back to the topic and give your main opinion.
Put 不過, 可是 or 但是 before it.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: So, Based on What You Said…
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Draw a conclusion from what the other person just said with 這麼說.
grammarPages.explanation: 「這麼說」是「按照你說的情況來看」的意思。「這麼說」的後面是說話的人根據對方說的內容，表達自己的推斷。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 這麼說 means 如果按照你說的情況來看(If, according to what you have said...). After 這麼說, the speaker expresses his own inferences based on what the other party has said.
grammarPages.pattern: 這麼說，+ conclusion from what the other person said

text.traditional:
東賢：……對她來說，都是小事。
明哲：這麼說，不管她想去哪裡，沒有去不成的？
text.simplified:
东贤：……对她来说，都是小事。
明哲：这么说，不管她想去哪里，没有去不成的？
text.pinyin:
Dōngxián:… Duì tā lái shuō, dōu shì xiǎoshì.
Míngzhé: Zhèmeshuō, bùguǎn tā xiǎng qù nǎlǐ, méiyǒu qù bù chéng de?
text.english:
Dongxian: …To her, these are all small matters.
Mingzhe: So, from what you're saying, no matter where she wants to go, there's nowhere she can't make it to?

text.traditional:
A：小張的雙胞胎孩子快滿月了。
B：這麼說，他會請同事吃油飯和紅蛋了。
text.simplified:
A：小张的双胞胎孩子快满月了。
B：这么说，他会请同事吃油饭和红蛋了。
text.pinyin:
A: Xiǎo Zhāng de shuāngbāotāi háizi kuài mǎnyuè le.
B: Zhèmeshuō, tā huì qǐng tóngshì chī yóufàn hé hóngdàn le.
text.english:
A: Xiao Zhang's twins are almost a month old.
B: So he'll be treating his colleagues to glutinous oil rice and red eggs.

text.traditional:
A：氣象預報說，強烈颱風明天會經過臺灣東北部，民眾出門時得小心。
B：這麼說，明天可能會放颱風假喔！
text.simplified:
A：气象预报说，强烈台风明天会经过台湾东北部，民众出门时得小心。
B：这么说，明天可能会放台风假喔！
text.pinyin:
A: Qìxiàng yùbào shuō, qiángliè táifēng míngtiān huì jīngguò Táiwān dōngběi bù, mínzhòng chūmén shí děi xiǎoxīn.
B: Zhèmeshuō, míngtiān kěnéng huì fàng táifēng jià o!
text.english:
A: The weather forecast says a strong typhoon will pass through northeastern Taiwan tomorrow, so people should be careful when going out.
B: So tomorrow may be a typhoon day off!

grammarPages.exerciseTitle: Complete the dialogues and answer the situations.
grammarPages.exercisePreview: Use 這麼說 to draw a conclusion from what was said.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Complete the dialogues and answer the situations.
summary: 這麼說 means going by what the other person just said.
The speaker then gives their own guess drawn from it.
這麼說 starts the reply. 也就是說 is different: it restates the same meaning in other words.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Verb + 成 (Completed / Not Completed / Possible / Impossible)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether an action was completed or whether it is possible with V 成.
grammarPages.explanation: 「成」是結果補語，有成功、完成、實現的意思。「V 成」表示動作已經完成、實現了；「沒 V 成」表示沒有完成、實現，用在已經發生的情況；「V 得成」、「V 不成」表示有或沒有完成、實現的可能性。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 成 is the result complement, with the meaning of success, completion, and realization. V 成 means that the action has been completed or realized; 沒 V 成 means that the action has not been completed or accomplished. V 得成, V 不成 means the possibility of completion or realization is uncertain.
grammarPages.pattern: V 成 / 沒 V 成 / V 得成 / V 不成

text.traditional: ……不管她想去哪裡，沒有去不成的？
text.simplified: ……不管她想去哪里，没有去不成的？
text.pinyin: …Bùguǎn tā xiǎng qù nǎlǐ, méiyǒu qù bù chéng de?
text.english: …No matter where she wants to go, there's nowhere she can't make it to?

text.traditional: 氣象預報說明天下雨的機會是百分之九十，明天的跨年活動恐怕辦不成了。
text.simplified: 气象预报说明天下雨的机会是百分之九十，明天的跨年活动恐怕办不成了。
text.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào shuō míngtiān xiàyǔ de jīhuì shì bǎifēnzhī jiǔshí, míngtiān de kuànián huódòng kǒngpà bàn bù chéng le.
text.english: The weather forecast says there's a 90 percent chance of rain tomorrow, so I'm afraid tomorrow's New Year's Eve event can't go ahead.

text.traditional: 我們跟那家大公司的生意，今天終於談成了，老闆要請大家吃大餐，慶祝一下。
text.simplified: 我们跟那家大公司的生意，今天终于谈成了，老板要请大家吃大餐，庆祝一下。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen gēn nà jiā dà gōngsī de shēngyì, jīntiān zhōngyú tán chéng le, lǎobǎn yào qǐng dàjiā chī dàcān, qìngzhù yíxià.
text.english: We finally closed the deal with that big company today; the boss will treat everyone to a big meal to celebrate.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Use 成 to show completion, failure, or possibility.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Complete the sentences with V 成, 沒 V 成, V 得成 or V 不成.
summary: 成 after a verb is the result of the action and means it succeeded or was done.
V 成 means it was done. 沒 V 成 means it didn't get done, for something that already happened.
V 得成 and V 不成 say it is possible or not possible to get done.

dialogue.title: 馬丁的環島旅行

text.traditional: 馬丁的好兄弟尚恩在臺灣學習中文，他常寄臺灣的明信片給馬丁。明信片上有的是有名的景點，像臺北101、太魯閣、孔廟；有的是臺灣文化的代表，像寺廟、歌仔戲、夜市小吃等等。
text.simplified: 马丁的好兄弟尚恩在台湾学习中文，他常寄台湾的明信片给马丁。明信片上有的是有名的景点，像台北101、太鲁阁、孔庙；有的是台湾文化的代表，像寺庙、歌仔戏、夜市小吃等等。
text.pinyin: Mǎdīng de hǎo xiōngdì Shàng'ēn zài Táiwān xuéxí Zhōngwén, tā cháng jì Táiwān de míngxìnpiàn gěi Mǎdīng. Míngxìnpiàn shàng yǒude shì yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn, xiàng Táiběi 101, Tàilǔgé, Kǒngmiào; yǒude shì Táiwān wénhuà de dàibiǎo, xiàng sìmiào, Gēzǐxì, yèshì xiǎochī děngděng.
text.english: Martin's close pal Shawn was studying Chinese in Taiwan and often mailed Taiwan postcards to Martin. Some depicted famous attractions like Taipei 101, Taroko Gorge, and the Confucius Temple; others represented Taiwanese culture, such as temples, Taiwanese opera, and night market snacks.

text.traditional: 馬丁常聽尚恩提到跟臺灣相關的事。比如，臺灣曾經是荷蘭和日本等國家的殖民地；臺灣人和中國人都說中文，可是有一些詞的用法不太一樣；就選舉文化來說，臺灣和法國很不同，不過願意服務民眾的人，都比較容易當選。
text.simplified: 马丁常听尚恩提到跟台湾相关的事。比如，台湾曾经是荷兰和日本等国家的殖民地；台湾人和中国人都说中文，可是有一些词的用法不太一样；就选举文化来说，台湾和法国很不同，不过愿意服务民众的人，都比较容易当选。
text.pinyin: Mǎdīng cháng tīng Shàng'ēn tídào gēn Táiwān xiāngguān de shì. Bǐrú, Táiwān céngjīng shì Hélán hé Rìběn děng guójiā de zhímíndì; Táiwān rén hé Zhōngguó rén dōu shuō Zhōngwén, kěshì yǒu yìxiē cí de yòngfǎ bú tài yíyàng; jiù xuǎnjǔ wénhuà lái shuō, Táiwān hé Fǎguó hěn bùtóng, búguò yuànyì fúwù mínzhòng de rén, dōu bǐjiào róngyì dāngxuǎn.
text.english: Martin often heard Shawn mention matters regarding Taiwan. For example, Taiwan had once been a colony of the Netherlands and Japan; both Taiwanese and mainland Chinese speak Chinese, but certain word usages differ; in terms of election culture, Taiwan and France are very different, though those willing to serve the public are more likely to get elected.

text.traditional: 馬丁覺得尚恩在臺灣的生活很有意思，他想，有一天一定要親自來確認一下，看看這個島是不是真的像尚恩說的那樣有意思。最近馬丁的工作不太順利，所以他決定給自己放個假，到離法國約一萬公里以外的臺灣走走。不僅要嚐嚐小吃，還計畫一個人騎自行車環島旅行。
text.simplified: 马丁觉得尚恩在台湾的生活很有意思，他想，有一天一定要亲自来确认一下，看看这个岛是不是真的像尚恩说的那样有意思。最近马丁的工作不太顺利，所以他决定给自己放个假，到离法国约一万公里以外的台湾走走。不仅要尝尝小吃，还计划一个人骑自行车环岛旅行。
text.pinyin: Mǎdīng juéde Shàng'ēn zài Táiwān de shēnghuó hěn yǒuyìsi, tā xiǎng, yǒu yì tiān yídìng yào qīnzì lái quèrèn yíxià, kànkan zhè ge dǎo shì bú shì zhēnde xiàng Shàng'ēn shuō de nàyàng yǒuyìsi. Zuìjìn Mǎdīng de gōngzuò bú tài shùnlì, suǒyǐ tā juédìng gěi zìjǐ fàng ge jià, dào lí Fǎguó yuē yíwàn gōnglǐ yǐwài de Táiwān zǒuzǒu. Bù jǐn yào cháng cháng xiǎochī, hái jìhuà yígerén qí zìxíngchē huándǎo lǚxíng.
text.english: Martin found Shawn's life in Taiwan fascinating and thought that one day he must come and see for himself whether this island was really as interesting as Shawn said. Recently Martin's work wasn't going smoothly, so he decided to take a holiday and visit Taiwan, some 10,000 kilometers away from France. He planned not only to taste local snacks, but also to cycle around the island alone.

text.traditional: 其實馬丁剛到臺灣時，還忘不了工作的問題，所以心情不太好。但是，當他在東部又寬又平的公路上，邊騎著自行車，邊欣賞美麗的風景時，他忽然覺得就像在天堂一樣，太美好、太值得了！還有一次，馬丁坐在凳子上，很專心地看著寺廟前的歌仔戲表演。演員演出時，剛好穿著和明信片上一樣的服裝，那種熟悉的感覺讓他很興奮，立刻拿起相機拍了起來。這段時間他也認識了一些樂觀、幽默的朋友，大家一起聊天、開玩笑，讓他開心得把工作的問題都忘了。馬丁覺得在臺灣經驗過的這些美好生活，就是這次旅行最珍貴的紀念。
text.simplified: 其实马丁刚到台湾时，还忘不了工作的问题，所以心情不太好。但是，当他在东部又宽又平的公路上，边骑着自行车，边欣赏美丽的风景时，他忽然觉得就像在天堂一样，太美好、太值得了！还有一次，马丁坐在凳子上，很专心地看着寺庙前的歌仔戏表演。演员演出时，刚好穿着和明信片上一样的服装，那种熟悉的感觉让他很兴奋，立刻拿起相机拍了起来。这段时间他也认识了一些乐观、幽默的朋友，大家一起聊天、开玩笑，让他开心得把工作的问题都忘了。马丁觉得在台湾经验过的这些美好生活，就是这次旅行最珍贵的纪念。
text.pinyin: Qíshí Mǎdīng gāng dào Táiwān shí, hái wàng bùliǎo gōngzuò de wèntí, suǒyǐ xīnqíng bú tài hǎo. Dànshì, dāng tā zài dōngbù yòu kuān yòu píng de gōnglù shàng, biān qí zhe zìxíngchē, biān xīnshǎng měilì de fēngjǐng shí, tā hūrán juéde jiù xiàng zài tiāntáng yíyàng, tài měihǎo, tài zhídé le! Háiyǒu yí cì, Mǎdīng zuò zài dèngzi shàng, hěn zhuānxīn de kàn zhe sìmiào qián de Gēzǐxì biǎoyǎn. Yǎnyuán yǎnchū shí, gānghǎo chuān zhe hé míngxìnpiàn shàng yíyàng de fúzhuāng, nà zhǒng shóuxī de gǎnjué ràng tā hěn xīngfèn, lìkè ná qǐ xiàngjī pāi le qǐlái. Zhè duàn shíjiān tā yě rènshì le yìxiē lèguān, yōumò de péngyǒu, dàjiā yìqǐ liáotiān, kāiwánxiào, ràng tā kāixīn de bǎ gōngzuò de wèntí dōu wàngle. Mǎdīng juéde zài Táiwān jīngyàn guò de zhèxiē měihǎo shēnghuó, jiùshì zhè cì lǚxíng zuì zhēnguì de jìniàn.
text.english: Actually when Martin first arrived, he couldn't put his work problems out of his mind and was in a low mood. But as he cycled along wide flat highways in eastern Taiwan while admiring the breathtaking scenery, he suddenly felt like he was in paradise—it was wonderful and so worthwhile! Another time, sitting on a stool, he watched a Taiwanese opera performance in front of a temple attentively. The actors were dressed in the exact costumes shown on the postcards; that familiar feeling thrilled him, and he immediately snapped photos. During this trip he also befriended optimistic, humorous companions; chatting and joking together made him so happy that he forgot all his work problems. Martin felt these wonderful experiences were the most precious souvenirs of the trip.

text.traditional: 經過這趟豐富的旅行後，馬丁的心情好多了，想法也改變了。回到法國後，到底要換新工作，還是要克服困難勇敢走下去，他相信自己一定能做出最佳選擇，讓生活過得更充實、更有意義。
text.simplified: 经过这趟丰富的旅行后，马丁的心情好多了，想法也改变了。回到法国后，到底要换新工作，还是要克服困难勇敢走下去，他相信自己一定能做出最佳选择，让生活过得更充实、更有意义。
text.pinyin: Jīngguò zhè tàng fēngfù de lǚxíng hòu, Mǎdīng de xīnqíng hǎo duō le, xiǎngfǎ yě gǎibiàn le. Huí dào Fǎguó hòu, dàodǐ yào huàn xīn gōngzuò, háishì yào kèfú kùnnán yǒnggǎn zǒu xiàqù, tā xiāngxìn zìjǐ yídìng néng zuòchū zuìjiā xuǎnzé, ràng shēnghuó guò de gèng chōngshí, gèng yǒu yìyì.
text.english: After this enriching journey, Martin felt much better and his outlook shifted. After returning to France, would he change jobs, or overcome the difficulties and bravely carry on? He was confident he could make the best choice and make his life fuller and more meaningful.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Limit a comment to one topic or area with 就……來說, mostly in writing.
grammarPages.explanation: 「就……來說」常用在書面，「就」有針對的意思。主要針對某個對象或某個範圍來敘述或分析。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 就……來說 is often used in written Chinese. 就 has a targeted meaning, used mainly to describe or analyze a certain object or a certain range.
grammarPages.pattern: 就 + topic + 來說，+ comment

text.traditional: 就選舉文化來說，臺灣和法國很不同……
text.simplified: 就选举文化来说，台湾和法国很不同……
text.pinyin: Jiù xuǎnjǔ wénhuà láishuō, Táiwān hé Fǎguó hěn bùtóng…
text.english: As for election culture, Taiwan and France are very different…

text.traditional: 就購物的方式來說，使用網路不僅方便，比價也容易多了。
text.simplified: 就购物的方式来说，使用网路不仅方便，比价也容易多了。
text.pinyin: Jiù gòuwù de fāngshì láishuō, shǐyòng wǎnglù bù jǐn fāngbiàn, bǐjià yě róngyì duō le.
text.english: As for the way we shop, using the internet is not only convenient, but comparing prices is also much easier.

text.traditional: 就我們中文系的課程來說，不僅一學期比一學期難，報告也越來越多了。
text.simplified: 就我们中文系的课程来说，不仅一学期比一学期难，报告也越来越多了。
text.pinyin: Jiù wǒmen Zhōngwén xì de kèchéng láishuō, bù jǐn yì xuéqí bǐ yì xuéqí nán, bàogào yě yuèláiyuè duō le.
text.english: As for the courses in our Chinese department, not only does each semester get harder than the last, but there are also more and more reports.

grammarPages.exerciseTitle: Complete the dialogues and answer the situations.
grammarPages.exercisePreview: Use 就……來說 to narrow a comment to one area.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Complete the dialogues and answer the situations.
summary: 就……來說 looks at one thing or one area to describe or analyze it, mostly in writing.
對……來說 gives one person's view. 就……來說 looks at a topic or standard.
Keep 來說 in the pattern. Don't use 看 in its place.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: V / Vs + 得 + Result or Degree
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say how far an action or state goes, often with an exaggerated result, using V/Vs 得.
grammarPages.explanation: 「得」的後面是補語，說明「得」前面的動作(V)，或是前面的狀態(Vs)達到什麼樣的程度。「得」後面表示結果，可以使用誇張的詞語或短句加以說明。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: Words after 得 ard complements. 得 explains the level of the action (V) or the state (Vs) in front of 得 to show the result. It can be expressed using exaggeration or short sentences.
grammarPages.pattern: V/Vs + 得 + result (often exaggerated)

text.traditional: ……讓他開心得把工作的問題都忘了。
text.simplified: ……让他开心得把工作的问题都忘了。
text.pinyin: …Ràng tā kāixīn de bǎ gōngzuò de wèntí dōu wàngle.
text.english: …It made him so happy that he forgot all his work problems.

text.traditional: 我在那家吃到飽餐廳一連吃了四個小時，吃得我都站不起來了。
text.simplified: 我在那家吃到饱餐厅一连吃了四个小时，吃得我都站不起来了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài nà jiā chīdàobǎo cāntīng yìlián chī le sì ge xiǎoshí, chī de wǒ dōu zhàn bù qǐlái le.
text.english: I ate at that all-you-can-eat restaurant for four hours straight; I ate so much I could not even stand up.

text.traditional: 那家包子店的生意好得不得了，店員忙得沒時間吃飯、上廁所。
text.simplified: 那家包子店的生意好得不得了，店员忙得没时间吃饭、上厕所。
text.pinyin: Nà jiā bāozi diàn de shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo, diànyuán máng de méi shíjiān chīfàn, shàng cèsuǒ.
text.english: That bun shop does such good business that the staff are too busy to eat or use the toilet.

grammarPages.exercisePreview: Use 得 to show how far an action or state goes.
grammarPages.exerciseInstruction: Complete the sentences with 得.
summary: 得 comes after a verb or adjective, and what follows tells how far the action or state goes.
What follows 得 can be an exaggerated word or a short sentence.
Use 得, not 的, for this.

dialogue.title: 穿著和品味
grammarFocus: S 把 NP1 + V 成 NP2

text.traditional: 朋子，妳最近穿衣服的風格跟以前很不一樣，名牌衣服怎麼不穿了呢？
text.simplified: 朋子，你最近穿衣服的风格跟以前很不一样，名牌衣服怎么不穿了呢？
text.pinyin: Péngzǐ, nǐ zuìjìn chuān yīfu de fēnggé gēn yǐqián hěn bù yíyàng, míngpái yīfu zěnme bù chuān le ne?
text.english: Tomoko, your clothing style lately is very different from before. How come you don't wear brand-name clothes anymore?

text.traditional: 我想改變別人對我的看法。以前，我的穿著容易讓人產生誤會，以為我是個不好相處的人。
text.simplified: 我想改变别人对我的看法。以前，我的穿着容易让人产生误会，以为我是个不好相处的人。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gǎibiàn biérén duì wǒ de kànfǎ. Yǐqián, wǒ de chuānzhuó róngyì ràng rén chǎnshēng wùhuì, yǐwéi wǒ shì ge bùhǎo xiāngchǔ de rén.
text.english: I want to change what people think of me. In the past, the way I dressed easily gave people the wrong idea; they thought I was hard to get along with.

text.traditional: 說真的，剛認識妳的時候，妳從頭到腳都是名牌，總是覺得我們有一段距離。
text.simplified: 说真的，刚认识你的时候，你从头到脚都是名牌，总是觉得我们有一段距离。
text.pinyin: Shuōzhēnde, gāng rènshì nǐ de shíhòu, nǐ cóng tóu dào jiǎo dōu shì míngpái, zǒngshì juéde wǒmen yǒu yí duàn jùlí.
text.english: Honestly, when I first met you, you wore designer labels from head to toe, and I always felt a distance between us.

text.traditional: 唉！不用說也知道你會這麼想。其實這跟我爸媽有關，他們對穿衣服很講究，也覺得穿名牌才有品味，所以影響了我對穿著的看法。
text.simplified: 唉！不用说也知道你会这么想。其实这跟我爸妈有关，他们对穿衣服很讲究，也觉得穿名牌才有品味，所以影响了我对穿着的看法。
text.pinyin: Āi! Búyòngshuō yě zhīdào nǐ huì zhème xiǎng. Qíshí zhè gēn wǒ bà mā yǒuguān, tāmen duì chuān yīfu hěn jiǎngjiù, yě juéde chuān míngpái cái yǒu pǐnwèi, suǒyǐ yǐngxiǎng le wǒ duì chuānzhuó de kànfǎ.
text.english: Sigh! It goes without saying you'd think that. Actually this has to do with my parents; they are very particular about clothing and feel only designer clothes have taste, so that influenced my view on dressing.

text.traditional: 妳爸媽的朋友，不是大老闆就是政治人物，有這樣的想法很自然啊！合適的穿著對他們很重要，名牌衣服才能表現出他們的地位。
text.simplified: 你爸妈的朋友，不是大老板就是政治人物，有这样的想法很自然啊！合适的穿着对他们很重要，名牌衣服才能表现出他们的地位。
text.pinyin: Nǐ bà mā de péngyǒu, búshì dà lǎobǎn jiùshì zhèngzhì rénwù, yǒu zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ hěn zìrán a! Héshì de chuānzhuó duì tāmen hěn zhòngyào, míngpái yīfu cáinéng biǎoxiàn chū tāmen de dìwèi.
text.english: Your parents' friends are either big bosses or political figures, so having that mindset is quite natural! Appropriate attire is very important for them; designer clothing expresses their status.

text.traditional: 你說的沒錯，可是我還是不希望大家把我看成只愛買名牌的人。
text.simplified: 你说的没错，可是我还是不希望大家把我看成只爱买名牌的人。
text.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de méicuò, kěshì wǒ háishì bù xīwàng dàjiā bǎ wǒ kàn chéng zhǐ ài mǎi míngpái de rén.
text.english: What you said is true, but I still don't want everyone to look at me as someone who only cares about buying luxury brands.

text.traditional: 跟以前比起來，妳現在的穿著更能表現出個人的特色。
text.simplified: 跟以前比起来，你现在的穿着更能表现出个人的特色。
text.pinyin: Gēn yǐqián bǐ qǐ lái, nǐ xiànzài de chuānzhuó gèng néng biǎoxiàn chū gèrén de tèsè.
text.english: Compared to before, your dressing now expresses your personal character much better.

text.traditional: 以前我和朋友聊天的話題，常常是哪些服裝很流行，哪個名牌又請了大明星拍廣告什麼的，現在我只想穿得舒適，又有屬於自己的風格，是不是名牌真的無所謂。
text.simplified: 以前我和朋友聊天的话题，常常是哪些服装很流行，哪个名牌又请了大明星拍广告什么的，现在我只想穿得舒适，又有属于自己的风格，是不是名牌真的无所谓。
text.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ hé péngyǒu liáotiān de huàtí, chángcháng shì nǎxiē fúzhuāng hěn liúxíng, nǎge míngpái yòu qǐng le dà míngxīng pāi guǎnggào shénme de, xiànzài wǒ zhǐ xiǎng chuān de shūshì, yòu yǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de fēnggé, shì bú shì míngpái zhēnde wúsuǒwèi.
text.english: In the past, topics when chatting with friends were often about which clothes were trendy, or which brand hired a celebrity for an ad. Now I just want to dress comfortably and have my own style; whether it's a name brand really doesn't matter.

text.traditional: 一般來說，明星的穿著都會吸引大家注意，所以服裝公司才會花大錢請明星拍廣告，這是正常的商業作法。其實多了解一些流行的現象也沒什麼不好。
text.simplified: 一般来说，明星的穿着都会吸引大家注意，所以服装公司才会花大钱请明星拍广告，这是正常的商业作法。其实多了解一些流行的现象也没什么不好。
text.pinyin: Yìbānláishuō, míngxīng de chuānzhuó dōu huì xīyǐn dàjiā zhùyì, suǒyǐ fúzhuāng gōngsī cái huì huā dà qián qǐng míngxīng pāi guǎnggào, zhè shì zhèngcháng de shāngyè zuòfǎ. Qíshí duō liǎojiě yìxiē liúxíng de xiànxiàng yě méishénme bùhǎo.
text.english: Generally speaking, celebrities' attire draws attention, so apparel companies spend big money to hire stars for commercials; that's a normal commercial practice. Actually, understanding fashion trends isn't a bad thing either.

text.traditional: 嗯，問題是流行的穿著不一定就有品味，再英俊、再漂亮的人也應該找到自己的風格。
text.simplified: 嗯，问题是流行的穿着不一定就有品味，再英俊、再漂亮的人也应该找到自己的风格。
text.pinyin: Ēn, wèntí shì liúxíng de chuānzhuó bù yídìng jiù yǒu pǐnwèi, zài yīngjùn, zài piàoliàng de rén yě yīnggāi zhǎodào zìjǐ de fēnggé.
text.english: Mm, the issue is that trendy dressing doesn't necessarily have good taste. No matter how handsome or pretty someone is, they should still find their own style.

text.traditional: 我同意妳的說法。想穿出自己的風格，可以多看看專櫃跟雜誌上流行的服裝，想像穿在自己身上的樣子。過些時間，就能抓到感覺了。
text.simplified: 我同意你的说法。想穿出自己的风格，可以多看看专柜跟杂志上流行的服装，想像穿在自己身上的样子。过些时间，就能抓到感觉了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ tóngyì nǐ de shuōfǎ. Xiǎng chuān chū zìjǐ de fēnggé, kěyǐ duō kànkan zhuānguì gēn zázhì shàng liúxíng de fúzhuāng, xiǎngxiàng chuān zài zìjǐ shēnshàng de yàngzi. Guò xiē shíjiān, jiù néng zhuā dào gǎnjué le.
text.english: I agree with what you said. If you want to dress with personal style, look at the trendy clothes at brand counters and in magazines, and imagine how they would look on you. After a while, you'll get a feel for it.

text.traditional: 不過也不能只跟著流行，一定要有自己的想法。我有幾個朋友跟我剛好相反，他們不僅天天穿名牌，也常上街買衣服，什麼流行就買什麼，好像花多少錢都沒有限制。
text.simplified: 不过也不能只跟着流行，一定要有自己的想法。我有几个朋友跟我刚好相反，他们不仅天天穿名牌，也常上街买衣服，什么流行就买什么，好像花多少钱都没有限制。
text.pinyin: Búguò yě bùnéng zhǐ gēnzhe liúxíng, yídìng yào yǒu zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ. Wǒ yǒu jǐ ge péngyǒu gēn wǒ gānghǎo xiāngfǎn, tāmen bù jǐn tiāntiān chuān míngpái, yě cháng shàngjiē mǎi yīfu, shénme liúxíng jiù mǎi shénme, hǎoxiàng huā duōshǎo qián dōu méiyǒu xiànzhì.
text.english: Still, one shouldn't just follow trends; you must have your own perspective. I have a few friends who are the exact opposite of me: not only do they wear designer clothes every day, but they often go shopping, buying whatever is trendy, as if there is no spending limit.

text.traditional: 難怪大家都說女孩子的櫃子裡永遠少一件衣服。
text.simplified: 难怪大家都说女孩子的柜子里永远少一件衣服。
text.pinyin: Nánguài dàjiā dōu shuō nǚhái zi de guìzi lǐ yǒngyuǎn shǎo yí jiàn yīfu.
text.english: No wonder everyone says a woman's wardrobe is always missing one piece of clothing.

text.traditional: 我可不是喔！以前，一有新商品我就去買；現在，我了解自己真正的需要是什麼，絕對不會亂買了。
text.simplified: 我可不是喔！以前，一有新商品我就去买；现在，我了解自己真正的需要是什么，绝对不会乱买了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ kě bú shì o! Yǐqián, yì yǒu xīn shāngpǐn wǒ jiù qù mǎi; xiànzài, wǒ liǎojiě zìjǐ zhēnzhèng de xūyào shì shénme, juéduì bú huì luàn mǎi le.
text.english: Not me, though! In the past, as soon as a new product came out I went to buy it; now, I understand what my real needs are, and I definitely won't buy recklessly.

text.traditional: 其實穿衣服也是個學問。名牌衣服，有的人穿起來好看，有的人穿起來可能很醜呢！
text.simplified: 其实穿衣服也是个学问。名牌衣服，有的人穿起来好看，有的人穿起来可能很丑呢！
text.pinyin: Qíshí chuān yīfu yě shì ge xuéwèn. Míngpái yīfu, yǒude rén chuān qǐlái hǎokàn, yǒude rén chuān qǐlái kěnéng hěn chǒu ne!
text.english: Actually, dressing well is a skill in itself. Brand-name clothes look great on some people, but on others they can look quite ugly!

text.traditional: 沒錯。對我來說，只要穿得慣、穿得自在，把自己當衣服的主人，這樣就能對自己更有信心了。
text.simplified: 没错。对我来说，只要穿得惯、穿得自在，把自己当衣服的主人，这样就能对自己更有信心了。
text.pinyin: Méicuò. Duì wǒ lái shuō, zhǐyào chuān de guàn, chuān de zìzài, bǎ zìjǐ dàng yīfu de zhǔrén, zhèyàng jiù néng duì zìjǐ gèng yǒu xìnxīn le.
text.english: Exactly. To me, as long as I feel accustomed and at ease wearing them, treating myself as the master of the clothes, that's how I gain more self-confidence.

text.traditional: 妳本來條件就好，加上穿著又變得這麼有品味，難怪越來越有魅力了。
text.simplified: 你本来条件就好，加上穿着又变得这么有品味，难怪越来越有魅力了。
text.pinyin: Nǐ běnlái tiáojiàn jiù hǎo, jiāshàng chuānzhuó yòu biànde zhème yǒu pǐnwèi, nánguài yuèláiyuè yǒu mèilì le.
text.english: You naturally have great qualities, and now that your attire has become so tasteful, no wonder you're growing more charming by the day.

text.traditional: 別開玩笑了，你的品味比我更好呢！
text.simplified: 别开玩笑了，你的品味比我更好呢！
text.pinyin: Bié kāiwánxiào le, nǐ de pǐnwèi bǐ wǒ gèng hǎo ne!
text.english: Stop joking, your taste is even better than mine!

grammarPages.titleTraditional: S 把 NP₁ + V 成 NP₂
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Turn A into B / Mistake A for B
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say how someone transforms one thing into another, or mistakes one thing for another.
grammarPages.explanation: 「成」有「成為」、「變成」的意思。表示某人經由某個動作，讓 NP₁ 成為或變成 NP₂。如果動詞是「看、聽、說、寫、念」，有時有「弄錯了」的意思。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 把 + NP1 + Verb + 成 + NP2

text.traditional: ……我還是不希望大家把我看成只愛買名牌的人。
text.simplified: ……我还是不希望大家把我看成只爱买名牌的人。
text.pinyin: …Wǒ háishì bù xīwàng dàjiā bǎ wǒ kànchéng zhǐ ài mǎi míngpái de rén.
text.english: …I still don't want people to see me as someone who only loves buying brand names.

text.traditional: 那本有名的英國小說，十年前就有人把它翻成了二十種語言，而且還拍成了電影。
text.simplified: 那本有名的英国小说，十年前就有人把它翻成了二十种语言，而且还拍成了电影。
text.pinyin: Nà běn yǒumíng de Yīngguó xiǎoshuō, shí nián qián jiù yǒurén bǎ tā fān chéng le èrshí zhǒng yǔyán, érqiě hái pāi chéng le diànyǐng.
text.english: Ten years ago, someone had already translated that famous British novel into twenty languages, and it had even been made into a film.

text.traditional: 阿姨把穿不下的舊衣服，修改成非常流行的帽子和袋子。
text.simplified: 阿姨把穿不下的旧衣服，修改成非常流行的帽子和袋子。
text.pinyin: Āyí bǎ chuān bú xià de jiù yīfu, xiūgǎi chéng fēicháng liúxíng de màozi hé dàizi.
text.english: My aunt altered the old clothes she could no longer fit into, turning them into very trendy hats and bags.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 成 has the meaning of "becoming" and "changing to". It means that someone makes NP₁ or becomes NP₂ through a certain action. If the verb is 看, 聽, 說, 寫, 念, sometimes 成 means "to get something wrong".
grammarPages.titleSimplified: S 把 NP1 + V 成 NP2
summary: 把 plus the first noun, verb, 成 and the second noun says someone turns one thing into another.
把旅行的經驗寫成一本書 means turning travel experiences into a book.
After 看, 聽, 說, 寫 or 念, 成 sometimes means you got it wrong, as in 看成.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that however extreme something gets, the result or your decision stays the same, with 再……也/都…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「再……也/都……」使用在假設的情況，有「就算……，也……」的意思（這個語法在本冊第一課）。「再」後面的句子是把情況說到最高或最低、最好或最壞的程度，而「也」或「都」後面的結果、決定或是想法不會改變；有時候表示說話的人覺得應該而且值得這樣做。例如：「再有錢也不可以亂買東西」、「再貴我都要買」、「再辛苦也要忍耐」。
grammarPages.pattern: (Subject) + 再 + adjective / condition + 也/都 + result that stays the same

text.traditional: ……再英俊、再漂亮的人也應該找到自己的風格。
text.simplified: ……再英俊、再漂亮的人也应该找到自己的风格。
text.pinyin: …Zài yīngjùn, zài piàoliàng de rén yě yīnggāi zhǎodào zìjǐ de fēnggé.
text.english: …No matter how handsome or beautiful someone is, they should still find their own style.

text.traditional: 孩子需要父母照顧，父母再忙都應該陪陪他們，了解他們的想法。
text.simplified: 孩子需要父母照顾，父母再忙都应该陪陪他们，了解他们的想法。
text.pinyin: Háizi xūyào fùmǔ zhàogù, fùmǔ zài máng dōu yīnggāi péi péi tāmen, liǎojiě tāmen de xiǎngfǎ.
text.english: Children need care from parents; no matter how busy parents are, they should spend time with them and understand their thoughts.

text.traditional: 為了得到更多經驗，也為了美好的未來，再討厭的工作也得忍耐。
text.simplified: 为了得到更多经验，也为了美好的未来，再讨厌的工作也得忍耐。
text.pinyin: Wèile dédào gèng duō jīngyàn, yě wèile měihǎo de wèilái, zài tǎoyàn de gōngzuò yě děi rěnnài.
text.english: To gain more experience, and for a better future, you have to put up with a job no matter how much you dislike it.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 再……也/都…… is used in a hypothetical situation, with a similar meaning to 就算……，也…… (this grammar is found in the first lesson of this volume). The sentence after 再 refers to the best or worst of a situation, and the result, decision or idea behind 也 or 都 will not change. Sometimes it means that the speaker thinks something should be done and is worth doing. For example, 再有錢也不可以亂買東西, 再貴我都要買, 再辛苦也要忍耐.
summary: 再……，也/都…… takes a situation to the extreme, and the result or decision stays the same.
It means almost the same as 就算……，也……, and the speaker may feel the action is right and worth doing.
Use 再, not 更 or 又, as in 再辛苦也要忍耐.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Getting Used to Something (V慣 / V得慣 / V不慣)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether you are used to doing an action, or can/cannot get accustomed to it.
grammarPages.explanation: 「動詞＋慣」的「慣」有習慣的意思，是結果補語，表示前面動作的結果。例如：他用慣了筷子，連吃西餐也用筷子。如果「慣」的前面加上「得/不」，表示前面的動作能或不能習慣，例如：「這個房間很小，你住得慣嗎？」「我吃不慣別人做的菜，每天都自己做。」
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + (得/不) + 慣 (+ Object)

text.traditional: 對我來說，只要穿得慣、穿得自在，把自己當衣服的主人……
text.simplified: 对我来说，只要穿得惯、穿得自在，把自己当衣服的主人……
text.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, zhǐyào chuān de guàn, chuān de zìzài, bǎ zìjǐ dàng yīfu de zhǔrén…
text.english: For me, as long as I'm used to wearing something and feel at ease in it, and I treat myself as the master of my clothes…

text.traditional: 很多部落格都推薦那家餐廳，不過他們的菜鹹了點兒，我吃不慣。
text.simplified: 很多部落格都推荐那家餐厅，不过他们的菜咸了点儿，我吃不惯。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō bùluògé dōu tuījiàn nà jiā cāntīng, búguò tāmen de cài xián le diǎnr, wǒ chī bú guàn.
text.english: Many blogs recommend that restaurant, but their dishes are a bit too salty; I can't get used to eating them.

text.traditional:
A：老闆要你去英國出差，還可以順便旅遊，為什麼你不太想去？
B：我睡慣了家裡的床，旅館的睡不慣。
text.simplified:
A：老板要你去英国出差，还可以顺便旅游，为什么你不太想去？
B：我睡惯了家里的床，旅馆的睡不惯。
text.pinyin:
A: Lǎobǎn yào nǐ qù Yīngguó chūchāi, hái kěyǐ shùnbiàn lǚyóu, wèishénme nǐ bú tài xiǎng qù?
B: Wǒ shuì guàn le jiālǐ de chuáng, lǚguǎn de shuì bú guàn.
text.english:
A: The boss wants you to go to the UK on a business trip, and you could travel while you're there. Why aren't you very keen to go?
B: I'm used to sleeping in my own bed at home; I can't get used to hotel beds.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The 慣 of "verb + 慣" has the meaning of habit. It is the complement of the result, indicating the result of the previous action. For example, 他用慣了筷子，連吃西餐也用筷子。(He is used to eating with chopsticks, and even uses chopsticks to eat western food). If 慣 is added in front of 得/不, it means that the previous action can or cannot be gotten used to. For example, 這個房間很小，你住得慣嗎？(This room is very small, are you accustomed to living here?) 我吃不慣別人做的菜，每天都自己做。(I'm not used to food prepared by others, so I make it myself every day.)
summary: 慣 after a verb means used to it, as the result of doing it.
Add 得 or 不 to say you can or can't get used to it: 住得慣 and 吃不慣.
Say 吃不慣, not 吃不習慣了.

items.title: Grammar 4–6 · Fast Fashion and Rational Choices

dialogue.title: 快時尚

text.traditional: 東賢以前是模特兒，他曾經和一家服裝公司合作，為推銷新產品拍廣告。廣告播出以後，商品賣得非常好。但是，過不了多久，就有樣式更新、更吸引人的服裝出來了。這種「快時尚」的現象，對民眾的生活產生了很大的影響。
text.simplified: 东贤以前是模特儿，他曾经和一家服装公司合作，为推销新产品拍广告。广告播出以后，商品卖得非常好。但是，过不了多久，就有样式更新、更吸引人的服装出来了。这种「快时尚」的现象，对民众的生活产生了很大的影响。
text.pinyin: Dōngxián yǐqián shì mótèr, tā céngjīng hé yì jiā fúzhuāng gōngsī hézuò, wèi tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn pāi guǎnggào. Guǎnggào bòchū yǐhòu, shāngpǐn mài de fēicháng hǎo. Dànshì, guò bùliǎo duōjiǔ, jiù yǒu yàngshì gèng xīn, gèng xīyǐn rén de fúzhuāng chūlái le. Zhè zhǒng “kuàishíshàng” de xiànxiàng, duì mínzhòng de shēnghuó chǎnshēng le hěn dà de yǐngxiǎng.
text.english: Dongxian was formerly a model; he once collaborated with an apparel firm to film commercials for new product promotions. After the commercial aired, products sold extremely well. However, before long, newer and more attractive styles came out. This phenomenon of fast fashion has profoundly impacted everyday life.

text.traditional: 所謂「快時尚」，意思是服裝公司掌握最新流行的方向，很快把服裝設計、生產出來，讓顧客能趕上流行，也能擁有平價的時尚商品。不過，流行的變化速度太快，越來越多新衣服還沒穿就被丟掉，讓人們不能不思考這樣的時尚有沒有意義。
text.simplified: 所谓「快时尚」，意思是服装公司掌握最新流行的方向，很快把服装设计、生产出来，让顾客能赶上流行，也能拥有平价的时尚商品。不过，流行的变化速度太快，越来越多新衣服还没穿就被丢掉，让人们不能不思考这样的时尚有没有意义。
text.pinyin: Suǒwèi “kuàishíshàng”, yìsi shì fúzhuāng gōngsī zhǎngwò zuìxīn liúxíng de fāngxiàng, hěn kuài bǎ fúzhuāng shèjì, shēngchǎn chūlái, ràng gùkè néng gǎnshàng liúxíng, yě néng yǒngyǒu píngjià de shíshàng shāngpǐn. Búguò, liúxíng de biànhuà sùdù tài kuài, yuèláiyuè duō xīn yīfu háiméi chuān jiù bèi diūdiào, ràng rénmen bùnéngbù sīkǎo zhèyàng de shíshàng yǒu méiyǒu yìyì.
text.english: The so-called fast fashion means apparel companies capture the latest fashion trends and quickly design and manufacture clothes, allowing customers to catch up with trends while owning affordable fashion items. However, fashion trends change so quickly that more and more new clothes are thrown out before being worn, forcing people to reconsider if such fashion holds real meaning.

text.traditional: 因為工作的需求，東賢的衣櫃裡掛著各式各樣的「快時尚」服裝。平時他不覺得有什麼問題，等到搬家時，才發現衣服這麼多，處理起來真的很麻煩。有的連一次也沒穿過，可是已經不流行了，到底要留下來、送人還是丟掉，讓東賢相當頭痛。他不得不承認，「快時尚」也是有壞處的。
text.simplified: 因为工作的需求，东贤的衣柜里挂着各式各样的「快时尚」服装。平时他不觉得有什么问题，等到搬家时，才发现衣服这么多，处理起来真的很麻烦。有的连一次也没穿过，可是已经不流行了，到底要留下来、送人还是丢掉，让东贤相当头痛。他不得不承认，「快时尚」也是有坏处的。
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi gōngzuò de xūqiú, Dōngxián de yīguì lǐ guà zhe gèshìgèyàng de “kuàishíshàng” fúzhuāng. Píngshí tā bù juéde yǒu shénme wèntí, děngdào bānjiā shí, cái fāxiàn yīfu zhème duō, chǔlǐ qǐlái zhēnde hěn máfán. Yǒude lián yí cì yě méi chuān guò, kěshì yǐjīng bù liúxíng le, dàodǐ yào liú xià lái, sòng rén háishì diūdiào, ràng Dōngxián xiāngdāng tóutòng. Tā bùdébù chéngrèn, “kuàishíshàng” yě shì yǒu huàichù de.
text.english: Due to job needs, Dongxian's closet was hung with all kinds of fast-fashion garments. Ordinarily he felt no issue, but when moving, he realized there were so many clothes and sorting them out was genuinely troublesome. Some hadn't even been worn once, yet were already out of style; whether to keep, gift, or toss them gave Dongxian a huge headache. He had to admit that fast fashion also has its downsides.

text.traditional: 過去，東賢對穿著不太有自信，也很擔心跟不上流行，所以才不斷地追求時尚。現在，他比較冷靜了，他要當衣服的主人，不再為了趕流行亂買衣服。況且把舊衣服修改一下，也能使自己穿得很有個性、很有品味，所以在東賢心中，沒有什麼是非買不可的。畢竟「快時尚」只是一時的流行，長得再帥、再漂亮的人，也應該找出屬於自己最合適的穿著，這樣才是正確的選擇。
text.simplified: 过去，东贤对穿着不太有自信，也很担心跟不上流行，所以才不断地追求时尚。现在，他比较冷静了，他要当衣服的主人，不再为了赶流行乱买衣服。况且把旧衣服修改一下，也能使自己穿得很有个性、很有品味，所以在东贤心中，没有什么是非买不可的。毕竟「快时尚」只是一时的流行，长得再帅、再漂亮的人，也应该找出属于自己最合适的穿着，这样才是正确的选择。
text.pinyin: Guòqù, Dōngxián duì chuānzhuó bú tài yǒu zìxìn, yě hěn dānxīn gēnbúshàng liúxíng, suǒyǐ cái búduàn de zhuīqiú shíshàng. Xiànzài, tā bǐjiào lěngjìng le, tā yào dāng yīfu de zhǔrén, bú zài wèile gǎn liúxíng luàn mǎi yīfu. Kuàngqiě bǎ jiù yīfu xiūgǎi yíxià, yě néng shǐ zìjǐ chuān de hěn yǒu gèxìng, hěn yǒu pǐnwèi, suǒyǐ zài Dōngxián xīnzhōng, méiyǒu shénme shì fēi mǎi bùkě de. Bìjìng “kuàishíshàng” zhǐshì yìshí de liúxíng, zhǎng de zài shuài, zài piàoliàng de rén, yě yīnggāi zhǎochū shǔyú zìjǐ zuì héshì de chuānzhuó, zhèyàng cái shì zhèngquè de xuǎnzé.
text.english: In the past, Dongxian lacked confidence in dressing and constantly feared falling behind trends, which drove him to chase fashion non-stop. Now he has calmed down; he wants to be the master of his clothes and no longer buys thoughtlessly to chase fads. Moreover, modifying old clothes can also allow one to dress with distinction and taste, so in his mind, nothing is an absolute must-buy. After all, fast fashion is merely a temporary fad; no matter how handsome or pretty one is, finding the attire that truly suits oneself is the right choice.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add one more reason to make your point or decision stronger with 況且.
grammarPages.explanation: 「況且」當連詞，表示更進一層的語氣，用來補充說明，讓理由更完整。常和「也、還、又」配合使用。
grammarPages.pattern: Primary Reason，況且 + (Subject) + 也/還/又 + Further Reason

text.traditional: ……不再為了趕流行亂買衣服。況且把舊衣服修改一下……
text.simplified: ……不再为了赶流行乱买衣服。况且把旧衣服修改一下……
text.pinyin: …Bú zài wèile gǎn liúxíng luàn mǎi yīfu. Kuàngqiě bǎ jiù yīfu xiūgǎi yíxià…
text.english: …He no longer buys clothes on impulse just to keep up with trends. Moreover, by altering old clothes a little…

text.traditional: 爸爸要我將來管理他的公司，可是我沒興趣，況且我還有自己的夢想，所以不想去。
text.simplified: 爸爸要我将来管理他的公司，可是我没兴趣，况且我还有自己的梦想，所以不想去。
text.pinyin: Bàba yào wǒ jiānglái guǎnlǐ tā de gōngsī, kěshì wǒ méi xìngqù, kuàngqiě wǒ hái yǒu zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng, suǒyǐ bù xiǎng qù.
text.english: My dad wants me to run his company in the future, but I'm not interested; moreover, I have dreams of my own, so I don't want to.

text.traditional:
兒子：我畢業後想當導演，拍出好電影來讓大家欣賞。
爸爸：你是學電影藝術的，況且也寫過劇本、當過演員，可以嘗試一下。
text.simplified:
儿子：我毕业后想当导演，拍出好电影来让大家欣赏。
爸爸：你是学电影艺术的，况且也写过剧本、当过演员，可以尝试一下。
text.pinyin:
Érzi: Wǒ bìyè hòu xiǎng dāng dǎoyǎn, pāi chū hǎo diànyǐng lái ràng dàjiā xīnshǎng.
Bàba: Nǐ shì xué diànyǐng yìshù de, kuàngqiě yě xiě guò jùběn, dāng guò yǎnyuán, kěyǐ chángshì yíxià.
text.english:
Son: After graduating I want to be a director and make good films for everyone to enjoy.
Dad: You studied film art; moreover, you have written scripts and acted, so you could give it a try.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 況且 is used as a conjunction to indicate a more advanced tone, to supplement the explanation and make the reasoning more complete. Often used in conjunction with 也, 還, 又.
summary: 況且 adds a further reason after the main reason, to make the reasoning fuller.
It often goes with 也, 還 or 又.
Put 況且 before the second reason, not the first. Use 況且, not 但是.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something simply has to be done and there is no other choice, with 非……不可.
grammarPages.explanation: 「非」是「不」的意思，「非……不可」表示一定得做某件事，沒有其他選擇。「非」的後面加動詞或動詞短語。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 非 + Action / Verb Phrase + 不可

text.traditional: ……在東賢心中，沒有什麼是非買不可的。
text.simplified: ……在东贤心中，没有什么是非买不可的。
text.pinyin: …Zài Dōngxián xīnzhōng, méiyǒu shénme shì fēi mǎi bùkě de.
text.english: …In Dongxian's mind, there is nothing he absolutely has to buy.

text.traditional: 他在衝浪時，牙齒被衝浪板打到了，血流個不停，非去看醫生不可。
text.simplified: 他在冲浪时，牙齿被冲浪板打到了，血流个不停，非去看医生不可。
text.pinyin: Tā zài chōnglàng shí, yáchǐ bèi chōnglàngbǎn dǎ dào le, xiě liú ge bùtíng, fēi qù kàn yīshēng bùkě.
text.english: While he was surfing, the surfboard hit him in the teeth and he kept bleeding, so he absolutely had to see a doctor.

text.traditional: 舅舅不小心把明天結婚要穿的衣服弄髒了，非立刻送洗不可。
text.simplified: 舅舅不小心把明天结婚要穿的衣服弄脏了，非立刻送洗不可。
text.pinyin: Jiùjiu bù xiǎoxīn bǎ míngtiān jiéhūn yào chuān de yīfu nòng zāng le, fēi lìkè sòng xǐ bùkě.
text.english: My uncle accidentally got the clothes for his wedding tomorrow dirty, so they absolutely have to go to the cleaner's right away.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 非 means 不, so 非……不可 means that something must be done, and there is no other choice. 非 is followed with a verb or verb phrase.
summary: 非……不可 means you must do something and have no other choice.
非 means 不, and a verb or verb phrase comes after it.
Put 非 before the whole action, as in 非向他道歉不可, and 不可 at the end.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Remind or convince someone by pointing out the key fact behind a situation with 畢竟.
grammarPages.explanation: 「畢竟」後面的句子是經過思考分析後的結論，用來說明事情的關鍵，目的是提醒或說服對方。例如：雖然中文不太好學，不過，那畢竟是我自己的選擇。
grammarPages.pattern: Statement，（不過）+ 畢竟 + key fact

text.traditional: ……沒有什麼是非買不可的。畢竟「快時尚」只是一時的流行……
text.simplified: ……没有什么是非买不可的。毕竟「快时尚」只是一时的流行……
text.pinyin: …Méiyǒu shénme shì fēi mǎi bùkě de. Bìjìng “kuàishíshàng” zhǐshì yìshí de liúxíng…
text.english: …There is nothing he absolutely has to buy. After all, "fast fashion" is only a passing trend…

text.traditional: 你要女兒學鋼琴，又要學跳舞，對她的要求太高了，畢竟她才三歲。
text.simplified: 你要女儿学钢琴，又要学跳舞，对她的要求太高了，毕竟她才三岁。
text.pinyin: Nǐ yào nǚ'ér xué gāngqín, yòu yào xué tiàowǔ, duì tā de yāoqiú tài gāo le, bìjìng tā cái sān suì.
text.english: You want your daughter to learn piano and dancing; your demands on her are too high—after all, she's only three.

text.traditional:
先生：這個星期很忙，週末也得加班，沒辦法陪妳去逛街了。
太太：你最好別再加班了，畢竟人不是機器，要是忙得沒時間休息一定會生病的。
text.simplified:
先生：这个星期很忙，周末也得加班，没办法陪你去逛街了。
太太：你最好别再加班了，毕竟人不是机器，要是忙得没时间休息一定会生病的。
text.pinyin:
Xiānshēng: Zhège xīngqí hěn máng, zhōumò yě děi jiābān, méibànfǎ péi nǐ qù guàngjiē le.
Tàitai: Nǐ zuìhǎo bié zài jiābān le, bìjìng rén búshì jīqì, yàoshì máng de méi shíjiān xiūxí yídìng huì shēngbìng de.
text.english:
Husband: This week is very busy, I have to work overtime on the weekend too, so I can't go shopping with you.
Wife: You'd better stop working overtime; after all, people aren't machines, and if you're too busy to rest you'll surely get sick.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The sentence after 畢竟 is the conclusion after thinking and analysis, used to explain the key point of the matter, and the purpose is to remind or convince the other party. For example, 雖然中文不太好學，不過，那畢竟是我自己的選擇。(Although Chinese is not easy to learn, it is my own choice after all.)
summary: 畢竟 is followed by a conclusion after thinking, which gives the key point of the matter.
The speaker uses it to remind or persuade the other person.
Put 畢竟 before the key point, not after it. 究竟 doesn't work here.

dialogue.title: 誰說得念大學才有未來？

text.traditional: 恭喜你弟弟參加網球比賽得到了第一名。好久沒看到他了，他最近怎麼樣？
text.simplified: 恭喜你弟弟参加网球比赛得到了第一名。好久没看到他了，他最近怎么样？
text.pinyin: Gōngxǐ nǐ dìdi cānjiā wǎngqiú bǐsài dédào le dìyī míng. Hǎojiǔ méi kàndào tā le, tā zuìjìn zěnmeyàng?
text.english: Congratulations on your younger brother taking first place in the tennis tournament! I haven't seen him in a while; how has he been lately?

text.traditional: 他忙著準備今年的大學考試，總是睡得不太安心，半夜會突然醒過來。
text.simplified: 他忙着准备今年的大学考试，总是睡得不太安心，半夜会突然醒过来。
text.pinyin: Tā mángzhe zhǔnbèi jīnnián de dàxué kǎoshì, zǒngshì shuì de bú tài ānxīn, bànyè huì túrán xǐng guòlái.
text.english: He's busy preparing for this year's college entrance exams. He never sleeps restfully and often wakes up suddenly in the middle of the night.

text.traditional: 記得你說過，你弟弟學習和運動的表現都很好。我想只要心情放輕鬆就沒問題了。
text.simplified: 记得你说过，你弟弟学习和运动的表现都很好。我想只要心情放轻松就没问题了。
text.pinyin: Jìde nǐ shuō guò, nǐ dìdi xuéxí hé yùndòng de biǎoxiàn dōu hěn hǎo. Wǒ xiǎng zhǐyào xīnqíng fàng qīngsōng jiù méi wèntí le.
text.english: I remember you said your brother performs well in both academics and sports. I think as long as he stays relaxed, he'll be fine.

text.traditional: 問題是，我爸媽希望他能考上前三名的大學，不是打球得第一，他們要求他把全部的時間都拿來準備考試。可是我弟弟覺得打球不會影響他念書，他們還因為這件事吵了一架。
text.simplified: 问题是，我爸妈希望他能考上前三名的大学，不是打球得第一，他们要求他把全部的时间都拿来准备考试。可是我弟弟觉得打球不会影响他念书，他们还因为这件事吵了一架。
text.pinyin: Wèntí shì, wǒ bà mā xīwàng tā néng kǎo shàng qián sān míng de dàxué, búshì dǎqiú dé dìyī, tāmen yāoqiú tā bǎ quánbù de shíjiān dōu nálái zhǔnbèi kǎoshì. Kěshì wǒ dìdi juéde dǎqiú bú huì yǐngxiǎng tā niànshū, tāmen hái yīnwèi zhè jiàn shì chǎo le yí jià.
text.english: The problem is that my parents hope he can test into a top-three university rather than placing first in ball games; they demand he devote all his time to exam prep. But my brother believes playing ball won't hurt his studies, and they even had a big argument over this.

text.traditional: 哦？你弟弟的運動成績那麼好，我以為你爸媽會為他高興。
text.simplified: 哦？你弟弟的运动成绩那么好，我以为你爸妈会为他高兴。
text.pinyin: Ó? Nǐ dìdi de yùndòng chéngjī nàme hǎo, wǒ yǐwéi nǐ bà mā huì wèi tā gāoxìng.
text.english: Oh? Your brother's athletic achievements are so stellar; I thought your parents would be thrilled for him.

text.traditional: 他們是很高興，可是現在要考大學，情況就不同了。我曾經有一次，考試前想跟同學去露營，爸媽知道了就罵我：「快考試了，怎麼不在家念書，反而想出去玩？」不管我怎麼解釋他們都不聽，讓我難過了半天。
text.simplified: 他们是很高兴，可是现在要考大学，情况就不同了。我曾经有一次，考试前想跟同学去露营，爸妈知道了就骂我：「快考试了，怎么不在家念书，反而想出去玩？」不管我怎么解释他们都不听，让我难过了半天。
text.pinyin: Tāmen shì hěn gāoxìng, kěshì xiànzài yào kǎo dàxué, qíngkuàng jiù bùtóng le. Wǒ céngjīng yǒu yí cì, kǎoshì qián xiǎng gēn tóngxué qù lùyíng, bà mā zhīdào le jiù mà wǒ: “Kuài kǎoshì le, zěnme bú zài jiā niànshū, fǎn'ér xiǎng chū qù wán?” Bùguǎn wǒ zěnme jiěshì tāmen dōu bù tīng, ràng wǒ nánguò le bàntiān.
text.english: They are happy, but now that college exams are ahead, the situation is different. Once before an exam, I wanted to go camping with classmates; when my parents found out, they scolded me: 'Exams are around the corner, why aren't you studying at home instead of wanting to go out playing?' No matter how I explained, they wouldn't listen, which made me upset for a long time.

text.traditional: 可是，生命中有很多事情比考試還要重要啊！再說，孩子怎麼受得了一直被逼著念書呢？
text.simplified: 可是，生命中有很多事情比考试还要重要啊！再说，孩子怎么受得了一直被逼着念书呢？
text.pinyin: Kěshì, shēngmìng zhōng yǒu hěn duō shìqíng bǐ kǎoshì háiyào zhòngyào a! Zàishuō, háizi zěnme shòudeliǎo yìzhí bèi bī zhe niànshū ne?
text.english: Still, there are many things in life even more important than exams! Besides, how can any kid stand being forced to study constantly?

text.traditional: 我爸媽才不這麼想。其實有一些高中老師也是這樣，雖然他們也教導學生做人做事的道理，但臺灣社會很重視升學，所以考試就變成教學的重心了。
text.simplified: 我爸妈才不这么想。其实有一些高中老师也是这样，虽然他们也教导学生做人做事的道理，但台湾社会很重视升学，所以考试就变成教学的重心了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bà mā cái bú zhème xiǎng. Qíshí yǒu yìxiē gāozhōng lǎoshī yě shì zhèyàng, suīrán tāmen yě jiàodǎo xuéshēng zuòrénzuòshì de dàolǐ, dàn Táiwān shèhuì hěn zhòngshì shēngxué, suǒyǐ kǎoshì jiù biànchéng jiàoxué de zhòngxīn le.
text.english: My parents certainly don't think that way. Actually, some high school teachers are like that too: while they teach life principles, Taiwanese society values college advancement so much that exams become the core focus of teaching.

text.traditional: 難怪你爸媽也認為考試最重要，好像只要考上好大學，將來就能有成就。
text.simplified: 难怪你爸妈也认为考试最重要，好像只要考上好大学，将来就能有成就。
text.pinyin: Nánguài nǐ bà mā yě rènwéi kǎoshì zuì zhòngyào, hǎoxiàng zhǐyào kǎo shàng hǎo dàxué, jiānglái jiù néng yǒu chéngjiù.
text.english: No wonder your parents think exams are paramount, as if as long as you get into a good college, you will achieve success in the future.

text.traditional: 是啊，就是因為這樣，所以老師要求學生做一堆測驗題目、記一堆筆記。要是孩子考不及格或學習成果不好，家長就逼孩子去補習，就算孩子再不滿也得去。
text.simplified: 是啊，就是因为这样，所以老师要求学生做一堆测验题目、记一堆笔记。要是孩子考不及格或学习成果不好，家长就逼孩子去补习，就算孩子再不满也得去。
text.pinyin: Shì a, jiùshì yīnwèi zhèyàng, suǒyǐ lǎoshī yāoqiú xuéshēng zuò yì duī cèyàn tímù, jì yì duī bǐjì. Yàoshì háizi kǎo bù jígé huò xuéxí chéngguǒ bùhǎo, jiāzhǎng jiù bī háizi qù bǔxí, jiùsuàn háizi zài bùmǎn yě děi qù.
text.english: Yeah, exactly because of that, teachers demand students do piles of test questions and take heaps of notes. If a child fails or performs poorly, parents force them into cram schools no matter how unhappy they are.

text.traditional: 不過，我聽語言交換的朋友說，現在不少臺灣老師的教學方式變活潑了。他們利用有趣的教材和網路工具，帶領學生吸收新知識，也讓本來沒有自信的學生，願意主動舉手請教老師了。
text.simplified: 不过，我听语言交换的朋友说，现在不少台湾老师的教学方式变活泼了。他们利用有趣的教材和网路工具，带领学生吸收新知识，也让本来没有自信的学生，愿意主动举手请教老师了。
text.pinyin: Búguò, wǒ tīng yǔyán jiāohuàn de péngyǒu shuō, xiànzài bùshǎo Táiwān lǎoshī de jiàoxué fāngshì biàn huópō le. Tāmen lìyòng yǒuqù de jiàocái hé wǎnglù gōngjù, dàilǐng xuéshēng xīshōu xīn zhīshì, yě ràng běnlái méiyǒu zìxìn de xuéshēng, yuànyì zhǔdòng jǔshǒu qǐngjiào lǎoshī le.
text.english: However, I heard from language exchange friends that many Taiwanese teachers are adopting livelier methods now. They use interesting teaching materials and online tools to lead students in taking in new knowledge, and they have also made students who used to lack confidence willing to raise their hands on their own and ask the teacher questions.

text.traditional: 是啊，不只教學方式變了，升學制度也改了。像有一些學生體育、美術或音樂的成績非常好，就能以特殊表現，選擇理想的大學。
text.simplified: 是啊，不只教学方式变了，升学制度也改了。像有一些学生体育、美术或音乐的成绩非常好，就能以特殊表现，选择理想的大学。
text.pinyin: Shì a, bù zhǐ jiàoxué fāngshì biàn le, shēngxué zhìdù yě gǎi le. Xiàng yǒu yìxiē xuéshēng tǐyù, měishù huò yīnyuè de chéngjī fēicháng hǎo, jiù néng yǐ tèshū biǎoxiàn, xuǎnzé lǐxiǎng de dàxué.
text.english: Right, not only have teaching methods changed, but the college admission system has changed too. For example, some students with very good results in sports, art or music can use these special achievements to choose their ideal university.

text.traditional: 我覺得這樣比較合理。像歐洲就有不少水準很高的職業學校，培養學生的專業能力，將來就比較容易找到工作。
text.simplified: 我觉得这样比较合理。像欧洲就有不少水准很高的职业学校，培养学生的专业能力，将来就比较容易找到工作。
text.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhèyàng bǐjiào hélǐ. Xiàng Ōuzhōu jiù yǒu bùshǎo shuǐzhǔn hěn gāo de zhíyè xuéxiào, péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì, jiānglái jiù bǐjiào róngyì zhǎodào gōngzuò.
text.english: I think that's more reasonable. Europe, for example, has quite a few high-standard vocational schools that train students' professional skills, so it's easier for them to find jobs in the future.

text.traditional: 我有一個高中同學沒考上大學，他父母不但沒生氣，反而讓他去義大利遊學。他邊旅行邊學外文，後來就留在當地的職業學校念服裝設計，現在已經是服裝公司的大老闆了。
text.simplified: 我有一个高中同学没考上大学，他父母不但没生气，反而让他去义大利游学。他边旅行边学外文，后来就留在当地的职业学校念服装设计，现在已经是服装公司的大老板了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yíge gāozhōng tóngxué méi kǎo shàng dàxué, tā fùmǔ búdàn méi shēngqì, fǎn'ér ràng tā qù Yìdàlì yóuxué. Tā biān lǚxíng biān xué wàiwén, hòulái jiù liú zài dāngdì de zhíyè xuéxiào niàn fúzhuāng shèjì, xiànzài yǐjīng shì fúzhuāng gōngsī de dà lǎobǎn le.
text.english: I had a high school classmate who didn't test into college; his parents didn't get angry at all, but sent him on a study trip to Italy instead. He studied foreign languages while traveling, later studied fashion design at a local vocational academy, and is now the boss of an apparel company.

text.traditional: 這樣的成就也很好啊！誰說一定要念大學才有美好的未來呢？
text.simplified: 这样的成就也很好啊！谁说一定要念大学才有美好的未来呢？
text.pinyin: Zhèyàng de chéngjiù yě hěn hǎo a! Shéi shuō yídìng yào niàn dàxué cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái ne?
text.english: That kind of accomplishment is wonderful too! Who can say that one must attend university to have a bright future?

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Back to Normal with V過來
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that someone comes back to a normal or better state, such as waking up (醒過來), correcting a habit (改過來) or finally realizing something (明白過來).
grammarPages.explanation: 「動詞＋過來」的「過來」是趨向補語，例如：請你把書拿過來。另外，「過來」還有回到或恢復到原來狀態的意思，大多表示正常的或是較好的狀態。例如：醒過來、改過來、明白過來。相反的，「過去」是從正常的狀態到另一種不好的狀態，比「過來」使用得少，例如：暈過去 (fainted)、昏過去 (fainted)。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + (Adverb) + (把 + Object) + Verb + 過來

text.traditional: ……總是睡得不太安心，半夜會突然醒過來。
text.simplified: ……总是睡得不太安心，半夜会突然醒过来。
text.pinyin: …Zǒngshì shuì de bú tài ānxīn, bànyè huì túrán xǐng guòlái.
text.english: …He always sleeps restlessly, and he suddenly wakes up in the middle of the night.

text.traditional: 被媽媽罵了好幾次以後，弟弟終於把亂丟髒衣服的壞習慣改過來了。
text.simplified: 被妈妈骂了好几次以后，弟弟终于把乱丢脏衣服的坏习惯改过来了。
text.pinyin: Bèi māma mà le hǎojǐ cì yǐhòu, dìdi zhōngyú bǎ luàndiū zāng yīfu de huài xíguàn gǎi guòlái le.
text.english: After being scolded by Mom several times, my younger brother finally broke his bad habit of leaving dirty clothes lying around.

text.traditional: 早上上班時，發現大家都對著我笑，過了一會兒我才明白過來，原來我穿著睡褲出門。
text.simplified: 早上上班时，发现大家都对着我笑，过了一会儿我才明白过来，原来我穿着睡裤出门。
text.pinyin: Zǎoshàng shàngbān shí, fāxiàn dàjiā dōu duì zhe wǒ xiào, guò le yìhuǐr wǒ cái míngbái guòlái, yuánlái wǒ chuān zhe shuìkù chūmén.
text.english: When I went to work this morning, I noticed everyone was laughing at me. After a while I finally realized why: I had left the house in my pajama pants.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The 過來 of 動詞＋過來 is a directional complement. For example, 請你把書拿過來。In addition, 過來 has the meaning of returning, or returning to the original state, and primarily indicating a normal or better state. For example, 醒過來, 改過來, 明白過來. On the contrary, 過去 is moving from a normal state to a less ideal one. It is used less frequently than 過來. For example, 暈過去, 昏過去.
summary: 過來 after a verb can mean coming back to the normal or original state, as in 醒過來.
過去 is the opposite: from a normal state to a bad one, as in 暈過去. It is used less.
忙不過來 means there is too much work to handle.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Questioning a Wrong Choice with 怎麼不……，反而……
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Question why someone fails to do what is reasonable and instead does something contrary or inappropriate.
grammarPages.explanation: 「怎麼不……呢？」是「為什麼不……呢？」的意思，表示說話的人對某種情況提出疑問，句尾常跟著「呢」。「怎麼不」後面是說話的人認為應該要做的事或建議；「反而」是連詞，後面是不應該做的或代表說話者的疑問。
grammarPages.pattern: (Subject) + 怎麼不 + Expected Action，反而 + Contrary Action + (呢)？

text.traditional: 快考試了，怎麼不在家念書，反而想出去玩？
text.simplified: 快考试了，怎么不在家念书，反而想出去玩？
text.pinyin: Kuài kǎoshì le, zěnme bú zài jiā niànshū, fǎn'ér xiǎng chūqù wán?
text.english: Exams are coming up. Why aren't you studying at home? Why do you want to go out and play instead?

text.traditional: 你聽不懂老師上課說的，怎麼不舉手請教老師，反而玩起手機來了？
text.simplified: 你听不懂老师上课说的，怎么不举手请教老师，反而玩起手机来了？
text.pinyin: Nǐ tīng bù dǒng lǎoshī shàngkè shuō de, zěnme bù jǔshǒu qǐngjiào lǎoshī, fǎn'ér wán qǐ shǒujī lái le?
text.english: You couldn't understand what the teacher said in class. Why didn't you raise your hand and ask the teacher? Why did you start playing with your phone instead?

text.traditional:
爸爸：孩子每次把衣服脫了就亂丟，每次都得幫他整理。
媽媽：你怎麼不跟他說，反而老是幫他整理呢？
text.simplified:
爸爸：孩子每次把衣服脱了就乱丢，每次都得帮他整理。
妈妈：你怎么不跟他说，反而老是帮他整理呢？
text.pinyin:
Bàba: Háizi měi cì bǎ yīfu tuō le jiù luàndiū, měi cì dōu děi bāng tā zhěnglǐ.
Māma: Nǐ zěnme bù gēn tā shuō, fǎn'ér lǎoshì bāng tā zhěnglǐ ne?
text.english:
Dad: Every time the kid takes off his clothes, he just throws them all over the place, and every time I have to tidy up after him.
Mom: Why don't you talk to him, instead of always tidying up after him?

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 怎麼不……呢？ has the same meaning as 為什麼不……呢？ indicating that the speaker is questioning a certain situation. The end of the sentence is often followed by 呢. 怎麼不 is followed by what the speaker thinks should be done, but 反而 as a conjunction, is followed by what should not be done or the speaker's doubt.
summary: 怎麼不……反而……呢 asks why someone didn't do what is expected and did something else instead.
After 怎麼不, put what the speaker thinks should be done.
After 反而, put what should not be done, or what the speaker doubts.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: The Opposite of What You'd Expect with 不但不/沒……，反而……
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that the expected thing did not happen and the opposite happened instead, with 不但不/沒……，反而…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「不但不」、「不但沒」後面接的是與說話的人預料相反的情況；「反而」的後面是出乎預料的情況或說話的人認為不應該發生的。有時候「不但」可以省略，例如：颱風快來了，他（不但）沒留在家裡，反而去衝浪，真是太危險了。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 不但不/沒 + Expected，反而 + Contrary

text.traditional: 我有一個高中同學沒考上大學，他父母不但沒生氣，反而讓他去義大利遊學。
text.simplified: 我有一个高中同学没考上大学，他父母不但没生气，反而让他去义大利游学。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yíge gāozhōng tóngxué méi kǎo shàng dàxué, tā fùmǔ búdàn méi shēngqì, fǎn'ér ràng tā qù Yìdàlì yóuxué.
text.english: A high school classmate of mine didn't get into college. His parents didn't get angry at all; instead, they let him go on a study tour in Italy.

text.traditional: 我們公司不但沒給男女員工同樣的工作機會，反而對女員工有許多不合理的要求。
text.simplified: 我们公司不但没给男女员工同样的工作机会，反而对女员工有许多不合理的要求。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī búdàn méi gěi nánnǚ yuángōng tóngyàng de gōngzuò jīhuì, fǎn'ér duì nǚ yuángōng yǒu xǔduō bù hélǐ de yāoqiú.
text.english: Our company not only hasn't given male and female employees the same job opportunities; instead, it makes many unreasonable demands of its female employees.

text.traditional: 小金最近胖了很多，體力也變差了，可是他不但不運動，反而天天約朋友去吃大餐。
text.simplified: 小金最近胖了很多，体力也变差了，可是他不但不运动，反而天天约朋友去吃大餐。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Jīn zuìjìn pàng le hěn duō, tǐlì yě biàn chà le, kěshì tā búdàn bú yùndòng, fǎn'ér tiāntiān yuē péngyǒu qù chī dàcān.
text.english: Xiao Jin has gained a lot of weight recently and his stamina has gotten worse, yet he not only refuses to exercise, but instead invites friends out for big meals every day.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 不但不 or 不但沒 is followed by circumstances that are contrary to what the speaker expected; 反而 is followed by an unexpected situation or one the person speaking thinks shouldn't happen. Sometimes 不但 can be omitted. For example, 颱風快來了，他（不但）沒留在家裡，反而去衝浪，真是太危險了。
summary: 不但不 or 不但沒 is followed by something opposite to what the speaker expected.
反而 then gives something surprising, or something the speaker thinks should not happen.
Sometimes 不但 can be left out.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Disagree strongly with what someone said by stressing your own view with 才……(呢).
grammarPages.explanation: 這一課的「才」是強調「才」後面所說的話，常用在反駁的時候，句尾常跟「呢」一起使用，例如：「你說那家餐廳的菜好吃，可是我覺得你煮的才好吃呢！」、「小明說我借了他的書，我才沒借呢！」
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 才 + (不/沒) + Your Own View + (呢)

text.traditional:
尚恩：可是，生命中有很多事情比考試還要重要啊！……
家豪：我爸媽才不這麼想。……
text.simplified:
尚恩：可是，生命中有很多事情比考试还要重要啊！……
家豪：我爸妈才不这么想。……
text.pinyin:
Shàng'ēn: Kěshì, shēngmìng zhōng yǒu hěn duō shìqíng bǐ kǎoshì háiyào zhòngyào a!…
Jiāháo: Wǒ bàmā cái bú zhème xiǎng.…
text.english:
Shawn: But there are lots of things in life that are more important than exams!…
Jiahao: My parents definitely don't think so…

text.traditional:
A：博物館不遠，我們走路去吧？
B：我才不要呢！搭公車比較快。
text.simplified:
A：博物馆不远，我们走路去吧？
B：我才不要呢！搭公车比较快。
text.pinyin:
A: Bówùguǎn bù yuǎn, wǒmen zǒulù qù ba?
B: Wǒ cái bú yào ne! Dā gōngchē bǐjiào kuài.
text.english:
A: The museum isn't far; shall we walk there?
B: No way I'm walking! Taking the bus is faster.

text.traditional:
A：王導演拍的那部戲非常好，今年的最佳導演一定是他。
B：不一定吧，我認為李導演拍的才好呢！
text.simplified:
A：王导演拍的那部戏非常好，今年的最佳导演一定是他。
B：不一定吧，我认为李导演拍的才好呢！
text.pinyin:
A: Wáng dǎoyǎn pāi de nà bù xì fēicháng hǎo, jīnnián de zuìjiā dǎoyǎn yídìng shì tā.
B: Bù yídìng ba, wǒ rènwéi Lǐ dǎoyǎn pāi de cái hǎo ne!
text.english:
A: The film Director Wang made is excellent. This year's Best Director is sure to be him.
B: Not necessarily. I think the one Director Li made is the really good one!

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The 才 in this lesson emphasizes what is said after 才. It is often used when refuting something, and the sentence end often uses 呢. For example, 你說那家餐廳的菜好吃，可是我覺得你煮的才好吃呢！Or 小明說我借了他的書，我才沒借呢！
summary: 才 stresses what comes after it, and is often used to argue against what someone said.
The sentence often ends with 呢.
Put 才 before what you stress, such as 不 or 沒: 我才不要呢.

items.title: Grammar 5–7 · Real Competence Over Test Scores

dialogue.title: 教育是有意義的學習

text.traditional: 臺灣社會一直都很重視學生的學習表現，尤其是考試的成績。人們似乎認為，成績好就代表書讀得好，書讀得好就會有美好的未來。因此，不少家長希望孩子能上好大學，甚至念到博士。為了達成這個目的，家長從孩子念國小、國中起，就非常注意每科的分數，老是擔心孩子進不了好高中、好大學。
text.simplified: 台湾社会一直都很重视学生的学习表现，尤其是考试的成绩。人们似乎认为，成绩好就代表书读得好，书读得好就会有美好的未来。因此，不少家长希望孩子能上好大学，甚至念到博士。为了达成这个目的，家长从孩子念国小、国中起，就非常注意每科的分数，老是担心孩子进不了好高中、好大学。
text.pinyin: Táiwān shèhuì yìzhí dōu hěn zhòngshì xuéshēng de xuéxí biǎoxiàn, yóuqí shì kǎoshì de chéngjī. Rénmen sìhū rènwéi, chéngjī hǎo jiù dàibiǎo shū dú de hǎo, shū dú de hǎo jiù huì yǒu měihǎo de wèilái. Yīncǐ, bùshǎo jiāzhǎng xīwàng háizi néng shàng hǎo dàxué, shènzhì niàn dào bóshì. Wèile dáchéng zhè ge mùdì, jiāzhǎng cóng háizi niàn guóxiǎo, guózhōng qǐ, jiù fēicháng zhùyì měi kē de fēnshù, lǎoshì dānxīn háizi jìn bùliǎo hǎo gāozhōng, hǎo dàxué.
text.english: Taiwanese society has always attached great importance to students' academic performance, especially test scores. People seem to believe that good grades equate to doing well in school, and doing well in school ensures a bright future. Consequently, many parents hope their children get into prestigious universities or even obtain doctorates. To achieve this goal, parents closely watch scores in every subject starting from elementary and junior high school, perpetually worrying their children won't enter top high schools or universities.

text.traditional: 有一些家長很誇張，不但陪孩子一起補習，還幫他們把筆記寫在本子上、把重點寫在便條上，以為孩子複習時用得著，這樣考試的成績就會更好。也有家長把孩子的學習時間排得很滿，下課後還叫他們寫很多考卷。後來，大家發現學生雖然掌握了考試的技巧，但在實際生活中碰到困難時，反而缺乏解決問題的能力。畢竟會考試，不代表擁有處理事情的能力。
text.simplified: 有一些家长很夸张，不但陪孩子一起补习，还帮他们把笔记写在本子上、把重点写在便条上，以为孩子复习时用得着，这样考试的成绩就会更好。也有家长把孩子的学习时间排得很满，下课后还叫他们写很多考卷。后来，大家发现学生虽然掌握了考试的技巧，但在实际生活中碰到困难时，反而缺乏解决问题的能力。毕竟会考试，不代表拥有处理事情的能力。
text.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng hěn kuāzhāng, búdàn péi háizi yìqǐ bǔxí, hái bāng tāmen bǎ bǐjì xiě zài běnzi shàng, bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiě zài biàntiáo shàng, yǐwéi háizi fùxí shí yòngdezháo, zhèyàng kǎoshì de chéngjī jiù huì gèng hǎo. Yě yǒu jiāzhǎng bǎ háizi de xuéxí shíjiān pái de hěn mǎn, xiàkè hòu hái jiào tāmen xiě hěn duō kǎojuàn. Hòulái, dàjiā fāxiàn xuéshēng suīrán zhǎngwò le kǎoshì de jìqiǎo, dàn zài shíjì shēnghuó zhōng pèngdào kùnnán shí, fǎn'ér quēfá jiějué wèntí de nénglì. Bìjìng huì kǎoshì, bú dàibiǎo yǒngyǒu chǔlǐ shìqíng de nénglì.
text.english: Some parents go to extreme lengths: not only attending cram school with their children, but copying notes into notebooks and writing key points on sticky notes, thinking kids will find them useful when reviewing, thereby scoring higher on tests. Other parents pack schedules to the brim and assign piles of test papers after class. Later on, people found that while students mastered test-taking techniques, they lacked problem-solving capabilities when encountering real-world challenges. After all, testing well does not mean having practical competence.

text.traditional: 其實，因為每年出生的孩子越來越少，許多學校的新生也變少了，因為這樣，被大學錄取的機會反而大大地增加了。但是國中、高中的考試沒減少，家長對教育的想法也沒有太大的改變。孩子就算考上了好大學，沒實力的人恐怕畢業後也很難找到工作，更不可能擔任公司的主管，甚至最後變成整個社會的負擔。
text.simplified: 其实，因为每年出生的孩子越来越少，许多学校的新生也变少了，因为这样，被大学录取的机会反而大大地增加了。但是国中、高中的考试没减少，家长对教育的想法也没有太大的改变。孩子就算考上了好大学，没实力的人恐怕毕业后也很难找到工作，更不可能担任公司的主管，甚至最后变成整个社会的负担。
text.pinyin: Qíshí, yīnwèi měi nián chūshēng de háizi yuèláiyuè shǎo, xǔduō xuéxiào de xīnshēng yě biàn shǎo le, yīnwèi zhèyàng, bèi dàxué lùqǔ de jīhuì fǎn'ér dà dà de zēngjiā le. Dànshì guózhōng, gāozhōng de kǎoshì méi jiǎnshǎo, jiāzhǎng duì jiàoyù de xiǎngfǎ yě méiyǒu tài dà de gǎibiàn. Háizi jiùsuàn kǎo shàng le hǎo dàxué, méi shílì de rén kǒngpà bìyè hòu yě hěn nán zhǎodào gōngzuò, gèng bù kěnéng dānrèn gōngsī de zhǔguǎn, shènzhì zuìhòu biànchéng zhěngge shèhuì de fùdān.
text.english: In fact, because fewer children are born each year, many schools have fewer new students, and because of this, the chances of being admitted to a university have instead greatly increased. Yet junior and senior high exams have not decreased, and parents' educational mindset remains mostly unchanged. Even if children get into a good university, those without real ability will probably find it hard to get a job after graduating, let alone become managers at a company, and may even end up as a burden on the whole society.

text.traditional: 這樣的例子一年比一年多。一直到最近幾年，家長和老師終於明白每個孩子都是獨特的，不是每個人都非念大學不可。再說，考試成績好的人，不一定就能幸福過日子。因此，有意義的學習是讓孩子以思考代替記答案，不僅給孩子自由的空間，發揮出自己的優點，而且還提供更好的教材和教學方式，讓孩子快樂地學習、成長。如果他們的能力可以變得更強，將來就能為社會貢獻一份力量了。
text.simplified: 这样的例子一年比一年多。一直到最近几年，家长和老师终于明白每个孩子都是独特的，不是每个人都非念大学不可。再说，考试成绩好的人，不一定就能幸福过日子。因此，有意义的学习是让孩子以思考代替记答案，不仅给孩子自由的空间，发挥出自己的优点，而且还提供更好的教材和教学方式，让孩子快乐地学习、成长。如果他们的能力可以变得更强，将来就能为社会贡献一份力量了。
text.pinyin: Zhèyàng de lìzi yì nián bǐ yì nián duō. Yìzhí dào zuìjìn jǐ nián, jiāzhǎng hé lǎoshī zhōngyú míngbái měi ge háizi dōu shì dútè de, búshì měi gè rén dōu fēi niàn dàxué bùkě. Zàishuō, kǎoshì chéngjī hǎo de rén, bù yídìng jiù néng xìngfú guòrìzi. Yīncǐ, yǒuyìyì de xuéxí shì ràng háizi yǐ sīkǎo dàitì jì dá'àn, bù jǐn gěi háizi zìyóu de kōngjiān, fāhuī chū zìjǐ de yōudiǎn, érqiě hái tígōng gèng hǎo de jiàocái hé jiàoxué fāngshì, ràng háizi kuàilè de xuéxí, chéngzhǎng. Rúguǒ tāmen de nénglì kěyǐ biàn de gèng qiáng, jiānglái jiù néng wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng le.
text.english: Such examples multiply year after year. Only in recent years have parents and educators finally realized that each child is unique and not everyone must attend university. Furthermore, individuals with high test scores do not necessarily lead happier lives. Therefore, meaningful learning lets children think instead of memorizing answers. It not only gives children the freedom to bring out their own strengths, but also provides better teaching materials and teaching methods so that children can learn and grow happily. If their capabilities grow stronger, they will be able to do their part for society in the future.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Highlight the most prominent or noteworthy item within a broader category using 尤其是.
grammarPages.explanation: 「尤其」是副詞，有「特別」的意思，表示和其他事物比起來更特別。一般放在後面的句子。「尤其」＋「是」有強調的意思。
grammarPages.pattern: Topic + Statement，尤其是 + Focus

text.traditional: 臺灣社會一直都很重視學生的學習表現，尤其是考試的成績。
text.simplified: 台湾社会一直都很重视学生的学习表现，尤其是考试的成绩。
text.pinyin: Táiwān shèhuì yìzhí dōu hěn zhòngshì xuéshēng de xuéxí biǎoxiàn, yóuqíshì kǎoshì de chéngjī.
text.english: Taiwanese society has always placed great importance on students' academic performance, especially their exam scores.

text.traditional: 這個學期我選了五門課，每門課都很有意思，尤其是英文會話課，不僅教授的教法活潑，說話也很幽默。
text.simplified: 这个学期我选了五门课，每门课都很有意思，尤其是英文会话课，不仅教授的教法活泼，说话也很幽默。
text.pinyin: Zhège xuéqí wǒ xuǎn le wǔ mén kè, měi mén kè dōu hěn yǒuyìsi, yóuqíshì Yīngwén huìhuà kè, bù jǐn jiàoshòu de jiàofǎ huópō, shuōhuà yě hěn yōumò.
text.english: I'm taking five courses this semester, and they're all interesting, especially English conversation. Not only is the professor's teaching lively, but the professor is also very funny.

text.traditional: 每種工作都有它的困難或問題，尤其是當警察的，經常會碰到麻煩或危險的事情。
text.simplified: 每种工作都有它的困难或问题，尤其是当警察的，经常会碰到麻烦或危险的事情。
text.pinyin: Měi zhǒng gōngzuò dōu yǒu tā de kùnnán huò wèntí, yóuqíshì dāng jǐngchá de, jīngcháng huì pèngdào máfán huò wéixiǎn de shìqíng.
text.english: Every job has its difficulties or problems, especially police work: police officers often run into trouble or danger.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 尤其 is an adverb similar to 特別, which means that something is more special compared to something else. Usually placed in the following sentence. 尤其+是 has the meaning of emphasis.
summary: 尤其 means especially. It shows one thing is more special than the others.
It usually goes in the second sentence.
尤其是 picks out one thing from a group, as in 五門課都很有意思，尤其是英文會話課.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Reaching an Aim or Not with V得著 / V不著 / V著了 / 沒V著
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say whether an action reaches its aim, like finding something (找著了) or guessing right (猜得著), with verbs such as 拿, 看, 打, 猜, 用 and 找.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示做某個動作，但達不到某種目的或結果。「著(zháo)」前面的動詞具有一定的目標性，動作有「接觸或達到」的意思，常用的有「拿、看、打、猜、用、找」等。「著」在此語法作為結構補語，說明前面動詞的結果。例如：鑰匙找著了/沒找著。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + 得/不 + 著 (+ Object)

text.traditional: ……把重點寫在便條上，以為孩子複習時用得著，這樣考試的成績就會更好。
text.simplified: ……把重点写在便条上，以为孩子复习时用得着，这样考试的成绩就会更好。
text.pinyin: …Bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiě zài biàntiáo shàng, yǐwéi háizi fùxí shí yòngdezháo, zhèyàng kǎoshì de chéngjī jiù huì gèng hǎo.
text.english: …write the key points on notes, thinking their kids could use them when reviewing, so that their exam scores would be even better.

text.traditional: 那個專櫃裡放著好多漂亮的名牌皮包，可惜我沒錢買，看得著、摸不著。
text.simplified: 那个专柜里放着好多漂亮的名牌皮包，可惜我没钱买，看得着、摸不着。
text.pinyin: Nàge zhuānguì lǐ fàng zhe hǎoduō piàoliàng de míngpái píbāo, kěxí wǒ méi qián mǎi, kàndezháo, mōbùzháo.
text.english: That display counter holds lots of beautiful designer handbags; unfortunately I can't afford to buy one. I can see them but can't touch them.

text.traditional:
A：游小姐的男朋友看起來很年輕，你猜他幾歲？
B：我跟他不熟，哪裡猜得著。
text.simplified:
A：游小姐的男朋友看起来很年轻，你猜他几岁？
B：我跟他不熟，哪里猜得着。
text.pinyin:
A: Yóu xiǎojiě de nánpéngyǒu kànqǐlái hěn niánqīng, nǐ cāi tā jǐ suì?
B: Wǒ gēn tā bù shóu, nǎlǐ cāidezháo.
text.english:
A: Miss You's boyfriend looks very young; how old do you guess he is?
B: I don't know him well; how could I possibly guess?

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: It expresses a certain action, but one which can not achieve a certain purpose or result. The verb in front of 著(zháo) has a certain purpose, and the action it expresses has to do with “contact or reach”. Commonly used verbs are 拿, 看, 打, 猜, 用, 找, etc. 著 here is to work as a structural complement, indicating the result of the preceding verb. For example, 鑰匙找著了/沒找著.
summary: 著 after a verb says whether the action reached its goal or result, like 找著了.
The verb must aim at a goal, such as 拿, 看, 打, 猜, 用 or 找.
Put 得 or 不 before 著 to say you can or can't reach it.

grammarPages.lessonTitle: 誰說得念大學才有未來？
grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Who Can Say That There Is No Future Unless You Are a College Graduate?
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that one thing or action is used in place of another with 以……代替…….
grammarPages.explanation: 「以」有「用」的意思，「以……代替……」意思是用某樣東西或某個行動來替換原本的東西或行動。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 以 + Substitute + 代替 + Original

text.traditional: 因此，有意義的學習是讓孩子以思考代替記答案……
text.simplified: 因此，有意义的学习是让孩子以思考代替记答案……
text.pinyin: Yīncǐ, yǒu yìyì de xuéxí shì ràng háizi yǐ sīkǎo dàitì jì dá'àn…
text.english: Therefore, meaningful learning means letting children think instead of memorizing answers…

text.traditional: 媽媽很重視家人的健康，常以蔬菜水果做成的點心代替一般的甜點。
text.simplified: 妈妈很重视家人的健康，常以蔬菜水果做成的点心代替一般的甜点。
text.pinyin: Māma hěn zhòngshì jiārén de jiànkāng, cháng yǐ shūcài shuǐguǒ zuò chéng de diǎnxīn dàitì yìbān de tiándiǎn.
text.english: Mom values the family's health, so she often uses snacks made from vegetables and fruit in place of ordinary desserts.

text.traditional: 如果大家都能以搭公車、騎自行車代替開車，這樣空氣就不會那麼髒了。
text.simplified: 如果大家都能以搭公车、骑自行车代替开车，这样空气就不会那么脏了。
text.pinyin: Rúguǒ dàjiā dōu néng yǐ dā gōngchē, qí zìxíngchē dàitì kāichē, zhèyàng kōngqì jiù bú huì nàme zāng le.
text.english: If everyone could take the bus or ride bicycles instead of driving, the air would not be so dirty.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 以 is similar to 用. 以……代替 means replacing some thing or action.
summary: 以 means 用. 以……代替…… means using one thing or action in place of the original.
Put the new thing after 以 and the old thing after 代替.

dialogue.title: 健康檢查不麻煩

text.traditional: 家豪，你手裡拿的是什麼？是健康檢查的簡介嗎？
text.simplified: 家豪，你手里拿的是什么？是健康检查的简介吗？
text.pinyin: Jiāháo, nǐ shǒulǐ ná de shì shénme? Shì jiànkāngjiǎnchá de jiǎnjiè ma?
text.english: Jiahao, what are you holding in your hand? Is it a brochure for health examinations?

text.traditional: 對啊，早上陪我阿姨去醫院辦理住院手續時，順便拿的，要帶回去給我爸媽看。
text.simplified: 对啊，早上陪我阿姨去医院办理住院手续时，顺便拿的，要带回去给我爸妈看。
text.pinyin: Duì a, zǎoshàng péi wǒ āyí qù yīyuàn bànlǐ zhùyuàn shǒuxù shí, shùnbiàn ná de, yào dài huí qù gěi wǒ bà mā kàn.
text.english: Yes. I picked it up this morning while accompanying my aunt to handle her hospital admission, to take home for my parents to see.

text.traditional: 你阿姨怎麼了？昨天我還在超市遇到她，看起來很健康啊！
text.simplified: 你阿姨怎么了？昨天我还在超市遇到她，看起来很健康啊！
text.pinyin: Nǐ āyí zěnmele? Zuótiān wǒ hái zài chāoshì yùdào tā, kànqǐlái hěn jiànkāng a!
text.english: What happened to your aunt? I just ran into her at the supermarket yesterday and she looked in great health!

text.traditional: 說也奇怪，她一向都有良好的飲食和生活習慣，也從來沒發覺自己有什麼毛病。直到上個月做了全身健康檢查，才知道病了。
text.simplified: 说也奇怪，她一向都有良好的饮食和生活习惯，也从来没发觉自己有什么毛病。直到上个月做了全身健康检查，才知道病了。
text.pinyin: Shuō yě qíguài, tā yíxiàng dōu yǒu liánghǎo de yǐnshí hé shēnghuó xíguàn, yě cónglái méi fājué zìjǐ yǒu shénme máobìng. Zhídào shàng ge yuè zuò le quánshēn jiànkāngjiǎnchá, cái zhīdào bìng le.
text.english: Strange to say, she has always maintained healthy dietary and living habits, and never sensed anything wrong. Not until she underwent a comprehensive health check last month did she realize she was ill.

text.traditional: 每次聽你阿姨說話，都感覺她只想著照顧家人，自己一定沒想到會變成病人吧？
text.simplified: 每次听你阿姨说话，都感觉她只想着照顾家人，自己一定没想到会变成病人吧？
text.pinyin: Měicì tīng nǐ āyí shuōhuà, dōu gǎnjué tā zhǐ xiǎng zhe zhàogù jiārén, zìjǐ yídìng méixiǎngdào huì biànchéng bìngrén ba?
text.english: Whenever I hear your aunt speak, I feel she only ever thinks of looking after her family; she certainly never imagined becoming a patient herself.

text.traditional: 是啊，她是家庭主婦，生活很單純，每天管孩子、注意家人的健康，照顧家人就是她生活的重心，從沒想過自己也需要別人照顧。
text.simplified: 是啊，她是家庭主妇，生活很单纯，每天管孩子、注意家人的健康，照顾家人就是她生活的重心，从没想过自己也需要别人照顾。
text.pinyin: Shì a, tā shì jiātíng zhǔfù, shēnghuó hěn dānchún, měitiān guǎn háizi, zhùyì jiārén de jiànkāng, zhàogù jiārén jiùshì tā shēnghuó de zhòngxīn, cóngméi xiǎng guò zìjǐ yě xūyào biérén zhàogù.
text.english: Yes. She's a homemaker and her life is simple: every day she looks after the kids and keeps an eye on the family's health. Taking care of her family is the center of her life, and she has never thought that she might need others to take care of her too.

text.traditional: 不過還好她去做了健檢，才知道該去看醫生。
text.simplified: 不过还好她去做了健检，才知道该去看医生。
text.pinyin: Búguò háihǎo tā qù zuò le jiànjiǎn, cái zhīdào gāi qù kàn yīshēng.
text.english: Still, it's fortunate she went for the checkup; only then did she know to see a doctor.

text.traditional: 妳說的沒錯。我早就想帶父母去做了，只不過他們覺得做健檢除了得花時間，還很麻煩，所以很被動，我得趁這個機會，跟他們溝通一下。
text.simplified: 你说的没错。我早就想带父母去做了，只不过他们觉得做健检除了得花时间，还很麻烦，所以很被动，我得趁这个机会，跟他们沟通一下。
text.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de méicuò. Wǒ zǎojiù xiǎng dài fùmǔ qù zuò le, zhǐbúguò tāmen juéde zuò jiànjiǎn chúle děi huā shíjiān, hái hěn máfán, suǒyǐ hěn bèidòng, wǒ děi chèn zhè ge jīhuì, gēn tāmen gōutōng yíxià.
text.english: You're right. I've wanted to take my parents for a checkup for a long time; it's just that they feel that, besides taking time, it's a lot of hassle, so they're very passive about it. I must seize this opportunity to talk with them.

text.traditional: 我先生也一樣。最近他頭痛了好幾天，我想帶他去看病，他不但不配合，反而很生氣地說：「我又沒什麼毛病，為什麼非去不可！」他死也不肯去，害我擔心得不得了。
text.simplified: 我先生也一样。最近他头痛了好几天，我想带他去看病，他不但不配合，反而很生气地说：「我又没什么毛病，为什么非去不可！」他死也不肯去，害我担心得不得了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiānshēng yě yíyàng. Zuìjìn tā tóutòng le hǎojǐ tiān, wǒ xiǎng dài tā qù kànbìng, tā búdàn bú pèihé, fǎn'ér hěn shēngqì de shuō: “Wǒ yòu méishénme máobìng, wèishénme fēi qù bùkě!” Tā sǐ yě bù kěn qù, hài wǒ dānxīn de bùdéliǎo.
text.english: My husband is just the same. He had headaches for several days recently, and when I wanted to take him to the clinic, far from cooperating, he snapped angrily: 'Nothing is wrong with me, why must I go!' He obstinately refused, causing me tremendous worry.

text.traditional: 如果感覺這麼不舒服，就是身體發出警告，表示健康有問題了。我看妳陪他去醫院，妳也順便做個免費的基本健檢吧。
text.simplified: 如果感觉这么不舒服，就是身体发出警告，表示健康有问题了。我看你陪他去医院，你也顺便做个免费的基本健检吧。
text.pinyin: Rúguǒ gǎnjué zhème bù shūfu, jiùshì shēntǐ fāchū jǐnggào, biǎoshì jiànkāng yǒu wèntí le. Wǒ kàn nǐ péi tā qù yīyuàn, nǐ yě shùnbiàn zuò ge miǎnfèi de jīběn jiànjiǎn ba.
text.english: If he feels that uncomfortable, that's his body sending a warning that something is wrong with his health. I suggest you accompany him to the hospital, and take advantage of a free basic checkup yourself.

text.traditional: 免費健檢的對象，好像年齡得滿四十歲。我還年輕呢！
text.simplified: 免费健检的对象，好像年龄得满四十岁。我还年轻呢！
text.pinyin: Miǎnfèi jiànjiǎn de duìxiàng, hǎoxiàng niánlíng děi mǎn sìshí suì. Wǒ hái niánqīng ne!
text.english: It seems you have to be at least forty to get a free checkup. I'm still young!

text.traditional: 對不起，對不起。
text.simplified: 对不起，对不起。
text.pinyin: Duìbùqǐ, duìbùqǐ.
text.english: My apologies, sorry about that.

text.traditional: 沒什麼啦！
text.simplified: 没什么啦！
text.pinyin: Méishénme la!
text.english: No worries at all!

text.traditional: （家豪看了一下手上的簡介）
text.simplified: （家豪看了一下手上的简介）
