text.pinyin: (Jiāháo kàn le yíxià shǒu shàng de jiǎnjiè)
text.english: (Jiahao glances at the brochure in his hand.)

text.traditional: 這家醫院的醫生挺有名的，應該很可靠，健檢手續也不麻煩，只要上網填個表就行了。
text.simplified: 这家医院的医生挺有名的，应该很可靠，健检手续也不麻烦，只要上网填个表就行了。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de yīshēng tǐng yǒumíng de, yīnggāi hěn kěkào, jiànjiǎn shǒuxù yě bù máfán, zhǐyào shàngwǎng tián ge biǎo jiù xíng le.
text.english: The doctors at this hospital are quite renowned and should be dependable; checkup procedures aren't complicated either—just fill out an online form.

text.traditional: 我最大的願望就是家人都健健康康的。既然手續這麼簡單，那明天就先帶我先生去做個健檢吧。
text.simplified: 我最大的愿望就是家人都健健康康的。既然手续这么简单，那明天就先带我先生去做个健检吧。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zuì dà de yuànwàng jiùshì jiārén dōu jiànjiàn kāngkāng de. Jìrán shǒuxù zhème jiǎndān, nà míngtiān jiù xiān dài wǒ xiānshēng qù zuò ge jiànjiǎn ba.
text.english: My greatest wish is for my family to stay completely healthy. Since the procedure is that simple, tomorrow I'll take my husband for a checkup first.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something did not happen until a certain time or event, later than expected, with 直到……才…….
grammarPages.explanation: 表示過去一直沒發生的事情，到了某個時間點才發生。「直到」後面接時間或情況。「才」後面接結果，表示說話的人覺得比預期的晚。
grammarPages.pattern: 直到 + Time / Event (+ 以後/時) + Subject + 才 + Result

text.traditional: ……從來沒發覺自己有什麼毛病。直到上個月做了全身健康檢查，才知道病了。
text.simplified: ……从来没发觉自己有什么毛病。直到上个月做了全身健康检查，才知道病了。
text.pinyin: …Cónglái méi fājué zìjǐ yǒu shénme máobìng. Zhídào shàng ge yuè zuò le quánshēn jiànkāngjiǎnchá, cái zhīdào bìng le.
text.english: …She had never noticed any health problems of her own. Not until a full checkup last month did she learn she was ill.

text.traditional: 小王大學畢業後一直找不到好工作，直到三十歲才找到合適的。
text.simplified: 小王大学毕业后一直找不到好工作，直到三十岁才找到合适的。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng dàxué bìyè hòu yìzhí zhǎobúdào hǎo gōngzuò, zhídào sānshí suì cái zhǎodào héshì de.
text.english: After graduating from college, Xiao Wang couldn't find a good job for a long time. He didn't find a suitable one until he was thirty.

text.traditional: 因為早上起床起晚了，直到飛機起飛前三十分鐘，我才趕到機場。
text.simplified: 因为早上起床起晚了，直到飞机起飞前三十分钟，我才赶到机场。
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi zǎoshàng qǐchuáng qǐ wǎn le, zhídào fēijī qǐfēi qián sānshí fēnzhōng, wǒ cái gǎndào jīchǎng.
text.english: Because I got up late this morning, I didn't make it to the airport until thirty minutes before takeoff.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 直到……（，）才…… means that what has not occurred will not happen until after a certain point in time. 直到 is followed by time or circumstances. 才 is followed by the result, which means that the speaker felt that the result was later than expected.
summary: 直到……才…… says something that had not happened until a certain time finally happened.
After 直到 put the time or situation. After 才 put the result.
才 shows the speaker thinks the result came later than expected.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: It's Just That … with 只不過
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add a small 'but' or an extra detail to what you just said with 只不過 (it's just that…).
grammarPages.explanation: 「只不過」是「只是」的意思，用來補充說明某件事，讓聽者更了解事情的情況。「只不過」的後面接要補充說明的內容。
grammarPages.pattern: Statement, + 只不過 + Extra Detail

text.traditional: 我早就想帶父母去做了，只不過他們覺得做健檢除了得花時間……
text.simplified: 我早就想带父母去做了，只不过他们觉得做健检除了得花时间……
text.pinyin: Wǒ zǎojiù xiǎng dài fùmǔ qù zuò le, zhǐbúguò tāmen juéde zuò jiànjiǎn chúle děi huā shíjiān…
text.english: I've wanted to take my parents for a checkup for a long time; it's just that they feel that, besides taking time, a checkup…

text.traditional: 我很喜歡這輛英國車，只不過價格太高了，我得多存一點錢才買得起。
text.simplified: 我很喜欢这辆英国车，只不过价格太高了，我得多存一点钱才买得起。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān zhè liàng Yīngguó chē, zhǐbúguò jiàgé tài gāo le, wǒ děi duō cún yìdiǎn qián cái mǎi de qǐ.
text.english: I really like this British car; it's just that the price is too high. I have to save more money before I can afford it.

text.traditional: 他很想當背包客去非洲旅行，只不過公司的事情太多，實在走不開。
text.simplified: 他很想当背包客去非洲旅行，只不过公司的事情太多，实在走不开。
text.pinyin: Tā hěn xiǎng dāng bēibāokè qù Fēizhōu lǚxíng, zhǐbúguò gōngsī de shìqíng tài duō, shízài zǒu bù kāi.
text.english: He'd really like to go backpacking in Africa; it's just that he has too much to do at work and really can't get away.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 只不過 has the same meaning as 只是, which is used to supplement something and let the listener know more about the situation. 只不過 is followed by the supplementary explanation.
summary: 只不過 adds a note to what was said, so the listener understands the situation better.
It means 只是. Put the added explanation after it.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that someone or something caused a bad result for someone, using 害.
grammarPages.explanation: 這個「害」有「讓」或「使」的意思，語氣比較強烈。「害」的後面接負面的結果。
grammarPages.pattern: Cause / Subject + 害 + Victim / Object + Negative Result

text.traditional: ……他死也不肯去，害我擔心得不得了。
text.simplified: ……他死也不肯去，害我担心得不得了。
text.pinyin: …Tā sǐ yě bù kěn qù, hài wǒ dānxīn de bùdéliǎo.
text.english: …He flatly refused to go, which made me terribly worried.

text.traditional: 周先生爬山時迷了路，山上很偏僻，手機的訊號很弱，害他沒辦法跟家人聯絡。
text.simplified: 周先生爬山时迷了路，山上很偏僻，手机的讯号很弱，害他没办法跟家人联络。
text.pinyin: Zhōu xiānshēng páshān shí mí le lù, shān shàng hěn piānpì, shǒujī de xùnhào hěn ruò, hài tā méibànfǎ gēn jiārén liánluò.
text.english: Mr. Zhou got lost while hiking. The mountain was very remote and his phone signal was weak, which left him unable to contact his family.

text.traditional: 要是老師每天要求學生寫很多測驗題目，不僅對學習沒好處，也會害他們更討厭讀書。
text.simplified: 要是老师每天要求学生写很多测验题目，不仅对学习没好处，也会害他们更讨厌读书。
text.pinyin: Yàoshì lǎoshī měitiān yāoqiú xuéshēng xiě hěn duō cèyàn tímù, bù jǐn duì xuéxí méi hǎochù, yě huì hài tāmen gèng tǎoyàn dúshū.
text.english: If teachers make students do lots of test questions every day, not only will it not help their learning, it will also make them hate studying even more.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This 害 has the meaning of 讓 or 使, but the tone is stronger. 害 is followed by a negative result.
summary: 害 is like 讓 or 使 but stronger. It says something causes a bad result for someone.
Put the cause before 害, then the person affected, then the bad result.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 追求健康與幸福的生活

text.traditional: 家豪的伯伯林水木是一家玩具工廠的大老闆，工作三十年了。雖然這段期間遇到了不少挫折，但是他很堅強，為了給家人安定的生活、當員工的榜樣，他都努力克服、堅持到底，終於擁有了今天的成就。
text.simplified: 家豪的伯伯林水木是一家玩具工厂的大老板，工作三十年了。虽然这段期间遇到了不少挫折，但是他很坚强，为了给家人安定的生活、当员工的榜样，他都努力克服、坚持到底，终于拥有了今天的成就。
text.pinyin: Jiāháo de bóbo Lín Shuǐmù shì yì jiā wánjù gōngchǎng de dà lǎobǎn, gōngzuò sānshí nián le. Suīrán zhè duàn qíjiān yùdào le bùshǎo cuòzhé, dànshì tā hěn jiānqiáng, wèile gěi jiārén āndìng de shēnghuó, dāng yuángōng de bǎngyàng, tā dōu nǔlì kèfú, jiānchí dàodǐ, zhōngyú yǒngyǒu le jīntiān de chéngjiù.
text.english: Jiahao's uncle Lin Shuimu is the owner of a toy factory, where he has worked for thirty years. Although encountering numerous setbacks over this period, he remained steadfast; to provide stability for his family and serve as a model for employees, he persevered through difficulties to the very end, finally achieving today's success.

text.traditional: 過去三十年，林伯伯不但經常到各部門了解情況，對產品標準的要求也較高。他認為自己是公司的主角，要是少了他，銷售成績一定不理想。在家豪的記憶中，伯伯每天的生活就像打仗一樣，老是忙得忘了吃飯，有時緊張得睡不著。有一次他跟部門主管開會，因為討論得太激烈，頭突然痛得不得了，連站都站不起來，助理立刻送他到醫院去。
text.simplified: 过去三十年，林伯伯不但经常到各部门了解情况，对产品标准的要求也较高。他认为自己是公司的主角，要是少了他，销售成绩一定不理想。在家豪的记忆中，伯伯每天的生活就像打仗一样，老是忙得忘了吃饭，有时紧张得睡不着。有一次他跟部门主管开会，因为讨论得太激烈，头突然痛得不得了，连站都站不起来，助理立刻送他到医院去。
text.pinyin: Guòqù sānshí nián, Lín bóbo búdàn jīngcháng dào gè bùmén liǎojiě qíngkuàng, duì chǎnpǐn biāozhǔn de yāoqiú yě jiào gāo. Tā rènwéi zìjǐ shì gōngsī de zhǔjiǎo, yàoshì shǎo le tā, xiāoshòu chéngjī yídìng bù lǐxiǎng. Zài Jiāháo de jìyì zhōng, bóbo měitiān de shēnghuó jiù xiàng dǎzhàng yíyàng, lǎoshì máng de wàngle chīfàn, yǒu shí jǐnzhāng de shuì bùzháo. Yǒu yí cì tā gēn bùmén zhǔguǎn kāihuì, yīnwèi tǎolùn de tài jīliè, tóu túrán tòng de bùdéliǎo, lián zhàn dōu zhàn bù qǐlái, zhùlǐ lìkè sòng tā dào yīyuàn qù.
text.english: Over the past thirty years, Uncle Lin not only inspected departments regularly, but maintained demanding product standards. He viewed himself as the key figure in the company, believing sales would suffer without him. In Jiahao's memory, his uncle lived every day like a battle, constantly too busy to eat, and sometimes too stressed to sleep. Once, during a meeting with his department managers, the discussion got so heated that he suddenly had a terrible headache and couldn't even stand up, and his assistant immediately took him to the hospital.

text.traditional: 醫生告訴林伯伯，想要早日恢復健康，除了調整生活作息，還要培養符合健康的飲食習慣。比如每天早睡早起、按時間吃飯、運動三十分鐘，避免吃太鹹、太油的食物。他也一再警告林伯伯，別拿生命開玩笑，假如不改變過去的生活方式，恐怕連上帝也救不了了。
text.simplified: 医生告诉林伯伯，想要早日恢复健康，除了调整生活作息，还要培养符合健康的饮食习惯。比如每天早睡早起、按时间吃饭、运动三十分钟，避免吃太咸、太油的食物。他也一再警告林伯伯，别拿生命开玩笑，假如不改变过去的生活方式，恐怕连上帝也救不了了。
text.pinyin: Yīshēng gàosu Lín bóbo, xiǎngyào zǎorì huīfù jiànkāng, chúle tiáozhěng shēnghuó zuòxí, háiyào péiyǎng fúhé jiànkāng de yǐnshí xíguàn. Bǐrú měitiān zǎoshuì zǎoqǐ, àn shíjiān chīfàn, yùndòng sānshí fēnzhōng, bìmiǎn chī tài xián, tài yóu de shíwù. Tā yě yízài jǐnggào Lín bóbo, bié ná shēngmìng kāiwánxiào, jiǎrú bù gǎibiàn guòqù de shēnghuó fāngshì, kǒngpà lián Shàngdì yě jiù bùliǎo le.
text.english: The doctor advised Uncle Lin that regaining health required adjusting daily schedules and cultivating balanced diet habits: sleeping early and rising early, eating meals on time, exercising thirty minutes daily, and avoiding overly salty or greasy fare. He also warned Uncle Lin again and again not to gamble with his life: if he didn't change his old way of life, he was afraid even God wouldn't be able to save him.

text.traditional: 最初，林伯伯不太能適應這樣的改變，要是覺得食物的味道太淡，還是會加一些醬料；為了多運動，每天走路去上班，但經常走到一半就沒體力了，只好搭計程車。最後家人不得不一起來協助他，陪他吃飯、運動，甚至走路上下班。還好經過了一段時間，林伯伯終於恢復健康，不再教家人擔心了。
text.simplified: 最初，林伯伯不太能适应这样的改变，要是觉得食物的味道太淡，还是会加一些酱料；为了多运动，每天走路去上班，但经常走到一半就没体力了，只好搭计程车。最后家人不得不一起来协助他，陪他吃饭、运动，甚至走路上下班。还好经过了一段时间，林伯伯终于恢复健康，不再教家人担心了。
text.pinyin: Zuìchū, Lín bóbo bú tài néng shìyìng zhèyàng de gǎibiàn, yàoshì juéde shíwù de wèidào tài dàn, háishì huì jiā yìxiē jiàngliào; wèile duō yùndòng, měitiān zǒulù qù shàngbān, dàn jīngcháng zǒu dào yíbàn jiù méi tǐlì le, zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē. Zuìhòu jiārén bùdébù yìqǐ lái xiézhù tā, péi tā chīfàn, yùndòng, shènzhì zǒulù shàng xiàbān. Háihǎo jīngguò le yí duàn shíjiān, Lín bóbo zhōngyú huīfù jiànkāng, búzài jiào jiārén dānxīn le.
text.english: Initially, Uncle Lin struggled with the shift: when food tasted bland he still added sauces; to exercise he walked to work, but frequently ran out of steam halfway and hailed a taxi. In the end, his family had no choice but to help him, sharing meals, exercising, and even walking commutes together. Fortunately, after a while Uncle Lin recovered his health, bringing peace of mind back to his family.

text.traditional: 就在林伯伯為了健康而努力時，他的一位老朋友因為工作太累，僅僅五十歲就不幸去世了。這個壞消息給了林伯伯很大的刺激，讓他重新思考努力工作到底是為了什麼，真正的幸福又是什麼。或許，誰都找不到正確的答案，不過健康一定是最重要的。
text.simplified: 就在林伯伯为了健康而努力时，他的一位老朋友因为工作太累，仅仅五十岁就不幸去世了。这个坏消息给了林伯伯很大的刺激，让他重新思考努力工作到底是为了什么，真正的幸福又是什么。或许，谁都找不到正确的答案，不过健康一定是最重要的。
text.pinyin: Jiù zài Lín bóbo wèile jiànkāng ér nǔlì shí, tā de yí wèi lǎo péngyǒu yīnwèi gōngzuò tài lèi, jǐnjǐn wǔshí suì jiù búxìng qùshì le. Zhè ge huài xiāoxí gěi le Lín bóbo hěn dà de cìjī, ràng tā chóngxīn sīkǎo nǔlì gōngzuò dàodǐ shì wèile shénme, zhēnzhèng de xìngfú yòu shì shénme. Huòxǔ, shéi dōu zhǎobúdào zhèngquè de dá'àn, búguò jiànkāng yídìng shì zuì zhòngyào de.
text.english: Just as Uncle Lin was striving for health, an old friend of his passed away at merely fifty years old from work exhaustion. This somber news dealt him a profound shock, causing him to reevaluate what relentless work is ultimately for, and what true happiness really means. Perhaps nobody has definitive answers, but good health is certainly paramount.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Carrying Through to the End with V到底
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize persevering, pursuing, or seeing an action through to the very end.
grammarPages.explanation: 強調某件事做到最後，或堅持、努力到最後。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + Verb + 到底

text.traditional: ……他都努力克服、堅持到底，終於擁有了今天的成就。
text.simplified: ……他都努力克服、坚持到底，终于拥有了今天的成就。
text.pinyin: …Tā dōu nǔlì kèfú, jiānchí dàodǐ, zhōngyú yǒngyǒu le jīntiān de chéngjiù.
text.english: …he worked hard to overcome every setback and stuck with it to the end, finally achieving the success he has today.

text.traditional: 既然我答應要幫你，就一定會幫到底的，請放心。
text.simplified: 既然我答应要帮你，就一定会帮到底的，请放心。
text.pinyin: Jìrán wǒ dāyìng yào bāng nǐ, jiù yídìng huì bāng dàodǐ de, qǐng fàngxīn.
text.english: Since I promised to help you, I'll definitely help you all the way to the end. Don't worry.

text.traditional: 這個工作是你自己決定要做的，必須負責到底，不可以碰到麻煩就不做了。
text.simplified: 这个工作是你自己决定要做的，必须负责到底，不可以碰到麻烦就不做了。
text.pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò shì nǐ zìjǐ juédìng yào zuò de, bìxū fùzé dàodǐ, bù kěyǐ pèngdào máfán jiù bú zuò le.
text.english: You decided to do this job yourself, so you have to take responsibility for it to the end. You can't just quit as soon as you run into trouble.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: V 到底 emphasizes that something is carried out to the end, persistently and diligently.
summary: 到底 after a verb stresses carrying something through to the end, with effort.
Put 到底 after the verb: say 堅持到底, not 到底堅持.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe actions, warnings, or appeals that recur again and again with 一再.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示某個動作或事情一次又一次地發生。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一再 + Verb Phrase

text.traditional: 他也一再警告林伯伯，別拿生命開玩笑……
text.simplified: 他也一再警告林伯伯，别拿生命开玩笑……
text.pinyin: Tā yě yízài jǐnggào Lín bóbo, bié ná shēngmìng kāiwánxiào…
text.english: He also warned Uncle Lin again and again not to gamble with his life…

text.traditional: 李先生上班一再遲到，直到老闆叫他明天起別來了，他才知道事情有多麼嚴重。
text.simplified: 李先生上班一再迟到，直到老板叫他明天起别来了，他才知道事情有多么严重。
text.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng shàngbān yízài chídào, zhídào lǎobǎn jiào tā míngtiān qǐ bié lái le, tā cái zhīdào shìqíng yǒu duóme yánzhòng.
text.english: Mr. Li was late for work again and again. Not until his boss told him not to come in anymore starting tomorrow did he realize how serious things were.

text.traditional: 選舉時市長一再向民眾強調，當選後一定會好好改善交通情況，但沒想到現在反而更嚴重了。
text.simplified: 选举时市长一再向民众强调，当选后一定会好好改善交通情况，但没想到现在反而更严重了。
text.pinyin: Xuǎnjǔ shí shìzhǎng yízài xiàng mínzhòng qiángdiào, dāngxuǎn hòu yídìng huì hǎohǎo gǎishàn jiāotōng qíngkuàng, dàn méixiǎngdào xiànzài fǎn'ér gèng yánzhòng le.
text.english: During the election, the mayor stressed to the public again and again that once elected, he would definitely improve traffic. Unexpectedly, it has now become even worse instead.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 一再 indicates that a certain action has taken place or an event has occurred again and again.
summary: 一再 says an action or event happens again and again.
Put it after the subject and before the verb.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Saying 'If' in Writing with 假如
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say 'if' or 'suppose' with 假如, mostly in writing, placing it before the subject.
grammarPages.explanation: 「假如」跟「如果」、「要是」一樣，用來假設某個條件或情況，常和「就」搭配使用，表示在假設條件或情況下發生的結果。「如果」可用在主語前後，可用於書面、口語；「要是」也可用在主語前後，但僅用於口語；「假如」用在主語前，多用於書面。
grammarPages.pattern: 假如 + Condition, + (Subject) + 就 / 恐怕 + Result

text.traditional: ……假如不改變過去的生活方式，恐怕連上帝也救不了了。
text.simplified: ……假如不改变过去的生活方式，恐怕连上帝也救不了了。
text.pinyin: …Jiǎrú bù gǎibiàn guòqù de shēnghuó fāngshì, kǒngpà lián Shàngdì yě jiù bùliǎo le.
text.english: …If he doesn't change his old way of life, I'm afraid even God won't be able to save him.

text.traditional: 假如你對自己的穿著品味沒有信心，可以多看服裝雜誌或聽聽專櫃小姐的意見。
text.simplified: 假如你对自己的穿着品味没有信心，可以多看服装杂志或听听专柜小姐的意见。
text.pinyin: Jiǎrú nǐ duì zìjǐ de chuānzhuó pǐnwèi méiyǒu xìnxīn, kěyǐ duō kàn fúzhuāng zázhì huò tīng tīng zhuānguì xiǎojiě de yìjiàn.
text.english: If you're not confident about your taste in clothes, you can read more fashion magazines or listen to the advice of the salespeople at the brand counters.

text.traditional: 他是個有耐心、做事認真的人，假如讓他負責推銷新產品，應該會有不錯的成果。
text.simplified: 他是个有耐心、做事认真的人，假如让他负责推销新产品，应该会有不错的成果。
text.pinyin: Tā shì ge yǒu nàixīn, zuòshì rènzhēn de rén, jiǎrú ràng tā fùzé tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn, yīnggāi huì yǒu búcuò de chéngguǒ.
text.english: He's a patient person who takes his work seriously. If we put him in charge of selling the new products, the results should be quite good.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: As with 如果 and 要是, 假如 is used to assume a certain condition or situation. The following sentence is often used in conjunction with 就 to indicate the result of a hypothetical condition or situation. 如果 can be used before and after the subject, both written and spoken. 要是 can also be used before and after the subject, but only in spoken Chinese; 假如 is used before the subject in written Chinese.
summary: 假如, 如果 and 要是 all set up a condition. The result often follows with 就.
假如 goes before the subject and is mostly used in writing.
如果 works in writing or speech. 要是 works only in speech. Both can go before or after the subject.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Purpose and Action with 為了……而……
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Link a goal (為了……) with what someone does to reach it (而……).
grammarPages.explanation: 「為了」之後的短語說明要達到的目標，「而」後面的短語說明為了達到目標所做的事情。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 為了 + Goal + 而 + Action

text.traditional: 就在林伯伯為了健康而努力時，他的一位老朋友因為工作太累……
text.simplified: 就在林伯伯为了健康而努力时，他的一位老朋友因为工作太累……
text.pinyin: Jiù zài Lín bóbo wèile jiànkāng ér nǔlì shí, tā de yí wèi lǎo péngyǒu yīnwèi gōngzuò tài lèi…
text.english: Right when Uncle Lin was striving for his health, an old friend of his, worn out from work…

text.traditional: 他為了挑戰臺灣最高的高山，而每天慢跑一小時，訓練自己的體力。
text.simplified: 他为了挑战台湾最高的高山，而每天慢跑一小时，训练自己的体力。
text.pinyin: Tā wèile tiǎozhàn Táiwān zuì gāo de gāoshān, ér měitiān mànpǎo yì xiǎoshí, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì.
text.english: In order to take on Taiwan's highest mountain peak, he jogs an hour every day to build his stamina.

text.traditional: 他為了讓生病的母親快點兒好起來，而學習做一些對身體健康有好處的菜。
text.simplified: 他为了让生病的母亲快点儿好起来，而学习做一些对身体健康有好处的菜。
text.pinyin: Tā wèile ràng shēngbìng de mǔqīn kuài diǎnr hǎo qǐlái, ér xuéxí zuò yìxiē duì shēntǐ jiànkāng yǒu hǎochù de cài.
text.english: To help his sick mother get better sooner, he learned to cook some dishes that are good for her health.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The clause following 為了 explains the objective to be achieved. The clause following 而 shows in what manner the objective was achieved.
summary: 為了……而…… says what someone does to reach a goal.
The part after 為了 is the goal. The part after 而 is what is done to reach it.

dialogue.title: 網路交友要小心

text.traditional: 最近新聞提到，有個博士透過社群網站，認識了一個女網友，給了她很多錢以後，才知道被騙了。
text.simplified: 最近新闻提到，有个博士透过社群网站，认识了一个女网友，给了她很多钱以后，才知道被骗了。
text.pinyin: Zuìjìn xīnwén tídào, yǒu ge bóshì tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, rènshì le yíge nǚ wǎngyǒu, gěi le tā hěn duō qián yǐhòu, cái zhīdào bèi piàn le.
text.english: The news recently reported that a PhD holder got to know a woman through a social networking site, gave her a lot of money, and only then realized he had been swindled.

text.traditional: 我看過那個新聞。那個騙子假裝是大學生，故意找很老實的男生聊天，表面上對他們很好，等對方相信她以後就騙他們說，媽媽病了，需要錢看醫生。對吧？
text.simplified: 我看过那个新闻。那个骗子假装是大学生，故意找很老实的男生聊天，表面上对他们很好，等对方相信她以后就骗他们说，妈妈病了，需要钱看医生。对吧？
text.pinyin: Wǒ kàn guò nà ge xīnwén. Nà ge piànzi jiǎzhuāng shì dàxuéshēng, gùyì zhǎo hěn lǎoshí de nánshēng liáotiān, biǎomiàn shàng duì tāmen hěn hǎo, děng duìfāng xiāngxìn tā yǐhòu jiù piàn tāmen shuō, māma bìng le, xūyào qián kàn yīshēng. Duì ba?
text.english: I saw that news. That scammer pretended to be a college student, deliberately chatted with honest men, acted very kindly on the surface, and once they trusted her, lied that her mother was sick and needed medical money. Right?

text.traditional: 嗯。看到這類新聞，害我不敢上網交友了。你呢？你有這樣的經驗嗎？
text.simplified: 嗯。看到这类新闻，害我不敢上网交友了。你呢？你有这样的经验吗？
text.pinyin: Ēn. Kàndào zhèlèi xīnwén, hài wǒ bù gǎn shàngwǎng jiāoyǒu le. Nǐ ne? Nǐ yǒu zhèyàng de jīngyàn ma?
text.english: Yes. Seeing news like this makes me afraid to make online friends. What about you? Have you had any experience like that?

text.traditional: 以前遇過一次。剛開始我和對方只聊了幾句，後來有幾次聊電影聊得很開心，就越來越熟了，也會互相問候家人。
text.simplified: 以前遇过一次。刚开始我和对方只聊了几句，后来有几次聊电影聊得很开心，就越来越熟了，也会互相问候家人。
text.pinyin: Yǐqián yù guò yí cì. Gāng kāishǐ wǒ hé duìfāng zhǐ liáo le jǐ jù, hòulái yǒu jǐ cì liáo diànyǐng liáo de hěn kāixīn, jiù yuèláiyuè shóu le, yě huì hùxiāng wènhòu jiārén.
text.english: I encountered it once before. At first we only exchanged a few words, but later after talking happily about movies several times, we grew closer and began asking after each other's families.

text.traditional: 那時候你想進一步認識對方嗎？比如說跟對方見個面、吃個飯什麼的。
text.simplified: 那时候你想进一步认识对方吗？比如说跟对方见个面、吃个饭什么的。
text.pinyin: Nà shíhòu nǐ xiǎng jìnyíbù rènshì duìfāng ma? Bǐrú shuō gēn duìfāng jiàn ge miàn, chī ge fàn shénme de.
text.english: At that time did you want to get to know her further? For example, meeting in person, sharing a meal, or something like that?

text.traditional: 我沒想過跟她約會。不過大概過了一個月，她突然跟我說，家人發生嚴重的車禍，住院的費用很高，想跟我借十萬塊。
text.simplified: 我没想过跟她约会。不过大概过了一个月，她突然跟我说，家人发生严重的车祸，住院的费用很高，想跟我借十万块。
text.pinyin: Wǒ méi xiǎng guò gēn tā yuēhuì. Búguò dàgài guò le yíge yuè, tā túrán gēn wǒ shuō, jiārén fāshēng yánzhòng de chēhuò, zhùyuàn de fèiyòng hěn gāo, xiǎng gēn wǒ jiè shíwàn kuài.
text.english: I never considered dating her. However, after about a month, she suddenly told me her family was in a severe car accident with high hospitalization costs, and wanted to borrow 100,000 NTD.

text.traditional: 十萬塊？這麼多！你借她了嗎？
text.simplified: 十万块？这么多！你借她了吗？
text.pinyin: Shíwàn kuài? Zhème duō! Nǐ jiè tā le ma?
text.english: 100,000 NTD? That's so much! Did you lend it to her?

text.traditional: 當然沒。如果是兩萬塊以下，我可能願意借，十萬塊就太多了。再說，雖然對她不陌生，可是畢竟沒見過面，萬一借了以後才發現她說的都是假的，不但錢拿不回來，心也會很痛的。
text.simplified: 当然没。如果是两万块以下，我可能愿意借，十万块就太多了。再说，虽然对她不陌生，可是毕竟没见过面，万一借了以后才发现她说的都是假的，不但钱拿不回来，心也会很痛的。
text.pinyin: Dāngrán méi. Rúguǒ shì liǎngwàn kuài yǐxià, wǒ kěnéng yuànyì jiè, shíwàn kuài jiù tài duō le. Zàishuō, suīrán duì tā bú mòshēng, kěshì bìjìng méi jiàn guò miàn, wànyī jiè le yǐhòu cái fāxiàn tā shuō de dōu shì jiǎ de, búdàn qián ná bù huílái, xīn yě huì hěn tòng de.
text.english: Of course not. If it were under 20,000 NTD, I might have been willing, but 100,000 is too much. Besides, although she wasn't a stranger to me, we had never met after all. What if I lent it and only then found out that everything she said was false? Not only would I never get the money back, it would break my heart too.

text.traditional: 是啊。有一些人在網路上填假資料，要是我們不小心，很可能就成了被騙的對象。不過，也許那個網友真的很可憐，需要你的幫助。
text.simplified: 是啊。有一些人在网路上填假资料，要是我们不小心，很可能就成了被骗的对象。不过，也许那个网友真的很可怜，需要你的帮助。
text.pinyin: Shì a. Yǒu yìxiē rén zài wǎnglù shàng tián jiǎ zīliào, yàoshì wǒmen bù xiǎoxīn, hěn kěnéng jiù chéng le bèi piàn de duìxiàng. Búguò, yěxǔ nà ge wǎngyǒu zhēnde hěn kělián, xūyào nǐ de bāngzhù.
text.english: Indeed. Some people fill out fake profiles online; if we aren't careful, we could easily become scam targets. Still, perhaps that online friend really deserved pity and needed your help.

text.traditional: 我本來也很同情她，還問她媽媽得住院住多久。可是她一下子說半個月，一下子說一個月，故意不說清楚。後來，我發現她不誠實，就不再跟她聯絡了。
text.simplified: 我本来也很同情她，还问她妈妈得住院住多久。可是她一下子说半个月，一下子说一个月，故意不说清楚。后来，我发现她不诚实，就不再跟她联络了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái yě hěn tóngqíng tā, hái wèn tā māma děi zhùyuàn zhù duōjiǔ. Kěshì tā yíxiàzi shuō bàn ge yuè, yíxiàzi shuō yíge yuè, gùyì bù shuō qīngchǔ. Hòulái, wǒ fāxiàn tā bù chéngshí, jiù bú zài gēn tā liánluò le.
text.english: I was sympathetic at first, and asked how long her mother had to be hospitalized. But she said half a month one moment and a month the next, deliberately not making it clear. Later, finding her dishonest, I stopped contacting her.

text.traditional: 發現她不誠實？怎麼說呢？
text.simplified: 发现她不诚实？怎么说呢？
text.pinyin: Fāxiàn tā bù chéngshí? Zěnme shuō ne?
text.english: Found her dishonest? How so?

text.traditional: 那時有一個網友把自己網路交友上當的經驗，寫在部落格上。我看了以後，發現騙他的人和跟我借錢的網友是同一個人，她用同樣的方法騙了不少人。
text.simplified: 那时有一个网友把自己网路交友上当的经验，写在部落格上。我看了以后，发现骗他的人和跟我借钱的网友是同一个人，她用同样的方法骗了不少人。
text.pinyin: Nà shí yǒu yíge wǎngyǒu bǎ zìjǐ wǎnglù jiāoyǒu shàngdàng de jīngyàn, xiě zài bùluògé shàng. Wǒ kàn le yǐhòu, fāxiàn piàn tā de rén hé gēn wǒ jiè qián de wǎngyǒu shì tóng yíge rén, tā yòng tóngyàng de fāngfǎ piàn le bùshǎo rén.
text.english: At that time an internet user wrote on his blog about how he had been tricked while making friends online. After reading it, I realized that the person who cheated him and the online friend who wanted to borrow money from me were the same person—she had defrauded many people the same way.

text.traditional: 這種人實在太可惡了。不過那時候你差點兒被騙了，後來還敢上網交朋友嗎？
text.simplified: 这种人实在太可恶了。不过那时候你差点儿被骗了，后来还敢上网交朋友吗？
text.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng rén shízài tài kěwù le. Búguò nà shíhòu nǐ chàdiǎnr bèi piàn le, hòulái hái gǎn shàngwǎng jiāo péngyǒu ma?
text.english: That kind of person is truly despicable. But having nearly been scammed back then, did you dare make friends online afterward?

text.traditional: 雖然我也看不起這種人，但網路交友的方式還是不錯的，而且網友也不都是壞人。
text.simplified: 虽然我也看不起这种人，但网路交友的方式还是不错的，而且网友也不都是坏人。
text.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ yě kànbùqǐ zhè zhǒng rén, dàn wǎnglù jiāoyǒu de fāngshì háishì búcuò de, érqiě wǎngyǒu yě bù dōu shì huàirén.
text.english: Although I also look down on such people, making friends online is still a good way to meet people, and not everyone you meet online is bad.

text.traditional: 聽你這麼說，讓我回想起剛來臺灣的時候，透過社群網站，找到了會說日語的臺灣網友。他幫我找房子、認識環境，真的很感謝他。
text.simplified: 听你这么说，让我回想起刚来台湾的时候，透过社群网站，找到了会说日语的台湾网友。他帮我找房子、认识环境，真的很感谢他。
text.pinyin: Tīng nǐ zhème shuō, ràng wǒ huíxiǎng qǐ gāng lái Táiwān de shíhòu, tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, zhǎodào le huì shuō Rì yǔ de Táiwān wǎngyǒu. Tā bāng wǒ zhǎo fángzi, rènshì huánjìng, zhēnde hěn gǎnxiè tā.
text.english: Hearing you say that reminds me of when I first arrived in Taiwan: through a social networking site I found a Taiwanese online friend who spoke Japanese. He helped me find a place to live and get to know the area; I'm genuinely grateful to him.

text.traditional: 嗯！透過網路可以擴大交友的範圍，所以別因為有人被騙了，就拒絕使用這種交友方式。況且在真實生活中，騙子也不少啊！
text.simplified: 嗯！透过网路可以扩大交友的范围，所以别因为有人被骗了，就拒绝使用这种交友方式。况且在真实生活中，骗子也不少啊！
text.pinyin: Ēn! Tòuguò wǎnglù kěyǐ kuòdà jiāoyǒu de fànwéi, suǒyǐ bié yīnwèi yǒu rén bèi piàn le, jiù jùjué shǐyòng zhè zhǒng jiāoyǒu fāngshì. Kuàngqiě zài zhēnshí shēnghuó zhōng, piànzi yě bùshǎo a!
text.english: Yes! Through the internet we can expand our social circle, so don't reject this channel just because someone was scammed. Besides, there are plenty of swindlers in real life too!

text.traditional: 你說的對。網路交友還是可靠的，也能認識不少興趣相同的朋友。像你建立的健身社團網站，裡面有很多訊息，包括健身的影片、舉行活動的日期和地點等等，都很有用、很吸引人。
text.simplified: 你说的对。网路交友还是可靠的，也能认识不少兴趣相同的朋友。像你建立的健身社团网站，里面有很多讯息，包括健身的影片、举行活动的日期和地点等等，都很有用、很吸引人。
text.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de duì. Wǎnglù jiāoyǒu háishì kěkào de, yě néng rènshì bùshǎo xìngqù xiāngtóng de péngyǒu. Xiàng nǐ jiànlì de jiànshēn shètuán wǎngzhàn, lǐmiàn yǒu hěn duō xùnxī, bāokuò jiànshēn de yǐngpiàn, jǔxíng huódòng de rìqī hé dìdiǎn děngděng, dōu hěn yǒuyòng, hěn xīyǐn rén.
text.english: You're right. Making friends online can still be reliable, helping us meet friends with shared interests. For instance, the fitness club site you built contains rich content—workout videos, event dates, locations—all very useful and engaging.

text.traditional: 既然妳覺得很吸引人，歡迎加入，免費喔！
text.simplified: 既然你觉得很吸引人，欢迎加入，免费喔！
text.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ juéde hěn xīyǐn rén, huānyíng jiārù, miǎnfèi o!
text.english: Since you find it appealing, welcome aboard—it's free!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express achieving a goal or contacting others through a medium, person, or method with 透過.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示經過某人、事物或某種行為，達到某種目的或結果。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 透過 + Medium + Action

text.traditional: ……有個博士透過社群網站，認識了一個女網友……
text.simplified: ……有个博士透过社群网站，认识了一个女网友……
text.pinyin: …Yǒu ge bóshì tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, rènshì le yíge nǚ wǎngyǒu…
text.english: …A man with a PhD got to know a woman through a social networking site…

text.traditional: 人們習慣透過眼睛確認實際的情況，總是認為眼睛看到的就是對的。
text.simplified: 人们习惯透过眼睛确认实际的情况，总是认为眼睛看到的就是对的。
text.pinyin: Rénmen xíguàn tòuguò yǎnjīng quèrèn shíjì de qíngkuàng, zǒngshì rènwéi yǎnjīng kàndào de jiùshì duì de.
text.english: People are used to confirming the real situation through their own eyes, and always believe that what they see is right.

text.traditional: 康教授認為透過團體活動的方式，能讓學生學習到溝通的技巧。
text.simplified: 康教授认为透过团体活动的方式，能让学生学习到沟通的技巧。
text.pinyin: Kāng jiàoshòu rènwéi tòuguò tuántǐ huódòng de fāngshì, néng ràng xuéshēng xuéxí dào gōutōng de jìqiǎo.
text.english: Professor Kang believes that through group activities, students can learn communication skills.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 透過 represents a person, thing, or behavior by which a certain result is achieved.
summary: 透過 says a person, thing or action is the way a result is reached.
Put what you went through after 透過, then the action.
Use 透過, not 經過 or 通過, for this meaning.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Above / Below with 以上 / 以下
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that an amount is at or above a point with 以上, or below it with 以下.
grammarPages.explanation: 「以上」表示「超過」或「高於」某一點，同時也包含「某一點」，例如：「六十分以上及格」包括「六十分」。「以下」表示「低於」或「未達到」某一點。「以」與方位詞一起使用時，例如：以內、以外、以北、以南等，表示在某個一定的範圍。
grammarPages.pattern: Number + 以上/以下 + Result

text.traditional: 如果是兩萬塊以下，我可能願意借，十萬塊就太多了。
text.simplified: 如果是两万块以下，我可能愿意借，十万块就太多了。
text.pinyin: Rúguǒ shì liǎngwàn kuài yǐxià, wǒ kěnéng yuànyì jiè, shíwàn kuài jiù tài duō le.
text.english: If it is under 20,000, I might be willing to lend it; 100,000 would be too much.

text.traditional: 教授說成績八十分以上的學生才能得到獎學金，我剛好八十分，太好了。
text.simplified: 教授说成绩八十分以上的学生才能得到奖学金，我刚好八十分，太好了。
text.pinyin: Jiàoshòu shuō chéngjī bāshí fēn yǐshàng de xuéshēng cái néng dédào jiǎngxuéjīn, wǒ gānghǎo bāshí fēn, tài hǎo le.
text.english: The professor said only students who score 80 or above can get the scholarship. I got exactly 80. That's great!

text.traditional: 那家網路商店為了吸引客人，只要購物一千元以上，就可以免費把商品送到家。
text.simplified: 那家网路商店为了吸引客人，只要购物一千元以上，就可以免费把商品送到家。
text.pinyin: Nà jiā wǎnglù shāngdiàn wèile xīyǐn kèrén, zhǐyào gòuwù yìqiān yuán yǐshàng, jiù kěyǐ miǎnfèi bǎ shāngpǐn sòng dào jiā.
text.english: To attract customers, that online store delivers goods home for free if you spend 1,000 or more.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 以上 means 超過(exceed) or 高於(be higher than) a certain point, and also includes 某一點(a certain point). For example, 六十分以上及格(grades above 60 points are considered passing) also includes 60 points. 以下 means 低於(below) or 未達到(not to have reached) a certain point. When 以 is used together with a position word, for example, 以內, 以外, 以北 or 以南, it means something within a certain range.
summary: 以上 means more than or higher than a point, and it includes that point. 六十分以上 includes 六十分.
以下 means lower than a point, or not reaching it.
以 with a direction word, as in 以內, 以外, 以北 or 以南, marks a range.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Think Highly of / Look Down Upon (看得起 / 看不起)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express respect or disdain toward someone with 看得起 ('respect/esteem') and 看不起 ('look down on').
grammarPages.explanation: 「看得起、看不起」表示對人的重視程度。「看得起」表示認為對方很重要；「看不起」有輕視對方的意思。第二冊第四課的語法「V 得起/V 不起」表示一個人的經濟能力能否負擔。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 看得起/看不起 + Person

text.traditional: 雖然我也看不起這種人，但網路交友的方式還是不錯的……
text.simplified: 虽然我也看不起这种人，但网路交友的方式还是不错的……
text.pinyin: Suīrán wǒ yě kànbùqǐ zhè zhǒng rén, dàn wǎnglù jiāoyǒu de fāngshì háishì búcuò de…
text.english: Although I look down on people like that too, making friends online is still not bad…

text.traditional: 你不可以看不起窮人，因為我們每個人都是一樣的，不能以地位、成就的高低來決定對人的態度。
text.simplified: 你不可以看不起穷人，因为我们每个人都是一样的，不能以地位、成就的高低来决定对人的态度。
text.pinyin: Nǐ bù kěyǐ kànbùqǐ qióngrén, yīnwèi wǒmen měi ge rén dōu shì yíyàng de, bùnéng yǐ dìwèi, chéngjiù de gāodī lái juédìng duì rén de tàidù.
text.english: You must not look down on poor people, because every one of us is the same; you can't decide how to treat people by how high or low their status and achievements are.

text.traditional: 主管看得起你，才把管理工廠工人的工作交給你，你要把握這個機會好好地表現。
text.simplified: 主管看得起你，才把管理工厂工人的工作交给你，你要把握这个机会好好地表现。
text.pinyin: Zhǔguǎn kàndeqǐ nǐ, cái bǎ guǎnlǐ gōngchǎng gōngrén de gōngzuò jiāo gěi nǐ, nǐ yào bǎwò zhè ge jīhuì hǎohǎo de biǎoxiàn.
text.english: The supervisor thinks highly of you, which is why he gave you the job of managing factory workers; you should seize this chance and do well.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 看得起, 看不起 indicates the level of respect shown to the other person. 看得起 means to consider the other party important; 看不起 means to look down on or to despise the other person. The grammar V 得起/V 不起, in the fourth lesson of Book 2, indicates whether a person can or can not afford something.
summary: 看得起 means you think the other person is important. 看不起 means you look down on them.
Don't mix it up with V得起 and V不起, which say whether someone can afford something.

items.title: Grammar 4–6 · Online Socializing Pros and Cons

dialogue.title: 短文 · 網路交友的優缺點

text.traditional: 自從無線網路出現的那天起，現代人的生活似乎就離不開網路了。
text.simplified: 自从无线网路出现的那天起，现代人的生活似乎就离不开网路了。
text.pinyin: Zìcóng wúxiàn wǎnglù chūxiàn de nà tiān qǐ, xiàndài rén de shēnghuó sìhū jiù lí bù kāi wǎnglù le.
text.english: Ever since the day wireless internet appeared, modern life seems unable to do without the internet.

text.traditional: 網路科技的進步，不但改變了從前的生活方式，就連人與人之間的關係，也產生了極大的變化。住在不同地區的人，可以透過網路互相交流，這一點是我們祖父母那個年代的人很難想像的。
text.simplified: 网路科技的进步，不但改变了从前的生活方式，就连人与人之间的关系，也产生了极大的变化。住在不同地区的人，可以透过网路互相交流，这一点是我们祖父母那个年代的人很难想像的。
text.pinyin: Wǎnglù kējì de jìnbù, búdàn gǎibiàn le cóngqián de shēnghuó fāngshì, jiù lián rén yǔ rén zhījiān de guānxì, yě chǎnshēng le jí dà de biànhuà. Zhù zài bùtóng dìqū de rén, kěyǐ tòuguò wǎnglù hùxiāng jiāoliú, zhè yìdiǎn shì wǒmen zǔfùmǔ nà ge niándài de rén hěn nán xiǎngxiàng de.
text.english: Advances in internet technology have not only changed the way people used to live; even relationships between people have changed enormously. People who live in different places can talk to each other online, something our grandparents' generation could hardly have imagined.

text.traditional: 在網路出現以前，想要做報告，得去圖書館借一堆書；想要認識新朋友，就非和本人面對面接觸不可。但現代社會只要有網路，就沒有時間和空間的限制，人人都可以隨時隨地傳訊息、查資料、認識世界各地的人。不但擴大了視野、增加了知識，甚至能和網友建立珍貴的友誼。但也因為這樣，越來越多人以網路傳訊息代替當面對話。時間久了，在真實世界中，人與人之間的關係就變得較冷淡了。
text.simplified: 在网路出现以前，想要做报告，得去图书馆借一堆书；想要认识新朋友，就非和本人面对面接触不可。但现代社会只要有网路，就没有时间和空间的限制，人人都可以随时随地传讯息、查资料、认识世界各地的人。不但扩大了视野、增加了知识，甚至能和网友建立珍贵的友谊。但也因为这样，越来越多人以网路传讯息代替当面对话。时间久了，在真实世界中，人与人之间的关系就变得较冷淡了。
text.pinyin: Zài wǎnglù chūxiàn yǐqián, xiǎngyào zuò bàogào, děi qù túshūguǎn jiè yì duī shū; xiǎngyào rènshì xīn péngyǒu, jiù fēi hé běnrén miàn duì miàn jiēchù bùkě. Dàn xiàndài shèhuì zhǐyào yǒu wǎnglù, jiù méiyǒu shíjiān hé kōngjiān de xiànzhì, rénrén dōu kěyǐ suíshí suídì chuán xùnxī, chá zīliào, rènshì shìjiè gèdì de rén. Búdàn kuòdà le shìyě, zēngjiā le zhīshì, shènzhì néng hé wǎngyǒu jiànlì zhēnguì de yǒuyí. Dàn yě yīnwèi zhèyàng, yuè lái yuè duō rén yǐ wǎnglù chuán xùnxī dàitì dāngmiàn duìhuà. Shíjiān jiǔ le, zài zhēnshí shìjiè zhōng, rén yǔ rén zhījiān de guānxì jiù biàn de jiào lěngdàn le.
text.english: Before the internet, if you wanted to write a report, you had to borrow a pile of books from the library; if you wanted to make new friends, you had to meet them face to face. But in modern society, as long as there is internet, there are no limits of time or space: anyone can send messages, look things up and get to know people from all over the world, anytime and anywhere. It not only broadens our horizons and adds to our knowledge; we can even build precious friendships with people we meet online. But because of this, more and more people send messages online instead of talking face to face. Over time, relationships between people in the real world have grown colder.

text.traditional: 在網路世界中，這種不必面對面的溝通方式，也讓部分不誠實的人，有機會用假資料到處騙人。例如，某人已經五十歲了，在網路上卻說自己才二十歲；有人已經有了老公或老婆，卻假裝自己單身。還有一些花心又不老實的人，用浪漫的話，讓渴望愛情的人或不懂事的青少年上當，那些騙子不僅可惡，還對不起社會。
text.simplified: 在网路世界中，这种不必面对面的沟通方式，也让部分不诚实的人，有机会用假资料到处骗人。例如，某人已经五十岁了，在网路上却说自己才二十岁；有人已经有了老公或老婆，却假装自己单身。还有一些花心又不老实的人，用浪漫的话，让渴望爱情的人或不懂事的青少年上当，那些骗子不仅可恶，还对不起社会。
text.pinyin: Zài wǎnglù shìjiè zhōng, zhè zhǒng búbì miàn duì miàn de gōutōng fāngshì, yě ràng bùfèn bù chéngshí de rén, yǒu jīhuì yòng jiǎ zīliào dàochù piàn rén. Lìrú, mǒu rén yǐjīng wǔshí suì le, zài wǎnglù shàng què shuō zìjǐ cái èrshí suì; yǒu rén yǐjīng yǒu le lǎogōng huò lǎopó, què jiǎzhuāng zìjǐ dānshēn. Háiyǒu yìxiē huāxīn yòu bù lǎoshí de rén, yòng làngmàn de huà, ràng kěwàng àiqíng de rén huò bù dǒngshì de qīngshàonián shàngdàng, nàxiē piànzi bù jǐn kěwù, hái duìbùqǐ shèhuì.
text.english: In the online world, this way of communicating without meeting face to face also gives some dishonest people the chance to cheat others with false information. For example, someone who is already fifty says online that he is only twenty; someone who already has a husband or wife pretends to be single. There are also fickle, dishonest people who use romantic words to fool people longing for love or naive teenagers. Those cheats are not only hateful; they also let society down.

text.traditional: 網路世界有美好的一面，也有危險的一面，網路交友同樣有優缺點。透過社群網站，可以交到好朋友，甚至找到理想的結婚對象；萬一不幸交到了壞朋友，錢被騙走了，就算怪自己也是沒有用的。畢竟網路只是提供一種更便利的交友方式給大家，至於要不要以網路交友取代傳統的交流方式，就看個人的選擇了。
text.simplified: 网路世界有美好的一面，也有危险的一面，网路交友同样有优缺点。透过社群网站，可以交到好朋友，甚至找到理想的结婚对象；万一不幸交到了坏朋友，钱被骗走了，就算怪自己也是没有用的。毕竟网路只是提供一种更便利的交友方式给大家，至于要不要以网路交友取代传统的交流方式，就看个人的选择了。
text.pinyin: Wǎnglù shìjiè yǒu měihǎo de yímiàn, yě yǒu wéixiǎn de yímiàn, wǎnglù jiāoyǒu tóngyàng yǒu yōu quē diǎn. Tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, kěyǐ jiāo dào hǎo péngyǒu, shènzhì zhǎodào lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng; wànyī búxìng jiāo dào le huài péngyǒu, qián bèi piàn zǒu le, jiùsuàn guài zìjǐ yě shì méiyǒu yòng de. Bìjìng wǎnglù zhǐshì tígōng yì zhǒng gèng biànlì de jiāoyǒu fāngshì gěi dàjiā, zhìyú yào bú yào yǐ wǎnglù jiāoyǒu qǔdài chuántǒng de jiāoliú fāngshì, jiù kàn gèrén de xuǎnzé le.
text.english: The online world has a good side and a dangerous side, and making friends online likewise has its pros and cons. Through social media you can make good friends and even find the ideal person to marry; but if you are unlucky enough to make bad friends and get cheated out of your money, blaming yourself won't help. After all, the internet only offers everyone a more convenient way to make friends; whether to replace the traditional ways of meeting people with online friendship is up to each person.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Highlight an unexpected, contrary result or reality using the adverb 卻 ('yet / however').
grammarPages.explanation: 「卻」作副詞，表示和事實或期望相反，放在主語後面、動詞前面，用來表示轉折。例如：他跟我約好在學校見面，等了半天，他卻沒來。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 卻 + Unexpected result

text.traditional: 某人已經五十歲了，在網路上卻說自己才二十歲……
text.simplified: 某人已经五十岁了，在网路上却说自己才二十岁……
text.pinyin: Mǒu rén yǐjīng wǔshí suì le, zài wǎnglù shàng què shuō zìjǐ cái èrshí suì…
text.english: Someone is already fifty years old, yet online he says he is only twenty…

text.traditional: 小馬是我的網友，我對他不陌生，可是面對面接觸時，我們卻聊不到幾句話。
text.simplified: 小马是我的网友，我对他不陌生，可是面对面接触时，我们却聊不到几句话。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Mǎ shì wǒ de wǎngyǒu, wǒ duì tā bú mòshēng, kěshì miànduìmiàn jiēchù shí, wǒmen què liáo búdào jǐ jù huà.
text.english: Xiao Ma is my online friend and he is no stranger to me, but when we meet face to face, we can hardly say a few words to each other.

text.traditional: 警察通知我室友，他家人發生了車禍，我以為他會很緊張，沒想到卻很冷靜。
text.simplified: 警察通知我室友，他家人发生了车祸，我以为他会很紧张，没想到却很冷静。
text.pinyin: Jǐngchá tōngzhī wǒ shìyǒu, tā jiārén fāshēng le chēhuò, wǒ yǐwéi tā huì hěn jǐnzhāng, méixiǎngdào què hěn lěngjìng.
text.english: The police informed my roommate that his family had a car accident; I thought he would be very nervous, but to my surprise he was very calm.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 卻 is an adverb, indicating things contrary to fact or expectation. It is often placed after the subject of the sentence or in front of the verb to indicate a transition. For example, 他跟我約好在學校見面，等了半天，他卻沒來。
summary: 卻 shows something is the opposite of the facts or of what was expected, as in 他卻沒來.
Put it after the subject and before the verb.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Live Up to / Let Down with 對得起 / 對不起
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express living up to expectations (對得起) or feeling guilty for letting someone down (對不起).
grammarPages.explanation: 「對得起」表示沒做不好或不應該的事，沒讓對方失望、生氣、丟臉。「對不起」的意思跟「對得起」相反。「對得起/對不起」後面可接事情的對象，例如：對得起老闆、對得起自己、對不起朋友、對不起社會。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 對得起/對不起 + Object

text.traditional: ……那些騙子不僅可惡，還對不起社會。
text.simplified: ……那些骗子不仅可恶，还对不起社会。
text.pinyin: …Nàxiē piànzi bù jǐn kěwù, hái duìbùqǐ shèhuì.
text.english: …Those scammers are not only despicable; they also let society down.

text.traditional: 李大華覺得父母工作很辛苦，要是他不好好讀書，怎麼對得起父母呢？
text.simplified: 李大华觉得父母工作很辛苦，要是他不好好读书，怎么对得起父母呢？
text.pinyin: Lǐ Dàhuá juéde fùmǔ gōngzuò hěn xīnkǔ, yàoshì tā bù hǎohǎo dúshū, zěnme duìdeqǐ fùmǔ ne?
text.english: Li Dahua feels his parents work very hard; if he does not study well, how could he face his parents?

text.traditional: 小陸常利用出差的機會，去夜店跟漂亮小姐約會，卻一點都不覺得對不起太太。
text.simplified: 小陆常利用出差的机会，去夜店跟漂亮小姐约会，却一点都不觉得对不起太太。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Lù cháng lìyòng chūchāi de jīhuì, qù yèdiàn gēn piàoliàng xiǎojiě yuēhuì, què yìdiǎn dōu bù juéde duìbùqǐ tàitai.
text.english: Xiao Lu often uses business trips as a chance to go to nightclubs and date pretty women, yet he doesn't feel at all that he is letting his wife down.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 對得起 means not doing something that should not be done; not letting the other party down, be angry, or embarrassed. On the contrary, 對不起 means being embarrassed or sorry for disappointing the other person. 對得起/對不起 can be followed by the object. For example, 對得起老闆, 對得起自己, 對不起朋友, 對不起社會.
summary: 對得起 means you did nothing wrong, so you didn't disappoint, anger or embarrass the other person.
對不起 means the opposite.
Put the person or thing after it, as in 對不起朋友.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Be Careful When Making Online Friends
grammarPages.titleEnglish: As for / Turning to with 至於
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Pivot to an associated point, unresolved question, or secondary topic with 至於 ('as for...').
grammarPages.explanation: 「至於」當句子之間的轉折語，引出另一個與原來主題相關的話題或觀點。
grammarPages.pattern: Claim, + 至於 + Topic + Comment

text.traditional: 網路只是提供一種更便利的交友方式給大家，至於要不要以網路交友……
text.simplified: 网路只是提供一种更便利的交友方式给大家，至于要不要以网路交友……
text.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhǐshì tígōng yì zhǒng gèng biànlì de jiāoyǒu fāngshì gěi dàjiā, zhìyú yào bú yào yǐ wǎnglù jiāoyǒu…
text.english: The internet just offers everyone a more convenient way to make friends; as for whether or not to make friends online…

text.traditional: 那對情侶有結婚的打算，至於什麼時候舉行婚禮，還要問家長的意見。
text.simplified: 那对情侣有结婚的打算，至于什么时候举行婚礼，还要问家长的意见。
text.pinyin: Nà duì qínglǚ yǒu jiéhūn de dǎsuàn, zhìyú shénme shíhòu jǔxíng hūnlǐ, hái yào wèn jiāzhǎng de yìjiàn.
text.english: That couple plans to get married; as for when to hold the wedding, they still need to ask the parents for their opinion.

text.traditional: 我只知道教育制度的改善計畫是夏教授帶領的，至於詳細內容就得問他本人了。
text.simplified: 我只知道教育制度的改善计划是夏教授带领的，至于详细内容就得问他本人了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ zhīdào jiàoyù zhìdù de gǎishàn jìhuà shì Xià jiàoshòu dàilǐng de, zhìyú xiángxì nèiróng jiù děi wèn tā běnrén le.
text.english: I only know that Professor Xia leads the plan to improve the education system; as for the details, you'll have to ask him directly.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 至於 is used as a turning point or pivot between sentences. What is said after 至於 is related to the previous topic or viewpoint.
summary: 至於 moves to another topic or view that connects to the first topic.
Put the new topic after 至於, then say what you think about it.

items.title: Grammar 1–4 · Do You Have Interview Experience?

dialogue.title: 你有面試的經驗嗎？

text.traditional: 您好，我是林家豪。貴公司上星期通知我今天十點來面試。
text.simplified: 您好，我是林家豪。贵公司上星期通知我今天十点来面试。
text.pinyin: Nínhǎo, wǒ shì Lín Jiāháo. Guì gōngsī shàng xīngqí tōngzhī wǒ jīntiān shí diǎn lái miànshì.
text.english: Hello, I am Lin Jiahao. Last week your company told me to come for an interview at ten today.

text.traditional: 林先生，歡迎您來本公司參加面試。請坐一下，我這就通知經理。
text.simplified: 林先生，欢迎您来本公司参加面试。请坐一下，我这就通知经理。
text.pinyin: Lín xiānshēng, huānyíng nín lái běn gōngsī cānjiā miànshì. Qǐng zuò yíxià, wǒ zhè jiù tōngzhī jīnglǐ.
text.english: Mr. Lin, welcome to our company for the interview. Please take a seat, I will inform the manager right away.

text.traditional: （在會議室）
text.simplified: （在会议室）
text.pinyin: (Zài huìyìshì)
text.english: (In the meeting room)

text.traditional: 你好。我姓王，負責今天的面試。
text.simplified: 你好。我姓王，负责今天的面试。
text.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo. Wǒ xìng Wáng, fùzé jīntiān de miànshì.
text.english: Hello. My surname is Wang, and I am in charge of today's interview.

text.traditional: 您好，王經理，我是林家豪。這是我的工作經驗相關資料，請您參考。
text.simplified: 您好，王经理，我是林家豪。这是我的工作经验相关资料，请您参考。
text.pinyin: Nínhǎo, Wáng jīnglǐ, wǒ shì Lín Jiāháo. Zhè shì wǒ de gōngzuò jīngyàn xiāngguān zīliào, qǐng nín cānkǎo.
text.english: Hello, Manager Wang, I am Lin Jiahao. This is the information related to my work experience for your reference.

text.traditional: （經理看了一下家豪的資料）
text.simplified: （经理看了一下家豪的资料）
text.pinyin: (Jīnglǐ kàn le yíxià Jiāháo de zīliào)
text.english: (The manager looks over Jiahao's papers.)

text.traditional: 這次我們要找的是銷售人員，你在這方面有經驗嗎？
text.simplified: 这次我们要找的是销售人员，你在这方面有经验吗？
text.pinyin: Zhè cì wǒmen yào zhǎo de shì xiāoshòu rényuán, nǐ zài zhè fāngmiàn yǒu jīngyàn ma?
text.english: We are looking for sales personnel this time. Do you have experience in this field?

text.traditional: 念大學時，我在電腦公司打過工。向客人介紹商品功能、使用方法、和其他牌子的差異，最重要的是想辦法把商品賣出去。
text.simplified: 念大学时，我在电脑公司打过工。向客人介绍商品功能、使用方法、和其他牌子的差异，最重要的是想办法把商品卖出去。
text.pinyin: Niàn dàxué shí, wǒ zài diànnǎo gōngsī dǎ guò gōng. Xiàng kèrén jièshào shāngpǐn gōngnéng, shǐyòng fāngfǎ, hé qítā páizi de chāyì, zuì zhòngyào de shì xiǎng bànfǎ bǎ shāngpǐn mài chū qù.
text.english: In university, I worked part-time at a computer company, introducing product features, instructions, and differences from other brands to customers. The most important thing was finding ways to sell products.

text.traditional: 不過推銷時，多多少少都會碰到喜歡隨便批評，甚至對你亂發脾氣的客人，你會怎麼處理呢？
text.simplified: 不过推销时，多多少少都会碰到喜欢随便批评，甚至对你乱发脾气的客人，你会怎么处理呢？
text.pinyin: Búguò tuīxiāo shí, duōduōshǎoshǎo dōu huì pèngdào xǐhuān suíbiàn pīpíng, shènzhì duì nǐ luàn fāpíqì de kèrén, nǐ huì zěnme chǔlǐ ne?
text.english: However, when selling, you will more or less encounter customers who criticize casually or even lose their tempers at you. How would you handle that?

text.traditional: 我會先了解問題是什麼，然後耐心地跟他說明，想辦法讓他理解。我想只要態度親切、謙虛，客人就會接受的。萬一他還是不滿意，我就說笑話逗他開心，或是送他小禮物什麼的。
text.simplified: 我会先了解问题是什么，然后耐心地跟他说明，想办法让他理解。我想只要态度亲切、谦虚，客人就会接受的。万一他还是不满意，我就说笑话逗他开心，或是送他小礼物什么的。
text.pinyin: Wǒ huì xiān liǎojiě wèntí shì shénme, ránhòu nàixīn de gēn tā shuōmíng, xiǎng bànfǎ ràng tā lǐjiě. Wǒ xiǎng zhǐyào tàidù qīnqiè, qiānxū, kèrén jiù huì jiēshòu de. Wànyī tā háishì bù mǎnyì, wǒ jiù shuō xiàohuà dòu tā kāixīn, huòshì sòng tā xiǎo lǐwù shénme de.
text.english: I would first find out what the problem is, then patiently explain things to them and try to help them understand. I think as long as I am friendly and modest, customers will accept it. If they are still not satisfied, I will tell jokes to cheer them up, or give them a small gift or something.

text.traditional: 你的推銷觀念很正確。透過良好的溝通，往往能解決不必要的麻煩。在職場上，你碰過什麼大問題嗎？
text.simplified: 你的推销观念很正确。透过良好的沟通，往往能解决不必要的麻烦。在职场上，你碰过什么大问题吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ de tuīxiāo guānniàn hěn zhèngquè. Tòuguò liánghǎo de gōutōng, wǎngwǎng néng jiějué bú bìyào de máfán. Zài zhíchǎng shàng, nǐ pèng guò shénme dà wèntí ma?
text.english: Your sales philosophy is sound. Through good communication, unnecessary troubles can often be resolved. In the workplace, have you encountered any major problems?

text.traditional: 沒有。不過有一次，公司舉辦電腦遊戲比賽，經理叫我們早上七點先去布置會場，因為鬧鐘壞了，我睡到八點才醒來。等我趕到時，小組的同事早就把任務完成了。雖然大家沒怪我，但我卻不能原諒自己，從那次之後，我就非常注意時間，絕對不再遲到了。
text.simplified: 没有。不过有一次，公司举办电脑游戏比赛，经理叫我们早上七点先去布置会场，因为闹钟坏了，我睡到八点才醒来。等我赶到时，小组的同事早就把任务完成了。虽然大家没怪我，但我却不能原谅自己，从那次之后，我就非常注意时间，绝对不再迟到了。
text.pinyin: Méiyǒu. Búguò yǒu yí cì, gōngsī jǔbàn diànnǎo yóuxì bǐsài, jīnglǐ jiào wǒmen zǎoshàng qī diǎn xiān qù bùzhì huìchǎng, yīnwèi nàozhōng huài le, wǒ shuì dào bā diǎn cái xǐnglái. Děng wǒ gǎndào shí, xiǎozǔ de tóngshì zǎojiù bǎ rènwù wánchéng le. Suīrán dàjiā méi guài wǒ, dàn wǒ què bùnéng yuánliàng zìjǐ, cóng nà cì zhīhòu, wǒ jiù fēicháng zhùyì shíjiān, juéduì bú zài chídào le.
text.english: No. But once, the company held a computer gaming contest, and the manager asked us to set up at seven in the morning. My alarm broke and I slept until eight. By the time I arrived, my teammates had already finished. Though no one blamed me, I couldn't forgive myself, and since then I've been extremely punctual and never late.

text.traditional: 其實，不論在哪裡工作，準時是最基本的要求。對了，假如主管忙不過來，你願意配合加班嗎？
text.simplified: 其实，不论在哪里工作，准时是最基本的要求。对了，假如主管忙不过来，你愿意配合加班吗？
text.pinyin: Qíshí, búlùn zài nǎlǐ gōngzuò, zhǔnshí shì zuì jīběn de yāoqiú. Duìle, jiǎrú zhǔguǎn mángbúguòlái, nǐ yuànyì pèihé jiābān ma?
text.english: In fact, no matter where one works, punctuality is the most fundamental requirement. By the way, if your supervisor is too busy to keep up, would you be willing to work overtime to help out?

text.traditional: 沒問題。平日或假日，我都能配合。
text.simplified: 没问题。平日或假日，我都能配合。
text.pinyin: Méi wèntí. Píngrì huò jiàrì, wǒ dōu néng pèihé.
text.english: No problem. Weekdays or holidays, I can always help out.

text.traditional: 除了準時，請你再說說自己其他的優點。
text.simplified: 除了准时，请你再说说自己其他的优点。
text.pinyin: Chúle zhǔnshí, qǐng nǐ zài shuōshuō zìjǐ qítā de yōudiǎn.
text.english: Besides punctuality, please tell me about your other strengths.

text.traditional: 我個性開朗、說話幽默、做事細心、溝通能力強，是個容易相處的人。
text.simplified: 我个性开朗、说话幽默、做事细心、沟通能力强，是个容易相处的人。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gèxìng kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, zuòshì xìxīn, gōutōng nénglì qiáng, shì ge róngyì xiāngchǔ de rén.
text.english: I have a cheerful personality, I speak with humor, I am careful in my work, and I have strong communication skills. I am easy to get along with.

text.traditional: 聽起來你挺優秀的。對這份工作你還有什麼要了解的？
text.simplified: 听起来你挺优秀的。对这份工作你还有什么要了解的？
text.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái nǐ tǐng yōuxiù de. Duì zhè fèn gōngzuò nǐ háiyǒu shénme yào liǎojiě de?
text.english: You sound quite outstanding. Is there anything else you would like to know about this job?

text.traditional: 請問薪水怎麼算？有哪些福利？
text.simplified: 请问薪水怎么算？有哪些福利？
text.pinyin: Qǐngwèn xīnshuǐ zěnme suàn? Yǒu nǎxiē fúlì?
text.english: May I ask how salary is calculated? What benefits are provided?

text.traditional: 有關這方面的問題，會有相關人員來跟你詳細說明。
text.simplified: 有关这方面的问题，会有相关人员来跟你详细说明。
text.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè fāngmiàn de wèntí, huì yǒu xiāngguān rényuán lái gēn nǐ xiángxì shuōmíng.
text.english: Regarding questions in this area, relevant personnel will come explain them to you in detail.

text.traditional: 好，感謝您。
text.simplified: 好，感谢您。
text.pinyin: Hǎo, gǎnxiè nín.
text.english: OK, thank you.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 這就 before a verb to say you will do something right away.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 這就 + Action

text.traditional: 請坐一下，我這就通知經理。
text.simplified: 请坐一下，我这就通知经理。
text.pinyin: Qǐng zuò yíxià, wǒ zhè jiù tōngzhī jīnglǐ.
text.english: Please have a seat; I will notify the manager right away.

text.traditional:
A：服務生，我點的是熱紅茶，不是冰咖啡。
B：對不起，我這就幫您換。
text.simplified:
A：服务生，我点的是热红茶，不是冰咖啡。
B：对不起，我这就帮您换。
text.pinyin:
A: Fúwùshēng, wǒ diǎn de shì rè hóngchá, búshì bīng kāfēi.
B: Duìbùqǐ, wǒ zhè jiù bāng nín huàn.
text.english:
A: Waiter, I ordered hot black tea, not iced coffee.
B: Sorry, I'll change it for you right away.

text.traditional:
A：經理，孔老闆快到公司了。
B：好，我這就到門口去歡迎他。
text.simplified:
A：经理，孔老板快到公司了。
B：好，我这就到门口去欢迎他。
text.pinyin:
A: Jīnglǐ, Kǒng lǎobǎn kuài dào gōngsī le.
B: Hǎo, wǒ zhè jiù dào ménkǒu qù huānyíng tā.
text.english:
A: Manager, Mr. Kong will arrive at the company soon.
B: OK, I'll go to the entrance right away to welcome him.

grammarPages.explanation: 「這」是「現在」的意思，「就」表示馬上，「這就」的後面接動詞或動詞短語，用來表示現在馬上做某事。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 這 means 現在, 就 means immediately. 這就 is followed by a verb or verb phrase to indicate that something is being done right now.
summary: 這就 says you will do something right now, on the spot.
這 means 現在 and 就 means immediately. Put a verb or verb phrase after it.
Don't use it for later times: you can't say 明天這就.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 在……方面 to name the area you are talking about, then say what is true in that area.
grammarPages.pattern: 在 + Area + 方面, + Comment

text.traditional: 這次我們要找的是銷售人員，你在這方面有經驗嗎？
text.simplified: 这次我们要找的是销售人员，你在这方面有经验吗？
text.pinyin: Zhè cì wǒmen yào zhǎo de shì xiāoshòu rényuán, nǐ zài zhè fāngmiàn yǒu jīngyàn ma?
text.english: We are looking for salespeople this time. Do you have experience in this area?

text.traditional: 在穿著方面，白小姐很有品味，身上穿的或手上戴的也都有個人的風格。
text.simplified: 在穿着方面，白小姐很有品味，身上穿的或手上戴的也都有个人的风格。
text.pinyin: Zài chuānzhuó fāngmiàn, Bái xiǎojiě hěn yǒu pǐnwèi, shēnshàng chuān de huò shǒu shàng dài de yě dōu yǒu gèrén de fēnggé.
text.english: When it comes to clothing, Miss Bai has great taste; whatever she wears, on her body or on her hands, has her own personal style.

text.traditional: 小藍從小在網球方面就表現得非常好，長大之後一定能代表國家參加比賽。
text.simplified: 小蓝从小在网球方面就表现得非常好，长大之后一定能代表国家参加比赛。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Lán cóngxiǎo zài wǎngqiú fāngmiàn jiù biǎoxiàn de fēicháng hǎo, zhǎngdà zhīhòu yídìng néng dàibiǎo guójiā cānjiā bǐsài.
text.english: Xiao Lan has been very good at tennis since childhood; when he grows up, he will surely be able to represent the country in competitions.

grammarPages.explanation: 用來說明在某個範圍或某個情況下的情形。「在」和「方面」中間是該範圍或情況，後面的句子表示產生什麼樣的情形或進一步的說明。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: It is used to describe a certain situation. The range or scope of the situation is placed between 在 and 方面, and the following sentence indicates the situation or further explanation.
summary: 在……方面 names the area you are talking about, and the rest says what is true there.
Put the area between 在 and 方面. Keep both words.
對……來說 gives a point of view, not an area. Don't say 對穿著方面.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 往往 to say what usually happens under certain conditions, based on past experience or general facts.
grammarPages.pattern: Condition or Topic + 往往 + Usual result

text.traditional: 透過良好的溝通，往往能解決不必要的麻煩。
text.simplified: 透过良好的沟通，往往能解决不必要的麻烦。
text.pinyin: Tòuguò liánghǎo de gōutōng, wǎngwǎng néng jiějué bú bìyào de máfán.
text.english: Through good communication, unnecessary trouble can often be resolved.

text.traditional: 許多家長都會逼孩子念書，要不要去補習往往不是孩子能夠決定的。
text.simplified: 许多家长都会逼孩子念书，要不要去补习往往不是孩子能够决定的。
text.pinyin: Xǔduō jiāzhǎng dōu huì bī háizi niànshū, yào bú yào qù bǔxí wǎngwǎng búshì háizi nénggòu juédìng de.
text.english: Many parents force their children to study; whether to go to cram school is often not for the child to decide.

text.traditional: 一般來說，夢想與真實生活往往有一段距離，不可能每次都夢想成真。
text.simplified: 一般来说，梦想与真实生活往往有一段距离，不可能每次都梦想成真。
text.pinyin: Yìbānláishuō, mèngxiǎng yǔ zhēnshí shēnghuó wǎngwǎng yǒu yí duàn jùlí, bù kěnéng měi cì dōu mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn.
text.english: Generally speaking, there is often a gap between dreams and real life; dreams can't come true every time.

grammarPages.explanation:
「往往」和「常常」都表示某種情況多次出現，但「往往」的用法限制較多：
(1) 表示在一定的條件下，從過去到現在經常發生的經驗或情況，不能用在未發生的事情，而且有一定的規律。例如：過去十年，每到週末，只要天氣好，歐先生往往起床後就去慢跑。
(2)「往往」用於一般的看法或事實，不能用在個人主觀的意願，例如：家庭教育非常重要，因為孩子做人做事的態度往往是被父母影響的。
(3)「往往」不能單用「往」一個字，而且前面不能加否定詞。例如不能說：*湯先生不往往週末去打球。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish:
Both 往往 and 常常 often mean that a certain situation occurs multiple times, but the usage of 往往 is more restrictive:
(1) 往往 and 常常 mean that under certain conditions, the experience or situation has frequently occurred from the past to the present, and cannot be used for things that have not happened. 往往 and 常常 always follow a certain pattern. For example, 過去十年，每到週末，只要天氣好，歐先生往往起床後就去慢跑。
(2) 往往 is used for general opinions or facts, and cannot be used for personal subjective wishes. For example, 家庭教育非常重要，因為孩子做人做事的態度往往是被父母影響的。
(3) 往往 cannot be used with one character 往 alone, and no negative word can be added before it. For example, it is not correct to say: *湯先生不往往週末去打球。
summary: 往往 says something tends to happen under certain conditions, as a pattern seen again and again.
Use it for what has already happened or for general facts, not for plans or personal wishes.
Always say both characters, and never put 不 before it: no 不往往.
常常 also means it happens often, but 往往 has more limits.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Start a sentence with 有關 to name the topic ('about …'), then explain it or give advice.
grammarPages.pattern: 有關 + Topic, + Explanation or Advice

text.traditional: 有關這方面的問題，會有相關人員來跟你詳細說明。
text.simplified: 有关这方面的问题，会有相关人员来跟你详细说明。
text.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè fāngmiàn de wèntí, huì yǒu xiāngguān rényuán lái gēn nǐ xiángxì shuōmíng.
text.english: Regarding questions in this area, the staff in charge will come and explain them to you in detail.

text.traditional: 有關那個明星吸毒的新聞，還要經過詳細地調查，才能確定是真是假。
text.simplified: 有关那个明星吸毒的新闻，还要经过详细地调查，才能确定是真是假。
text.pinyin: Yǒuguān nàge míngxīng xīdú de xīnwén, hái yào jīngguò xiángxì de diàochá, cái néng quèdìng shì zhēn shì jiǎ.
text.english: Regarding the news that the celebrity took drugs, a detailed investigation is still needed before we can be sure whether it is true or false.

text.traditional: 有關法律方面的問題，你最好請教專業律師，不要隨便相信網路上的說法。
text.simplified: 有关法律方面的问题，你最好请教专业律师，不要随便相信网路上的说法。
text.pinyin: Yǒuguān fǎlǜ fāngmiàn de wèntí, nǐ zuìhǎo qǐngjiào zhuānyè lǜshī, búyào suíbiàn xiāngxìn wǎnglù shàng de shuōfǎ.
text.english: For legal questions, you had better consult a professional lawyer rather than casually believing claims online.

grammarPages.explanation: 「有關」常放在句首，連接事物或情況，後面的句子表示進一步地說明或建議。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 有關 is often placed at the beginning of a sentence to connect things or situations, and the following sentence indicates further explanation or suggestion.
summary: 有關 usually starts a sentence to bring up a topic. The next part explains it or gives advice.
It can also describe a noun: 跟……有關的資料.
對於 gives the speaker's view of the object, but 有關 only brings up the topic.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 我的面試經驗

text.traditional: 一般來說，現代人找工作得經過面試。面試時表現得好，被錄取的機會就比較大。今天，我就來跟各位說說我最近面試的經驗和感想。
text.simplified: 一般来说，现代人找工作得经过面试。面试时表现得好，被录取的机会就比较大。今天，我就来跟各位说说我最近面试的经验和感想。
text.pinyin: Yìbānláishuō, xiàndài rén zhǎo gōngzuò děi jīngguò miànshì. Miànshì shí biǎoxiàn de hǎo, bèi lùqǔ de jīhuì jiù bǐjiào dà. Jīntiān, wǒ jiù lái gēn gèwèi shuōshuo wǒ zuìjìn miànshì de jīngyàn hé gǎnxiǎng.
text.english: Generally speaking, modern people must go through interviews to find jobs. Performing well in an interview brings greater chances of being hired. Today, let me share my recent interview experience and thoughts with everyone.

text.traditional: 上個月，我在網站上，看到某家企業有銷售人員的需求，就立刻把個人資料寄過去。資料中除了說明我過去的工作經驗，也包含我對工作的看法和態度。兩個星期之後，我收到了面試通知。儘管我不是第一次參加面試，但還是擔心表現不佳，所以面試當天很早就醒來，出門前還一再確認穿著是不是整齊、資料是不是都放進了背包。我想，這樣又緊張又興奮的心情，往往是面試時經常有的表現。
text.simplified: 上个月，我在网站上，看到某家企业有销售人员的需求，就立刻把个人资料寄过去。资料中除了说明我过去的工作经验，也包含我对工作的看法和态度。两个星期之后，我收到了面试通知。尽管我不是第一次参加面试，但还是担心表现不佳，所以面试当天很早就醒来，出门前还一再确认穿着是不是整齐、资料是不是都放进了背包。我想，这样又紧张又兴奋的心情，往往是面试时经常有的表现。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè, wǒ zài wǎngzhàn shàng, kàndào mǒu jiā qìyè yǒu xiāoshòu rényuán de xūqiú, jiù lìkè bǎ gèrén zīliào jì guòqù. Zīliào zhōng chúle shuōmíng wǒ guòqù de gōngzuò jīngyàn, yě bāohán wǒ duì gōngzuò de kànfǎ hé tàidù. Liǎng ge xīngqí zhīhòu, wǒ shōudào le miànshì tōngzhī. Jǐnguǎn wǒ búshì dì yī cì cānjiā miànshì, dàn háishì dānxīn biǎoxiàn bù jiā, suǒyǐ miànshì dāngtiān hěn zǎo jiù xǐnglái, chū mén qián hái yízài quèrèn chuānzhuó shì bú shì zhěngqí, zīliào shì bú shì dōu fàng jìn le bēibāo. Wǒ xiǎng, zhèyàng yòu jǐnzhāng yòu xīngfèn de xīnqíng, wǎngwǎng shì miànshì shí jīngcháng yǒu de biǎoxiàn.
text.english: Last month, I saw on a website that an enterprise needed sales personnel and sent my personal information immediately. Beyond outlining my past work experience, the materials covered my views and attitudes toward work. Two weeks later, I received an interview notification. Even though it wasn't my first interview, I still worried about performing poorly, so I woke up very early on the day, and before leaving home I checked again and again that my clothes were neat and that all my papers were in my backpack. I think this kind of nervous yet excited feeling is often how people react at interviews.

text.traditional: 一開始，經理請我說明對銷售工作的想法。我回答他，銷售人員是最常接觸顧客的，所以對客人要有禮貌，態度也要主動，絕對不能像木頭一樣沒反應；萬一他們亂發脾氣，就該忍耐、冷靜。畢竟，只顧自己的感覺，把跟顧客的關係搞壞，甚至變成了敵人，又有什麼好處呢？
text.simplified: 一开始，经理请我说明对销售工作的想法。我回答他，销售人员是最常接触顾客的，所以对客人要有礼貌，态度也要主动，绝对不能像木头一样没反应；万一他们乱发脾气，就该忍耐、冷静。毕竟，只顾自己的感觉，把跟顾客的关系搞坏，甚至变成了敌人，又有什么好处呢？
text.pinyin: Yìkāishǐ, jīnglǐ qǐng wǒ shuōmíng duì xiāoshòu gōngzuò de xiǎngfǎ. Wǒ huídá tā, xiāoshòu rényuán shì zuì cháng jiēchù gùkè de, suǒyǐ duì kèrén yào yǒu lǐmào, tàidù yě yào zhǔdòng, juéduì bùnéng xiàng mùtou yíyàng méi fǎnyìng; wànyī tāmen luàn fāpíqì, jiù gāi rěnnài, lěngjìng. Bìjìng, zhǐ gù zìjǐ de gǎnjué, bǎ gēn gùkè de guānxì gǎo huài, shènzhì biànchéng le dírén, yòu yǒu shénme hǎochù ne?
text.english: To begin, the manager asked for my thoughts on sales work. I replied that sales staff have the closest contact with customers, so one must be polite, take the initiative, and never act unresponsive like a piece of wood. If customers lose their temper, one should be patient and calm. After all, considering only one's own feelings and ruining relations with customers, or even making enemies of them, brings no benefit.

text.traditional: 後來，經理又問我對團體合作的看法。我之前的工作，就是以小組的方式來推銷產品，所以能理解合作是必要的。況且，主管要領導整個部門，為全公司創造好成績，要是小組人員不配合，恐怕就不能順利實行銷售計畫，也會出現混亂的情況。因此，為了公司，我認為不論主管有什麼要求，只要是合理的，員工都應該配合。
text.simplified: 后来，经理又问我对团体合作的看法。我之前的工作，就是以小组的方式来推销产品，所以能理解合作是必要的。况且，主管要领导整个部门，为全公司创造好成绩，要是小组人员不配合，恐怕就不能顺利实行销售计划，也会出现混乱的情况。因此，为了公司，我认为不论主管有什么要求，只要是合理的，员工都应该配合。
text.pinyin: Hòulái, jīnglǐ yòu wèn wǒ duì tuántǐ hézuò de kànfǎ. Wǒ zhīqián de gōngzuò, jiùshì yǐ xiǎozǔ de fāngshì lái tuīxiāo chǎnpǐn, suǒyǐ néng lǐjiě hézuò shì bìyào de. Kuàngqiě, zhǔguǎn yào lǐngdǎo zhěngge bùmén, wèi quán gōngsī chuàngzào hǎo chéngjī, yàoshì xiǎozǔ rényuán bú pèihé, kǒngpà jiù bùnéng shùnlì shíxíng xiāoshòu jìhuà, yě huì chūxiàn hùnluàn de qíngkuàng. Yīncǐ, wèile gōngsī, wǒ rènwéi búlùn zhǔguǎn yǒu shénme yāoqiú, zhǐyào shì hélǐ de, yuángōng dōu yīnggāi pèihé.
text.english: Later, the manager asked about my views on teamwork. In my previous job we sold products in small teams, so I understand that teamwork is necessary. Moreover, a supervisor has to lead the whole department and get good results for the whole company; if the team members don't cooperate, I'm afraid the sales plan can't be carried out smoothly, and things will get chaotic. So, for the good of the company, I believe that no matter what the supervisor asks, as long as it is reasonable, employees should go along with it.

text.traditional: 最後，經理問我要是被錄取了，能為公司付出什麼。我說，在推銷產品方面，我的經驗很豐富，商品銷售可說是我一輩子的事業，所以一定會盡最大的力量認真工作、完成任務。
text.simplified: 最后，经理问我要是被录取了，能为公司付出什么。我说，在推销产品方面，我的经验很丰富，商品销售可说是我一辈子的事业，所以一定会尽最大的力量认真工作、完成任务。
text.pinyin: Zuìhòu, jīnglǐ wèn wǒ yàoshì bèi lùqǔ le, néng wèi gōngsī fùchū shénme. Wǒ shuō, zài tuīxiāo chǎnpǐn fāngmiàn, wǒ de jīngyàn hěn fēngfù, shāngpǐn xiāoshòu kě shuō shì wǒ yíbèizi de shìyè, suǒyǐ yídìng huì jìn zuì dà de lìliàng rènzhēn gōngzuò, wánchéng rènwù.
text.english: Finally, the manager asked what I could contribute to the company if hired. I stated that my experience in sales is extensive, that sales can be said to be my lifelong career, and that I would do my very best to work hard and complete my tasks.

text.traditional: 上星期我收到了通過面試的通知，下個月就要上班了。盼望了好久，我終於美夢成真了。很多人說，想找到理想的工作，多多少少需要一點兒運氣。其實，個性、能力，加上不斷地努力才是最重要的。
text.simplified: 上星期我收到了通过面试的通知，下个月就要上班了。盼望了好久，我终于美梦成真了。很多人说，想找到理想的工作，多多少少需要一点儿运气。其实，个性、能力，加上不断地努力才是最重要的。
text.pinyin: Shàng xīngqí wǒ shōudào le tōngguò miànshì de tōngzhī, xià ge yuè jiùyào shàngbān le. Pànwàng le hǎojiǔ, wǒ zhōngyú měimèng chéngzhēn le. Hěn duō rén shuō, xiǎng zhǎodào lǐxiǎng de gōngzuò, duōduōshǎoshǎo xūyào yìdiǎnr yùnqì. Qíshí, gèxìng, nénglì, jiāshàng búduàn de nǔlì cái shì zuì zhòngyào de.
text.english: Last week I received notification of passing the interview, and I start next month. After longing for so long, my dream has finally come true. Many say finding an ideal job takes a bit of luck, but personality, ability, and persistent effort are truly what matter most.

text.traditional: 以上就是我找工作的經驗和感想，如果有任何問題，歡迎跟我聯絡，謝謝！
text.simplified: 以上就是我找工作的经验和感想，如果有任何问题，欢迎跟我联络，谢谢！
text.pinyin: Yǐshàng jiùshì wǒ zhǎo gōngzuò de jīngyàn hé gǎnxiǎng, rúguǒ yǒu rènhé wèntí, huānyíng gēn wǒ liánluò, xièxie!
text.english: The above is my experience and reflection on job seeking. If you have questions, please feel free to contact me. Thank you!

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 儘管 to state a fact, then show with 但是, 可是, 還是 or 卻 that the result goes against it.
grammarPages.pattern: 儘管 + Fact, + (但是 / 可是 / 還是 / 卻) + Contrary Result

text.traditional: 儘管我不是第一次參加面試，但還是擔心表現不佳……
text.simplified: 尽管我不是第一次参加面试，但还是担心表现不佳……
text.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn wǒ búshì dì yī cì cānjiā miànshì, dàn háishì dānxīn biǎoxiàn bù jiā…
text.english: Even though this isn't my first interview, I'm still worried that I won't do well…

text.traditional: 儘管他平時測驗的成績都不理想，卻不影響他對中文的興趣。
text.simplified: 尽管他平时测验的成绩都不理想，却不影响他对中文的兴趣。
text.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn tā píngshí cèyàn de chéngjī dōu bù lǐxiǎng, què bù yǐngxiǎng tā duì Zhōngwén de xìngqù.
text.english: Although his test scores are usually poor, they do not affect his interest in Chinese.

text.traditional: 儘管已經下課了，張老師還是留在教室裡改作業，直到晚餐時間才離開。
text.simplified: 尽管已经下课了，张老师还是留在教室里改作业，直到晚餐时间才离开。
text.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yǐjīng xiàkè le, Zhāng lǎoshī háishì liú zài jiàoshì lǐ gǎi zuòyè, zhídào wǎncān shíjiān cái líkāi.
text.english: Although class was already over, Teacher Zhang still stayed in the classroom grading homework and didn't leave until dinnertime.

grammarPages.explanation: 「儘管」是連詞，用在第一個句子的句首，主要用來描述事實或某件事的結論，與「雖然」的意思相近；後面的分句常用「可是、但是、還是、卻」，表示與前句的結果相反。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 儘管 is a conjunction, similar to 雖然, and is used in the first half of the sentence. 儘管 is mainly used to describe the facts, or the conclusion of one thing. The second half of the sentence is often used with 但是, 可是, 卻 or 還是, indicating that the result of the first half is the opposite of what was hoped for or expected.
summary: 儘管 means about the same as 雖然. It starts the first part and states a fact.
The second part often uses 可是, 但是, 還是 or 卻 to show the opposite result.
儘管 is for facts that already happened. 即使 is for an imagined situation.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 不論……都…… to say that whatever the situation, the result stays the same.
grammarPages.pattern: 不論 + Situation, + Subject + 都 + Result

text.traditional: 我認為不論主管有什麼要求，只要是合理的，員工都應該配合。
text.simplified: 我认为不论主管有什么要求，只要是合理的，员工都应该配合。
text.pinyin: Wǒ rènwéi búlùn zhǔguǎn yǒu shénme yāoqiú, zhǐyào shì hélǐ de, yuángōng dōu yīnggāi pèihé.
text.english: I think that no matter what demands the supervisor makes, as long as they are reasonable, employees should cooperate.

text.traditional: 包老闆很堅持自己的想法，不論你說什麼，他都不會改變。
text.simplified: 包老板很坚持自己的想法，不论你说什么，他都不会改变。
text.pinyin: Bāo lǎobǎn hěn jiānchí zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ, búlùn nǐ shuō shénme, tā dōu bú huì gǎibiàn.
text.english: Boss Bao is very stubborn about his own ideas; no matter what you say, he won't change his mind.

text.traditional: 不論你有升學或工作方面的問題，都可以請教紀伯伯，他一定能給你寶貴的意見。
text.simplified: 不论你有升学或工作方面的问题，都可以请教纪伯伯，他一定能给你宝贵的意见。
text.pinyin: Búlùn nǐ yǒu shēngxué huò gōngzuò fāngmiàn de wèntí, dōu kěyǐ qǐngjiào Jì bóbo, tā yídìng néng gěi nǐ bǎoguì de yìjiàn.
text.english: No matter whether you have questions about further study or work, you can consult Uncle Ji, who will surely give you valuable advice.

text.traditional: 我為了這次的比賽準備了很久，不論教練去不去，我都要參加。
text.simplified: 我为了这次的比赛准备了很久，不论教练去不去，我都要参加。
text.pinyin: Wǒ wèile zhè cì de bǐsài zhǔnbèi le hěn jiǔ, búlùn jiàoliàn qù bú qù, wǒ dōu yào cānjiā.
text.english: I have been preparing for this competition for a long time; whether or not the coach goes, I will take part.

grammarPages.explanation: 用來表示雖然情況不同，但是最後的結果不因情況而受影響。「不論」的後面可搭配疑問詞、反義複合詞（例如：高低、大小、上下、左右、胖瘦、生死、長短、快慢等等）或 A not A 句，表示各種情況；「都」後面則是一定會出現的結果或事實。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 不論……都…… is used to indicate that although the situation is different, the final result is not affected by the situation. 不論 is followed by question words, antisense compound words (such as 大小, 高矮, 胖瘦, 遠近, etc.) or, "A not A sentences", indicating various situations. 都 is followed by the result or fact that will definitely occur.
summary: 不論……都…… shows that the result stays the same even when the situation changes.
After 不論 put a question word, a pair of opposites like 大小, or an A not A question.
After 都 put the result or fact that will surely happen.
既然……就 is different: it says what naturally follows from something already true.

items.title: Grammar 1–3 · Cloud Technology Is Really Convenient

dialogue.title: 雲端科技真便利

text.traditional: 明哲，你不要一直看手機啦。
text.simplified: 明哲，你不要一直看手机啦。
text.pinyin: Míngzhé, nǐ búyào yìzhí kàn shǒujī la.
text.english: Mingzhe, don't keep staring at your phone all the time.

text.traditional: 我在查借書記錄，看看雲端圖書館的電子書還能借多久。
text.simplified: 我在查借书记录，看看云端图书馆的电子书还能借多久。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zài chá jiè shū jìlù, kànkan yúnduān túshūguǎn de diànzǐshū hái néng jiè duōjiǔ.
text.english: I'm checking my borrowing record to see how much longer I can keep the cloud library e-book.

text.traditional: 我從來沒用過雲端圖書館系統，你可以教我嗎？
text.simplified: 我从来没用过云端图书馆系统，你可以教我吗？
text.pinyin: Wǒ cónglái méi yòng guò yúnduān túshūguǎn xìtǒng, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
text.english: I have never used the cloud library system before. Could you teach me?

text.traditional: 妳只要上雲端圖書館的網站填資料，建立帳號、密碼，就能用了。
text.simplified: 你只要上云端图书馆的网站填资料，建立帐号、密码，就能用了。
text.pinyin: Nǐ zhǐyào shàng yúnduān túshūguǎn de wǎngzhàn tián zīliào, jiànlì zhànghào, mìmǎ, jiù néng yòng le.
text.english: You just need to fill in information on the cloud library website and create an account and password, then you can use it.

text.traditional: 聽起來不難嘛！什麼時候借都可以嗎？
text.simplified: 听起来不难嘛！什么时候借都可以吗？
text.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái bù nán ma! Shénme shíhòu jiè dōu kěyǐ ma?
text.english: Sounds easy! Can you borrow anytime?

text.traditional: 是啊，而且還書時間一到，系統就會自動還書。不像以前，想借書只能親自跑一趟圖書館，要是多借了幾本，還得抱著一堆書回家。
text.simplified: 是啊，而且还书时间一到，系统就会自动还书。不像以前，想借书只能亲自跑一趟图书馆，要是多借了几本，还得抱着一堆书回家。
text.pinyin: Shì a, érqiě huán shū shíjiān yí dào, xìtǒng jiù huì zìdòng huán shū. Bú xiàng yǐqián, xiǎng jiè shū zhǐ néng qīnzì pǎo yí tàng túshūguǎn, yàoshì duō jiè le jǐ běn, hái děi bào zhe yì duī shū huí jiā.
text.english: Yes, and as soon as the due date arrives, the system returns it automatically. It's not like before, when you had to go to the library in person to borrow books, and if you borrowed a few extra, you had to carry a pile of books home.

text.traditional: 現在的讀者實在太幸福了。
text.simplified: 现在的读者实在太幸福了。
text.pinyin: Xiànzài de dúzhě shízài tài xìngfú le.
text.english: Modern readers are truly fortunate.

text.traditional: 就是啊，只要帶著手機或平板，就能隨時隨地閱讀了。
text.simplified: 就是啊，只要带着手机或平板，就能随时随地阅读了。
text.pinyin: Jiùshì a, zhǐyào dài zhe shǒujī huò píngbǎn, jiù néng suíshí suídì yuèdú le.
text.english: Exactly; as long as you carry a phone or tablet, you can read anytime, anywhere.

text.traditional: 這樣我的書包就能變得很空，放得下外套、雨傘什麼的。
text.simplified: 这样我的书包就能变得很空，放得下外套、雨伞什么的。
text.pinyin: Zhèyàng wǒ de shūbāo jiù néng biàn de hěn kòng, fàng de xià wàitào, yǔsǎn shénme de.
text.english: That way my schoolbag can become very spacious, leaving room for a coat, umbrella, and so on.

text.traditional: 是啊。現在我什麼文件都存在雲端，要是忘了帶隨身碟也不必擔心。
text.simplified: 是啊。现在我什么文件都存在云端，要是忘了带随身碟也不必担心。
text.pinyin: Shì a. Xiànzài wǒ shénme wénjiàn dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàoshì wàngle dài suíshēndié yě búbì dānxīn.
text.english: Indeed. Now I store all documents in the cloud; even if I forget my flash drive, there is no need to worry.

text.traditional: 有一次小組發表報告前五分鐘，我發現忘了帶隨身碟，也沒把預備好的資料寄到同學的電子信箱。我那時候想，這下子沒辦法報告了，還好同學說雲端上也有一份，問題就馬上解決了。
text.simplified: 有一次小组发表报告前五分钟，我发现忘了带随身碟，也没把预备好的资料寄到同学的电子信箱。我那时候想，这下子没办法报告了，还好同学说云端上也有一份，问题就马上解决了。
text.pinyin: Yǒu yí cì xiǎozǔ fābiǎo bàogào qián wǔ fēnzhōng, wǒ fāxiàn wàngle dài suíshēndié, yě méi bǎ yùbèi hǎo de zīliào jì dào tóngxué de diànzǐ xìnxiāng. Wǒ nà shíhòu xiǎng, zhèxiàzi méibànfǎ bàogào le, háihǎo tóngxué shuō yúnduān shàng yě yǒu yí fèn, wèntí jiù mǎshàng jiějué le.
text.english: Once, five minutes before our group presentation, I found I had forgotten my flash drive and hadn't emailed the prepared files to classmates. I thought, 'Now we can't present!' Luckily a classmate said there was a copy on the cloud, and the problem was resolved immediately.

text.traditional: 現在的網路科技水平提高了不少，企業能透過高速網路把資料上傳到雲端處理，不同地區的人也能在網路上一起開會，既省時間又方便，更別說提供個人下載資料、傳訊息等基本服務了。
text.simplified: 现在的网路科技水平提高了不少，企业能透过高速网路把资料上传到云端处理，不同地区的人也能在网路上一起开会，既省时间又方便，更别说提供个人下载资料、传讯息等基本服务了。
text.pinyin: Xiànzài de wǎnglù kējì shuǐpíng tígāo le bùshǎo, qìyè néng tòuguò gāosù wǎnglù bǎ zīliào shàngchuán dào yúnduān chǔlǐ, bùtóng dìqū de rén yě néng zài wǎnglù shàng yìqǐ kāihuì, jì shěng shíjiān yòu fāngbiàn, gèng bié shuō tígōng gèrén xiàzài zīliào, chuán xùnxī děng jīběn fúwù le.
text.english: Internet technology has improved a lot these days. Businesses can upload data to the cloud over high-speed internet for processing, and people in different places can also hold meetings together online, which both saves time and is convenient, not to mention basic services like downloading personal data and sending messages.

text.traditional: 除了這些優點，雲端還能把會議資料自動存起來，也能把變更的時間和內容記錄下來，讓不能參加會議的人隨時掌握最新情況。
text.simplified: 除了这些优点，云端还能把会议资料自动存起来，也能把变更的时间和内容记录下来，让不能参加会议的人随时掌握最新情况。
text.pinyin: Chúle zhèxiē yōudiǎn, yúnduān hái néng bǎ huìyì zīliào zìdòng cún qǐlái, yě néng bǎ biàngēng de shíjiān hé nèiróng jìlù xiàlái, ràng bùnéng cānjiā huìyì de rén suíshí zhǎngwò zuìxīn qíngkuàng.
text.english: Besides these advantages, the cloud can also save meeting files automatically and record when and what was changed, so people who can't attend the meeting can keep up with the latest situation at any time.

text.traditional: 其實也有不少老師利用這樣的科技，把教材放上雲端，讓學生預習、複習，提高學習的效果。
text.simplified: 其实也有不少老师利用这样的科技，把教材放上云端，让学生预习、复习，提高学习的效果。
text.pinyin: Qíshí yě yǒu bùshǎo lǎoshī lìyòng zhèyàng de kējì, bǎ jiàocái fàng shàng yúnduān, ràng xuéshēng yùxí, fùxí, tígāo xuéxí de xiàoguǒ.
text.english: Actually, quite a few teachers use this technology, putting course materials on the cloud for students to preview and review, making their learning more effective.

text.traditional: 不過，我覺得要利用雲端科技來改變傳統的教學方式，恐怕說起來容易，做起來不簡單吧。
text.simplified: 不过，我觉得要利用云端科技来改变传统的教学方式，恐怕说起来容易，做起来不简单吧。
text.pinyin: Búguò, wǒ juéde yào lìyòng yúnduān kējì lái gǎibiàn chuántǒng de jiàoxué fāngshì, kǒngpà shuōqǐlái róngyì, zuò qǐlái bù jiǎndān ba.
text.english: However, I think using cloud technology to transform conventional teaching methods is probably easier said than done.

text.traditional: （明哲的手機忽然響了，他看了看雲端日曆。）
text.simplified: （明哲的手机忽然响了，他看了看云端日历。）
text.pinyin: (Míngzhé de shǒujī hūrán xiǎng le, tā kàn le kàn yúnduān rìlì.)
text.english: (Mingzhe's phone suddenly rings; he checks his cloud calendar.)

text.traditional: 明天系主任邀請馬博士來演講，題目跟雲端科技有關，妳要一起去嗎？
text.simplified: 明天系主任邀请马博士来演讲，题目跟云端科技有关，你要一起去吗？
text.pinyin: Míngtiān xì zhǔrèn yāoqǐng Mǎ bóshì lái yǎnjiǎng, tímù gēn yúnduān kējì yǒuguān, nǐ yào yìqǐ qù ma?
text.english: The department chair has invited Dr. Ma to give a talk tomorrow on a topic related to cloud technology. Do you want to go together?

text.traditional: 說實話，我本來對雲端科技沒什麼興趣，今天聽你說了這麼多，似乎該研究一下了。
text.simplified: 说实话，我本来对云端科技没什么兴趣，今天听你说了这么多，似乎该研究一下了。
text.pinyin: Shuō shíhuà, wǒ běnlái duì yúnduān kējì méishénme xìngqù, jīntiān tīng nǐ shuō le zhème duō, sìhū gāi yánjiù yíxià le.
text.english: Honestly, I initially had little interest in cloud tech, but hearing you share so much today, it seems I should look into it.

text.traditional: 那我明天騎摩托車去接妳。
text.simplified: 那我明天骑摩托车去接你。
text.pinyin: Nà wǒ míngtiān qí mótuōchē qù jiē nǐ.
text.english: Then I'll pick you up on my scooter tomorrow.

text.traditional: 太好了！麻煩你了！
text.simplified: 太好了！麻烦你了！
text.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Máfán nǐ le!
text.english: Wonderful! Thanks so much!

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Express an immediate realization, reaction, or consequence of a sudden situation using 這下子 ('now / as a result').
grammarPages.explanation: 在對話中說到某件事情或情況，說話的人表達自己的看法，也可以是自己面對突然發生的情況，當下做出的反應。
grammarPages.pattern: Situation + 這下子 + Result

text.traditional: 我那時候想，這下子沒辦法報告了，還好同學說雲端上也有一份……
text.simplified: 我那时候想，这下子没办法报告了，还好同学说云端上也有一份……
text.pinyin: Wǒ nà shíhòu xiǎng, zhèxiàzi méibànfǎ bàogào le, háihǎo tóngxué shuō yúnduān shàng yě yǒu yí fèn…
text.english: At that moment I thought, now I won't be able to give the presentation, but luckily a classmate said there was also a copy in the cloud…

text.traditional:
A：唉，我們工廠早上突然停電了，到現在還沒恢復，什麼都做不了。
B：真的？這下子你們的貨趕得出來嗎？
text.simplified:
A：唉，我们工厂早上突然停电了，到现在还没恢复，什么都做不了。
B：真的？这下子你们的货赶得出来吗？
text.pinyin:
A: Āi, wǒmen gōngchǎng zǎoshàng túrán tíngdiàn le, dào xiànzài háiméi huīfù, shénme dōu zuò bùliǎo.
B: Zhēnde? Zhèxiàzi nǐmen de huò gǎn de chūlái ma?
text.english:
A: Ugh, our factory suddenly lost power this morning, and it still isn't back, so we can't do anything.
B: Really? So now, can you still get your goods out in time?

text.traditional:
A：沒想到小顧計畫要去旅遊的國家，昨天發生了嚴重的大地震。
B：是啊。這下子他得改變計畫了。
text.simplified:
A：没想到小顾计划要去旅游的国家，昨天发生了严重的大地震。
B：是啊。这下子他得改变计划了。
text.pinyin:
A: Méixiǎngdào Xiǎo Gù jìhuà yào qù lǚyóu de guójiā, zuótiān fāshēng le yánzhòng de dà dìzhèn.
B: Shì a. Zhèxiàzi tā děi gǎibiàn jìhuà le.
text.english:
A: Who would have thought the country Xiao Gu was planning to visit would be hit by a severe earthquake yesterday?
B: Yes. So now he'll have to change his plans.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: When talking about a certain event or situation in a conversation, the person speaking expresses his or her own views, or their immediate reaction to a sudden change in the situation.
summary: 這下子 gives the speaker's view of a situation just mentioned, or a reaction to something sudden.
It stresses the immediate result of what just happened. 現在 only states the time now.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that the same person or thing is both A and B with 既……又……, when A and B are both good or both bad.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示同一個主語具有兩種狀態或情況。「既」跟「又」後面常接形容詞、動詞或動詞短語，形容詞前面不可以加副詞，動詞前面可加能願動詞「會、要、能、願意」等。所連接的兩個狀態或情況，必須同樣是正面的或負面的。而「又」後面狀態或情況的程度，比「既」來得更高一些。「既……又……」比「又……又……」書面。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 既 + Quality 1 + 又 + Quality 2

text.traditional: ……不同地區的人也能在網路上一起開會，既省時間又方便……
text.simplified: ……不同地区的人也能在网路上一起开会，既省时间又方便……
text.pinyin: …Bùtóng dìqū de rén yě néng zài wǎnglù shàng yìqǐ kāihuì, jì shěng shíjiān yòu fāngbiàn…
text.english: ...people in different regions can also hold meetings together online, which both saves time and is convenient...

text.traditional: 陳教授既是我的好老師，又是我的老朋友，我很重視我們的友誼。
text.simplified: 陈教授既是我的好老师，又是我的老朋友，我很重视我们的友谊。
text.pinyin: Chén jiàoshòu jì shì wǒ de hǎo lǎoshī, yòu shì wǒ de lǎo péngyǒu, wǒ hěn zhòngshì wǒmen de yǒuyí.
text.english: Professor Chen is both my good teacher and my old friend, and I value our friendship very much.

text.traditional: 阮小姐對穿著很講究，她對衣服的要求是既要品質好，又要設計佳。
text.simplified: 阮小姐对穿着很讲究，她对衣服的要求是既要品质好，又要设计佳。
text.pinyin: Ruǎn xiǎojiě duì chuānzhuó hěn jiǎngjiù, tā duì yīfu de yāoqiú shì jì yào pǐnzhí hǎo, yòu yào shèjì jiā.
text.english: Miss Ruan is very particular about what she wears: she wants her clothes to be both of good quality and well designed.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 既……又…… indicates that the same subject has two states or situations. 既 and 又 are often followed by adjectives, verbs, or verb phrases. Adverbs are not used in front of adjectives, though volitive auxiliary verbs such as 會, 要, 能, 願意, etc. can be added before verbs.
