The adjectives, verbs or verb phrases following 既 and 又 must both be positive or negative. The level of the state or the situation after 又 is higher than 既. Finally, 既……又……is used more in written language than 又……又…….
summary: 既……又…… says the same subject has two states or situations.
Both must be good or both must be bad.
Don't put an adverb like 很 before the adjectives.
The state after 又 is a little stronger, and this pattern is used more in writing than 又……又…….

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say 'not to mention' or 'let alone' with 更別說……了, adding a case so obvious it needs no more words.
grammarPages.explanation: 「更別說」的意思是「不必說」、「不需要說」，因為「更別說」後面所表達的情況是非常清楚的，不需要再多說。
grammarPages.pattern: Basic Case + 更別說 + Advanced Case + 了

text.traditional: ……既省時間又方便，更別說提供個人下載資料、傳訊息等基本服務了。
text.simplified: ……既省时间又方便，更别说提供个人下载资料、传讯息等基本服务了。
text.pinyin: …Jì shěng shíjiān yòu fāngbiàn, gèng biéshuō tígōng gèrén xiàzài zīliào, chuán xùnxī děng jīběn fúwù le.
text.english: …it's both time-saving and convenient, not to mention basic services such as downloading personal data and sending messages.

text.traditional: 我奶奶連怎麼上傳資料都不會，更別說建立自己的網站了。
text.simplified: 我奶奶连怎么上传资料都不会，更别说建立自己的网站了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai lián zěnme shàngchuán zīliào dōu bú huì, gèng biéshuō jiànlì zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn le.
text.english: My grandma can't even figure out how to upload data, let alone build her own website.

text.traditional: 溫先生一見到陌生人，就害羞得說不出話來，更別說要他演講了。
text.simplified: 温先生一见到陌生人，就害羞得说不出话来，更别说要他演讲了。
text.pinyin: Wēn xiānshēng yí jiàn dào mòshēngrén, jiù hàixiū de shuō bù chū huà lái, gèng biéshuō yào tā yǎnjiǎng le.
text.english: As soon as Mr. Wen sees a stranger, he gets so shy he can't say a word, let alone give a speech.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 更別說 means the same as 不必說 or 不需要說. Because the situation after 更別說 is very clear, there is no need to say more.
summary: 更別說 means there is no need to say it, because the case after it is so clear.
First give the easier or basic case, often with 連……都, then 更別說 and the harder one.

items.title: Grammar 4–5 · Towards The New Cloud Era

dialogue.title: 短文 · 走向雲端的新時代

text.traditional: 想當年還沒有雲端科技時，人們不論想閱讀某位作者出版的作品，或是需要找某類題材的文章，都得到圖書館去查資料、借書。不過，自從有了雲端之後，人們就是不出門，也可透過網路滿足相關的需求。
text.simplified: 想当年还没有云端科技时，人们不论想阅读某位作者出版的作品，或是需要找某类题材的文章，都得到图书馆去查资料、借书。不过，自从有了云端之后，人们就是不出门，也可透过网路满足相关的需求。
text.pinyin: Xiǎng dāngnián háiméi yǒu yúnduān kējì shí, rénmen búlùn xiǎng yuèdú mǒu wèi zuòzhě chūbǎn de zuòpǐn, huòshì xūyào zhǎo mǒu lèi tícái de wénzhāng, dōu děi dào túshūguǎn qù chá zīliào, jiè shū. Búguò, zìcóng yǒu le yúnduān zhīhòu, rénmen jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě tòuguò wǎnglù mǎnzú xiāngguān de xūqiú.
text.english: Back in the days before cloud technology, whether people wanted to read works published by an author or find articles on a topic, they had to go to libraries to research and borrow books. Since the advent of the cloud, however, people can satisfy relevant needs online without leaving home.

text.traditional: 雲端科技的主要功能，是讓人們能隨時隨地上傳或下載資料；也因為不需要使用紙、筆來記錄，還能為地球的環保盡一份力量。以往，雲端科技多用來管理資料和電子郵件；現在遇到淹水、颱風的特殊情況，不出門也能在家開會或學習，把該做的事情都做好。上班族在家中裝上了攝影機，透過手機或電腦能看到家人的活動情況，要是他們碰上了麻煩，就能立刻請鄰居或警察協助。除了個人，企業在管理公共空間或服務方面也用得著雲端。比如說，旅館透過雲端掌握房客進出的情況、調整房間內冷氣的強弱等等。以上都是雲端科技帶來的好處。
text.simplified: 云端科技的主要功能，是让人们能随时随地上传或下载资料；也因为不需要使用纸、笔来记录，还能为地球的环保尽一份力量。以往，云端科技多用来管理资料和电子邮件；现在遇到淹水、台风的特殊情况，不出门也能在家开会或学习，把该做的事情都做好。上班族在家中装上了摄影机，透过手机或电脑能看到家人的活动情况，要是他们碰上了麻烦，就能立刻请邻居或警察协助。除了个人，企业在管理公共空间或服务方面也用得着云端。比如说，旅馆透过云端掌握房客进出的情况、调整房间内冷气的强弱等等。以上都是云端科技带来的好处。
text.pinyin: Yúnduān kējì de zhǔyào gōngnéng, shì ràng rénmen néng suíshí suídì shàngchuán huò xiàzài zīliào; yě yīnwèi bù xūyào shǐyòng zhǐ, bǐ lái jìlù, hái néng wèi dìqiú de huánbǎo jìn yí fèn lìliàng. Yǐwǎng, yúnduān kējì duō yòng lái guǎnlǐ zīliào hé diànzǐ yóujiàn; xiànzài yùdào yānshuǐ, táifēng de tèshū qíngkuàng, bù chūmén yě néng zài jiā kāihuì huò xuéxí, bǎ gāi zuò de shìqíng dōu zuò hǎo. Shàngbān zú zài jiā zhōng zhuāng shàng le shèyǐng jī, tòuguò shǒujī huò diànnǎo néng kàndào jiārén de huódòng qíngkuàng, yàoshì tāmen pèngshàng le máfán, jiù néng lìkè qǐng línjū huò jǐngchá xiézhù. Chúle gèrén, qìyè zài guǎnlǐ gōnggòng kōngjiān huò fúwù fāngmiàn yě yòngdezháo yúnduān. Bǐrú shuō, lǚguǎn tòuguò yúnduān zhǎngwò fángkè jìnchū de qíngkuàng, tiáozhěng fángjiān nèi lěngqì de qiángruò děngděng. Yǐshàng dōu shì yúnduān kējì dàilái de hǎochù.
text.english: The main function of cloud technology is to let people upload or download data anytime, anywhere; and because there is no need to use paper and pens to record things, it can also do its part to protect the earth's environment. In the past, cloud technology was mostly used to manage data and email; now, in special situations such as floods and typhoons, people can hold meetings or study at home without going out, and get done everything they need to do. Office workers who have installed cameras at home can see what their family members are doing through their phones or computers; if their family members run into trouble, they can immediately ask the neighbors or the police for help. Besides individuals, businesses also find the cloud useful in managing public spaces or services. For example, hotels use the cloud to keep track of guests coming and going, adjust the strength of the air conditioning in the rooms, and so on. All of the above are benefits that cloud technology brings.

text.traditional: 但話說回來，雖然雲端的優點不少，卻還是有現實的問題需要克服。例如某個時刻突然停電了，或是連不上網路，再重要的會議也只能暫時停下來；也可能因為雲端系統出現安全問題，上傳的資料突然沒了或被偷了。所以最好別太依靠雲端，重要資料也應多存一份。
text.simplified: 但话说回来，虽然云端的优点不少，却还是有现实的问题需要克服。例如某个时刻突然停电了，或是连不上网路，再重要的会议也只能暂时停下来；也可能因为云端系统出现安全问题，上传的资料突然没了或被偷了。所以最好别太依靠云端，重要资料也应多存一份。
text.pinyin: Dàn huàshuō huílái, suīrán yúnduān de yōudiǎn bùshǎo, què háishì yǒu xiànshí de wèntí xūyào kèfú. Lìrú mǒu ge shíkè túrán tíngdiàn le, huòshì lián bú shàng wǎnglù, zài zhòngyào de huìyì yě zhǐ néng zhànshí tíng xiàlái; yě kěnéng yīnwèi yúnduān xìtǒng chūxiàn ānquán wèntí, shàngchuán de zīliào túrán méi le huò bèi tōu le. Suǒyǐ zuìhǎo bié tài yīkào yúnduān, zhòngyào zīliào yě yīng duō cún yí fèn.
text.english: But then again, although the cloud has many advantages, there are still real problems that need to be overcome. For example, if the power suddenly goes out at some moment, or you can't connect to the internet, even the most important meeting has to stop for the time being; and security problems in the cloud system may also cause uploaded data to suddenly disappear or be stolen. So it's best not to rely too much on the cloud, and you should also save an extra copy of important data.

text.traditional: 雲端就像一張大網，把各種資源連在一起，提供各式各樣的服務，一方面帶給人們更便利的生活，一方面也帶給企業更良好的管理方式，對全球商業、教育、文化等方面都產生了重大的影響，相信未來雲端能夠帶領我們走向美好的新時代。
text.simplified: 云端就像一张大网，把各种资源连在一起，提供各式各样的服务，一方面带给人们更便利的生活，一方面也带给企业更良好的管理方式，对全球商业、教育、文化等方面都产生了重大的影响，相信未来云端能够带领我们走向美好的新时代。
text.pinyin: Yúnduān jiù xiàng yì zhāng dà wǎng, bǎ gèzhǒng zīyuán lián zài yìqǐ, tígōng gèshìgèyàng de fúwù, yìfāngmiàn dài gěi rénmen gèng biànlì de shēnghuó, yìfāngmiàn yě dài gěi qìyè gèng liánghǎo de guǎnlǐ fāngshì, duì quánqiú shāngyè, jiàoyù, wénhuà děng fāngmiàn dōu chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng, xiāngxìn wèilái yúnduān nénggòu dàilǐng wǒmen zǒuxiàng měihǎo de xīn shídài.
text.english: The cloud is like a big net that links all kinds of resources together and provides all kinds of services. On the one hand, it brings people a more convenient life; on the other hand, it also brings businesses better ways of managing. It has had a major impact on business, education, culture and other areas around the world, and I believe that in the future the cloud will be able to lead us into a wonderful new era.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that even if something happened, the result would stay the same, with 就是……也…… ('even if… still…').
grammarPages.explanation: 「就是」的後面是假設的情況，就算發生這些情況，「也」後面的結果也不會因為這樣而改變。
grammarPages.pattern: 就是 + Condition, + 也 + Result

text.traditional: ……人們就是不出門，也可透過網路滿足相關的需求。
text.simplified: ……人们就是不出门，也可透过网路满足相关的需求。
text.pinyin: …Rénmen jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě tòuguò wǎnglù mǎnzú xiāngguān de xūqiú.
text.english: ...even if people do not go out, they can still meet related needs through the internet.

text.traditional: 為了追求夢想，就是吃再多苦，我也要堅持到底。
text.simplified: 为了追求梦想，就是吃再多苦，我也要坚持到底。
text.pinyin: Wèile zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng, jiùshì chī zài duō kǔ, wǒ yě yào jiānchí dàodǐ.
text.english: To pursue my dream, I'll keep going to the end, even if I have to endure a great deal of hardship.

text.traditional: 林老闆既然做了決定就不會改變，就是總統來跟他說也沒用。
text.simplified: 林老板既然做了决定就不会改变，就是总统来跟他说也没用。
text.pinyin: Lín lǎobǎn jìrán zuò le juédìng jiù bú huì gǎibiàn, jiùshì zǒngtǒng lái gēn tā shuō yě méi yòng.
text.english: Since Boss Lin has made up his mind, he will not change it; even if the president came and told him, it would be useless.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 就是 is followed by a hypothetical situation. Even if this situation should occur, the results after 也 will not change.
summary: 就是……也…… means even if. The imagined situation after 就是 does not change the result after 也.
In speech it works like 即使……也…….
只要……就 is different: it says if A happens, B must follow.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: On One Hand, On the Other Hand (一方面……一方面……)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Present two parallel aspects, reasons, or objectives of a situation using 一方面……，一方面…….
grammarPages.explanation: 使用「一方面……，一方面……」的句式說明一件事情兩個方面的原因、結果或目的等，前後兩句沒有重要程度的差別。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 一方面 + Aspect 1, + 一方面 + Aspect 2

text.traditional: ……一方面帶給人們更便利的生活，一方面也帶給企業更良好的管理方式……
text.simplified: ……一方面带给人们更便利的生活，一方面也带给企业更良好的管理方式……
text.pinyin: …Yìfāngmiàn dàigěi rénmen gèng biànlì de shēnghuó, yìfāngmiàn yě dàigěi qìyè gèng liánghǎo de guǎnlǐ fāngshì…
text.english: ...on the one hand it brings people a more convenient life, and on the other hand it also brings enterprises better management methods...

text.traditional: 錢老闆每天從早忙到晚，一方面要照顧生意，一方面要訓練員工，連陪家人的時間都沒有。
text.simplified: 钱老板每天从早忙到晚，一方面要照顾生意，一方面要训练员工，连陪家人的时间都没有。
text.pinyin: Qián lǎobǎn měitiān cóng zǎo máng dào wǎn, yìfāngmiàn yào zhàogù shēngyì, yìfāngmiàn yào xùnliàn yuángōng, lián péi jiārén de shíjiān dōu méiyǒu.
text.english: Boss Qian is busy from morning till night: on the one hand he has to look after the business, and on the other hand he has to train his staff. He doesn't even have time to spend with his family.

text.traditional: 店員建議我買這部筆電，一方面打了折之後便宜得多，一方面筆電該有的功能它都有。
text.simplified: 店员建议我买这部笔电，一方面打了折之后便宜得多，一方面笔电该有的功能它都有。
text.pinyin: Diànyuán jiànyì wǒ mǎi zhè bù bǐ diàn, yìfāngmiàn dǎ le zhé zhīhòu piányí de duō, yìfāngmiàn bǐ diàn gāi yǒu de gōngnéng tā dōu yǒu.
text.english: The shop clerk suggested I buy this laptop: on the one hand it is much cheaper after the discount, and on the other hand it has all the functions a laptop should have.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The use of the phrase 一方面……，一方面……can explain the cause, result or purpose of two aspects of a thing, and there is no important difference between the preceding and following sentences.
summary: 一方面……一方面…… gives two sides of one matter, such as two reasons, results or purposes.
The two parts are equal. Neither is more important.
不但……而且…… is different: the second part goes a step further.

items.title: Grammar 1–3 · The Story of the Double Seventh Festival

dialogue.title: 七夕情人節的故事

text.traditional: 你這個布做的錢包好漂亮，在哪裡買的？
text.simplified: 你这个布做的钱包好漂亮，在哪里买的？
text.pinyin: Nǐ zhège bù zuò de qiánbāo hǎo piàoliàng, zài nǎlǐ mǎi de?
text.english: This cloth wallet of yours is so pretty. Where did you buy it?

text.traditional: 是我女朋友親手做的七夕情人節禮物。法國也有情人節吧？
text.simplified: 是我女朋友亲手做的七夕情人节礼物。法国也有情人节吧？
text.pinyin: Shì wǒ nǚpéngyǒu qīnshǒu zuò de Qīxī Qíngrénjié lǐwù. Fǎguó yě yǒu Qíngrénjié ba?
text.english: It's a Qixi Valentine's gift handmade by my girlfriend. France has Valentine's Day too, right?

text.traditional: 有啊，不過不是在七夕。你們這個節日背後應該有故事吧？
text.simplified: 有啊，不过不是在七夕。你们这个节日背后应该有故事吧？
text.pinyin: Yǒu a, búguò búshì zài Qīxī. Nǐmen zhège jiérì bèihòu yīnggāi yǒu gùshì ba?
text.english: Yes, but not on Qixi. There must be a story behind your festival, right?

text.traditional: 這就要從牛郎、織女說起了。從前有個叫牛郎的青年，每天都帶著老牛去田裡工作。有一天，他在河邊休息時，看見了一位非常美麗的姑娘。
text.simplified: 这就要从牛郎、织女说起了。从前有个叫牛郎的青年，每天都带着老牛去田里工作。有一天，他在河边休息时，看见了一位非常美丽的姑娘。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiùyào cóng Niúláng, Zhīnǚ shuōqǐ le. Cóngqián yǒu ge jiào Niúláng de qīngnián, měitiān dōu dài zhe lǎo niú qù tián lǐ gōngzuò. Yǒu yì tiān, tā zài hébiān xiūxí shí, kànjiàn le yí wèi fēicháng měilì de gūniáng.
text.english: To explain that, we have to start with Niulang and Weaver Girl. Once there was a young man named Niulang who took his old ox to work the fields every day. One day while resting by the river, he saw an exceptionally beautiful girl.

text.traditional: 我猜牛郎第一眼看到她，就覺得遇到了真愛吧。
text.simplified: 我猜牛郎第一眼看到她，就觉得遇到了真爱吧。
text.pinyin: Wǒ cāi Niúláng dì yī yǎn kàndào tā, jiù juéde yùdào le zhēn'ài ba.
text.english: I bet the very first moment Niulang saw her, he felt he had found true love.

text.traditional: 是啊。那個天真可愛的姑娘名叫織女，她是天上的仙女，跟著幾個姊姊來人間玩，過幾天就得回到天上。
text.simplified: 是啊。那个天真可爱的姑娘名叫织女，她是天上的仙女，跟着几个姊姊来人间玩，过几天就得回到天上。
text.pinyin: Shì a. Nàge tiānzhēn kě'ài de gūniáng míng jiào Zhīnǚ, tā shì tiānshàng de xiānnǚ, gēn zhe jǐ ge jiějie lái rénjiān wán, guò jǐ tiān jiù děi huídào tiānshàng.
text.english: Indeed. That innocent and lovely girl was named Weaver Girl. She was a celestial fairy from heaven, visiting the mortal world with her older sisters for fun, and had to return to heaven after a few days.

text.traditional: 牛郎不想把她留下來嗎？
text.simplified: 牛郎不想把她留下来吗？
text.pinyin: Niúláng bù xiǎng bǎ tā liú xià lái ma?
text.english: Didn't Niulang want to keep her here?

text.traditional: 當然想啊！為了把織女留在身邊，牛郎就拿走了能讓織女飛回天上的衣服。後來，因為牛郎很溫柔、很體貼，織女就慢慢愛上他了，最後他們成了夫婦，還生了兩個寶貝。
text.simplified: 当然想啊！为了把织女留在身边，牛郎就拿走了能让织女飞回天上的衣服。后来，因为牛郎很温柔、很体贴，织女就慢慢爱上他了，最后他们成了夫妇，还生了两个宝贝。
text.pinyin: Dāngrán xiǎng a! Wèile bǎ Zhīnǚ liú zài shēnbiān, Niúláng jiù ná zǒu le néng ràng Zhīnǚ fēi huí tiānshàng de yīfu. Hòulái, yīnwèi Niúláng hěn wēnróu, hěn tǐtiē, Zhīnǚ jiù mànmàn àishàng tā le, zuìhòu tāmen chéng le fūfù, hái shēng le liǎng ge bǎobèi.
text.english: Of course he did! To keep Weaver Girl by his side, Niulang took away the clothes that allowed her to fly back to heaven. Later, because Niulang was gentle and thoughtful, Weaver Girl gradually fell in love with him, and eventually they became husband and wife and had two precious children.

text.traditional: 他們就這樣過著幸福快樂的日子嗎？
text.simplified: 他们就这样过着幸福快乐的日子吗？
text.pinyin: Tāmen jiù zhèyàng guò zhe xìngfú kuàilè de rìzi ma?
text.english: And did they live happily ever after just like that?

text.traditional: 唉，沒那麼簡單。天帝知道了以後，氣得叫王母娘娘把織女抓回天上，還把她關了起來。牛郎找來找去，總算在天上某個神祕的地方找到了織女。沒想到王母娘娘卻在他們中間變出一條銀河，讓他們只能遠遠地看著對方。
text.simplified: 唉，没那么简单。天帝知道了以后，气得叫王母娘娘把织女抓回天上，还把她关了起来。牛郎找来找去，总算在天上某个神秘的地方找到了织女。没想到王母娘娘却在他们中间变出一条银河，让他们只能远远地看着对方。
text.pinyin: Āi, méi nàme jiǎndān. Tiāndì zhīdào le yǐhòu, qì de jiào Wángmǔ Niángniang bǎ Zhīnǚ zhuā huí tiānshàng, hái bǎ tā guān le qǐlái. Niúláng zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, zǒngsuàn zài tiānshàng mǒu ge shénmì de dìfāng zhǎodào le Zhīnǚ. Méixiǎngdào Wángmǔ Niángniang què zài tāmen zhōngjiān biàn chū yì tiáo Yínhé, ràng tāmen zhǐ néng yuǎnyuǎn de kàn zhe duìfāng.
text.english: Alas, it wasn't so simple. When the Heavenly Emperor found out, he was furious and ordered the Queen Mother of the West to drag Weaver Girl back to heaven and lock her up. Niulang searched everywhere and finally found Weaver Girl in a mysterious place in heaven. Unexpectedly, the Queen Mother conjured up the Milky Way between them, allowing them only to gaze at each other from afar.

text.traditional: 織女不能跟牛郎聚在一起，也不能在人間住下去，真可憐。
text.simplified: 织女不能跟牛郎聚在一起，也不能在人间住下去，真可怜。
text.pinyin: Zhīnǚ bùnéng gēn Niúláng jù zài yìqǐ, yě bùnéng zài rénjiān zhù xiàqù, zhēn kělián.
text.english: Weaver Girl couldn't be together with Niulang, nor could she live on in the mortal world; how pitiful.

text.traditional: 還好姊姊們很同情她，好幾次請求王母娘娘幫忙。王母娘娘仔細觀察了兩人的情況，終於被他們的愛情感動了，答應讓他們在每年的農曆七月初七見面。有人說，七夕年年都會下雨，那就是織女流下的眼淚。
text.simplified: 还好姊姊们很同情她，好几次请求王母娘娘帮忙。王母娘娘仔细观察了两人的情况，终于被他们的爱情感动了，答应让他们在每年的农历七月初七见面。有人说，七夕年年都会下雨，那就是织女流下的眼泪。
text.pinyin: Háihǎo jiějie men hěn tóngqíng tā, hǎojǐ cì qǐngqiú Wángmǔ Niángniang bāngmáng. Wángmǔ Niángniang zǐxì guānchá le liǎng rén de qíngkuàng, zhōngyú bèi tāmen de àiqíng gǎndòng le, dāyìng ràng tāmen zài měinián de nónglì qīyuè chū qī jiànmiàn. Yǒu rén shuō, Qīxī niánnián dōu huì xiàyǔ, nà jiùshì Zhīnǚ liú xià de yǎnlèi.
text.english: Fortunately her sisters sympathized with her and begged the Queen Mother repeatedly for help. The Queen Mother carefully observed the couple's situation and was finally moved by their love, granting them permission to meet every year on the seventh day of the seventh lunar month. Some say that it rains every year on Qixi, and that is Weaver Girl shedding tears.

text.traditional: 幸虧有姊姊們的幫助，要不然他們一生都不能團圓了。
text.simplified: 幸亏有姊姊们的帮助，要不然他们一生都不能团圆了。
text.pinyin: Xìngkuī yǒu jiějie men de bāngzhù, yàobùrán tāmen yìshēng dōu bùnéng tuányuán le.
text.english: Fortunately they had the sisters' help, otherwise they would never have reunited in their entire lives.

text.traditional: 可是一年只能見一次面，這樣的結局讓我很難過。
text.simplified: 可是一年只能见一次面，这样的结局让我很难过。
text.pinyin: Kěshì yì nián zhǐ néng jiàn yí cì miàn, zhèyàng de jiéjú ràng wǒ hěn nánguò.
text.english: But meeting only once a year—such an ending makes me sad.

text.traditional: 怎麼說呢？
text.simplified: 怎么说呢？
text.pinyin: Zěnme shuō ne?
text.english: Why do you say that?

text.traditional: 我女朋友畢業後就要出國念書，我擔心兩個人分開太久，關係就變淡了。
text.simplified: 我女朋友毕业后就要出国念书，我担心两个人分开太久，关系就变淡了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ nǚpéngyǒu bìyè hòu jiùyào chūguó niànshū, wǒ dānxīn liǎng ge rén fēnkāi tài jiǔ, guānxì jiù biàn dàn le.
text.english: My girlfriend is going abroad to study after graduation. I worry that being apart too long will cause our relationship to fade.

text.traditional: 別擔心，現在網路這麼方便，隨時都能聊天、傳照片，距離再遠也沒問題。
text.simplified: 别担心，现在网路这么方便，随时都能聊天、传照片，距离再远也没问题。
text.pinyin: Bié dānxīn, xiànzài wǎnglù zhème fāngbiàn, suíshí dōu néng liáotiān, chuán zhàopiàn, jùlí zài yuǎn yě méi wèntí.
text.english: Don't worry. The internet is so convenient now; you can chat and send photos anytime. No matter how far the distance, it won't be a problem.

text.traditional: 沒問題倒是沒問題，不過遠距離的戀愛還是很辛苦的。
text.simplified: 没问题倒是没问题，不过远距离的恋爱还是很辛苦的。
text.pinyin: Méi wèntí dàoshì méi wèntí, búguò yuǎnjùlí de liàn'ài háishì hěn xīnkǔ de.
text.english: It's true that it's not a problem, but a long-distance relationship is still really hard.

text.traditional: 別想那麼多了，你還是說說跟七夕有關的習俗吧。
text.simplified: 别想那么多了，你还是说说跟七夕有关的习俗吧。
text.pinyin: Bié xiǎng nàme duō le, nǐ háishì shuōshuo gēn Qīxī yǒuguān de xísú ba.
text.english: Don't overthink it; why not tell me about customs related to Qixi instead?

text.traditional: 好吧。七夕那天，當月亮升起時，就會有拜織女的活動。因為織女織布的技巧很好，能織出漂亮的衣服和美麗的雲。人間的姑娘希望能像她那樣又聰明又漂亮，就會用一些親手做的東西來拜她。
text.simplified: 好吧。七夕那天，当月亮升起时，就会有拜织女的活动。因为织女织布的技巧很好，能织出漂亮的衣服和美丽的云。人间的姑娘希望能像她那样又聪明又漂亮，就会用一些亲手做的东西来拜她。
text.pinyin: Hǎo ba. Qīxī nà tiān, dāng yuèliàng shēngqǐ shí, jiù huì yǒu bài Zhīnǚ de huódòng. Yīnwèi Zhīnǚ zhībù de jìqiǎo hěn hǎo, néng zhī chū piàoliàng de yīfu hé měilì de yún. Rénjiān de gūniáng xīwàng néng xiàng tā nàyàng yòu cōngmíng yòu piàoliàng, jiù huì yòng yìxiē qīnshǒu zuò de dōngxi lái bài tā.
text.english: All right. On Qixi day, when the moon rises, there are activities honoring Weaver Girl. Because Weaver Girl was very good at weaving, she could weave beautiful clothes and lovely clouds. Girls in the mortal world who hope to be as clever and pretty as she was worship her with things they have made by hand.

text.traditional: 你女朋友在七夕送你這個親手做的錢包，原來有特別的意義啊！
text.simplified: 你女朋友在七夕送你这个亲手做的钱包，原来有特别的意义啊！
text.pinyin: Nǐ nǚpéngyǒu zài Qīxī sòng nǐ zhège qīnshǒu zuò de qiánbāo, yuánlái yǒu tèbié de yìyì a!
text.english: So your girlfriend giving you this handmade wallet on Qixi carries a special meaning after all!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Story of the Double Seventh Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day)
grammarPages.titleEnglish: Starting to explain/narrate from a specific point
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something can't be explained simply and has to start from a certain point, with (這)就要從……說起了 (說 can also be 看, 找, 做…).
grammarPages.explanation: 本課對話中使用「（這）就要從……說起了」，表示說話者提到的某件事，沒辦法簡單說清楚，得從某個角度、部分或時間開始說，才能讓聽者明白。這個「說」可換成「看、做、寫、找、談、講、聊」等單音節動詞，表示開始做那件事。假如前句已提到主題，就不需用「這/那」。
grammarPages.pattern: (這) + 就要從 + Starting point + Verb (說/看/找…) + 起了

text.traditional: 這就要從牛郎、織女說起了。……
text.simplified: 这就要从牛郎、织女说起了。……
text.pinyin: Zhè jiùyào cóng Niúláng, Zhīnǚ shuōqǐ le.…
text.english: To explain that, we have to start with the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl…

text.traditional: 這個計畫一再地調整內容，想找到舊資料的話，就要從兩年前的找起了。
text.simplified: 这个计划一再地调整内容，想找到旧资料的话，就要从两年前的找起了。
text.pinyin: Zhè ge jìhuà yízài de tiáozhěng nèiróng, xiǎng zhǎodào jiù zīliào dehuà, jiùyào cóng liǎng nián qián de zhǎo qǐ le.
text.english: This plan's content has been changed again and again, so if you want to find the old files, you'll have to start looking with the ones from two years ago.

text.traditional:
A：我花了很多錢去健身房運動，怎麼過了三個月還沒變瘦？
B：這就要從你的飲食習慣說起了。要是你不改掉愛吃零食的壞習慣，怎麼瘦得下來呢？
text.simplified:
A：我花了很多钱去健身房运动，怎么过了三个月还没变瘦？
B：这就要从你的饮食习惯说起了。要是你不改掉爱吃零食的坏习惯，怎么瘦得下来呢？
text.pinyin:
A: Wǒ huā le hěn duō qián qù jiànshēnfáng yùndòng, zěnme guò le sān ge yuè háiméi biàn shòu?
B: Zhè jiùyào cóng nǐ de yǐnshí xíguàn shuōqǐ le. Yàoshì nǐ bù gǎidiào ài chī língshí de huài xíguàn, zěnme shòu de xiàlái ne?
text.english:
A: I've spent a lot of money going to the gym, so how come I still haven't lost weight after three months?
B: For that, we have to start with your eating habits. If you don't break your bad habit of snacking, how will you ever lose weight?

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: In the dialogue in this lesson, （這）就要從……說起了 means that something mentioned by the speaker cannot be easily stated clearly. You must start from a certain angle, part or time to make the listener understand. “Speak” can be replaced with a single-syllable verb such as “see, do, write, find, discuss, speak, chat”, which means to begin that action. If the subject is mentioned in the previous sentence, “this/that” is not necessary.
summary: 就要從……說起了 says something is hard to explain simply, so you must start from one angle, part or time.
Change 說 to a one-syllable verb like 看, 做 or 聊, not a longer one like 說明.
End with 起了, not 起來. If the topic was already mentioned, leave out 這 or 那.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Story of the Double Seventh Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that someone keeps on doing something, or can or can't keep going, with V下去, V得下去 and V不下去.
grammarPages.explanation: 「下去」放在動詞之後，當作補語，表示某個動作繼續進行，「V下去」後面不可加賓語。
grammarPages.pattern: Verb + 下去 / 得下去 / 不下去

text.traditional: 織女不能跟牛郎聚在一起，也不能在人間住下去，真可憐。
text.simplified: 织女不能跟牛郎聚在一起，也不能在人间住下去，真可怜。
text.pinyin: Zhīnǚ bùnéng gēn Niúláng jù zài yìqǐ, yě bùnéng zài rénjiān zhù xiàqù, zhēn kělián.
text.english: The Weaver Girl could not be together with the Cowherd, and could not keep living in the human world either. How pitiful.

text.traditional: 這部電影很無聊，演員的演戲技巧也不好，我實在看不下去了。
text.simplified: 这部电影很无聊，演员的演戏技巧也不好，我实在看不下去了。
text.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng hěn wúliáo, yǎnyuán de yǎnxì jìqiǎo yě bùhǎo, wǒ shízài kàn bú xiàqù le.
text.english: This movie is boring, and the actors' acting isn't good either. I really can't keep watching it.

text.traditional:
A：總統給你們的任務很危險，你們能堅持下去嗎？
B：我們是軍人，為了國家，就算犧牲生命也必須完成。
text.simplified:
A：总统给你们的任务很危险，你们能坚持下去吗？
B：我们是军人，为了国家，就算牺牲生命也必须完成。
text.pinyin:
A: Zǒngtǒng gěi nǐmen de rènwù hěn wéixiǎn, nǐmen néng jiānchí xiàqù ma?
B: Wǒmen shì jūnrén, wèile guójiā, jiùsuàn xīshēng shēngmìng yě bìxū wánchéng.
text.english:
A: The task the president gave you is very dangerous. Can you keep going?
B: We are soldiers; for the country, we must complete it even if we sacrifice our lives.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 下去 is placed after the verb and used as a complement to indicate that a certain action continues. No object can be added after “V 下去”.
summary: 下去 after a verb shows that an action keeps going.
No object can come after V下去.
得 means you can keep going and 不 means you can't, as in 看不下去.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Story of the Double Seventh Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Explain how a lucky circumstance prevented a terrible outcome from happening.
grammarPages.explanation: 「幸虧」是副詞，後面敘述某個因為很幸運而發生的事件，要是沒有這個事件，「要不然」後面不好的、擔心的情況就會出現。
grammarPages.pattern: 幸虧 + Fortunate event, + 要不然 + Negative outcome

text.traditional: 幸虧有姊姊們的幫助，要不然他們一生都不能團圓了。
text.simplified: 幸亏有姊姊们的帮助，要不然他们一生都不能团圆了。
text.pinyin: Xìngkuī yǒu jiějie men de bāngzhù, yàobùrán tāmen yìshēng dōu bùnéng tuányuán le.
text.english: Luckily the older sisters helped; otherwise they could never have been reunited in their lifetime.

text.traditional: 奶奶天天去拜拜的那座寺廟前天忽然塌了，幸虧她那天沒去，要不然就糟了。
text.simplified: 奶奶天天去拜拜的那座寺庙前天忽然塌了，幸亏她那天没去，要不然就糟了。
text.pinyin: Nǎinai tiāntiān qù bàibài de nà zuò sìmiào qiántiān hūrán tā le, xìngkuī tā nà tiān méi qù, yàobùrán jiù zāo le.
text.english: The temple where Grandma goes to pray every day suddenly collapsed the day before yesterday. Luckily she didn't go that day; otherwise it would have been terrible.

text.traditional: 錢先生發生嚴重車禍時，幸虧警察就在路邊，趕快把他送到了醫院，要不然他的命就沒了。
text.simplified: 钱先生发生严重车祸时，幸亏警察就在路边，赶快把他送到了医院，要不然他的命就没了。
text.pinyin: Qián xiānshēng fāshēng yánzhòng chēhuò shí, xìngkuī jǐngchá jiù zài lùbiān, gǎnkuài bǎ tā sòng dào le yīyuàn, yàobùrán tā de mìng jiù méi le.
text.english: When Mr. Qian had a serious car accident, luckily a police officer was right by the road and quickly took him to the hospital; otherwise he would have died.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 幸虧 is an adverb. The statement after 幸虧 describes an event that happened because of luck. If there is no such event, the bad and worrisome situation behind 要不然 will appear.
summary: 幸虧 introduces a lucky event that happened.
要不然 then gives the bad or worrying result that would have happened without it.

items.title: Grammar 4–5 · The Meaning of Chinese Valentine's Day

dialogue.title: 短文 · 情人節的意義
grammarFocus: 按照 / 按 / 照 NP + V

text.traditional: 根據中國古代的說法，農曆七月初七是所謂的「七夕」。一提到七夕，人們就會想到牛郎和織女的愛情故事。這個故事不是真的，不過大家對愛情還是有無窮的想像，希望在現實中能夠擁有最美好的愛情。
text.simplified: 根据中国古代的说法，农历七月初七是所谓的「七夕」。一提到七夕，人们就会想到牛郎和织女的爱情故事。这个故事不是真的，不过大家对爱情还是有无穷的想像，希望在现实中能够拥有最美好的爱情。
text.pinyin: Gēnjù Zhōngguó gǔdài de shuōfǎ, nónglì qīyuè chū qī shì suǒwèi de “Qīxī”. Yì tídào Qīxī, rénmen jiù huì xiǎngdào Niúláng hé Zhīnǚ de àiqíng gùshì. Zhège gùshì búshì zhēnde, búguò dàjiā duì àiqíng háishì yǒu wú qióng de xiǎngxiàng, xīwàng zài xiànshí zhōng nénggòu yǒngyǒu zuì měihǎo de àiqíng.
text.english: According to ancient Chinese accounts, the seventh day of the seventh lunar month is known as "Qixi". Whenever Qixi is mentioned, people think of the love story of Niulang and Weaver Girl. This story isn't true, but people still have endless imagination about love and hope to have the most beautiful love in real life.

text.traditional: 按照過去的習俗，姑娘會在七夕把親手做的小東西送給朋友，向對方表達心意。後來，商人抓到了這個能創造更多利益的機會，就在七夕和西方情人節這兩個節日，推銷屬於情人節的特別禮物。不僅戀愛中的男女願意花錢買，平時只有以網路聊天、寫信等方式談戀愛的情侶，也會在這天送禮。但是某一些商業廣告強調，情人節交換禮物是愛對方的表現，也是情侶之間該有的責任。讓很多人以為不送禮、不約會是個錯誤，而犯了錯的人就得道歉。其實只要對情人是真心的，送不送禮物沒那麼重要，畢竟單純的愛情才是最珍貴的。
text.simplified: 按照过去的习俗，姑娘会在七夕把亲手做的小东西送给朋友，向对方表达心意。后来，商人抓到了这个能创造更多利益的机会，就在七夕和西方情人节这两个节日，推销属于情人节的特别礼物。不仅恋爱中的男女愿意花钱买，平时只有以网路聊天、写信等方式谈恋爱的情侣，也会在这天送礼。但是某一些商业广告强调，情人节交换礼物是爱对方的表现，也是情侣之间该有的责任。让很多人以为不送礼、不约会是个错误，而犯了错的人就得道歉。其实只要对情人是真心的，送不送礼物没那么重要，毕竟单纯的爱情才是最珍贵的。
text.pinyin: Ànzhào guòqù de xísú, gūniáng huì zài Qīxī bǎ qīnshǒu zuò de xiǎo dōngxi sòng gěi péngyǒu, xiàng duìfāng biǎodá xīnyì. Hòulái, shāngrén zhuā dào le zhège néng chuàngzào gèng duō lìyì de jīhuì, jiù zài Qīxī hé xīfāng Qíngrénjié zhè liǎng ge jiérì, tuīxiāo shǔyú Qíngrénjié de tèbié lǐwù. Bù jǐn liàn'ài zhōng de nánnǚ yuànyì huāqián mǎi, píngshí zhǐyǒu yǐ wǎnglù liáotiān, xiěxìn děng fāngshì tán liàn'ài de qínglǚ, yě huì zài zhè tiān sònglǐ. Dànshì mǒu yìxiē shāngyè guǎnggào qiángdiào, Qíngrénjié jiāohuàn lǐwù shì ài duìfāng de biǎoxiàn, yě shì qínglǚ zhījiān gāi yǒu de zérèn. Ràng hěn duō rén yǐwéi bú sònglǐ, bù yuēhuì shì ge cuòwù, ér fàn le cuò de rén jiù děi dàoqiàn. Qíshí zhǐyào duì qíngrén shì zhēnxīn de, sòng bú sòng lǐwù méi nàme zhòngyào, bìjìng dānchún de àiqíng cái shì zuì zhēnguì de.
text.english: According to past customs, young maidens would give handmade trinkets to friends on Qixi to express their affection. Later, merchants seized upon this opportunity to create greater profits, promoting special Valentine gifts during both Qixi and Western Valentine's Day. Not only were courting couples eager to spend money, but couples who usually date only through online chatting, letters and the like would also send gifts on this day. However, certain commercial advertisements emphasized that exchanging gifts on Valentine's Day proves one's love and is an obligation between lovers. This led many to believe that not giving gifts or going on dates is a misstep requiring an apology. In reality, as long as one is sincere toward their beloved, whether gifts are given is not so critical—after all, pure love is what is truly precious.

text.traditional: 不過話說回來，像牛郎與織女這樣的愛情故事，還是感動了無數人。不少文學與戲劇都採用這類的題材，畫家也常透過作品來表達浪漫的愛情。如能花點時間欣賞這方面的作品，或許就能更深入了解情人節的意義了。
text.simplified: 不过话说回来，像牛郎与织女这样的爱情故事，还是感动了无数人。不少文学与戏剧都采用这类的题材，画家也常透过作品来表达浪漫的爱情。如能花点时间欣赏这方面的作品，或许就能更深入了解情人节的意义了。
text.pinyin: Búguò huàshuō huílái, xiàng Niúláng yǔ Zhīnǚ zhèyàng de àiqíng gùshì, háishì gǎndòng le wúshù rén. Bùshǎo wénxué yǔ xìjù dōu cǎiyòng zhè lèi de tícái, huàjiā yě cháng tòuguò zuòpǐn lái biǎodá làngmàn de àiqíng. Rú néng huā diǎn shíjiān xīnshǎng zhè fāngmiàn de zuòpǐn, huòxǔ jiù néng gèng shēnrù liǎojiě Qíngrénjié de yìyì le.
text.english: Then again, love stories like Niulang and Weaver Girl still touch countless hearts. Many literary works and dramas adopt themes of this kind, and painters frequently convey romantic love through their art. If one can take some time to appreciate works in this domain, perhaps one will gain a deeper understanding of Valentine's true meaning.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Meaning of Chinese Valentine's Day
grammarPages.titleEnglish: According to / Based on (basis or evidence)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say what a statement, decision or conclusion is based on (a report, survey, law, experience…) with 根據.
grammarPages.explanation: 「根據」是介詞，意思是用某個行為、情況、資料、研究結果等當作基礎，做出判斷、行動或結論。「根據」的後面接名詞短語，常使用的名詞如：報告、調查、經驗、法律、規定、情況、了解、看法、結果、說明等等。
grammarPages.pattern: 根據 + Basis (Source / Law / Report / Survey), + Claim

text.traditional: 根據中國古代的說法，農曆七月初七是所謂的「七夕」。
text.simplified: 根据中国古代的说法，农历七月初七是所谓的「七夕」。
text.pinyin: Gēnjù Zhōngguó gǔdài de shuōfǎ, nónglì qīyuè chū qī shì suǒwèi de “Qīxī”.
text.english: According to ancient Chinese accounts, the seventh day of the seventh lunar month is what is known as Qixi.

text.traditional: 根據我國的法律，十八歲以上才可以喝酒。
text.simplified: 根据我国的法律，十八岁以上才可以喝酒。
text.pinyin: Gēnjù wǒguó de fǎlǜ, shíbā suì yǐshàng cái kěyǐ hē jiǔ.
text.english: According to our country's law, you have to be 18 or older to drink alcohol.

text.traditional: 根據氣象調查的資料，全球溫度比以前高了兩度，也因此造成了一些環境問題。
text.simplified: 根据气象调查的资料，全球温度比以前高了两度，也因此造成了一些环境问题。
text.pinyin: Gēnjù qìxiàng diàochá de zīliào, quánqiú wēndù bǐ yǐqián gāo le liǎng dù, yě yīncǐ zàochéng le yìxiē huánjìng wèntí.
text.english: According to the meteorological survey data, global temperature has risen two degrees compared with before, which has also caused some environmental problems.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 根據 is a preposition, making relevant conclusions based on certain behaviors, research results, stories or materials. After 根據, the words often used together are 報告, 調查, 經驗, 法律, 規定, 情況, 了解 看法, 結果, 說明, etc.
summary: 根據 means using something as the base for a judgment, action or conclusion.
After 根據 put a noun phrase for the basis, such as 報告, 調查, 經驗 or 法律.
根據 gives the reason behind a conclusion. 按照 is about how something is done.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: The Meaning of Chinese Valentine's Day
grammarPages.titleEnglish: In accordance with / Following (method or rule)
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Specify the rule, custom, plan, or instruction followed when performing an action.
grammarPages.explanation: 「按照」是介詞，意思是以某種方法、要求、規定、計畫、決定、標準等來做事情。「按照」主要強調「怎麼做」，例如：咖啡的價錢是按照杯子大小算的、薪水是按照在公司地位的高低決定的。「按照」可以只用「按」或「照」；「根據」則強調「為什麼這麼說、這麼做；為什麼有這樣的結論」，例如：根據臺灣的升學制度，想進好大學就得通過大學考試。「根據」也可以當名詞，例如：網路上有很多訊息是沒有根據的，不能完全相信。
grammarPages.pattern: 按照 / 按 / 照 + Standard + Action

text.traditional: 按照過去的習俗，姑娘會在七夕把親手做的小東西送給朋友……
text.simplified: 按照过去的习俗，姑娘会在七夕把亲手做的小东西送给朋友……
text.pinyin: Ànzhào guòqù de xísú, gūniáng huì zài Qīxī bǎ qīnshǒu zuò de xiǎo dōngxi sòng gěi péngyǒu…
text.english: Following past custom, girls would give the little things they made by hand to their friends on Qixi…

text.traditional:
A：怎麼辦？奶奶忽然生病住院了。
B：別擔心，只要按照醫生的話去做，應該可以很快出院的。
text.simplified:
A：怎么办？奶奶忽然生病住院了。
B：别担心，只要按照医生的话去做，应该可以很快出院的。
text.pinyin:
A: Zěnmebàn? Nǎinai hūrán shēngbìng zhùyuàn le.
B: Bié dānxīn, zhǐyào ànzhào yīshēng de huà qù zuò, yīnggāi kěyǐ hěn kuài chūyuàn de.
text.english:
A: What should we do? Grandma suddenly got sick and is in the hospital.
B: Don't worry. As long as she does what the doctor says, she should be able to leave the hospital soon.

text.traditional:
助理：下個月的員工訓練，要怎麼做呢？
老闆：昨天已經開過主管會議了，就按會議的決定做吧。
text.simplified:
助理：下个月的员工训练，要怎么做呢？
老板：昨天已经开过主管会议了，就按会议的决定做吧。
text.pinyin:
Zhùlǐ: Xià ge yuè de yuángōng xùnliàn, yào zěnme zuò ne?
Lǎobǎn: Zuótiān yǐjīng kāi guò zhǔguǎn huìyì le, jiù àn huìyì de juédìng zuò ba.
text.english:
Assistant\: How should we run next month's staff training?
Boss: We already held the managers' meeting yesterday, so just do it the way the meeting decided.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 按照 is a preposition. It means to do things according to certain methods, requirements, regulations, plans, decisions, and standards. “According to” mainly emphasizes “how to do it”. For example, 咖啡的價錢是按照杯子大小算的，薪水是按照在公司地位的高低決定的. 按照 can only use 按 or 照; 根據 emphasizes “why you say so and do this; why there is such a conclusion”. For example, 根據臺灣的升學制度，想進好大學就得通過大學考試. 根據 can also be used as a noun. For example, 網路上有很多訊息是沒有根據的，不能完全相信。
summary: 按照 means doing something by a method, rule, plan or standard.
It stresses how something is done, as in 按照杯子大小算. You can shorten it to 按 or 照.
根據 stresses why you say or do something, and it can also be a noun.

items.title: Grammar 1–2 · Visit the Historic Sites in Tamsui

dialogue.title: 去淡水參觀古蹟

text.traditional: 老師要我們寫一份報告，主題是臺灣的古蹟，我想介紹紅毛城，這個週末要去一趟。
text.simplified: 老师要我们写一份报告，主题是台湾的古迹，我想介绍红毛城，这个周末要去一趟。
text.pinyin: Lǎoshī yào wǒmen xiě yí fèn bàogào, zhǔtí shì Táiwān de gǔjī, wǒ xiǎng jièshào Hóngmáochéng, zhège zhōumò yào qù yí tàng.
text.english: The teacher wants us to write a report on the theme of Taiwan's historic sites. I want to introduce Fort San Domingo, and I'm going there this weekend.

text.traditional: 你說的紅毛城就是淡水那座著名的古蹟吧，我知道紅毛城是一棟古老的房子，它有什麼特色嗎？
text.simplified: 你说的红毛城就是淡水那座著名的古迹吧，我知道红毛城是一栋古老的房子，它有什么特色吗？
text.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de Hóngmáochéng jiùshì Dànshuǐ nà zuò zhùmíng de gǔjī ba, wǒ zhīdào Hóngmáochéng shì yí dòng gǔlǎo de fángzi, tā yǒu shénme tèsè ma?
text.english: The Fort San Domingo you mentioned is that famous historic site in Tamsui, right? I know it's an old building, does it have any special features?

text.traditional: 紅毛城是荷蘭人在三、四百年前蓋的，在臺灣的歷史上，具有政治和外交上的意義。
text.simplified: 红毛城是荷兰人在三、四百年前盖的，在台湾的历史上，具有政治和外交上的意义。
text.pinyin: Hóngmáochéng shì Hélán rén zài sān, sìbǎi nián qián gài de, zài Táiwān de lìshǐ shàng, jùyǒu zhèngzhì hé wàijiāo shàng de yìyì.
text.english: Fort San Domingo was built by the Dutch three or four hundred years ago; in Taiwan's history, it carries political and diplomatic significance.

text.traditional: 聽起來很有意思，週末我跟你一起去吧！
text.simplified: 听起来很有意思，周末我跟你一起去吧！
text.pinyin: Tīngqǐlái hěn yǒuyìsi, zhōumò wǒ gēn nǐ yìqǐ qù ba!
text.english: Sounds very interesting; let me go with you this weekend!

text.traditional: 好啊。那我先帶你去參觀龍山寺。那裡有石頭刻的龍，刻得十分生動，看過的人都說那幾條龍簡直快飛起來了，是非常了不起的藝術品。
text.simplified: 好啊。那我先带你去参观龙山寺。那里有石头刻的龙，刻得十分生动，看过的人都说那几条龙简直快飞起来了，是非常了不起的艺术品。
text.pinyin: Hǎo a. Nà wǒ xiān dài nǐ qù cānguān Lóngshān sì. Nàlǐ yǒu shítou kè de lóng, kè de shífēn shēngdòng, kàn guò de rén dōu shuō nà jǐ tiáo lóng jiǎnzhí kuài fēi qǐlái le, shì fēicháng liǎobùqǐ de yìshùpǐn.
text.english: Sure. Then first I'll take you to visit Longshan Temple. There are stone-carved dragons there, sculpted so vividly that everyone who sees them says they look as if they're about to fly away; they are truly marvelous works of art.

text.traditional: 旅遊網站也說龍山寺在宗教上的地位很重要，值得參觀。
text.simplified: 旅游网站也说龙山寺在宗教上的地位很重要，值得参观。
text.pinyin: Lǚyóu wǎngzhàn yě shuō Lóngshān sì zài zōngjiào shàng de dìwèi hěn zhòngyào, zhídé cānguān.
text.english: Travel websites also note that Longshan Temple holds an important religious standing and is well worth visiting.

text.traditional: 對臺灣人來說，龍山寺不僅是一座古蹟，更是拜拜求平安、健康、發財的地方。
text.simplified: 对台湾人来说，龙山寺不仅是一座古迹，更是拜拜求平安、健康、发财的地方。
text.pinyin: Duì Táiwān rén lái shuō, Lóngshān sì bù jǐn shì yí zuò gǔjī, gèng shì bàibài qiú píng'ān, jiànkāng, fācái de dìfāng.
text.english: To Taiwanese people, Longshan Temple is not only a historic site, but even more a place to pray for peace, health, and prosperity.

text.traditional: 聽你這麼說，倒是讓我想起了老家的教堂。自從我有記憶以來，我們全家每個禮拜天都上教堂。教堂旁的廣場，每到假日就有人來擺攤子，賣一些跟宗教有關的商品，還有吃的、用的小東西。
text.simplified: 听你这么说，倒是让我想起了老家的教堂。自从我有记忆以来，我们全家每个礼拜天都上教堂。教堂旁的广场，每到假日就有人来摆摊子，卖一些跟宗教有关的商品，还有吃的、用的小东西。
text.pinyin: Tīng nǐ zhème shuō, dàoshì ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ le lǎojiā de jiàotáng. Zìcóng wǒ yǒu jìyì yǐlái, wǒmen quánjiā měi ge lǐbài tiān dōu shàng jiàotáng. Jiàotáng páng de guǎngchǎng, měi dào jiàrì jiù yǒu rén lái bǎi tānzi, mài yìxiē gēn zōngjiào yǒuguān de shāngpǐn, háiyǒu chī de, yòng de xiǎo dōngxi.
text.english: Hearing you say that actually reminds me of the church back in my hometown. For as long as I can remember, our entire family went to church every Sunday. In the plaza next to the church, people would set up stalls on holidays selling religious items, as well as food and daily odds and ends.

text.traditional: 這跟臺灣很像。在臺灣，寺廟常是當地人生活的中心，居住在附近的人除了常去拜拜，也會在周圍做生意，一到週末就熱鬧極了。
text.simplified: 这跟台湾很像。在台湾，寺庙常是当地人生活的中心，居住在附近的人除了常去拜拜，也会在周围做生意，一到周末就热闹极了。
text.pinyin: Zhè gēn Táiwān hěn xiàng. Zài Táiwān, sìmiào cháng shì dāngdì rén shēnghuó de zhōngxīn, jūzhù zài fùjìn de rén chúle cháng qù bàibài, yě huì zài zhōuwéi zuò shēngyì, yí dào zhōumò jiù rènao jíle.
text.english: That is very much like Taiwan. Here temples are often the hub of local community life; residents nearby not only pray often, but also conduct business around them, making weekends exceptionally lively.

text.traditional: 我去過台南的孔廟，還有佛教、道教的寺廟，情形也差不多。
text.simplified: 我去过台南的孔庙，还有佛教、道教的寺庙，情形也差不多。
text.pinyin: Wǒ qù guò Táinán de Kǒngmiào, háiyǒu Fójiào, Dàojiào de sìmiào, qíngxíng yě chàbùduō.
text.english: I've visited Tainan's Confucian Temple, as well as Buddhist and Taoist temples; the situation is quite similar.

text.traditional: 你從小就信天主教，有機會我帶你去參觀天主教和基督教的教堂，有些古老的教堂被保留下來，還成了有名的古蹟呢。
text.simplified: 你从小就信天主教，有机会我带你去参观天主教和基督教的教堂，有些古老的教堂被保留下来，还成了有名的古迹呢。
text.pinyin: Nǐ cóngxiǎo jiù xìn Tiānzhǔ jiào, yǒu jīhuì wǒ dài nǐ qù cānguān Tiānzhǔ jiào hé Jīdūjiào de jiàotáng, yǒuxiē gǔlǎo de jiàotáng bèi bǎoliú xiàlái, hái chéng le yǒumíng de gǔjī ne.
text.english: You've been Catholic since childhood; when there's a chance, I'll take you to visit Catholic and Protestant churches. Some ancient churches have been preserved and even became renowned historic landmarks.

text.traditional: 太好了！這樣我就能更了解東西方宗教文化的差異了。
text.simplified: 太好了！这样我就能更了解东西方宗教文化的差异了。
text.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zhèyàng wǒ jiù néng gèng liǎojiě dōngxī fāng zōngjiào wénhuà de chāyì le.
text.english: Wonderful! That way I can gain a deeper understanding of the differences between Eastern and Western religious cultures.

text.traditional: 其實把古蹟好好保留下來很重要。幾年前，我看到一座古蹟被燒光的新聞，那時候覺得很難過，沒辦法用文字來形容。
text.simplified: 其实把古迹好好保留下来很重要。几年前，我看到一座古迹被烧光的新闻，那时候觉得很难过，没办法用文字来形容。
text.pinyin: Qíshí bǎ gǔjī hǎohǎo bǎoliú xiàlái hěn zhòngyào. Jǐ nián qián, wǒ kàndào yí zuò gǔjī bèi shāo guāng de xīnwén, nà shíhòu juéde hěn nánguò, méibànfǎ yòng wénzì lái xíngróng.
text.english: Actually preserving historic sites properly is very important. A few years ago I saw news of a historic landmark burning down completely; I felt so heartbroken then that words couldn't begin to describe it.

text.traditional: 我能體會你的心情。要是大家不重視古蹟的存在，被破壞了也不修理，從文化和歷史價值來看，都是相當可惜的。
text.simplified: 我能体会你的心情。要是大家不重视古迹的存在，被破坏了也不修理，从文化和历史价值来看，都是相当可惜的。
text.pinyin: Wǒ néng tǐhuì nǐ de xīnqíng. Yàoshì dàjiā bú zhòngshì gǔjī de cúnzài, bèi pòhuài le yě bù xiūlǐ, cóng wénhuà hé lìshǐ jiàzhí lái kàn, dōu shì xiāngdāng kěxí de.
text.english: I can empathize with your feelings. If people don't value the existence of historic relics and don't repair them when damaged, in terms of cultural and historical worth, that is deeply regrettable.

text.traditional: 是啊。古蹟記錄了祖先生活在這塊土地上的事實，要是不見了，對家鄉的記憶也會沒了。
text.simplified: 是啊。古迹记录了祖先生活在这块土地上的事实，要是不见了，对家乡的记忆也会没了。
text.pinyin: Shì a. Gǔjī jìlù le zǔxiān shēnghuó zài zhè kuài tǔdì shàng de shìshí, yàoshì bújiàn le, duì jiāxiāng de jìyì yě huì méi le.
text.english: Indeed. Historic relics document the reality of our ancestors living on this land; if they disappear, our collective memory of our homeland will vanish as well.

text.traditional: 好了好了，你別擔心了。我們換個開心的話題吧！
text.simplified: 好了好了，你别担心了。我们换个开心的话题吧！
text.pinyin: Hǎo le hǎo le, nǐ bié dānxīn le. Wǒmen huàn ge kāixīn de huàtí ba!
text.english: Alright, alright, don't worry so much. Let's switch to a cheerier topic!

text.traditional: 嗯。除了紅毛城，我還可以帶你去淡水碼頭看夕陽，大家都說那裡的夕陽美得沒話說呢！
text.simplified: 嗯。除了红毛城，我还可以带你去淡水码头看夕阳，大家都说那里的夕阳美得没话说呢！
text.pinyin: Ēn. Chúle Hóngmáochéng, wǒ hái kěyǐ dài nǐ qù Dànshuǐ mǎtóu kàn xīyáng, dàjiā dōu shuō nàlǐ de xīyáng měi de méi huà shuō ne!
text.english: Mm. Besides Fort San Domingo, I can also take you to Tamsui pier to watch the sunset—everyone says the sunset there is incomparably gorgeous!

text.traditional: 太棒了，幸好你是我的好朋友，願意當我的導遊，要不然我就看不到美麗的夕陽，更別說了解臺灣的古蹟了。
text.simplified: 太棒了，幸好你是我的好朋友，愿意当我的导游，要不然我就看不到美丽的夕阳，更别说了解台湾的古迹了。
text.pinyin: Tài bàng le, xìnghǎo nǐ shì wǒ de hǎo péngyǒu, yuànyì dāng wǒ de dǎoyóu, yàobùrán wǒ jiù kàn búdào měilì de xīyáng, gèng bié shuō liǎojiě Táiwān de gǔjī le.
text.english: Terrific! Luckily you're my good friend and willing to be my guide, otherwise I wouldn't get to see the beautiful sunset, let alone understand Taiwan's historic landmarks.

text.traditional: 你別開玩笑了，我可不是專業的導遊啊。週末我打算跟當地人聊聊，從他們口中說出的歷史，一定更有意思。
text.simplified: 你别开玩笑了，我可不是专业的导游啊。周末我打算跟当地人聊聊，从他们口中说出的历史，一定更有意思。
text.pinyin: Nǐ bié kāiwánxiào le, wǒ kě búshì zhuānyè de dǎoyóu a. Zhōumò wǒ dǎsuàn gēn dāngdì rén liáo liáo, cóng tāmen kǒu zhōng shuōchū de lìshǐ, yídìng gèng yǒuyìsi.
text.english: Stop teasing, I'm certainly no professional tour guide. Over the weekend I plan to chat with locals; history told from their own mouths will surely be even more fascinating.

text.traditional: 是啊。那麼週末見吧！
text.simplified: 是啊。那么周末见吧！
text.pinyin: Shì a. Nàme zhōumò jiàn ba!
text.english: Indeed. See you this weekend then!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Visit the Historic Sites in Tamsui
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 簡直 (often before 像, 就像, 是 or 就是) to say, with vivid exaggeration, that something has practically reached a certain state or is practically like something else.
grammarPages.explanation: 「簡直」是副詞，後面可連接「像、就像、是、就是」等。表示說話者用較誇張、生動的方式，來形容差不多達到某個情況或程度。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 簡直 is an adverb, which can be followed by 像, 就像, 是, 就是, etc. It means that the speaker uses a more exaggerated and vivid way to describe a certain situation.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 簡直 + Comparison

text.traditional: ……看過的人都說那幾條龍簡直快飛起來了……
text.simplified: ……看过的人都说那几条龙简直快飞起来了……
text.pinyin: …Kàn guò de rén dōu shuō nà jǐ tiáo lóng jiǎnzhí kuài fēi qǐlái le…
text.english: …Everyone who has seen them says those dragons are practically about to take flight…

text.traditional: 方小姐長得很漂亮，皮膚也很好，簡直像個仙女一樣。
text.simplified: 方小姐长得很漂亮，皮肤也很好，简直像个仙女一样。
text.pinyin: Fāng xiǎojiě zhǎng de hěn piàoliàng, pífū yě hěn hǎo, jiǎnzhí xiàng ge xiānnǚ yíyàng.
text.english: Miss Fang is very pretty and has lovely skin too; she's practically a fairy.

text.traditional: 在工作上，畢經理總是做得又快又好，也從來沒犯過什麼錯，簡直就像機器一樣。
text.simplified: 在工作上，毕经理总是做得又快又好，也从来没犯过什么错，简直就像机器一样。
text.pinyin: Zài gōngzuò shàng, Bì jīnglǐ zǒngshì zuò de yòu kuài yòu hǎo, yě cónglái méi fàn guò shénme cuò, jiǎnzhí jiù xiàng jīqì yíyàng.
text.english: At work, Manager Bi always does things quickly and well, and he has never made any mistakes; he's practically a machine.

summary: 簡直 describes something in an exaggerated, vivid way, to say it is almost like that.
It can be followed by 像, 就像, 是 or 就是.
簡直 is a vivid view from the speaker, not just a degree word like 很 or 非常.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Visit the Historic Sites in Tamsui
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Praise something as so good that you can't find better words to describe it.
grammarPages.explanation: 這個語法表示說話者對某件事情、某個情況，找不出更合適、更好的語詞來形容或說明。多用於正面語氣。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This grammar means that the speaker cannot find a better, more suitable word to describe or explain some thing or a situation. Mostly used in a positive tone.
grammarPages.pattern: Vs + 得 + 沒話說

text.traditional: ……大家都說那裡的夕陽美得沒話說呢！
text.simplified: ……大家都说那里的夕阳美得没话说呢！
text.pinyin: …Dàjiā dōu shuō nàlǐ de xīyáng měi de méi huà shuō ne!
text.english: …Everyone says the sunset there is beautiful beyond words!

text.traditional: 這台電腦處理資料的速度快得沒話說，上傳和下載影片只要幾秒就完成了。
text.simplified: 这台电脑处理资料的速度快得没话说，上传和下载影片只要几秒就完成了。
text.pinyin: Zhè tái diànnǎo chǔlǐ zīliào de sùdù kuài de méi huà shuō, shàngchuán hé xiàzài yǐngpiàn zhǐyào jǐ miǎo jiù wánchéng le.
text.english: This computer processes data unbelievably fast; uploading and downloading videos takes only a few seconds.

text.traditional: 方同學不僅用功讀書、尊敬老師、關心同學，假日還去育幼院服務，簡直是優秀得沒話說。
text.simplified: 方同学不仅用功读书、尊敬老师、关心同学，假日还去育幼院服务，简直是优秀得没话说。
text.pinyin: Fāng tóngxué bù jǐn yònggōng dúshū, zūnjìng lǎoshī, guānxīn tóngxué, jiàrì hái qù yùyòuyuàn fúwù, jiǎnzhí shì yōuxiù de méi huà shuō.
text.english: Fang not only studies hard, respects the teachers and cares about classmates, but also volunteers at a children's home on holidays. Fang is simply outstanding beyond words.

summary: Put a describing word before 得沒話說 to say you can't find a better word for it.
It is mostly positive, for praise, not for criticism.
沒話說 can also stand alone, as in 服務沒話說, to mean nothing to complain about.

items.title: Grammar 3–5 · Historic Sites in the Jigsaw Puzzle of History

dialogue.title: 短文 · 歷史拼圖中的古蹟

text.traditional: 歷史是人類真實生活有系統的記錄。人類每天都在記錄歷史，同時也在創造歷史。古蹟是歷史的一部分，透過相關的研究，人們能明白在某塊土地上，曾經發生過什麼重大的事情，也能體會祖先克服困難的精神。因此，現代人除了得感謝祖先留下來的智慧，也必須好好地保護古蹟。
text.simplified: 历史是人类真实生活有系统的记录。人类每天都在记录历史，同时也在创造历史。古迹是历史的一部分，透过相关的研究，人们能明白在某块土地上，曾经发生过什么重大的事情，也能体会祖先克服困难的精神。因此，现代人除了得感谢祖先留下来的智慧，也必须好好地保护古迹。
text.pinyin: Lìshǐ shì rénlèi zhēnshí shēnghuó yǒu xìtǒng de jìlù. Rénlèi měitiān dōu zài jìlù lìshǐ, tóngshí yě zài chuàngzào lìshǐ. Gǔjī shì lìshǐ de yí bùfèn, tòuguò xiāngguān de yánjiù, rénmen néng míngbái zài mǒu kuài tǔdì shàng, céngjīng fāshēng guò shénme zhòngdà de shìqíng, yě néng tǐhuì zǔxiān kèfú kùnnán de jīngshén. Yīncǐ, xiàndài rén chúle děi gǎnxiè zǔxiān liú xià lái de zhìhuì, yě bìxū hǎohǎo de bǎohù gǔjī.
text.english: History is a systematic record of the real lives of humankind. Every day humanity records history, and at the same time it also makes history. Historic sites are a part of history. Through related research, people can understand what major events once happened on a certain piece of land, and can also appreciate their ancestors' spirit in overcoming difficulties. So besides having to thank their ancestors for the wisdom they left behind, people today must also take good care of historic sites.

text.traditional: 一般人認為，古蹟是從以前保留到現在的古屋、古廟、古橋等等。不過，古蹟事實上是祖先留給我們的寶貝。不論是某個國王住過的大房子，或是某個民族建立的小寺廟，只要它具有歷史意義及紀念價值，就該被重視和保留。
text.simplified: 一般人认为，古迹是从以前保留到现在的古屋、古庙、古桥等等。不过，古迹事实上是祖先留给我们的宝贝。不论是某个国王住过的大房子，或是某个民族建立的小寺庙，只要它具有历史意义及纪念价值，就该被重视和保留。
text.pinyin: Yìbānrén rènwéi, gǔjī shì cóng yǐqián bǎoliú dào xiànzài de gǔ wū, gǔ miào, gǔ qiáo děngděng. Búguò, gǔjī shìshíshàng shì zǔxiān liú gěi wǒmen de bǎobèi. Búlùn shì mǒu ge guówáng zhù guò de dà fángzi, huòshì mǒu ge mínzú jiànlì de xiǎo sìmiào, zhǐyào tā jùyǒu lìshǐ yìyì jí jìniàn jiàzhí, jiù gāi bèi zhòngshì hé bǎoliú.
text.english: Most people think that historic sites are old houses, old temples, old bridges and so on that have been preserved from the past until now. In fact, though, historic sites are treasures our ancestors left us. Whether it is a big house where some king once lived or a small temple built by some ethnic group, as long as it has historical significance and commemorative value, it should be valued and preserved.

text.traditional: 絕大部分的古蹟，給人一種既陌生又熟悉的感覺。一方面是古蹟裡的某一些物品、圖畫，在現代已極少見，甚至不存在了；一方面是從祖父母口中說出的古人古事，透過參觀相關的古蹟，能讓人感覺更親切。這樣的現象十分有趣，如果能夠深入研究，還有機會發現歷史上的祕密呢！
text.simplified: 绝大部分的古迹，给人一种既陌生又熟悉的感觉。一方面是古迹里的某一些物品、图画，在现代已极少见，甚至不存在了；一方面是从祖父母口中说出的古人古事，透过参观相关的古迹，能让人感觉更亲切。这样的现象十分有趣，如果能够深入研究，还有机会发现历史上的秘密呢！
text.pinyin: Juédàbùfèn de gǔjī, gěi rén yì zhǒng jì mòshēng yòu shóuxī de gǎnjué. Yìfāngmiàn shì gǔjī lǐ de mǒu yìxiē wùpǐn, túhuà, zài xiàndài yǐ jí shǎo jiàn, shènzhì bù cúnzài le; yìfāngmiàn shì cóng zǔfùmǔ kǒu zhōng shuōchū de gǔrén gǔshì, tòuguò cānguān xiāngguān de gǔjī, néng ràng rén gǎnjué gèng qīnqiè. Zhèyàng de xiànxiàng shífēn yǒuqù, rúguǒ nénggòu shēnrù yánjiù, háiyǒu jīhuì fāxiàn lìshǐ shàng de mìmì ne!
text.english: The vast majority of historic sites give people a feeling that is both strange and familiar. On one hand, some of the objects and pictures in historic sites are now very rare, or no longer even exist; on the other hand, the people and events of long ago that our grandparents tell us about feel closer when we visit the related historic sites. This is very interesting, and with deeper research, we may even discover secrets of history!

text.traditional: 其實，某個國家的古蹟維持得越久、越好，人民越覺得驕傲。況且，參觀古蹟早就是現代人的休閒活動，所以得採用積極的方法來保護古蹟。最重要的是國家得提供經費，請專業人員使用新科技，讓古蹟恢復到良好的狀態；其次是重新整理古蹟周圍的環境，變成公園或藝術表演的場所，增加古蹟的文化價值及現代功能。例如，某個幾百年前因為戰爭而建設的房子，地下有幾條又暗又神祕的隧道。最初只有年輕人敢進去，後來市長決定把那裡當成旅遊景點，開放給一般民眾參觀，好些當地人還因為這樣有了工作、發了財。
text.simplified: 其实，某个国家的古迹维持得越久、越好，人民越觉得骄傲。况且，参观古迹早就是现代人的休闲活动，所以得采用积极的方法来保护古迹。最重要的是国家得提供经费，请专业人员使用新科技，让古迹恢复到良好的状态；其次是重新整理古迹周围的环境，变成公园或艺术表演的场所，增加古迹的文化价值及现代功能。例如，某个几百年前因为战争而建设的房子，地下有几条又暗又神秘的隧道。最初只有年轻人敢进去，后来市长决定把那里当成旅游景点，开放给一般民众参观，好些当地人还因为这样有了工作、发了财。
text.pinyin: Qíshí, mǒu ge guójiā de gǔjī wéichí de yuè jiǔ, yuè hǎo, rénmín yuè juéde jiāo'ào. Kuàngqiě, cānguān gǔjī zǎojiù shì xiàndài rén de xiūxián huódòng, suǒyǐ děi cǎiyòng jījí de fāngfǎ lái bǎohù gǔjī. Zuì zhòngyào de shì guójiā děi tígōng jīngfèi, qǐng zhuānyè rényuán shǐyòng xīn kējì, ràng gǔjī huīfù dào liánghǎo de zhuàngtài; qícì shì chóngxīn zhěnglǐ gǔjī zhōuwéi de huánjìng, biànchéng gōngyuán huò yìshù biǎoyǎn de chǎngsuǒ, zēngjiā gǔjī de wénhuà jiàzhí jí xiàndài gōngnéng. Lìrú, mǒu ge jǐ bǎi nián qián yīnwèi zhànzhēng ér jiànshè de fángzi, dìxià yǒu jǐ tiáo yòu àn yòu shénmì de suìdào. Zuìchū zhǐyǒu niánqīngrén gǎn jìnqù, hòulái shìzhǎng juédìng bǎ nàlǐ dàngchéng lǚyóu jǐngdiǎn, kāifàng gěi yìbān mínzhòng cānguān, hǎoxiē dāngdì rén hái yīnwèi zhèyàng yǒu le gōngzuò, fā le cái.
text.english: In fact, the longer and better a country's historic sites are maintained, the prouder its people feel. Moreover, visiting historic sites has long been a leisure activity for people today, so active methods must be used to protect them. The most important thing is for the state to provide funding and hire professionals who use new technology to bring historic sites back to good condition. Next comes reorganizing the area around a historic site and turning it into a park or a place for art performances, adding to the site's cultural value and modern uses. For example, under a house built several hundred years ago because of a war, there are several dark, mysterious tunnels. At first only young people dared to go in; later the mayor decided to make the place a tourist spot open to the public, and quite a few local people even found jobs and got rich because of it.

text.traditional: 總而言之，古蹟就像歷史拼圖中的一片，如果能認得這個部分，就能透過它們拼出有意義的歷史故事。從這些故事中，我們能避免再次犯錯，尋找更有價值的生命意義，創造更美好的明天。這就是所謂的「了解過去、掌握未來」吧！
text.simplified: 总而言之，古迹就像历史拼图中的一片，如果能认得这个部分，就能透过它们拼出有意义的历史故事。从这些故事中，我们能避免再次犯错，寻找更有价值的生命意义，创造更美好的明天。这就是所谓的「了解过去、掌握未来」吧！
text.pinyin: Zǒng'ér yánzhī, gǔjī jiù xiàng lìshǐ pīntú zhōng de yí piàn, rúguǒ néng rènde zhège bùfèn, jiù néng tòuguò tāmen pīn chū yǒu yìyì de lìshǐ gùshì. Cóng zhèxiē gùshì zhōng, wǒmen néng bìmiǎn zàicì fàncuò, xúnzhǎo gèng yǒu jiàzhí de shēngmìng yìyì, chuàngzào gèng měihǎo de míngtiān. Zhè jiù shì suǒwèi de “liǎojiě guòqù, zhǎngwò wèilái” ba!
text.english: In short, historic sites are like a piece of the history puzzle. If we can recognize this piece, we can use them to put together meaningful stories of history. From these stories, we can avoid making mistakes again, look for a more valuable meaning in life, and create a better tomorrow. This is probably what people mean by "understand the past, master the future"!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Historic Sites in the Jigsaw Puzzle of History
grammarPages.titleEnglish: At the same time / Concurrently / Furthermore
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 同時 to say two things happen at the same time, or to join two clauses and add a further point.
grammarPages.explanation: 「同時」當名詞或副詞使用時，如例句 1、2，表示動作、事件在相同的時間或時段發生。在複句中的功能是連詞，連接兩個對等的句子，表示進一層的關係，如例句 3。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: When 同時 is used as a noun or adverb, such as example sentences 1 and 2, it means that actions and events occur at the same time. The function in a complex sentence is as a conjunction which connects two equivalent sentences to indicate a further relationship, such as in example sentence 3.
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 同時 + Verb phrase / Clause，同時（也）+ Clause

text.traditional: 人類每天都在記錄歷史，同時也在創造歷史。
text.simplified: 人类每天都在记录历史，同时也在创造历史。
text.pinyin: Rénlèi měitiān dōu zài jìlù lìshǐ, tóngshí yě zài chuàngzào lìshǐ.
text.english: Every day humanity records history, and at the same time it also makes history.

text.traditional: 我和姊姊比賽看誰先把房間打掃乾淨，沒想到最後我們同時完成了。
text.simplified: 我和姊姊比赛看谁先把房间打扫干净，没想到最后我们同时完成了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hé jiějie bǐsài kàn shéi xiān bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo gānjìng, méixiǎngdào zuìhòu wǒmen tóngshí wánchéng le.
text.english: My older sister and I competed to see who could clean their room first; unexpectedly, we finished at the exact same moment.

text.traditional: 在中國歷史上，孔子是哲學方面的代表人物，同時也是華人最尊敬的老師。
text.simplified: 在中国历史上，孔子是哲学方面的代表人物，同时也是华人最尊敬的老师。
text.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó lìshǐ shàng, Kǒngzǐ shì zhéxué fāngmiàn de dàibiǎo rénwù, tóngshí yě shì Huárén zuì zūnjìng de lǎoshī.
text.english: In Chinese history, Confucius is the leading figure in philosophy, and he is also the teacher Chinese people respect most.

summary: 同時 as a noun or adverb means actions or events happen at the same time.
Between two sentences, it joins two equal ones and adds a further point.
一邊……一邊…… is for one person doing two actions at once. 同時 can also join two roles or further points.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Historic Sites in the Jigsaw Puzzle of History
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Join nouns or noun phrases with 及, a formal written 'and'; in a list, put 及 between the last two items.
grammarPages.explanation: 「及」是連詞，意思和「和」、「跟」一樣，不過用法較正式，多用於書面。「及」的前後常是名詞、名詞短語，例如：中文及法文；培養好的習慣及生活作息。如果用來連接三個以上的名詞或名詞短語，「及」則用在最後兩個之間，例如：英國、美國及德國。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 及 is a conjunction, meaning the same as 和 and 跟, but 及 is more formal and used mostly in writing. 及 is often preceded by, or followed by, nouns and noun phrases such as 中文及法文; 培養好的習慣及生活作息. If used to connect more than three nouns or noun phrases, 及 is used between the last two. For example, 英國、美國及德國.
grammarPages.pattern: Noun（、Noun）+ 及 + Noun

text.traditional: ……只要它具有歷史意義及紀念價值，就該被重視和保留。
text.simplified: ……只要它具有历史意义及纪念价值，就该被重视和保留。
text.pinyin: …Zhǐyào tā jùyǒu lìshǐ yìyì jí jìniàn jiàzhí, jiù gāi bèi zhòngshì hé bǎoliú.
text.english: …As long as it has historical significance and commemorative value, it should be valued and preserved.

text.traditional: 手機、筆電及平板都是現代人常用的3C產品。
text.simplified: 手机、笔电及平板都是现代人常用的3C产品。
text.pinyin: Shǒujī, bǐ diàn jí píngbǎn dōu shì xiàndài rén chángyòng de 3C chǎnpǐn.
text.english: Phones, laptops, and tablets are all electronic devices commonly used by modern people.

text.traditional: 老闆希望公司可以提高產品的品質及更好的服務。
text.simplified: 老板希望公司可以提高产品的品质及更好的服务。
text.pinyin: Lǎobǎn xīwàng gōngsī kěyǐ tígāo chǎnpǐn de pǐnzhí jí gèng hǎo de fúwù.
text.english: The boss hopes the company can enhance product quality as well as provide better services.

summary: 及 joins nouns and means the same as 和 or 跟, but it is more formal.
It is mostly for writing. Don't use it to join whole sentences.
With three or more items, put 及 only between the last two.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Historic Sites in the Jigsaw Puzzle of History
grammarPages.titleEnglish: In short / In conclusion / All in all
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 總而言之 or 總之 to sum up what was just said in a short conclusion.
grammarPages.explanation: 「總而言之」也可以簡單說成「總之」。「總而言之」是將前面的內容或情況做個簡單的結論，不用說得太詳細。
grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 總而言之 can also be simply referred to as 總之. It is used to make a simple conclusion from the previous content or situation, without needing to go into detail.
grammarPages.pattern: 總而言之／總之，……

text.traditional: 總而言之，古蹟就像歷史拼圖中的一片……
text.simplified: 总而言之，古迹就像历史拼图中的一片……
text.pinyin: Zǒng'ér yánzhī, gǔjī jiù xiàng lìshǐ pīntú zhōng de yí piàn…
text.english: In short, historic sites are like a piece of the history puzzle…

text.traditional: 這個產品的品質有問題，不完全是小張的錯，檢查人員也有責任。總而言之，大家應該要一起解決這個問題。
text.simplified: 这个产品的品质有问题，不完全是小张的错，检查人员也有责任。总而言之，大家应该要一起解决这个问题。
text.pinyin: Zhège chǎnpǐn de pǐnzhí yǒu wèntí, bù wánquán shì Xiǎo Zhāng de cuò, jiǎnchá rényuán yě yǒu zérèn. Zǒng'ér yánzhī, dàjiā yīnggāi yào yìqǐ jiějué zhège wèntí.
text.english: There is a problem with this product's quality. It's not entirely Xiao Zhang's fault; the inspectors are responsible too. In short, everyone should work together to solve this problem.

text.traditional:
A：我理想的結婚對象，得有房子、車子，當然還得長得帥、聰明、體貼等等。總之，各方面都得一百分才行。
B：你別做夢了。
text.simplified:
A：我理想的结婚对象，得有房子、车子，当然还得长得帅、聪明、体贴等等。总之，各方面都得一百分才行。
B：你别做梦了。
text.pinyin:
A: Wǒ lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng, děi yǒu fángzi, chēzi, dāngrán hái děi zhǎng de shuài, cōngmíng, tǐtiē děngděng. Zǒngzhī, gè fāngmiàn dōu děi yì bǎi fēn cái xíng.
B: Nǐ bié zuòmèng le.
text.english:
A: My ideal marriage partner needs a house and a car, and of course must also be handsome, smart, considerate and so on. In short, they must score a hundred in every respect.
B: You're dreaming.

summary: 總而言之 gives a short conclusion to what came before, without much detail.
It can be shortened to 總之.
Don't mix it up with 總算, which means finally, or 總共, which adds up amounts.

items.title: Grammar 1–2 · Cherishing Food Starts with You and Me

dialogue.title: 愛惜食物從你我做起

text.traditional: 你看，這包麵條跟這幾袋玉米都打六折，好便宜，可以吃好幾頓呢！
text.simplified: 你看，这包面条跟这几袋玉米都打六折，好便宜，可以吃好几顿呢！
text.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, zhè bāo miàntiáo gēn zhè jǐ dài yùmǐ dōu dǎ liù zhé, hǎo piányí, kěyǐ chī hǎojǐ dùn ne!
text.english: Look, this pack of noodles and these bags of corn are all 40% off. So cheap! They can last for several meals!

text.traditional: 是啊。這家超市常把賣不出去，或時間較久但還能吃的食物，以優惠的價格賣給客人。不但能幫客人省錢，也能減少超市的垃圾。
text.simplified: 是啊。这家超市常把卖不出去，或时间较久但还能吃的食物，以优惠的价格卖给客人。不但能帮客人省钱，也能减少超市的垃圾。
text.pinyin: Shì a. Zhè jiā chāoshì cháng bǎ mài bù chūqù, huò shíjiān jiào jiǔ dàn hái néng chī de shíwù, yǐ yōuhuì de jiàgé mài gěi kèrén. Búdàn néng bāng kèrén shěngqián, yě néng jiǎnshǎo chāoshì de lèsè.
text.english: Yeah. This supermarket often sells unsold food or items near expiration that are still edible to customers at discounted prices. It not only saves customers money, but also reduces supermarket waste.

text.traditional: 你說的沒錯，還能吃的食物就不該被當作垃圾丟掉。有一些地區十分缺乏食物，價格甚至比金子還貴，這個問題到現在還無法解決。
text.simplified: 你说的没错，还能吃的食物就不该被当作垃圾丢掉。有一些地区十分缺乏食物，价格甚至比金子还贵，这个问题到现在还无法解决。
text.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de méicuò, hái néng chī de shíwù jiù bù gāi bèi dāngzuò lèsè diūdiào. Yǒu yìxiē dìqū shífēn quēfá shíwù, jiàgé shènzhì bǐ jīnzi hái guì, zhè ge wèntí dào xiànzài hái wúfǎ jiějué.
text.english: You are so right; food that is still edible shouldn't be discarded as trash. Some regions suffer extreme food shortages where food is even more expensive than gold, and this problem remains unresolved to this day.

text.traditional: 臺灣雖然面積小，生活空間不大，但至少不必擔心食物不夠，實在太幸福了。不過，話說回來，全球缺乏食物的情形還是會越來越嚴重的。
text.simplified: 台湾虽然面积小，生活空间不大，但至少不必担心食物不够，实在太幸福了。不过，话说回来，全球缺乏食物的情形还是会越来越严重的。
text.pinyin: Táiwān suīrán miànjī xiǎo, shēnghuó kōngjiān bú dà, dàn zhìshǎo búbì dānxīn shíwù bú gòu, shízài tài xìngfú le. Búguò, huàshuō huílái, quánqiú quēfá shíwù de qíngxíng háishì huì yuè lái yuè yánzhòng de.
text.english: Taiwan may have a small land area and compact living space, but at least we don't have to worry about food shortages, which is truly fortunate. That said, worldwide food shortage conditions will only grow increasingly severe.

text.traditional: 我看過不少這類的影片，有個記者訪問了農業相關的專業人員，他們表示早就注意到這方面的問題，也已利用科學的方法擴大了某一些地區的生產面積。
text.simplified: 我看过不少这类的影片，有个记者访问了农业相关的专业人员，他们表示早就注意到这方面的问题，也已利用科学的方法扩大了某一些地区的生产面积。
text.pinyin: Wǒ kàn guò bùshǎo zhè lèi de yǐngpiàn, yǒu ge jìzhě fǎngwèn le nóngyè xiāngguān de zhuānyè rényuán, tāmen biǎoshì zǎojiù zhùyì dào zhè fāngmiàn de wèntí, yě yǐ lìyòng kēxué de fāngfǎ kuòdà le mǒu yìxiē dìqū de shēngchǎn miànjī.
text.english: I've watched quite a few videos on this. A reporter interviewed agricultural specialists, who said they noticed this issue long ago and have used scientific methods to expand farming acreage in certain areas.

text.traditional: 為了讓農業產品的收穫更多、更穩定，不少國家提供很多經費給科學家，讓他們在這個領域進行深入的研究，目前已有了很好的成果。
text.simplified: 为了让农业产品的收获更多、更稳定，不少国家提供很多经费给科学家，让他们在这个领域进行深入的研究，目前已有了很好的成果。
text.pinyin: Wèile ràng nóngyè chǎnpǐn de shōuhuò gèng duō, gèng wěndìng, bùshǎo guójiā tígōng hěn duō jīngfèi gěi kēxuéjiā, ràng tāmen zài zhè ge lǐngyù jìnxíng shēnrù de yánjiù, mùqián yǐ yǒu le hěn hǎo de chéngguǒ.
text.english: To make crop yields higher and more reliable, many countries supply substantial funding to scientists for in-depth research in this field, yielding impressive results thus far.

text.traditional: 食物缺乏和全球人口不斷增加也有密切的關係。雖然科學家發明了提高農業收穫的方法，不過，用什麼更好的辦法來處理剩下的食物也很重要。
text.simplified: 食物缺乏和全球人口不断增加也有密切的关系。虽然科学家发明了提高农业收获的方法，不过，用什么更好的办法来处理剩下的食物也很重要。
text.pinyin: Shíwù quēfá hé quánqiú rénkǒu búduàn zēngjiā yě yǒu mìqiè de guānxì. Suīrán kēxuéjiā fāmíng le tígāo nóngyè shōuhuò de fāngfǎ, búguò, yòng shénme gèng hǎo de bànfǎ lái chǔlǐ shèngxià de shíwù yě hěn zhòngyào.
text.english: Food shortages are also closely linked to relentless global population growth. While scientists have devised ways to boost agricultural harvests, finding better ways to handle leftover food is just as critical.

text.traditional: 是啊，我看過一篇有關「食物銀行」的文章，概念是把多出來的食物放在某個地方，提供給需要的人。關心環保的人，實行了一段時間之後，證明了這個作法是有效的。
text.simplified: 是啊，我看过一篇有关「食物银行」的文章，概念是把多出来的食物放在某个地方，提供给需要的人。关心环保的人，实行了一段时间之后，证明了这个作法是有效的。
text.pinyin: Shì a, wǒ kàn guò yì piān yǒuguān “shíwù yínháng” de wénzhāng, gàiniàn shì bǎ duō chūlái de shíwù fàng zài mǒu ge dìfāng, tígōng gěi xūyào de rén. Guānxīn huánbǎo de rén, shíxíng le yí duàn shíjiān zhīhòu, zhèngmíng le zhè ge zuòfǎ shì yǒuxiào de.
text.english: Indeed, I read an article about "food banks"; the concept is placing surplus food in a designated spot for people in need. After practicing this for some time, eco-conscious advocates proved this approach works.

text.traditional: 我的社區門口就放著一個大冰箱，裡面的食物免費提供給需要的人。有人把食物送去時，安全人員都會當場檢查，要是品質有問題或腐敗了就不收，以免吃了影響健康。一開始，還是我當大家的榜樣呢！
text.simplified: 我的社区门口就放着一个大冰箱，里面的食物免费提供给需要的人。有人把食物送去时，安全人员都会当场检查，要是品质有问题或腐败了就不收，以免吃了影响健康。一开始，还是我当大家的榜样呢！
text.pinyin: Wǒ de shèqū ménkǒu jiù fàng zhe yíge dà bīngxiāng, lǐmiàn de shíwù miǎnfèi tígōng gěi xūyào de rén. Yǒu rén bǎ shíwù sòng qù shí, ānquán rényuán dōu huì dāngchǎng jiǎnchá, yàoshì pǐnzhí yǒu wèntí huò fǔbài le jiù bù shōu, yǐmiǎn chī le yǐngxiǎng jiànkāng. Yìkāishǐ, háishì wǒ dāng dàjiā de bǎngyàng ne!
text.english: Right outside my community entrance sits a big refrigerator providing free food for those in need. When donations arrive, security staff inspect them on the spot; if the food is of poor quality or has gone bad, they don't accept it, so that no one's health is harmed by eating it. In the beginning, I was the role model for everyone!

text.traditional: 看妳說得那麼得意，感覺很有成就吧？
text.simplified: 看你说得那么得意，感觉很有成就吧？
text.pinyin: Kàn nǐ shuō de nàme déyì, gǎnjué hěn yǒu chéngjiù ba?
text.english: Seeing how proud you look talking about it, you must feel a real sense of accomplishment!

text.traditional: 我們是做得挺不錯的。再說，把能吃的食物丟掉跟提供給需要的人，這兩種做法是相對的，聰明的人當然知道怎麼做了。
text.simplified: 我们是做得挺不错的。再说，把能吃的食物丢掉跟提供给需要的人，这两种做法是相对的，聪明的人当然知道怎么做了。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen shì zuò de tǐng búcuò de. Zàishuō, bǎ néng chī de shíwù diūdiào gēn tígōng gěi xūyào de rén, zhè liǎng zhǒng zuòfǎ shì xiāngduì de, cōngmíng de rén dāngrán zhīdào zěnme zuò le.
text.english: We really did quite well. Furthermore, throwing away edible food versus giving it to those in need are two opposite approaches; any sensible person naturally knows which path to choose.

text.traditional: 說真的，環保工作做得越好，對我們也越有好處。至於缺乏食物的問題，就留給科學家去想辦法吧！
text.simplified: 说真的，环保工作做得越好，对我们也越有好处。至于缺乏食物的问题，就留给科学家去想办法吧！
text.pinyin: Shuōzhēnde, huánbǎo gōngzuò zuò de yuè hǎo, duì wǒmen yě yuè yǒu hǎochù. Zhìyú quēfá shíwù de wèntí, jiù liú gěi kēxuéjiā qù xiǎng bànfǎ ba!
text.english: Honestly speaking, the better we do with environmental protection, the greater the benefits to us all. As for the problem of food shortages, let's leave it to the scientists to find a way!

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Cherishing Food Starts with You and Me
grammarPages.titleEnglish: To Regard As / To Treat As
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 當作 to say someone treats or takes one thing as another, or acts as if something were so.
grammarPages.explanation: 「當作」是狀態動詞，有兩種用法：(1) 把前後描述的對象或事情認定是相同的。例如：「他常常加班，已經把公司當作自己的家了。」、「老師常把我們當作是自己的孩子，非常關心我們。」、「我很討厭小方，就算他從我旁邊經過，我也當作沒看見。」(2) 表示對前後描述對象或事情的判斷。例如：「張阿姨已經四十多歲了，看起來卻很年輕，常被人當作是學生。」、「我把這次的感冒當作是一般的感冒，所以沒去看醫生。」
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 把/被 + Object + 當作 + Role / Subject + 當作 + Clause

text.traditional: 你說的沒錯，還能吃的食物就不該被當作垃圾丟掉。
text.simplified: 你说的没错，还能吃的食物就不该被当作垃圾丢掉。
text.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de méicuò, hái néng chī de shíwù jiù bù gāi bèi dāngzuò lèsè diū diào.
text.english: You're right; food that can still be eaten should not be treated as garbage and thrown away.

text.traditional: 如果沒人舉手問問題，老師就當作你們都懂了。
text.simplified: 如果没人举手问问题，老师就当作你们都懂了。
text.pinyin: Rúguǒ méi rén jǔshǒu wèn wèntí, lǎoshī jiù dāngzuò nǐmen dōu dǒng le.
text.english: If nobody raises a hand to ask a question, the teacher will take it that you all understand.

text.traditional: 弟弟運動後口很渴，把冰箱裡的水果酒當作果汁喝了，真糊塗。
text.simplified: 弟弟运动后口很渴，把冰箱里的水果酒当作果汁喝了，真糊涂。
text.pinyin: Dìdi yùndòng hòu kǒu hěn kě, bǎ bīngxiāng lǐ de shuǐguǒ jiǔ dāngzuò guǒzhī hē le, zhēn hútú.
text.english: My younger brother was very thirsty after exercising and drank the fruit wine in the fridge, thinking it was juice. How scatterbrained!

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 當作/當做 is a verb used in two ways: (1) Think of the objects described before and after as being taken for the same. For example, “他常常加班，已經把公司當作自己的家了。” “老師常把我們當作自己的孩子，非常關心我們。” “我很討厭小方，就算他從我旁邊經過，我也當作沒看見。” (2) 當作/當做 represents the judgment of the speaker on things. For examples, “張阿姨已經四十多歲了，看起來卻很年輕，常被人當作是學生。” “我很討厭小方，就算他從我旁邊經過，我也當作沒看見。”“我把這次的感冒當作是一般的感冒，所以沒去看醫生。”
summary: 當作 means to treat one thing as if it were the same as another.
It can also show a judgment about something, such as 被人當作是學生.
With 把, the subject does the treating. With 被, the subject is the one treated that way.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Cherishing Food Starts with You and Me
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 至少 ('at least') before a number or a short clause to give the lowest amount or degree.
grammarPages.explanation: 「至少」當作副詞，後面接數量詞或短句，用來表示最低範圍或程度。
grammarPages.pattern: 至少 + Quantity / Clause

text.traditional: 臺灣雖然面積小，生活空間不大，但至少不必擔心食物不夠，實在太幸福了。
text.simplified: 台湾虽然面积小，生活空间不大，但至少不必担心食物不够，实在太幸福了。
text.pinyin: Táiwān suīrán miànjī xiǎo, shēnghuó kōngjiān bú dà, dàn zhìshǎo búbì dānxīn shíwù bú gòu, shízài tài xìngfú le.
text.english: Although Taiwan is small and living space is limited, at least we don't have to worry about not having enough food. We're really lucky.

text.traditional: 這次的車禍，他受了很嚴重的傷，至少兩個月才能完全恢復。
text.simplified: 这次的车祸，他受了很严重的伤，至少两个月才能完全恢复。
text.pinyin: Zhè cì de chēhuò, tā shòu le hěn yánzhòng de shāng, zhìshǎo liǎng ge yuè cái néng wánquán huīfù.
text.english: He was badly hurt in this car accident and needs at least two months to fully recover.

text.traditional:
小英：昨天看了介紹中美洲的旅遊節目，很吸引人，我打算下個月就去當個背包客。
小華：你太急了吧！至少得先聽聽其他人的意見，再看自己適合不適合。
text.simplified:
小英：昨天看了介绍中美洲的旅游节目，很吸引人，我打算下个月就去当个背包客。
小华：你太急了吧！至少得先听听其他人的意见，再看自己适合不适合。
text.pinyin:
Xiǎoyīng: Zuótiān kàn le jièshào Zhōngměizhōu de lǚyóu jiémù, hěn xīyǐn rén, wǒ dǎsuàn xià ge yuè jiù qù dāng ge bēibāokè.
Xiǎohuá: Nǐ tài jí le ba! Zhìshǎo děi xiān tīng tīng qítā rén de yìjiàn, zài kàn zìjǐ shìhé bú shìhé.
text.english:
Xiao Ying: Yesterday I watched a travel show about Central America. It was really appealing, so I'm planning to go backpacking next month.
Xiao Hua: You're being too hasty! At least listen to other people's opinions first, then see whether it suits you.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 至少 is used as an adverb, followed by a quantifier or a short sentence to indicate the lowest range or degree.
summary: 至少 means at least: it shows the lowest amount or level.
After 至少 put a quantity or a short sentence.
It can also name the smallest step that must be done, as in 至少得先聽聽其他人的意見.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 謝老闆的愛心冰箱

text.traditional: 謝老闆是一名廚師，也擁有自己的餐廳事業。去年他在餐廳門外擺了一台愛心冰箱，得到許多人的肯定。以下是整件事的經過。
text.simplified: 谢老板是一名厨师，也拥有自己的餐厅事业。去年他在餐厅门外摆了一台爱心冰箱，得到许多人的肯定。以下是整件事的经过。
text.pinyin: Xiè lǎobǎn shì yì míng chúshī, yě yǒngyǒu zìjǐ de cāntīng shìyè. Qùnián tā zài cāntīng ménwài bǎi le yì tái àixīn bīngxiāng, dédào xǔduō rén de kěndìng. Yǐxià shì zhěng jiàn shì de jīngguò.
text.english: Boss Xie is a chef who also owns his own restaurant business. Last year, he set up a "community fridge" outside his restaurant door and won praise from many people. Here is how it all unfolded.

text.traditional: 謝老闆從小就對做菜有興趣，又去過法國培養廚師的專業學校學了兩年。回國後，就跟朋友投資餐廳事業，一開始生意不太穩定，令他相當煩惱。為此他積極試做新菜，不斷地改進做法和味道。由於新菜仍然無法吸引更多顧客上門，因此每天總是有一些還能吃的食物被丟進垃圾箱。
text.simplified: 谢老板从小就对做菜有兴趣，又去过法国培养厨师的专业学校学了两年。回国后，就跟朋友投资餐厅事业，一开始生意不太稳定，令他相当烦恼。为此他积极试做新菜，不断地改进做法和味道。由于新菜仍然无法吸引更多顾客上门，因此每天总是有一些还能吃的食物被丢进垃圾箱。
text.pinyin: Xiè lǎobǎn cóngxiǎo jiù duì zuòcài yǒu xìngqù, yòu qù guò Fǎguó péiyǎng chúshī de zhuānyè xuéxiào xué le liǎng nián. Huíguó hòu, jiù gēn péngyǒu tóuzī cāntīng shìyè, yìkāishǐ shēngyì bú tài wěndìng, lìng tā xiāngdāng fánnǎo. Wèicǐ tā jījí shì zuò xīn cài, búduàn de gǎijìn zuòfǎ hé wèidào. Yóuyú xīn cài réngrán wúfǎ xīyǐn gèng duō gùkè shàngmén, yīncǐ měitiān zǒngshì yǒu yìxiē hái néng chī de shíwù bèi diū jìn lèsè xiāng.
text.english: From a young age, Boss Xie had a passion for cooking, and he even studied for two years at a culinary academy in France. After returning home, he partnered with friends to invest in a restaurant enterprise. Initially business was unsteady, causing him tremendous worry. For this reason, he actively tried out new dishes, constantly improving how he made them and how they tasted. Because the new dishes still couldn't bring in more customers, every day some food that could still be eaten ended up in the trash.

text.traditional: 謝老闆認為人人都應該愛惜食物，再說，從道德角度來看，有人沒飯可吃，能吃的食物卻被白白丟掉，這樣的行為是不對的。每次想到這點都使得他夜裡睡不好。於是，他在餐廳門外放了一台冰箱，裡面擺著沒賣完，但還新鮮的米飯、麵、甜點等食物，外面貼著「提供免費食物」的海報。冰箱旁還有一張簡單的餐桌，一到夜晚謝老闆就點上小燈，讓溫暖的燈光吸引大家的注意。
text.simplified: 谢老板认为人人都应该爱惜食物，再说，从道德角度来看，有人没饭可吃，能吃的食物却被白白丢掉，这样的行为是不对的。每次想到这点都使得他夜里睡不好。于是，他在餐厅门外放了一台冰箱，里面摆着没卖完，但还新鲜的米饭、面、甜点等食物，外面贴着「提供免费食物」的海报。冰箱旁还有一张简单的餐桌，一到夜晚谢老板就点上小灯，让温暖的灯光吸引大家的注意。
text.pinyin: Xiè lǎobǎn rènwéi rénrén dōu yīnggāi àixí shíwù, zàishuō, cóng dàodé jiǎodù lái kàn, yǒu rén méi fàn kě chī, néng chī de shíwù què bèi báibái diūdiào, zhèyàng de xíngwéi shì bú duì de. Měi cì xiǎngdào zhè diǎn dōu shǐde tā yèlǐ shuì bùhǎo. Yúshì, tā zài cāntīng ménwài fàng le yì tái bīngxiāng, lǐmiàn bǎi zhe méi mài wán, dàn hái xīnxiān de mǐfàn, miàn, tiándiǎn děng shíwù, wàimiàn tiē zhe “tígōng miǎnfèi shíwù” de hǎibào. Bīngxiāng páng háiyǒu yì zhāng jiǎndān de cānzhuō, yí dào yèwǎn Xiè lǎobǎn jiù diǎn shàng xiǎo dēng, ràng wēnnuǎn de dēngguāng xīyǐn dàjiā de zhùyì.
text.english: Boss Xie believed everyone should cherish food. Besides, from a moral point of view, when some people have nothing to eat while food that could be eaten is thrown away for nothing, that kind of behavior is wrong. Every time he thought about this, it kept him from sleeping well at night. So he put a fridge outside his restaurant door, filled with rice, noodles, desserts and other food that hadn't sold but was still fresh, with a poster on the outside saying "Free Food Provided". Next to the fridge there was also a simple dining table, and when night fell, Boss Xie would turn on a small lamp so that its warm light caught everyone's attention.

text.traditional: 最初，謝老闆這樣的做法在國內不普遍，大家的反應也很冷淡。於是，他開始向客人說明愛心冰箱與愛地球是相關的，希望大家能了解這樣的觀點。最近，有共同想法的人慢慢多了起來，愛心冰箱的功能也發揮得越來越好了。
text.simplified: 最初，谢老板这样的做法在国内不普遍，大家的反应也很冷淡。于是，他开始向客人说明爱心冰箱与爱地球是相关的，希望大家能了解这样的观点。最近，有共同想法的人慢慢多了起来，爱心冰箱的功能也发挥得越来越好了。
text.pinyin: Zuìchū, Xiè lǎobǎn zhèyàng de zuòfǎ zài guónèi bù pǔbiàn, dàjiā de fǎnyìng yě hěn lěngdàn. Yúshì, tā kāishǐ xiàng kèrén shuōmíng àixīn bīngxiāng yǔ ài dìqiú shì xiāngguān de, xīwàng dàjiā néng liǎojiě zhèyàng de guāndiǎn. Zuìjìn, yǒu gòngtóng xiǎngfǎ de rén mànmàn duō le qǐlái, àixīn bīngxiāng de gōngnéng yě fāhuī de yuè lái yuè hǎo le.
text.english: At first, what Boss Xie was doing was not common in the country, and people's reaction was cold. So he began explaining to customers that the community fridge is connected to loving the earth, hoping everyone could understand this point of view. Recently, more and more people have come to share his idea, and the community fridge is doing its job better and better.

text.traditional: 理論上，人們的生活需求越容易滿足，就會越不愛惜食物。尤其在現代工業、商業發達的社會中，一切都相當便利，到處都有便利商店、超市，想吃什麼隨時都買得到，把食物丟掉的情形就變得很自然了。其實丟掉食物就是把錢丟掉，不僅不能幫助別人，對人類的生活環境也不好。所以謝老闆決定，無論如何都要堅持愛心冰箱的作法，還要進一步建立食物銀行網站，如此才能達成人人做環保、大家有飯吃的理想。
text.simplified: 理论上，人们的生活需求越容易满足，就会越不爱惜食物。尤其在现代工业、商业发达的社会中，一切都相当便利，到处都有便利商店、超市，想吃什么随时都买得到，把食物丢掉的情形就变得很自然了。其实丢掉食物就是把钱丢掉，不仅不能帮助别人，对人类的生活环境也不好。所以谢老板决定，无论如何都要坚持爱心冰箱的作法，还要进一步建立食物银行网站，如此才能达成人人做环保、大家有饭吃的理想。
text.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, rénmen de shēnghuó xūqiú yuè róngyì mǎnzú, jiù huì yuè bú àixí shíwù. Yóuqí zài xiàndài gōngyè, shāngyè fādá de shèhuì zhōng, yíqiè dōu xiāngdāng biànlì, dàochù dōu yǒu biànlì shāngdiàn, chāoshì, xiǎng chī shénme suíshí dōu mǎi de dào, bǎ shíwù diūdiào de qíngxíng jiù biàn de hěn zìrán le. Qíshí diūdiào shíwù jiùshì bǎ qián diūdiào, bù jǐn bùnéng bāngzhù biérén, duì rénlèi de shēnghuó huánjìng yě bùhǎo. Suǒyǐ Xiè lǎobǎn juédìng, wúlùnrúhé dōu yào jiānchí àixīn bīngxiāng de zuòfǎ, háiyào jìnyíbù jiànlì shíwù yínháng wǎngzhàn, rúcǐ cáinéng dáchéng rénrén zuò huánbǎo, dàjiā yǒu fàn chī de lǐxiǎng.
text.english: In theory, the more easily people's needs in life are met, the less they cherish food. Especially in modern societies with developed industry and business, everything is very convenient: there are convenience stores and supermarkets everywhere, and you can buy whatever you want to eat at any time, so throwing food away has become very natural. In fact, throwing away food is throwing away money; not only does it not help others, it is also bad for the environment people live in. So Boss Xie decided that no matter what, he would keep up the community fridge, and go a step further by setting up a food bank website. Only in this way can the ideal of everyone protecting the environment and everyone having food to eat be achieved.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Cherishing Food Starts with You and Me
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 由於 (often paired with 因此) to give a cause and its result, more formally than 因為 and 所以.
grammarPages.explanation: 「由於」的後面表示原因或理由，「因此」的後面表示結果。比「因為……，所以……」的用法正式。「因為」可以放在前句或後句的句首；「由於」多放在前句的句首，若要放在後句要寫「……，是由於……」。例如：這座城市的空氣品質越來越差，是由於工廠越來越多。
grammarPages.pattern: 由於 + Cause，（因此）+ Result

text.traditional: 由於新菜仍然無法吸引更多顧客上門，因此每天總是有一些還能吃的食物被丟進垃圾箱。
text.simplified: 由于新菜仍然无法吸引更多顾客上门，因此每天总是有一些还能吃的食物被丢进垃圾箱。
text.pinyin: Yóuyú xīn cài réngrán wúfǎ xīyǐn gèng duō gùkè shàngmén, yīncǐ měitiān zǒngshì yǒu yìxiē hái néng chī de shíwù bèi diū jìn lèsè xiāng.
text.english: Because the new dishes still couldn't bring in more customers, every day some food that could still be eaten ended up in the trash.

text.traditional: 由於這個都市規劃得不理想，（因此）商業活動增加後，交通就變得又擠又亂。
text.simplified: 由于这个都市规划得不理想，（因此）商业活动增加后，交通就变得又挤又乱。
text.pinyin: Yóuyú zhège dūshì guīhuà de bù lǐxiǎng, (yīncǐ) shāngyè huódòng zēngjiā hòu, jiāotōng jiù biàn de yòu jǐ yòu luàn.
text.english: Because this city was poorly planned, traffic became crowded and chaotic once business activity increased.

text.traditional: 由於人口不斷增加，居住土地的需求也越來越大，（因此）農業生產的土地就變少了。
text.simplified: 由于人口不断增加，居住土地的需求也越来越大，（因此）农业生产的土地就变少了。
text.pinyin: Yóuyú rénkǒu búduàn zēngjiā, jūzhù tǔdì de xūqiú yě yuè lái yuè dà, (yīncǐ) nóngyè shēngchǎn de tǔdì jiù biàn shǎo le.
text.english: Because the population keeps growing and the demand for land to live on keeps rising, there is now less land for farming.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The statement after 由於 indicates the cause or reason, and the the statement after 因此 indicates the result. Such expressions are more formal than “因為……，所以……”. 因為 can be placed at the beginning of the preceding or following sentence; 由於 is usually placed at the beginning of the preceding sentence. If it is placed at the end, then the sentence should be written as “……，是由於……”. For example, 這座城市的空氣品質越來越差，是由於工廠越來越多。
summary: 由於 gives the reason and 因此 gives the result. This is more formal than 因為……，所以…….
由於 usually starts the first part.
If the reason comes second, write 是由於, not just 由於.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Cherishing Food Starts with You and Me
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 使得 in formal contexts to express that an actual situation or event caused a specific outcome.
grammarPages.explanation: 「使得」是及物狀態動詞（Vst）。「使得」的前句是導致某個事件發生的原因，後句是前句導致或引起的結果，與「使（V）」的用法相似，但「使得」的用法較正式。已發生的事實常用「使得」；假設的情況常用「使」。例如：「由於這次強烈颱風帶來了大風大雨，使得很多地區都淹水了。」、「古代寺廟如能好好保留下來，就能使民眾更了解宗教的歷史意義。」
grammarPages.pattern: Cause + 使得 + Result

text.traditional: ……每次想到這點都使得他夜裡睡不好。
text.simplified: ……每次想到这点都使得他夜里睡不好。
text.pinyin: …Měi cì xiǎngdào zhè diǎn dōu shǐde tā yèlǐ shuì bùhǎo.
text.english: …Every time he thought about this, it kept him from sleeping well at night.

text.traditional: 九二一大地震的規模很大，使得許多房屋跟馬路都塌了。
text.simplified: 九二一大地震的规模很大，使得许多房屋跟马路都塌了。
text.pinyin: Jiǔ'èryī dà dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, shǐde xǔduō fángwū gēn mǎlù dōu tā le.
text.english: The 921 Earthquake was so massive that it caused many houses and roads to collapse.

text.traditional: 由於紅毛城古蹟維持得很好，使得參觀的民眾一年比一年多了。
text.simplified: 由于红毛城古迹维持得很好，使得参观的民众一年比一年多了。
text.pinyin: Yóuyú Hóngmáochéng gǔjī wéichí de hěn hǎo, shǐde cānguān de mínzhòng yì nián bǐ yì nián duō le.
text.english: Because Fort San Domingo is so well maintained, the number of visitors grows year by year.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 使得 is a transitive verb (Vst). The first use of 使得 is the cause of an event, and the following usage is the result of the preceding sentence. This is similar to the usage of 使(V), but the usage of 使得 is more formal. The facts that have occurred are often used with 使得, while the hypothetical situations are often used with 使. For example, 由於這次強烈颱風帶來了大風大雨，使得很多地區都淹水了。Or 古代寺廟如能好好保留下來，就能使民眾更了解宗教的歷史意義。
summary: 使得 links a cause to the result it brings about.
It is like 使 but more formal.
使得 is often used for facts that already happened, and 使 for imagined situations.

grammarPages.lessonTitleEnglish: Cherishing Food Starts with You and Me
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Use 於是 to introduce an action consciously taken in direct response to a preceding situation.
grammarPages.explanation: 「於是」是連詞，連接前後兩個句子，後句是因為前句的情況而採取的行動。但自然現象不可使用「於是」，例如：「*天很黑，於是下雨了。」、「*強烈颱風來了，於是很多地區淹水了。」
grammarPages.pattern: Cause，於是 + Action

text.traditional: 每次想到這點都使得他夜裡睡不好。於是，他在餐廳門外放了一台冰箱……
text.simplified: 每次想到这点都使得他夜里睡不好。于是，他在餐厅门外放了一台冰箱……
text.pinyin: Měi cì xiǎngdào zhè diǎn dōu shǐde tā yèlǐ shuì bùhǎo. Yúshì, tā zài cāntīng ménwài fàng le yì tái bīngxiāng…
text.english: Every time he thought about this, it kept him from sleeping well at night. So he put a fridge outside the restaurant door…

text.traditional: 現代人為了擁有更舒適的生活，於是發明了許多既好用、功能又多的生活用品。
text.simplified: 现代人为了拥有更舒适的生活，于是发明了许多既好用、功能又多的生活用品。
text.pinyin: Xiàndài rén wèile yǒngyǒu gèng shūshì de shēnghuó, yúshì fāmíng le xǔduō jì hǎoyòng, gōngnéng yòu duō de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
text.english: Modern people wanted more comfortable lives, so they invented many everyday products that are both easy to use and full of features.

text.traditional: 戴先生為公司付出很多，卻沒得到相對的肯定與合理的薪水，於是決定換工作。
text.simplified: 戴先生为公司付出很多，却没得到相对的肯定与合理的薪水，于是决定换工作。
text.pinyin: Dài xiānshēng wèi gōngsī fùchū hěn duō, què méi dédào xiāngduì de kěndìng yǔ hélǐ de xīnshuǐ, yúshì juédìng huàn gōngzuò.
text.english: Mr. Dai gave a lot to the company but didn't get the recognition he deserved or a fair salary, so he decided to change jobs.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 於是 is a conjunction that connects the two sentences, with the latter sentence describing the action taken because of the situation in the previous sentence. However, 於是 cannot be used for natural phenomena. For example, *天很黑，於是下雨了。Or *強烈颱風來了，於是很多地區淹水了。
summary: 於是 joins two sentences. The second shows an action taken because of the first.
Don't use it when the second part is a natural event, as in 於是下雨了. Use 所以 instead.
